Lib.DragOffset = Vector2.zero

function Lib.MainLayout()
	local original = State.OriginalSize
	local s = Lib.MenuBaseScale or 1
	local offset = State.Maximized and Vector2.zero or Lib.DragOffset
	if State.Minimized then
		if State.Maximized then
			return UDim2.new(1 / s, -30 / s, 0, 58), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 15 + 29 * s)
		end
		return UDim2.new(original.X.Scale, original.X.Offset, 0, 58), UDim2.new(0.5, offset.X, 0.5, (29 - original.Y.Offset / 2) * s + offset.Y)
	end
	if State.Maximized then
		return UDim2.new(1 / s, -30 / s, 1 / s, -30 / s), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	end
	return original, UDim2.new(0.5, offset.X, 0.5, offset.Y)
end

function Lib.WindowBusy()
	return State.MenuHiding or (Lib.WindowTween ~= nil and Lib.WindowTween.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Playing)
end

function Lib.ApplyWindowState()
	local minimized = State.Minimized
	State.WindowAnimId = (State.WindowAnimId or 0) + 1
	local id = State.WindowAnimId
	local size, position = Lib.MainLayout()
	if not minimized then
		UI.TopNavContainer.Visible = true
		UI.ContentArea.Visible = true
	end
	local tween = Lib.Tween(UI.Main, 0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, { Size = size, Position = position })
	Lib.WindowTween = tween
	Lib.Tween(UI.TopNavContainer, 0.38, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, minimized and Enum.EasingDirection.In or Enum.EasingDirection.Out, {
		Position = Lib.NavPosition(minimized and -44 or 11)
	})
	if minimized then
		tween.Completed:Connect(function()
			if State.WindowAnimId == id and State.Minimized then
				UI.TopNavContainer.Visible = false
				UI.ContentArea.Visible = false
			end
		end)
	end
end

function Lib.ToggleMenu(force)
	local show = force
	if show == nil then show = (not UI.Main.Visible) or State.MenuHiding end
	State.MenuToken = (State.MenuToken or 0) + 1
	local token = State.MenuToken
	local scale, button, main = UI.MainScale, UI.SHToggleButton, UI.Main
	if not scale or not button then
		main.Visible = show
		return
	end
	local base = Lib.MenuBaseScale or 1
	local size, target = Lib.MainLayout()
	local mode = State.MenuAnim
	local center = button.AbsolutePosition + button.AbsoluteSize / 2
	local origin = UDim2.fromOffset(center.X, center.Y)
	local below = UDim2.new(target.X.Scale, target.X.Offset, target.Y.Scale, target.Y.Offset + UI.Screen.AbsoluteSize.Y)
	local line = UDim2.new(size.X.Scale, size.X.Offset, 0, 4)
	local quint = Enum.EasingStyle.Quint

	local function Finish()
		if State.MenuToken ~= token then return end
		main.Visible = false
		State.MenuHiding = false
		scale.Scale = base
		main.Size, main.Position = Lib.MainLayout()
	end

	local function Chain(first, nextStage)
		Lib.WindowTween = first
		first.Completed:Connect(function()
			if State.MenuToken == token then nextStage() end
		end)
	end

	if show then
		State.MenuHiding = false
		if not State.Minimized then UI.ContentArea.Visible = true end
		if mode == "Slide Up" then
			scale.Scale = base * 0.9
			main.Size, main.Position = size, below
			main.Visible = true
			Lib.WindowTween = Lib.Tween(main, 0.6, quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Position = target })
			Lib.Tween(scale, 0.6, quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Scale = base })
		elseif mode == "Unfold" then
			scale.Scale = base
			main.Size, main.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 4), target
			main.Visible = true
			Chain(Lib.Tween(main, 0.3, quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Size = line }), function()
				Lib.WindowTween = Lib.Tween(main, 0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Size = size })
			end)
		else
			scale.Scale = base * 0.05
			main.Size, main.Position = size, origin
			main.Visible = true
			Lib.WindowTween = Lib.Tween(main, 0.5, quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Position = target })
			Lib.Tween(scale, 0.5, quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Scale = base })
		end
		return
	end

	State.MenuHiding = true
	UI.ContentArea.Visible = false
	if mode == "Slide Up" then
		Lib.WindowTween = Lib.Tween(main, 0.45, quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In, { Position = below })
		Lib.Tween(scale, 0.45, quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In, { Scale = base * 0.9 }).Completed:Connect(Finish)
	elseif mode == "Unfold" then
		Chain(Lib.Tween(main, 0.3, quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In, { Size = line }), function()
			local last = Lib.Tween(main, 0.22, quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 4) })
			Lib.WindowTween = last
			last.Completed:Connect(Finish)
		end)
	else
		Lib.WindowTween = Lib.Tween(main, 0.34, quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In, { Position = origin })
		Lib.Tween(scale, 0.34, quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In, { Scale = base * 0.05 }).Completed:Connect(Finish)
	end
end

do
	local UIS = Services.UserInputService
	local handle = Lib.Create("Frame", { Name = "DragHandle", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Active = true, ZIndex = 1, Parent = UI.Main })
	local dragging, origin, startOffset, goal, loop = false, nil, nil, Lib.DragOffset, nil

	local function Clamp(v)
		local view = UI.Screen.AbsoluteSize
		local s = Lib.MenuBaseScale or 1
		local w, h = State.OriginalSize.X.Offset * s, State.OriginalSize.Y.Offset * s
		return Vector2.new(
			math.clamp(v.X, -view.X / 2 - w / 2 + 140, view.X / 2 + w / 2 - 140),
			math.clamp(v.Y, h / 2 - view.Y / 2, view.Y / 2 + h / 2 - 58 * s)
		)
	end

	local function Step(dt)
		Lib.DragOffset = Lib.DragOffset:Lerp(goal, 1 - math.exp(-dt * 22))
		if not dragging and (Lib.DragOffset - goal).Magnitude < 0.4 then
			Lib.DragOffset = goal
			loop:Disconnect()
			loop = nil
		end
		UI.Main.Position = select(2, Lib.MainLayout())
	end

	handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and not State.Maximized and not Lib.WindowBusy() then
			dragging = true
			origin = input.Position
			startOffset = Lib.DragOffset
			goal = Lib.DragOffset
			if not loop then loop = Services.Run.RenderStepped:Connect(Step) end
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
			end)
		end
	end)

	Lib.C(UIS.InputChanged, function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local delta = input.Position - origin
			goal = Clamp(startOffset + Vector2.new(delta.X, delta.Y))
		end
	end)
end

do
	local UIS = Services.UserInputService
	local MIN_W, MIN_H, MAX_W, MAX_H = 560, 380, 1500, 950
	local EDGE, CORNER = 6, 14
	local active, origin, startW, startH, startOffset

	local handles = {
		{ -1, 0, UDim2.new(0, EDGE, 1, -CORNER * 2), UDim2.fromOffset(0, CORNER) },
		{ 1, 0, UDim2.new(0, EDGE, 1, -CORNER * 2), UDim2.new(1, -EDGE, 0, CORNER) },
		{ 0, -1, UDim2.new(1, -CORNER * 2, 0, EDGE), UDim2.fromOffset(CORNER, 0) },
		{ 0, 1, UDim2.new(1, -CORNER * 2, 0, EDGE), UDim2.new(0, CORNER, 1, -EDGE) },
		{ -1, -1, UDim2.fromOffset(CORNER, CORNER), UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) },
		{ 1, -1, UDim2.fromOffset(CORNER, CORNER), UDim2.new(1, -CORNER, 0, 0) },
		{ -1, 1, UDim2.fromOffset(CORNER, CORNER), UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -CORNER) },
		{ 1, 1, UDim2.fromOffset(CORNER, CORNER), UDim2.new(1, -CORNER, 1, -CORNER) }
	}

	local function Blocked()
		return State.Maximized or State.Minimized or Lib.WindowBusy()
	end

	for _, data in ipairs(handles) do
		local handle = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Name = "ResizeHandle", Size = data[3], Position = data[4], BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true, ZIndex = 60, Parent = UI.Main
		})
		local function Glow(transparency)
			handle.BackgroundColor3 = State.LightTheme and Color3.new(0, 0, 0) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			Lib.Tween(handle, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { BackgroundTransparency = transparency })
		end
		handle.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			if not active and not Blocked() then Glow(0.82) end
		end)
		handle.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			if active ~= data then Glow(1) end
		end)
		handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			if Blocked() then return end
			active, origin = data, input.Position
			startW, startH, startOffset = State.OriginalSize.X.Offset, State.OriginalSize.Y.Offset, Lib.DragOffset
			Glow(0.6)
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					active = nil
					Glow(1)
				end
			end)
		end)
	end

	Lib.C(UIS.InputChanged, function(input)
		if not active or (input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then return end
		if Blocked() then
			active = nil
			return
		end
		local s = Lib.MenuBaseScale or 1
		local view = UI.Screen.AbsoluteSize
		local dx, dy = active[1], active[2]
		local delta = input.Position - origin
		local w = math.clamp(startW + dx * delta.X / s, MIN_W, math.max(MIN_W, math.min(MAX_W, view.X / s - 20)))
		local h = math.clamp(startH + dy * delta.Y / s, MIN_H, math.max(MIN_H, math.min(MAX_H, view.Y / s - 20)))
		State.OriginalSize = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
		Lib.DragOffset = startOffset + Vector2.new(dx * (w - startW) * s / 2, dy * (h - startH) * s / 2)
		UI.Main.Size, UI.Main.Position = Lib.MainLayout()
	end)
end

		BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 6, Parent = UI.TopNavContainer,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }), TipStroke,
		Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 9), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 9), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 5) }),
		TipLabel
	})

	local function Context()
		local theme, palette, light = Lib.Theme, Lib.Palette, State.LightTheme
		local active
		for i = 1, TAB_COUNT do
			if NavTabsData[i].id == State.ActiveMain then
				active = i
				break
			end
		end
		return {
			hover = UI.CurrentHoveredNav, active = active,
			primary = palette.Primary, secondary = palette.Secondary, onPrimary = theme.Main, plate = theme.Item,
			thumb = light and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Lib.Lighten(theme.Item, 0.16),
			tile = light and theme.Item:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.07) or Lib.Lighten(theme.Item, 0.1)
		}
	end

	Layouts.Classic = function(c, instant)
		local isWhite = State.LightTheme
		local widths, totalWidth = {}, 0
		for i, tab in ipairs(NavTabsData) do
			widths[i] = (c.hover == i) and tab.expWidth or BASE_TAB_WIDTH
			totalWidth = totalWidth + widths[i]
		end
		totalWidth = totalWidth + (TAB_COUNT - 1) * TAB_GAP
		local currentX = -totalWidth / 2
		local activeColor = isWhite and Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		local inactiveColor = isWhite and Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
		for i = 1, TAB_COUNT do
			local elem, w = UI.NavElements[i], widths[i]
			local isHover, isActive = c.hover == i, c.active == i
			Go(elem.Container, 0.22, Cubic, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, currentX, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, 36), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, instant)
			Go(elem.Icon, 0.2, Quad, {
				Position = isHover and UDim2.new(0, 7, 0.5, -9) or UDim2.new(0.5, -9, 0.5, -9), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
				ImageColor3 = (isActive or isHover) and activeColor or inactiveColor, ImageTransparency = 0
			}, instant)
			Go(elem.Text, 0.2, Quad, { TextTransparency = isHover and 0 or 1, TextColor3 = (isActive or isHover) and activeColor or inactiveColor }, instant)
			local lineWidth = isActive and (isHover and (w - 14) or 18) or 0
			elem.Line.BackgroundColor3 = activeColor
			Go(elem.Line, 0.2, Quad, {
				Position = UDim2.new(0, isHover and 7 or (w / 2 - lineWidth / 2), 1, -2), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(lineWidth, 2)
			}, instant)
			currentX = currentX + w + TAB_GAP
		end
	end

	Layouts["Floating Dock"] = function(c, instant)
		local sizes, total = {}, 0
		for i = 1, TAB_COUNT do
			local distance = c.hover and math.abs(c.hover - i)
			sizes[i] = distance == 0 and 46 or distance == 1 and 42 or 38
			total = total + sizes[i]
		end
		total = total + (TAB_COUNT - 1) * 6
		local x, tipX = -total / 2, nil
		for i = 1, TAB_COUNT do
			local elem, s = UI.NavElements[i], sizes[i]
			local isActive, isHover = c.active == i, c.hover == i
			local icon = s - 18
			Go(elem.Container, 0.2, Cubic, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x, 0, 18 - s / 2), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(s, s), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, instant)
			Go(elem.Icon, 0.2, Quad, {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(icon, icon), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -icon / 2, 0.5, -icon / 2 - (isActive and 2 or 0)),
				ImageColor3 = (isActive or isHover) and c.primary or c.secondary, ImageTransparency = 0
			}, instant)
			Go(elem.Text, 0.15, Quad, { TextTransparency = 1 }, instant)
			elem.Line.BackgroundColor3 = c.primary
			Go(elem.Line, 0.2, Quad, {
				Position = UDim2.new(0.5, isActive and -2 or 0, 1, isActive and -7 or -5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(isActive and 4 or 0, isActive and 4 or 0)
			}, instant)
			if isHover then tipX = x + s / 2 end
			x = x + s + 6
		end
		Go(Plate, 0.2, Cubic, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(total + 20, 46), BackgroundColor3 = c.plate }, instant)
		PlateStroke.Color = c.secondary
		TipStroke.Color = c.secondary
		Tip.BackgroundColor3 = c.plate
		TipLabel.TextColor3 = c.primary
		if tipX then
			TipLabel.Text = Lib.Tr(NavTabsData[c.hover].title)
			Tip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
			Tip.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, tipX, 0, 46)
			Tip.Visible = true
		else
			Tip.Visible = false
		end
	end

	Layouts["Floating Pill"] = function(c, instant)
		local widths, total = {}, 0
		for i, tab in ipairs(NavTabsData) do
			widths[i] = c.active == i and tab.expWidth + 8 or 34
			total = total + widths[i]
		end
		total = total + (TAB_COUNT - 1) * 4
		local x, activeX, activeW = -total / 2, nil, nil
		for i = 1, TAB_COUNT do
			local elem, w = UI.NavElements[i], widths[i]
			local isActive, isHover = c.active == i, c.hover == i
			Go(elem.Container, 0.25, Cubic, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x, 0, 2), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, 32), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, instant)
			Go(elem.Icon, 0.22, Quad, {
				Position = isActive and UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -9) or UDim2.new(0.5, -9, 0.5, -9), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
				ImageColor3 = isActive and c.onPrimary or (isHover and c.primary or c.secondary), ImageTransparency = 0
			}, instant)
			Go(elem.Text, 0.22, Quad, { TextTransparency = isActive and 0 or 1, TextColor3 = c.onPrimary }, instant)
			Go(elem.Line, 0.15, Quad, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) }, instant)
			if isActive then activeX, activeW = x, w end
			x = x + w + 4
		end
		Go(Plate, 0.25, Cubic, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -2), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(total + 8, 40), BackgroundColor3 = c.plate }, instant)
		PlateStroke.Color = c.secondary
		if activeX then
			Go(Indicator, 0.25, Cubic, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, activeX, 0, 2), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(activeW, 32), BackgroundColor3 = c.primary }, instant)
		end
		Tip.Visible = false
	end

	Layouts.Segmented = function(c, instant)
		local total = SEGMENT_WIDTH * TAB_COUNT
		local x, activeX = -total / 2, nil
		for i = 1, TAB_COUNT do
			local elem = UI.NavElements[i]
			local isActive, isHover = c.active == i, c.hover == i
			Go(elem.Container, 0.25, Cubic, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x, 0, 3), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SEGMENT_WIDTH, 28), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, instant)
			Go(elem.Icon, 0.15, Quad, { ImageTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -9, 0.5, -9), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18) }, instant)
			Go(elem.Text, 0.2, Quad, { TextTransparency = 0, TextColor3 = (isActive or isHover) and c.primary or c.secondary }, instant)
			Go(elem.Line, 0.15, Quad, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) }, instant)
			if isActive then activeX = x end
			x = x + SEGMENT_WIDTH
		end
		Go(Plate, 0.25, Cubic, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(total + 6, 34), BackgroundColor3 = c.plate }, instant)
		PlateStroke.Color = c.secondary
		if activeX then
			Go(Indicator, 0.3, Quint, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, activeX, 0, 3), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SEGMENT_WIDTH, 28), BackgroundColor3 = c.thumb }, instant)
		end
		Tip.Visible = false
	end

	Layouts["Icon Rail"] = function(c, instant)
		local tipY, activeY
		for i = 1, TAB_COUNT do
			local elem = UI.NavElements[i]
			local isActive, isHover = c.active == i, c.hover == i
			local y = 8 + (i - 1) * 42
			Go(elem.Container, 0.2, Cubic, {
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36), BackgroundColor3 = c.primary,
				BackgroundTransparency = (isHover and not isActive) and 0.9 or 1
			}, instant)
			Go(elem.Icon, 0.2, Quad, {
				Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -10, 0.5, -10), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
				ImageColor3 = (isActive or isHover) and c.primary or c.secondary, ImageTransparency = 0
			}, instant)
			Go(elem.Text, 0.1, Quad, { TextTransparency = 1 }, instant)
			elem.Line.BackgroundColor3 = c.primary
			Go(elem.Line, 0.2, Quad, { Position = UDim2.new(0, -4, 0.5, isActive and -9 or 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, isActive and 18 or 0) }, instant)
			Go(elem.Corner, 0.2, Quad, { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, (isActive or isHover) and 10 or 18) }, instant)
			if isHover then tipY = y end
			if isActive then activeY = y end
		end
		Go(Plate, 0.2, Quad, { BackgroundColor3 = c.plate }, instant)
		PlateStroke.Color = c.secondary
		if activeY then
			Go(Indicator, 0.25, Cubic, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, activeY), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36), BackgroundColor3 = c.tile }, instant)
		end
		TipStroke.Color = c.secondary
		Tip.BackgroundColor3 = c.plate
		TipLabel.TextColor3 = c.primary
		if tipY then
			TipLabel.Text = Lib.Tr(NavTabsData[c.hover].title)
			Tip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
			Tip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(RAIL_WIDTH + 2, tipY + 18)
			Tip.Visible = true
		else
			Tip.Visible = false
		end
	end

	function Lib.RecalculateNavPositions(instant)
		if not UI.NavElements[TAB_COUNT] then return end
		Layouts[State.NavStyle or "Classic"](Context(), instant == true)
	end

	for i, tab in ipairs(NavTabsData) do
		local TabCorner = Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0) })
		local TabFrame = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Name = "NavTab_" .. tab.id,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BASE_TAB_WIDTH, 36),
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			ClipsDescendants = true,
			ZIndex = 3,
			Parent = UI.TopNavContainer,
			TabCorner
		})

		local TabIcon = Lib.Create("ImageLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -9, 0.5, -9),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Image = tab.icon,
			ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150),
			ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
			Parent = TabFrame
		})

		local TabText = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 1, 0),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = tab.title,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150),
			TextSize = 13,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTransparency = 1,
			Parent = TabFrame
		})

		local LineCorner = Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 1) })
		local TabLine = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2),
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -9, 1, -2),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Parent = TabFrame,
			LineCorner
		})

		UI.NavElements[i] = {
			Container = TabFrame,
			Icon = TabIcon,
			Text = TabText,
			Line = TabLine,
			Corner = TabCorner,
			LineCorner = LineCorner,
			Data = tab
		}

		TabFrame.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			UI.CurrentHoveredNav = i
			Lib.RecalculateNavPositions()
		end)

		TabFrame.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			if UI.CurrentHoveredNav == i then
				UI.CurrentHoveredNav = nil
				Lib.RecalculateNavPositions()
			end
		end)

		TabFrame.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			Lib.SwitchMainTab(tab.id)
		end)
	end

	function Lib.ApplyNavStyle(style, instant)
		if not Layouts[style] then style = "Classic" end
		State.NavStyle = style
		local rail, classic = style == "Icon Rail", style == "Classic"
		local dock, pill, segmented = style == "Floating Dock", style == "Floating Pill", style == "Segmented"
		local container = UI.TopNavContainer
		container.AnchorPoint = rail and Vector2.zero or Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		container.Size = rail and UDim2.new(0, RAIL_WIDTH, 1, -58) or UDim2.fromOffset(460, 36)
		container.Position = Lib.NavPosition(State.Minimized and -44 or 11)
		UI.ContentArea.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(rail and RAIL_WIDTH or 0, 58)
		UI.ContentArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, rail and -RAIL_WIDTH or 0, 1, -58)
		Plate.Visible = not classic
		Plate.AnchorPoint = rail and Vector2.zero or Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		if rail then
			Plate.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0)
			Plate.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 1, -8)
		end
		PlateCorner.CornerRadius = pill and UDim.new(0.5, 0) or UDim.new(0, dock and 15 or segmented and 9 or 12)
		Indicator.Visible = pill or segmented or rail
		ThumbCorner.CornerRadius = pill and UDim.new(0.5, 0) or UDim.new(0, segmented and 7 or 10)
		ThumbStroke.Enabled = segmented
		for i = 1, TAB_COUNT do
			local elem = UI.NavElements[i]
			local text = elem.Text
			elem.Container.ClipsDescendants = not rail
			elem.LineCorner.CornerRadius = classic and UDim.new(0, 1) or UDim.new(0.5, 0)
			if not rail then elem.Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0) end
			text.TextSize = segmented and 12 or 13
			if segmented then
				text.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
				text.Position = UDim2.new()
				text.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			else
				text.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
				text.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pill and 34 or 30, 0)
				text.Size = UDim2.new(1, pill and -38 or -30, 1, 0)
			end
		end
		Tip.Visible = false
		Lib.RecalculateNavPositions(instant)
	end

	function Lib.CreateNavStylePicker(parentCard)
		local roles, cards, dots = {}, {}, {}
		local R1, R2, R3, RF = UDim.new(0, 1), UDim.new(0, 2), UDim.new(0, 3), UDim.new(0.5, 0)
		local CARD_W, CARD_H, STEP, VIEW_H = 140, 112, 130, 124
		local SCREEN_W, SCREEN_H = CARD_W - 12, 70
		local focus = table.find(STYLES, State.NavStyle) or 1
		local viewport, Focus, Layout, Paint, prevButton, nextButton

		local function Shown(gui)
			while gui and gui:IsA("GuiObject") do
				if not gui.Visible then return false end
				gui = gui.Parent
			end
			return true
		end

		local function Box(parent, x, y, w, h, role, radius)
			local frame = Lib.Create("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = parent })
			if radius then Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = radius, Parent = frame }) end
			roles[#roles + 1] = { frame, role }
			return frame
		end

		local function Content(p, y, h)
			Box(p, 6, y, 76, h, "card", R3)
			Box(p, 11, y + 5, 40, 3, "item", R1)
			Box(p, 11, y + 12, 26, 3, "item", R1)
		end

		local function At(x, y)
			return UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
		end

		local Previews = {
			Classic = function(p)
				for i = 0, 4 do Box(p, 24 + i * 9, 4, 5, 5, "dim", R1) end
				local mark = Box(p, 33, 4, 5, 5, "bright", R1)
				local line = Box(p, 33, 11, 5, 1, "bright")
				Content(p, 16, 26)
				return 1, 5, function(i)
					local x = 24 + i * 9
					return { { mark, { Position = At(x, 4) } }, { line, { Position = At(x, 11) } } }
				end
			end,
			["Floating Dock"] = function(p)
				Box(p, 22, 2, 44, 13, "item", UDim.new(0, 5))
				for i = 0, 4 do Box(p, 26 + i * 8, 5, 5, 5, "dim", R2) end
				local big = Box(p, 41, 4, 7, 7, "bright", R2)
				local dot = Box(p, 43, 12, 2, 2, "bright", RF)
				Content(p, 19, 23)
				return 2, 5, function(i)
					return { { big, { Position = At(25 + i * 8, 4) } }, { dot, { Position = At(27 + i * 8, 12) } } }
				end
			end,
			["Floating Pill"] = function(p)
				local stops = { 20, 28, 38, 52 }
				Box(p, 18, 3, 54, 11, "item", RF)
				for i = 0, 3 do Box(p, 45 + i * 7, 6, 4, 4, "dim", RF) end
				local thumb = Box(p, 20, 5, 18, 7, "bright", RF)
				local label = Box(p, 26, 8, 7, 1, "main")
				Content(p, 19, 23)
				return 0, 4, function(i)
					local x = stops[i + 1]
					return { { thumb, { Position = At(x, 5) } }, { label, { Position = At(x + 6, 8) } } }
				end
			end,
			Segmented = function(p)
				Box(p, 18, 3, 52, 11, "item", R2)
				local thumb = Box(p, 29, 4, 10, 9, "thumb", R2)
				for i = 0, 4 do Box(p, 21 + i * 10, 8, 6, 1, "dim") end
				local mark = Box(p, 31, 8, 6, 1, "bright")
				Content(p, 19, 23)
				return 1, 5, function(i)
					return { { thumb, { Position = At(19 + i * 10, 4) } }, { mark, { Position = At(21 + i * 10, 8) } } }
				end
			end,
			["Icon Rail"] = function(p)
				Box(p, 3, 3, 11, 43, "item", UDim.new(0, 4))
				local thumb = Box(p, 4, 13, 9, 9, "thumb", R2)
				local bar = Box(p, 3, 14, 1, 7, "bright")
				for i = 0, 4 do Box(p, 6, 7 + i * 8, 5, 5, "dim", R1) end
				local mark = Box(p, 6, 15, 5, 5, "bright", R1)
				Box(p, 18, 3, 64, 42, "card", R3)
				Box(p, 23, 9, 36, 3, "item", R1)
				Box(p, 23, 16, 24, 3, "item", R1)
				return 1, 5, function(i)
					return { { thumb, { Position = At(4, 5 + i * 8) } }, { bar, { Position = At(3, 6 + i * 8) } }, { mark, { Position = At(6, 7 + i * 8) } } }
				end
			end
		}

		local function Hover()
			if State.LightTheme then return Lib.Theme.Item:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.06) end
			return Lib.Lighten(Lib.Theme.Item, 0.07)
		end

		local function Snap(c, index)
			for _, pair in ipairs(c.Move(index)) do
				for prop, value in pairs(pair[2]) do pair[1][prop] = value end
			end
		end

		local function Animate(c, on)
			c.Token += 1
			local token = c.Token
			if not on then
				local back = TweenInfo.new(0.25, Quint, Out)
				for _, pair in ipairs(c.Move(c.Rest)) do
					Services.Tween:Create(pair[1], back, pair[2]):Play()
				end
				return
			end
			local info = TweenInfo.new(0.34, Quint, Out)
			task.spawn(function()
				local index = c.Rest
				while c.Token == token and not State.Unloaded do
					if not Shown(c.Card) then
						Snap(c, c.Rest)
						return
					end
					index = (index + 1) % c.Count
					for _, pair in ipairs(c.Move(index)) do
						Services.Tween:Create(pair[1], info, pair[2]):Play()
					end
					task.wait(0.62)
				end
			end)
		end

		local item = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 196), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = parentCard })

		local titleLabel = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 12), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Navigation Style",
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = item
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(titleLabel, "Primary")

		local descLabel = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "Choose how the tab bar looks. Tabs work the same in every style.", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130),
			TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = item
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(descLabel, "Secondary")

		viewport = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, VIEW_H), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 50), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = item })

		local dotRow = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 6), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 182), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = item,
			Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center, Padding = UDim.new(0, 5), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
		})

		Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 195), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), BackgroundTransparency = 0.9,
			BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = item
		})

		local function BuildCard(index, name)
			local scale = Lib.Create("UIScale", { Scale = 1 })
			local stroke = Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.85, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150) })
			local card = Lib.Create("CanvasGroup", {
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CARD_W, CARD_H), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = viewport,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) }), stroke, scale
			})
			local screen = Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SCREEN_W, SCREEN_H), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0,
				ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = card, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7) })
			})
			local canvas = Lib.Create("Frame", {
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(88, 48), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = screen,
				Lib.Create("UIScale", { Scale = SCREEN_W / 88 })
			})
			local rest, count, move = Previews[name](canvas)
			local caption = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 84), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = name, TextSize = 12,
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), Parent = card
			})
			local hit = Lib.Create("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 5, Parent = card })
			local c = { Card = card, Screen = screen, Stroke = stroke, Caption = caption, Scale = scale, Hit = hit, Rest = rest, Count = count, Move = move, Token = 0 }
			cards[index] = c

			hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
				Lib.Tween(card, 0.12, Quad, Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Hover() })
				Animate(c, true)
			end)
			hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
				Lib.Tween(card, 0.12, Quad, Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Theme.Item })
				Animate(c, false)
			end)
			hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				local kind = input.UserInputType
				if kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
				local startX = input.Position.X
				local connection
				connection = input.Changed:Connect(function()
					if input.UserInputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.End then return end
					connection:Disconnect()
					local delta = input.Position.X - startX
					if math.abs(delta) > 36 then
						Lib.PlayClick()
						Focus(focus + (delta < 0 and 1 or -1))
					elseif index ~= focus then
						Lib.PlayClick()
						Focus(index)
					end
				end)
			end)

			local dot = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, LayoutOrder = index, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = dotRow,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
			})
			dot.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				Lib.PlayClick()
				Focus(index)
			end)
			dots[index] = dot
		end

		for index, name in ipairs(STYLES) do BuildCard(index, name) end

		local function Arrow(side, text)
			local right = side > 0
			local button = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(right and 1 or 0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(right and 1 or 0, right and -6 or 6, 0.5, 0),
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), Text = text, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), TextSize = 18, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 30, Parent = viewport, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
			})
			button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				Lib.PlayClick()
				Focus(focus + side)
			end)
			return button
		end
		prevButton, nextButton = Arrow(-1, "‹"), Arrow(1, "›")

		function Layout(instant)
			local width = viewport.AbsoluteSize.X
			if width <= 0 then return end
			local info = TweenInfo.new(0.42, Quint, Out)
			for index = 1, #STYLES do
				local c = cards[index]
				local d = index - focus
				local ad = math.abs(d)
				local position = UDim2.new(0, width / 2 + d * STEP, 0.5, 0)
				local fade = ad == 0 and 0 or ad == 1 and 0.55 or 1
				local size = ad == 0 and 1 or ad == 1 and 0.82 or 0.66
				c.Card.ZIndex = 10 - ad
				c.Hit.Visible = ad <= 1
				if instant then
					c.Card.Position, c.Card.GroupTransparency, c.Scale.Scale = position, fade, size
				else
					Services.Tween:Create(c.Card, info, { Position = position, GroupTransparency = fade }):Play()
					Services.Tween:Create(c.Scale, info, { Scale = size }):Play()
				end
			end
		end

		function Paint()
			local theme, palette = Lib.Theme, Lib.Palette
			local K = {
				main = theme.Main, card = theme.Card, item = theme.Item, bright = palette.Primary, dim = palette.Secondary,
				thumb = State.LightTheme and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Lib.Lighten(theme.Item, 0.16)
			}
			for i = 1, #roles do
				local role = roles[i]
				role[1].BackgroundColor3 = K[role[2]]
			end
			for index = 1, #STYLES do
				local c = cards[index]
				local selected = index == focus
				c.Card.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Item
				c.Screen.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Main
				Lib.Tween(c.Stroke, 0.22, Quad, Out, {
					Color = selected and palette.SwitchOn or palette.Secondary, Thickness = selected and 2 or 1, Transparency = selected and 0 or 0.85
				})
				Lib.Tween(c.Caption, 0.22, Quad, Out, { TextColor3 = selected and palette.Primary or palette.Secondary })
				local dot = dots[index]
				dot.BackgroundColor3 = selected and palette.Primary or palette.Secondary
				dot.BackgroundTransparency = selected and 0 or 0.55
				Lib.Tween(dot, 0.25, Quint, Out, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(selected and 18 or 6, 6) })
			end
			prevButton.BackgroundColor3, nextButton.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Item, theme.Item
			prevButton.TextColor3 = focus > 1 and palette.Primary or palette.Secondary
			nextButton.TextColor3 = focus < #STYLES and palette.Primary or palette.Secondary
		end

		function Focus(index, instant)
			index = math.clamp(index, 1, #STYLES)
			focus = index
			Layout(instant)
			Paint()
			local name = STYLES[index]
			if State.NavStyle ~= name then Lib.ApplyNavStyle(name, instant) end
		end

		Lib.ChoiceControls["Navigation Style"] = {
			Get = function() return State.NavStyle end,
			Set = function(value)
				local index = table.find(STYLES, value)
				if index then Focus(index, true) end
			end
		}

		viewport:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function() Layout(true) end)
		table.insert(Lib.ThemeHooks, Paint)
		Layout(true)
		Paint()
		Lib.SearchAdd(parentCard, item, "Navigation Style")
		return item
	end
end

do
	local COLS, ROWS, DAY = 53, 7, 86400
	local CELLS = COLS * ROWS
	local MONTHS = { "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec" }
	local MODES = { "Daily", "Weekly", "Cumulative" }
	local Quad, Out = Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out

	local function Duration(seconds)
		local ru = State.Language == "Русский"
		local hours, minutes = seconds // 3600, seconds % 3600 // 60
		if hours > 0 then return string.format(ru and "%d ч %d м" or "%dh %dm", hours, minutes) end
		if minutes > 0 then return string.format(ru and "%d м" or "%dm", minutes) end
		return ru and "<1 м" or "<1m"
	end

	local function Clock(minute)
		return string.format("%02d:%02d", minute // 60, minute % 60)
	end

	local function Sessions(entry)
		local count = (#entry - 1) // 2
		if count < 1 then return nil end
		local first = math.max(1, count - 2)
		local parts = {}
		for i = first, count do
			parts[#parts + 1] = Clock(entry[i * 2]) .. " – " .. Clock(entry[i * 2 + 1])
		end
		local text = table.concat(parts, ", ")
		if first > 1 then text = "+" .. (first - 1) .. " · " .. text end
		return text
	end

	function Lib.BuildActivityCard(parent, order)
		local Activity = Lib.Activity
		local mode, builtKey, hovered, hoveredKind = "Daily", nil, nil, nil
		local dayTime, dayKey, secs, cum, weekSecs = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
		local cells, bars, hits, monthLabels, tabs = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
		local cw, ch = 1 / COLS, 1 / ROWS

		local card = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15),
			LayoutOrder = order, Parent = parent,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }),
			Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 14), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 14), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 16), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 16) }),
			Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 12), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(card, "BackgroundColor3", 0.5)

		local header = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = card })
		local title = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 20), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Activity", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
			TextSize = 16, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = header
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(title, "Primary")
		local subtitle = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 24), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Your activity over the last year",
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = header
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(subtitle, "Secondary")
		local ruler = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = header })
		local tabsHolder = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = header,
			Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 2) })
		})

		local body = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = card,
			Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
		})
		local grid = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 90), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = body })
		local monthRow = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = body })
		local cellsHolder = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = grid })
		local barsHolder = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, Parent = grid })

		local hoverStroke = Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1.2, Transparency = 0.15, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) })
		local tipStroke = Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.7, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150) })
		local function TipLine(textSize, font, order)
			return Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", TextSize = textSize,
				Font = font, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = 21
			})
		end
		local tipTitle = TipLine(12, Enum.Font.GothamBold, 1)
		local tipLine1 = TipLine(11, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, 2)
		local tipLine2 = TipLine(11, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, 3)
		local tip = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Name = "ActivityTip", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22),
			BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 20,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }), tipStroke,
			Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 9), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 9), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6) }),
			Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
			tipTitle, tipLine1, tipLine2
		})

		local Refresh

		local function Fit()
			local k = ruler.AbsoluteSize.X / 100
			if k <= 0 then return end
			local height = math.floor(body.AbsoluteSize.X / k / COLS * ROWS)
			if height > 0 and grid.Size.Y.Offset ~= height then grid.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height) end
		end
		body:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(Fit)
		ruler:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(Fit)

		local function Rebuild(now)
			local noon = os.time({ year = now.year, month = now.month, day = now.day, hour = 12 })
			local todayRow = (now.wday + 5) % 7
			for col = 0, COLS - 1 do
				for row = 0, ROWS - 1 do
					local idx = col * ROWS + row + 1
					local ago = (COLS - 1 - col) * 7 + todayRow - row
					if ago < 0 then
						dayTime[idx] = false
					else
						local t = noon - ago * DAY
						dayTime[idx] = t
						dayKey[idx] = Activity.DayKey(t)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local function Labels()
			local list, previous = {}, nil
			for col = 0, COLS - 1 do
				local t = dayTime[col * ROWS + 1]
				if t then
					local month = tonumber(os.date("%m", t))
					if month ~= previous then
						list[#list + 1] = { col, month }
						previous = month
					end
				end
			end
			if #list > 1 and list[2][1] - list[1][1] < 3 then table.remove(list, 1) end
			for i = 1, math.max(#list, #monthLabels) do
				local label, info = monthLabels[i], list[i]
				if info then
					if not label then
						label = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 14), BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130), TextSize = 11,
							Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = monthRow
						})
						Lib.RegisterThemeText(label, "Secondary")
						monthLabels[i] = label
					end
					label.Text = MONTHS[info[2]]
					label.Position = UDim2.new(info[1] * cw, 0, 0, 0)
					label.Visible = true
				elseif label then
					label.Visible = false
				end
			end
		end

		local function ClearHover()
			if hovered then
				hovered.ZIndex = 1
				if hoveredKind == "bar" then hovered.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
				hovered = nil
			end
			hoverStroke.Parent = nil
			tip.Parent = nil
		end

		local function ShowTip(owner, col, heading, line1, line2)
			tipTitle.Text = heading
			tipLine1.Text = line1
			tipLine2.Text = line2 or ""
			tipLine2.Visible = line2 ~= nil
			if col <= 8 then
				tip.AnchorPoint, tip.Position = Vector2.new(0, 1), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -6)
			elseif col >= COLS - 9 then
				tip.AnchorPoint, tip.Position = Vector2.new(1, 1), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, -6)
			else
				tip.AnchorPoint, tip.Position = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -6)
			end
			tip.Parent = owner
		end

		local function HoverCell(idx)
			local t = dayTime[idx]
			if not t then return end
			if hovered then hovered.ZIndex = 1 end
			local cell = cells[idx]
			hovered, hoveredKind = cell, "cell"
			cell.ZIndex = 5
			hoverStroke.Parent = cell
			local entry = Activity.Days[dayKey[idx]]
			local line1, line2
			if mode == "Cumulative" and cum[idx] > 0 then
				line1 = Lib.Tr("Total") .. ": " .. Duration(cum[idx])
				line2 = entry and Sessions(entry)
			elseif mode == "Daily" and secs[idx] > 0 then
				line1 = Lib.Tr("In hub") .. ": " .. Duration(secs[idx])
				line2 = entry and Sessions(entry)
			elseif mode == "Cumulative" and secs[idx] > 0 then
				line1 = Lib.Tr("In hub") .. ": " .. Duration(secs[idx])
				line2 = entry and Sessions(entry)
			else
				line1 = Lib.Tr("No activity")
			end
			ShowTip(cell, (idx - 1) // ROWS, os.date("%d.%m.%Y", t), line1, line2)
		end

		local function HoverBar(col)
			if hovered then
				hovered.ZIndex = 1
				if hoveredKind == "bar" then hovered.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
			end
			local hit = hits[col]
			hovered, hoveredKind = hit, "bar"
			hit.ZIndex = 5
			hit.BackgroundTransparency = 0.93
			local base = (col - 1) * ROWS
			local last = dayTime[base + ROWS] or dayTime[base + 1]
			for row = ROWS, 1, -1 do
				if dayTime[base + row] then
					last = dayTime[base + row]
					break
				end
			end
			local total = weekSecs[col] or 0
			ShowTip(
				hit, col - 1,
				os.date("%d.%m", dayTime[base + 1]) .. " – " .. os.date("%d.%m.%Y", last),
				total > 0 and (Lib.Tr("In hub") .. ": " .. Duration(total)) or Lib.Tr("No activity")
			)
		end

		for col = 0, COLS - 1 do
			for row = 0, ROWS - 1 do
				local idx = col * ROWS + row + 1
				local cell = Lib.Create("Frame", {
					Size = UDim2.new(cw, -2, ch, -2), Position = UDim2.fromScale(col * cw, row * ch), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22),
					BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = cellsHolder,
					Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.25, 0) })
				})
				cells[idx] = cell
				cell.MouseEnter:Connect(function() HoverCell(idx) end)
			end
			local hit = Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.fromScale(cw, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(col * cw, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = barsHolder,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3) })
			})
			local column = col + 1
			hits[column] = hit
			bars[column] = Lib.Create("Frame", {
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 0, 3), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22),
				BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = hit,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2) })
			})
			hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function() HoverBar(column) end)
		end
		grid.MouseLeave:Connect(ClearHover)

		Refresh = function(animate)
			local now = os.date("*t")
			local todayKey = now.year * 10000 + now.month * 100 + now.day
			if todayKey ~= builtKey then
				builtKey = todayKey
				Rebuild(now)
				Labels()
			end
			local days = Activity.Days
			local empty, full = Lib.Theme.Item, Lib.Palette.Primary
			local total = 0
			for idx = 1, CELLS do
				local seconds = 0
				if dayTime[idx] then
					local entry = days[dayKey[idx]]
					seconds = entry and entry[1] or 0
				end
				secs[idx] = seconds
				total = total + seconds
			end
			if mode == "Weekly" then
				local peak = 0
				for col = 1, COLS do
					local sum, base = 0, (col - 1) * ROWS
					for row = 1, ROWS do sum = sum + secs[base + row] end
					weekSecs[col] = sum
					if sum > peak then peak = sum end
				end
				for col = 1, COLS do
					local sum = weekSecs[col]
					local ratio = peak > 0 and sum / peak or 0
					local goal = {
						Size = sum > 0 and UDim2.new(1, -2, math.max(ratio, 0.05), 0) or UDim2.new(1, -2, 0, 3),
						BackgroundColor3 = empty:Lerp(full, sum > 0 and 0.25 + 0.75 * ratio or 0)
					}
					if animate then
						Lib.Tween(bars[col], 0.3, Quad, Out, goal)
					else
						bars[col].Size, bars[col].BackgroundColor3 = goal.Size, goal.BackgroundColor3
					end
				end
				return
			end
			local running = 0
			for idx = 1, CELLS do
				local cell = cells[idx]
				if dayTime[idx] then
					local seconds, level = secs[idx], 0
					if mode == "Cumulative" then
						running = running + seconds
						cum[idx] = running
						if running > 0 then level = 0.2 + 0.8 * running / total end
					elseif seconds > 0 then
						level = 0.2 + 0.8 * math.min(1, seconds / 14400) ^ 0.7
					end
					cell.Visible = true
					cell.BackgroundColor3 = empty:Lerp(full, level)
				else
					cell.Visible = false
				end
			end
		end

		local function Paint()
			local theme, palette = Lib.Theme, Lib.Palette
			for name, button in pairs(tabs) do
				button.TextColor3 = name == mode and palette.Primary or palette.Secondary
			end
			tip.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Item
			tipStroke.Color = palette.Secondary
			tipTitle.TextColor3 = palette.Primary
			tipLine1.TextColor3 = palette.Secondary
			tipLine2.TextColor3 = palette.Secondary
			hoverStroke.Color = palette.Primary
			for col = 1, COLS do hits[col].BackgroundColor3 = palette.Primary end
			Refresh()
		end

		for i, name in ipairs(MODES) do
			local button = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutoButtonColor = false,
				Text = name, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, LayoutOrder = i, Parent = tabsHolder,
				Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6) })
			})
			tabs[name] = button
			button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				if mode == name then return end
				Lib.PlayClick()
				mode = name
				ClearHover()
				cellsHolder.Visible = name ~= "Weekly"
				barsHolder.Visible = name == "Weekly"
				local palette = Lib.Palette
				for other, tab in pairs(tabs) do
					Lib.Tween(tab, 0.15, Quad, Out, { TextColor3 = other == name and palette.Primary or palette.Secondary })
				end
				Refresh(true)
			end)
		end

		local view = parent.Parent
		if view then
			view:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
				if view.Visible then Refresh() end
			end)
		end

		Activity.OnRefresh = function()
			if State.ActiveMain == "Home" and State.CurrentTab == "Account" and not State.Minimized and UI.Main.Visible then
				Refresh()
			end
		end

		table.insert(Lib.ThemeHooks, Paint)
		Fit()
		Paint()
		return card
	end
end

function Lib.HoverStroke(card, stroke)
	stroke = stroke or card:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	card.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Lib.Tween(stroke, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Transparency = 0.6 }) end)
	card.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Lib.Tween(stroke, 0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Transparency = 0.88 }) end)
end

	local scroll = Lib.Create("ScrollingFrame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 2,
		ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
		Parent = view,
		Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 10), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
		Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 14) })
	})

	local Version = Lib.Version
	local card = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 64), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15), LayoutOrder = 0, Parent = scroll,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12) }),
		Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128), Transparency = 0.88, Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeElement(card, "BackgroundColor3", 0.5)
	Lib.HoverStroke(card)

	local dot = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0.5, -4), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = card,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
	})

	local statusLabel = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -290, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 12), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", TextSize = 13,
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = card
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(statusLabel, "Primary")

	local detailLabel = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -290, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 33), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", TextSize = 11,
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(145, 145, 145), Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = card
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(detailLabel, "Secondary")

	local actions = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 28), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = card,
		Lib.Create("UIListLayout", {
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
		})
	})

	local function ActionButton(label, order, callback)
		local button = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 28), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, LayoutOrder = order, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.92, Text = label, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235), TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
			AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = actions,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7) }),
			Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128), Transparency = 0.75, Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }),
			Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12) })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(button, "Primary")
		button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			Lib.Tween(button, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.82 })
		end)
		button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			Lib.Tween(button, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.92 })
		end)
		button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			callback()
		end)
		return button
	end

	ActionButton("Check for Updates", 1, Version.Check)
	local copyButton = ActionButton("Copy Link", 2, function()
		local copy = setclipboard or toclipboard or set_clipboard
		if copy then pcall(copy, Version.Repo) end
		Lib.Notify({ Title = "GitHub", Text = "Copied!" })
	end)
	copyButton.Visible = false

	local tones = {
		checking = { Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), "Checking for updates..." },
		latest = { Color3.fromRGB(96, 214, 128), "Up to date" },
		outdated = { Color3.fromRGB(255, 184, 77), "Update available" },
		failed = { Color3.fromRGB(214, 96, 96), "Update check failed" }
	}
	tones.idle = tones.checking
	local pulse
	Version.Listen(function(status, latest)
		if not card.Parent then return end
		if pulse then
			pulse:Cancel()
			pulse = nil
		end
		local tone = tones[status] or tones.idle
		dot.BackgroundColor3, dot.BackgroundTransparency = tone[1], 0
		statusLabel.Text = tone[2]
		detailLabel.Text = "Installed: " .. Version.Display .. "  ·  Latest: " .. (latest and ("V" .. latest) or "—")
		copyButton.Visible = status == "outdated"
		if tone == tones.checking then
			pulse = Services.Tween:Create(dot, TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.75 })
			pulse:Play()
		end
	end)

	local TONES = { NEW = Color3.fromRGB(46, 213, 115), FIX = Color3.fromRGB(230, 162, 60) }
	local HEAD = 62
	local Quad, Quint, Out = Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out

	local function Kind(note)
		return (note:find("^Fix") or note:find("^Correct")) and "FIX" or "NEW"
	end

	local function BuildNotes(body, list)
		for i = 1, #list do
			local kind = Kind(list[i])
			local tone = TONES[kind]
			local row = Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = i, Parent = body
			})
			Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = tone, BackgroundTransparency = 0.84,
				Text = kind, TextColor3 = tone, TextSize = 9, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = row,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5) })
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -54, 0, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = list[i], TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(145, 145, 145), TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, TextWrapped = true, Parent = row
			}), "Secondary")
		end
	end

	for index, release in ipairs(releases) do
		local list, fixes = release.notes, 0
		for i = 1, #list do
			if Kind(list[i]) == "FIX" then fixes += 1 end
		end
		local open, built, settled, running = release.latest == true, false, false, nil

		local card = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, HEAD), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15), ClipsDescendants = true, LayoutOrder = index, Parent = scroll,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12) }),
			Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128), Transparency = 0.88, Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(card, "BackgroundColor3", 0.5)

		local head = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, HEAD), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = card
		})
		Lib.HoverStroke(head, card:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke"))

		local left = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 10), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = head,
			Lib.Create("UIListLayout", {
				FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
				Padding = UDim.new(0, 10), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
			})
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 1,
			Text = release.title and (release.version .. " " .. release.title) or release.version,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245), TextSize = 17, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = left
		}), "Primary")

		if release.latest then
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128),
				BackgroundTransparency = 0.8, LayoutOrder = 2, Text = "LATEST", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245),
				TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = left,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5) }),
				Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8) })
			}), "Primary")
		end

		Lib.RegisterThemeText(Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 38), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = string.format("Changes: %d  \u{00B7}  New: %d  \u{00B7}  Fixes: %d", #list, #list - fixes, fixes),
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140), TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = head
		}), "Secondary")

		Lib.RegisterThemeText(Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(110, 16), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, 14), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = release.date, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(145, 145, 145), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Parent = head
		}), "Secondary")

		local arrow = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "\u{25BC}", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
			Rotation = open and 180 or 0, Parent = head
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(arrow, "Secondary")

		local body = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, HEAD), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = card,
			Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
			Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 16), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 16), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 2), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 16) })
		})

		local function Fit(time)
			if running then running:Cancel() end
			local goal = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, open and (HEAD + body.AbsoluteSize.Y) or HEAD)
			if time == 0 then
				card.Size = goal
				return
			end
			running = Services.Tween:Create(card, TweenInfo.new(time, Quint, Out), { Size = goal })
			running:Play()
		end

		if open then
			built = true
			BuildNotes(body, list)
		end

		body:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
			if not open then return end
			Fit(settled and 0.18 or 0)
			settled = true
		end)

		head.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			open = not open
			if open and not built then
				built, settled = true, true
				BuildNotes(body, list)
			end
			Lib.Tween(arrow, 0.22, Quad, Out, { Rotation = open and 180 or 0 })
			Fit(0.3)
		end)
	end
end

		{ names = { "listfiles" }, desc = "Lists saved configs and macros and trims the image cache" },
		{ names = { "getcustomasset" }, desc = "Displays downloaded script images, URL music and custom fonts" },
		{ names = { "delfile" }, desc = "Deletes configs, macros and old cached images" }
	} },

		{ names = { "loadstring" }, desc = "Runs scripts from the Scripts details window and compiles Remote Spy spoof values and copied loadstring references" },

	} },
	{ "Interface", {
		{ names = { "gethui" }, desc = "Mounts the hub in a hidden container the game cannot see" },
		{ names = { "syn.protect_gui" }, optional = true, desc = "Legacy GUI protection on older Synapse-style executors" },
		{ names = { "setclipboard", "toclipboard", "set_clipboard" }, desc = "Copy buttons, loadstring copying and Remote Spy code export" },
		{ names = { "identifyexecutor" }, optional = true, desc = "Shows the executor name in the compatibility report" }
	} },
	{ "Visuals", {
		{ names = { "Drawing.new" }, label = "Drawing", desc = "ESP tracers and box rendering" },
		{ names = { "gethiddenproperty" }, desc = "Reads the Lighting technology before Boost FPS changes it" },
		{ names = { "sethiddenproperty" }, desc = "Changes the Lighting technology for Boost FPS and lighting features" }
	} },
	{ "Input", {
		{ names = { "mouse1click" }, optional = true, desc = "Combat auto-fire click (falls back to VirtualInputManager)" },
		{ names = { "mouse1press" }, optional = true, desc = "Combat auto-fire press when mouse1click is missing" },
		{ names = { "mouse1release" }, optional = true, desc = "Combat auto-fire release when mouse1click is missing" },

		{ names = { "hookmetamethod" }, desc = "Hooks __namecall to log outgoing remotes and bindables" },

		{ names = { "create_comm_channel" }, optional = true, label = "create_comm_channel / get_comm_channel", desc = "Sends actor logs back to the main environment" }
	} }
}

do
	local CHECK_FILE, CHECK_DIR = "SeptusHub_compat.tmp", "SeptusHub_compat_dir"
	local Lighting = Services.Lighting

	Lib.CompatTests = {
		writefile = function(fn) fn(CHECK_FILE, "septus") return true end,
		readfile = function(fn) return fn(CHECK_FILE) == "septus" end,
		isfile = function(fn) return fn(CHECK_FILE) == true and fn(CHECK_FILE .. ".none") == false end,
		makefolder = function(fn) fn(CHECK_DIR) return true end,
		isfolder = function(fn) return fn(CHECK_DIR) == true and fn(CHECK_DIR .. "_none") == false end,
		listfiles = function(fn) return type(fn(CHECK_DIR)) == "table" end,
		getcustomasset = function(fn)
			local asset = fn(CHECK_FILE)
			return type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= ""
		end,
		delfile = function(fn, resolve)
			fn(CHECK_FILE)
			return resolve("isfile")(CHECK_FILE) == false
		end,
		request = function(fn)
			local response = fn({ Url = "https://example.com", Method = "GET" })
			return type(response) == "table" and response.StatusCode == 200 and type(response.Body) == "string"
		end,
		["game.HttpGet"] = function(fn) return type(fn(game, "https://example.com")) == "string" end,
		loadstring = function(fn)
			local chunk = fn("return 7")
			return type(chunk) == "function" and chunk() == 7
		end,
		getgenv = function(fn)
			local env = fn()
			env.__SeptusCompat = 1
			local ok = env.__SeptusCompat == 1
			env.__SeptusCompat = nil
			return ok
		end,
		gethui = function(fn) return typeof(fn()) == "Instance" end,
		identifyexecutor = function(fn) return type((fn())) == "string" end,
		["Drawing.new"] = function(fn)
			local object = fn("Line")
			object.Visible = false
			if object.Remove then object:Remove() else object:Destroy() end
			return true
		end,
		gethiddenproperty = function(fn) return fn(Lighting, "Technology") ~= nil end,
		sethiddenproperty = function(fn, resolve)
			fn(Lighting, "Technology", resolve("gethiddenproperty")(Lighting, "Technology"))
			return true
		end,
		newcclosure = function(fn) return fn(function(value) return value end)(5) == 5 end,
		checkcaller = function(fn) return fn() == true end,
		firesignal = function(fn)
			local event = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
			local received
			event.Event:Connect(function(value) received = value end)
			fn(event.Event, 7)
			task.wait(0.1)
			event:Destroy()
			return received == 7
		end,
		getcallbackvalue = function(fn)
			local bindable = Instance.new("BindableFunction")
			local callback = function() end
			bindable.OnInvoke = callback
			local same = fn(bindable, "OnInvoke") == callback
			bindable:Destroy()
			return same
		end,
		getactors = function(fn) return type(fn()) == "table" end,
		create_comm_channel = function(fn)
			local id, event = fn()
			return id ~= nil and event ~= nil
		end
	}

	local function Resolve(path)
		local value, rest = nil, path
		if path:find("^game%.") then
			value, rest = game, path:sub(6)
		else
			value = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or getfenv(1)
		end
		for part in rest:gmatch("[^.]+") do
			local ok, nextValue = pcall(function() return value[part] end)
			if not ok or nextValue == nil then return nil end
			value = nextValue
		end
		return value
	end

	function Lib.RunCompat()
		local report = { ok = {}, bad = {}, optional = {}, total = 0 }
		local identify = Resolve("identifyexecutor")
		report.executor = "Unknown executor"
		if identify then
			local ok, name, version = pcall(identify)
			if ok and name then report.executor = tostring(name) .. (version and (" " .. tostring(version)) or "") end
		end

		for _, group in ipairs(Lib.CompatCatalog) do
			for _, entry in ipairs(group[2]) do
				local primary = entry.names[1]
				local found
				for _, name in ipairs(entry.names) do
					local value = Resolve(name)
					if type(value) == "function" then found = value break end
				end
				local test = Lib.CompatTests[primary]
				local passed = found ~= nil
				if found and test then
					local ok, result = Lib.Timed(function() return test(found, Resolve) end, 8)
					passed = ok and result == true
				end
				local record = { entry = entry, deep = test ~= nil and found ~= nil }
				report.total += 1
				if passed then
					report.ok[#report.ok + 1] = record
				elseif entry.optional then
					report.optional[#report.optional + 1] = record
				else
					report.bad[#report.bad + 1] = record
				end
				entry.status = passed and "ok" or (entry.optional and "optional" or "bad")
			end
		end

		local delFolder = Resolve("delfolder")
		local delFile = Resolve("delfile")
		if delFile then pcall(delFile, CHECK_FILE) end
		if delFolder then pcall(delFolder, CHECK_DIR) end
		return report
	end
end

function Lib.ShowCompat(report)
	if not Lib.CompatModal then Lib.CompatModal = Lib.CreateModal("Compatibility Report", 440, 480) end
	local modal = Lib.CompatModal
	for _, child in ipairs(modal.Content:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") then child:Destroy() end
	end

	local order = 0
	local function Label(text, size, font, color, role, rich)
		order += 1
		local label = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order,
			Text = text, TextColor3 = color, TextSize = size, Font = font, RichText = rich or false,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, TextWrapped = true, ZIndex = 33, Parent = modal.Content
		})
		if role then Lib.RegisterThemeText(label, role) end
	end

	local white = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	Label(string.format("%s  |  %d of %d compatible", report.executor, #report.ok, report.total), 13, Enum.Font.GothamBold, white, "Primary")

	local function Section(title, color, hex, mark, list, details)
		if #list == 0 then return end
		Label(string.format("%s (%d)", title, #list), 13, Enum.Font.GothamBold, color)
		for _, record in ipairs(list) do
			local entry = record.entry
			local note = (not details and not record.deep) and ' <font color="#8c8c8c">(detected only)</font>' or ""
			local line = details and ("Affects: " .. entry.desc) or entry.desc
			Label(
				string.format('<font color="%s"><b>%s  %s</b></font>%s\n<font color="#8c8c8c">%s</font>', hex, mark, entry.label or entry.names[1], note, line),
				12, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, white, "Primary", true
			)
		end
	end

	Section("Compatible", Color3.fromRGB(46, 213, 115), "#2ed573", "✓", report.ok, false)
	Section("Incompatible", Color3.fromRGB(235, 87, 87), "#eb5757", "✕", report.bad, true)
	Section("Optional, unavailable", Color3.fromRGB(230, 162, 60), "#e6a23c", "–", report.optional, true)
	modal.Open()
end
