		}), "Primary")
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 24), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -2, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = tostring(#group[2]),
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130), TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Parent = groupRow
		}), "Secondary")

		for _, entry in ipairs(group[2]) do
			local row = Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15), LayoutOrder = Next(), Parent = scroll,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12) }),
				Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128), Transparency = 0.88, Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }),
				Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 12), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 12), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 16), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 14) })
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeElement(row, "BackgroundColor3", 0.5)
			Lib.HoverStroke(row)

			local text = Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = row,
				Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 3), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
			})

			local name = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 1, Text = entry.label or entry.names[1],
				TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245), TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = text
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(name, "Primary")

			local alias = #entry.names > 1 and ("\nAlso accepts: " .. table.concat(entry.names, ", ", 2)) or ""
			local desc = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 2,
				Text = entry.desc .. alias, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(145, 145, 145), TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextWrapped = true,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, Parent = text
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(desc, "Secondary")

			chips[entry] = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(74, 22), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0),
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128), BackgroundTransparency = 0.85, Text = entry.optional and "Optional" or "Required",
				TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = row,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
			})
		end
	end

	local busy = false
	run.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if busy then return end
		busy = true
		Lib.PlayClick()
		run.Text = "Testing..."
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, report = pcall(Lib.RunCompat)
			busy = false
			run.Text = "Run Test"
			if not ok then
				Lib.Notify({ Title = "Compatibility", Text = "Test failed: " .. tostring(report):sub(1, 80) })
				return
			end
			for entry, chip in pairs(chips) do
				local status = STATUS[entry.status]
				if status then
					chip.Text, chip.TextColor3 = status[1], status[2]
					chip.BackgroundColor3, chip.BackgroundTransparency = status[2], 0.82
				end
			end
			Lib.ShowCompat(report)
		end)
	end)
end

function Lib.BuildDiscordButton(parent)
	local CODE = "GjMcEKnRQJ"
	local URL = "https://discord.gg/" .. CODE
	local ICON = ""
	local UIS, Http, Gui = Services.UserInputService, Services.HttpService, Services.GuiService
	local busy = false

	local function Palette(hover)
		if State.LightTheme then
			return hover and Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30) or Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110), hover and 0.92 or 1, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		end
		return hover and Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 210) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), hover and 0.96 or 1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	end

	local textColor, transparency, fill = Palette(false)

	local button = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
		Name = "DiscordButton", Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 34), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 1, -16), BackgroundColor3 = fill, BackgroundTransparency = transparency,
		AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "Discord", TextColor3 = textColor, TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = parent,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7) }),
		Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12) })
	})

	local icon
	if ICON ~= "" then
		icon = Lib.Create("ImageLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -8), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Image = "rbxassetid://" .. ICON, ImageColor3 = textColor, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, Parent = button
		})
		local function Place() icon.Position = UDim2.new(0, button.TextBounds.X + 8, 0.5, -8) end
		button:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextBounds"):Connect(Place)
		Place()
	end

	local function Apply(hover, time)
		local color, alpha, base = Palette(hover)
		Lib.Tween(button, time, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { TextColor3 = color, BackgroundTransparency = alpha, BackgroundColor3 = base })
		if icon then
			Lib.Tween(icon, time, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { ImageColor3 = color })
		end
	end

	local function IsMobile()
		local ok, platform = pcall(UIS.GetPlatform, UIS)
		if ok and (platform == Enum.Platform.Android or platform == Enum.Platform.IOS) then return true end
		return UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled and not UIS.MouseEnabled
	end

	local function Copy()
		local copy = setclipboard or toclipboard or set_clipboard
		if not copy then return false end
		return (pcall(copy, URL))
	end

	local function OpenViaClient()
		local send = (syn and syn.request) or http_request or request or (fluxus and fluxus.request) or (http and http.request)
		if not send then return false end
		local body = Http:JSONEncode({ cmd = "INVITE_BROWSER", args = { code = CODE }, nonce = Http:GenerateGUID(false) })
		for port = 6463, 6472 do
			local ok, response = pcall(send, {
				Url = "http://127.0.0.1:" .. port .. "/rpc?v=1", Method = "POST", Body = body,
				Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json", Origin = "https://discord.com" }
			})
			if ok and type(response) == "table" and (response.Success or response.StatusCode == 200) then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function Open()
		if pcall(Gui.OpenBrowserWindow, Gui, URL) then return true end
		return OpenViaClient()
	end

	button.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Apply(true, 0.15) end)
	button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		Apply(false, 0.15)
		Lib.Tween(button, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 34) })
	end)
	button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
		Lib.PlayClick()
		Lib.Tween(button, 0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 31) })
	end)
	button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
		Lib.Tween(button, 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 34) })
	end)

	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if busy then return end
		busy = true
		task.spawn(function()
			local opened = not IsMobile() and Open()
			local copied = Copy()
			Lib.Notify({
				Title = "Discord",
				Text = (opened or copied) and "Check your discord or clipboard." or ("Clipboard is unavailable: discord.gg/" .. CODE)
			})
			task.wait(1)
			busy = false
		end)
	end)
end

do
	local HomeSection = Lib.Create("CanvasGroup", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, Parent = UI.ContentArea })
	UI.HomeSection = HomeSection

	local HomeTitle = Lib.Create("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 30), Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 10), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Home", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), TextSize = 20, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left })
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(HomeTitle, "Primary")

	local SideBar = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = HomeSection, HomeTitle })

	local HomeTabs = Lib.Create("ScrollingFrame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -90), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ScrollBarThickness = 2, ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100), ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = SideBar
	})

	local MakeTab, HomeViews
	Lib.SwitchTab, MakeTab, HomeViews = Lib.CreateTabSystem(HomeSection, HomeTabs, "CurrentTab")

	local View_Overview = MakeTab("Overview", 50)
	local View_Account = MakeTab("Account", 90)
	local View_Achievements = MakeTab("Achievements", 130)
	Lib.BuildDevelopers(MakeTab("Developers", 170))
	Lib.BuildUpdateLog(MakeTab("Update Log", 210))
	Lib.BuildInfo(MakeTab("Info", 250))
	Lib.BuildDiscordButton(SideBar)
	UI.HomeSearch = { SideBar, HomeTabs, HomeViews }

	Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 14), Parent = View_Overview })

	Lib.GraphKit = {}
	do
		local N = 15
		local Kits = Lib.GraphKit
		local Quad, Out = Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out

		local function Draw(g, mode)
			local cols, vals = g.cols, g.vals
			local count = #cols
			local sum, peak = 0, 0
			for i = 2, count do
				local v = vals[cols[i]] or 0
				sum = sum + v
				if v > peak then peak = v end
			end
			local avg = sum / (count - 1)
			local top = math.max(g.floor, peak * 1.15)
			g.avgLabel.Text = "avg " .. math.floor(avg + 0.5)
			local avgPos = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1 - math.clamp(avg / top, 0.06, 1), -2)
			if mode == "tween" then Lib.Tween(g.avgLine, 0.5, Quad, Out, { Position = avgPos }) else g.avgLine.Position = avgPos end

			for i = 1, count do
				local col = cols[i]
				local slot = i - 2
				local h = math.clamp((vals[col] or 0) / top, 0.06, 1)
				local fade = slot < 0 and 1 or 0.8 - 0.7 * (slot / (N - 1))
				local pos = UDim2.new(slot / N, 2, 1, -2)
				if mode == "tween" then
					if i == count then
						col.Position = UDim2.new(1, 2, 1, -2)
						col.Size = UDim2.new(1 / N, -4, 0.06, 0)
						col.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					end
					Lib.Tween(col, 0.55, Quad, Out, { Position = pos, Size = UDim2.new(1 / N, -4, h, 0), BackgroundTransparency = fade })
				elseif mode == "intro" then
					col.Position = pos
					col.BackgroundTransparency = fade
					col.Size = UDim2.new(1 / N, -4, 0.06, 0)
					task.delay((i - 1) * 0.03, function()
						if col.Parent then Lib.Tween(col, 0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Out, { Size = UDim2.new(1 / N, -4, h, 0) }) end
					end)
				else
					col.Position = pos
					col.Size = UDim2.new(1 / N, -4, h, 0)
					col.BackgroundTransparency = fade
				end
			end
		end

		function Lib.GraphPush(key, value, text, show)
			local g = Kits[key]
			g.value.Text = text
			local col = table.remove(g.cols, 1)
			g.vals[col] = value
			g.cols[#g.cols + 1] = col
			if not show then
				g.dirty = true
				return
			end
			local mode = g.dirty and "intro" or "tween"
			g.dirty = false
			Draw(g, mode)
		end

		function Lib.GraphIntro()
			for _, g in pairs(Kits) do
				g.dirty = false
				Draw(g, "intro")
			end
		end

		function Lib.BuildGraphCard(parent, title, layout, key, floor)
			local primary = (Lib.Palette and Lib.Palette.Primary) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			local card = Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1 / 3, -8, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15), LayoutOrder = layout, Parent = parent,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12) }),
				Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128), Transparency = 0.88, Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeElement(card, "BackgroundColor3", 0.5)
			local stroke = card:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
			card.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Lib.Tween(stroke, 0.2, Quad, Out, { Transparency = 0.6 }) end)
			card.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Lib.Tween(stroke, 0.25, Quad, Out, { Transparency = 0.88 }) end)

			local titleLbl = Lib.Create("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 12), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = title, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = card })
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(titleLbl, "Secondary")
			local avgLabel = Lib.Create("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 16), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 12), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "avg 0", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120), TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Parent = card })
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(avgLabel, "Secondary")
			local dot = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 17), BackgroundColor3 = primary, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = card, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }) })
			Services.Tween:Create(dot, TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.8 }):Play()

			local value = Lib.Create("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 28), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "0", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), TextSize = 22, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = card })
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(value, "Primary")
			UI.Labels[key] = value

			local holder = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, -84), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 68), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = card })
			local list = UI.Graphs[key]
			local base = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -1), BackgroundColor3 = primary, BackgroundTransparency = 0.88, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2, Parent = holder })
			local avgLine = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -8), BackgroundColor3 = primary, BackgroundTransparency = 0.78, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3, Parent = holder })

			local kit = { cols = {}, vals = {}, value = value, avgLabel = avgLabel, avgLine = avgLine, floor = floor, dirty = true }
			for i = 1, N + 1 do
				local bar = Lib.Create("Frame", {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Size = UDim2.new(1 / N, -4, 0.06, 0), Position = UDim2.new((i - 2) / N, 2, 1, -2),
					BackgroundColor3 = primary, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = holder,
					Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3) }),
					Lib.Create("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.55) }) })
				})
				kit.cols[i] = bar
				kit.vals[bar] = 0
				list[#list + 1] = bar
			end
			list[#list + 1] = base
			list[#list + 1] = avgLine
			list[#list + 1] = dot
			Kits[key] = kit
			Draw(kit, "snap")
			return card
		end
	end

	do
		local Version = Lib.Version
		local plate = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 66), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15), LayoutOrder = 0, Parent = View_Overview,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12) }),
			Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128), Transparency = 0.88, Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(plate, "BackgroundColor3", 0.5)

		local badge = Lib.Create("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 42), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 12), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), BackgroundTransparency = 0.92, Text = "SH", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), TextSize = 15, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = plate, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 11) }) })
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(badge, "Primary")

		local cap = Lib.Create("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 14), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(68, 11), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Script Version", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140), TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = plate })
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(cap, "Secondary")

		local row = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -250, 0, 28), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(68, 27), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = plate,
			Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, Padding = UDim.new(0, 10), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
		})
		local verLabel = Lib.Create("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 28), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, LayoutOrder = 1, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = Version.Display, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), TextSize = 22, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = row })
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(verLabel, "Primary")

		local pill = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, LayoutOrder = 2, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128), BackgroundTransparency = 0.85, Parent = row,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
			Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 9), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10) }),
			Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
		})
		local pillDot = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), LayoutOrder = 1, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = pill, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }) })
		local pillText = Lib.Create("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, LayoutOrder = 2, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220), TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Parent = pill })
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(pillText, "Primary")

		local check = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, 0), AutoButtonColor = false,
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), BackgroundTransparency = 0.92, Text = "Check for Updates", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235), TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Parent = plate,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }),
			Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 14), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 14) }),
			Lib.Create("UIScale", { Scale = 1 })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(check, "Primary")
		local checkScale = check:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		check.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Lib.Tween(check, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.82 }) end)
		check.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			Lib.Tween(check, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.92 })
			Lib.Tween(checkScale, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Scale = 1 })
		end)
		check.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() Lib.Tween(checkScale, 0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Scale = 0.94 }) end)
		check.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() Lib.Tween(checkScale, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Scale = 1 }) end)
		check.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			Version.Check()
		end)

		local tones = {
			checking = { Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), "Checking for updates..." },
			latest = { Color3.fromRGB(96, 214, 128), "Up to date" },
			outdated = { Color3.fromRGB(255, 184, 77), "Update available" },
			failed = { Color3.fromRGB(214, 96, 96), "Update check failed" }
		}
		tones.idle = tones.checking
		Lib.VersionTones = tones

		local pulse
		Version.Listen(function(status)
			if not plate.Parent then return end
			if pulse then
				pulse:Cancel()
				pulse = nil
			end
			local tone = tones[status] or tones.idle
			Lib.Tween(pillDot, 0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { BackgroundColor3 = tone[1] })
			pillDot.BackgroundTransparency = 0
			pillText.Text = tone[2]
			if tone == tones.checking then
				pulse = Services.Tween:Create(pillDot, TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.75 })
				pulse:Play()
			end
		end)
	end

	local StatsArea = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 160), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = View_Overview, Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 12) }) })
	Lib.BuildGraphCard(StatsArea, "FPS", 1, "FPS", 60)
	Lib.BuildGraphCard(StatsArea, "Ping", 2, "Ping", 120)
	Lib.BuildGraphCard(StatsArea, "Players", 3, "Players", 8)
	View_Overview:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if View_Overview.Visible then Lib.GraphIntro() end

	local function MakeCopyCard(title, val, layout)
		local card = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15), LayoutOrder = layout, Parent = InfoArea,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12) }),

		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(card, "BackgroundColor3", 0.5)
		local stroke = card:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
		card.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Lib.Tween(stroke, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Transparency = 0.6 }) end)
		card.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Lib.Tween(stroke, 0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Transparency = 0.88 }) end)

		local tLbl = Lib.Create("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 11), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = title, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140), TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = card })
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(tLbl, "Secondary")
		local vLbl = Lib.Create("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 28), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = val, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235), TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = card })
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(vLbl, "Primary")

		local btn = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 30), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, 0), AutoButtonColor = false,
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), BackgroundTransparency = 0.92, Text = "Copy", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Parent = card,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }),
			Lib.Create("UIScale", { Scale = 1 })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(btn, "Primary")
		local scale = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Lib.Tween(btn, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.82 }) end)
		btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			Lib.Tween(btn, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.92 })
			Lib.Tween(scale, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Scale = 1 })
		end)
		btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() Lib.Tween(scale, 0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Scale = 0.93 }) end)
		btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() Lib.Tween(scale, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Scale = 1 }) end)
		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			local copy = setclipboard or toclipboard or set_clipboard
			if copy then pcall(copy, tostring(val)) end
			btn.Text = "Copied!"
			task.delay(1.5, function() if btn.Parent then btn.Text = "Copy" end end)
		end)
	end

	local function UpdateDecorButtonState()
		if not State.Ach_10Hours_Claimed then
			ToggleDecorBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
			ToggleDecorBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120)
			ToggleDecorBtn.Text = "Locked"
			PulseDescLabel.Text = "Locked (Reach 10h achievement)"
			PulseDescLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 80)
		else
			PulseDescLabel.Text = "Unlocked from 10 Hours Played"
			PulseDescLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140)
			if State.IsDecorActive then
				ToggleDecorBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Lib.GetActiveSwitchColor()
				ToggleDecorBtn.TextColor3 = State.LightTheme and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
				ToggleDecorBtn.Text = "Equipped"
			else
				ToggleDecorBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
				ToggleDecorBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
				ToggleDecorBtn.Text = "Equip"
			end
		end
		AvatarGlowRing.Visible = State.IsDecorActive
		if State.IsDecorActive then GlowTween:Play() else GlowTween:Pause() end
	end

	local function RefreshAchievementUI()
		local hours = State.TotalPlaytimeSeconds / 3600
		if State.Ach_10Hours_Claimed then
			ClaimAchBtn.Text = "Claimed ✓"
			ClaimAchBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
			ClaimAchBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120)
			ClaimAchBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
		elseif hours >= 10 then
			ClaimAchBtn.Text = "Claim Reward"
			ClaimAchBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Lib.GetActiveSwitchColor()
			ClaimAchBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			ClaimAchBtn.AutoButtonColor = true
		else
			ClaimAchBtn.Text = string.format("%.1f / 10h", math.min(hours, 10))
			ClaimAchBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 24)
			ClaimAchBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130)
			ClaimAchBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
		end
	end

	ClaimAchBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Lib.PlayClick()
		local hours = State.TotalPlaytimeSeconds / 3600
		if (hours >= 10 or App.Player.Name:lower() == "cherrycalcor") and not State.Ach_10Hours_Claimed then
			State.Ach_10Hours_Claimed = true
			State.IsDecorActive = true
			Lib.SavePlaytimeData()
			RefreshAchievementUI()
			UpdateDecorButtonState()
			Lib.Notify({ Title = "Achievement Unlocked", Text = "You unlocked Profile Decoration!" })
		end
	end)

	UI.AchUpdateCallback = RefreshAchievementUI
	RefreshAchievementUI()
	UpdateDecorButtonState()
end

do
	Lib.SearchItems, Lib.SearchGroups, Lib.SearchScrolls = {}, {}, {}

	function Lib.SearchAdd(card, item, title)
		if not Lib.SearchGroups[card] then return end
		local list = Lib.SearchItems
		local index = #list + 1
		list[index] = { Item = item, Parent = card, Title = Lib.Lower(title), Alt = Lib.Lower(Lib.Ru(title)) }
		item.LayoutOrder = index
	end

	function Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(parentScroll, title, layoutOrder)
		local GroupContainer = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			LayoutOrder = layoutOrder,
			Parent = parentScroll
		})

		local grpTitle = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = title,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220),
			TextSize = 14,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			Parent = GroupContainer
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(grpTitle, "Primary")

		local grp = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 26),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15),
			Parent = GroupContainer,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }),
			Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(grp, "BackgroundColor3", 0.5)
		if Lib.SearchScrolls[parentScroll] then Lib.SearchGroups[grp] = true end
		return grp
	end

	function Lib.CreateSettingToggleItem(parentCard, title, desc, defaultState, onToggle, isLast)
		local Item = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Parent = parentCard
		})

		local titleLabel = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 20),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 7),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = title,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240),
			TextSize = 13,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			Parent = Item
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(titleLabel, "Primary")

		local descLabel = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 16),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 26),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = desc,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130),
			TextSize = 11,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			Parent = Item
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(descLabel, "Secondary")

		local inactiveBg = Lib.Palette.SwitchOff
		local activeBg = Lib.GetActiveSwitchColor()

		local SwitchBg = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 22),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -54, 0.5, -11),
			BackgroundColor3 = defaultState and activeBg or inactiveBg,
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			Parent = Item,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
		})

		local SwitchKnob = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
			Position = defaultState and UDim2.new(1, -19, 0.5, -8) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -8),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
			Parent = SwitchBg,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
		})

		if not isLast then
			Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 1),
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -1),
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25),
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Parent = Item
			})
		end

		local state = defaultState
		local function UpdateSwitchVisual()
			Lib.SetSwitch(SwitchBg, SwitchKnob, state, state and Lib.GetActiveSwitchColor() or Lib.Palette.SwitchOff, true)
		end

		Lib.BindSwitchPress(SwitchBg, SwitchKnob)
		Lib.RegisterSwitch(SwitchBg, function() return state end, UpdateSwitchVisual)

		Lib.ToggleControls[title] = {
			Item = Item,
			Get = function() return state end,
			Set = function(value)
				if state == value then return end
				state = value
				UpdateSwitchVisual()
				onToggle(state)
				local hook = Lib.ToggleChanged
				if hook then hook(title, state) end
			end
		}

		SwitchBg.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			state = not state
			UpdateSwitchVisual()
			onToggle(state)
			local hook = Lib.ToggleChanged
			if hook then hook(title, state) end
			Lib.Notify({ Title = title, Text = state and "Enabled" or "Disabled" })
		end)

		Lib.SearchAdd(parentCard, Item, title)
		return Item
	end

	function Lib.CreateSettingSliderItem(parentCard, title, desc, minVal, maxVal, defaultVal, onChange, isLast, suffix, step)
		local digits = step and #(tostring(step):match("%.(%d+)") or "") or 0
		local function Fmt(value)
			if not step then return tostring(math.floor(value)) end
			return string.format("%." .. digits .. "f", value)
		end

		local Item = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Parent = parentCard
		})

		local titleLabel = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -190, 0, 20),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 7),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = title,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240),
			TextSize = 13,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			Parent = Item
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(titleLabel, "Primary")

		local DescLabel = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -190, 0, 16),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 26),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = desc .. " (" .. Fmt(defaultVal) .. (suffix or "") .. ")",
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130),
			TextSize = 11,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			Parent = Item
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(DescLabel, "Secondary")

		local SliderContainer = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(130, 24),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -144, 0.5, -12),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Parent = Item
		})

		local SliderTrack = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 4),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -2),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Parent = SliderContainer,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
		})

		local SliderFill = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.5,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Parent = SliderTrack,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
		})

		local SliderKnob = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 12),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Parent = SliderTrack,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
		})

		if not isLast then
			Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 1),
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -1),
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
				BackgroundTransparency = 0.9,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Parent = Item
			})
		end

		local dragging = false

		local function UpdateSlider(inputPos)
			local trackAbsPos = SliderTrack.AbsolutePosition.X
			local trackAbsSize = SliderTrack.AbsoluteSize.X
			local relX = math.clamp((inputPos.X - trackAbsPos) / trackAbsSize, 0, 1)
			local currentVal = math.floor(minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * relX)
			local shown = relX
			if step then
				currentVal = tonumber(Fmt(math.clamp(minVal + math.floor((maxVal - minVal) * relX / step + 0.5) * step, minVal, maxVal)))
				shown = math.clamp((currentVal - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0, 1)
			end

			SliderKnob.Position = UDim2.new(shown, 0, 0.5, 0)
			SliderFill.Size = UDim2.new(shown, 0, 1, 0)
			DescLabel.Text = desc .. " (" .. Fmt(currentVal) .. (suffix or "") .. ")"
			onChange(currentVal)
		end

		local function Display(value)
			local percent = math.clamp((value - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0, 1)
			SliderKnob.Position = UDim2.new(percent, 0, 0.5, 0)
			SliderFill.Size = UDim2.new(percent, 0, 1, 0)
			DescLabel.Text = desc .. " (" .. Fmt(value) .. (suffix or "") .. ")"
		end

		Display(defaultVal)
		Lib.SliderControls[title] = function(value)
			Display(value)
			onChange(value)
		end

		local TriggerBtn = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "",
			Parent = SliderContainer
		})

		TriggerBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging = true
				UpdateSlider(input.Position)
			end
		end)

		Lib.C(Services.UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
			if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
				UpdateSlider(input.Position)
			end
		end)

		Lib.C(Services.UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)

		Lib.SearchAdd(parentCard, Item, title)
		return Item
	end

	function Lib.CreateSettingChoiceItem(parentCard, title, options, default, onChange, isLast, multi)
		local entries = {}
		for i, option in ipairs(options) do
			entries[i] = type(option) == "table" and option or { option, option }
		end
		local cycle = not multi and #entries > 4
		local selected, current = {}, entries[1][2]
		if multi then
			for _, value in ipairs(default or {}) do selected[value] = true end
		elseif default ~= nil then
			current = default
		end

		local Item = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = parentCard })

		local titleLabel = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, 0),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = title,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240),
			TextSize = 13,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			Parent = Item
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(titleLabel, "Primary")

		local holder = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 24),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Parent = Item,
			Lib.Create("UIListLayout", {
				FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
				Padding = UDim.new(0, 4),
				SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
				VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
			})
		})

		local pills = {}

		local function Active(value)
			if multi then return selected[value] == true end
			return current == value
		end

		local function Label(value)
			for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
				if entry[2] == value then return entry[1] end
			end
			return tostring(value)
		end

		local function Snapshot()
			local copy = {}
			for key in pairs(selected) do copy[key] = true end
			return copy
		end

		local function Paint()
			if cycle then
				pills[1].Text = Label(current)
				return
			end
			local on, off = Lib.Palette.SwitchOn, Lib.Palette.SwitchOff
			for i, pill in ipairs(pills) do
				local active = Active(entries[i][2])
				Lib.Tween(pill, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, {
					BackgroundColor3 = active and on or off,
					TextColor3 = active and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170)
				})
			end
		end

		for i = 1, cycle and 1 or #entries do
			local pill = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 24),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
				LayoutOrder = i,
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.SwitchOff,
				TextColor3 = cycle and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170),
				Text = cycle and Label(current) or entries[i][1],
				TextSize = 11,
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
				Parent = holder,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }),
				Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10) })
			})
			pills[i] = pill
			if not cycle then
				Lib.RegisterSwitch(pill, function() return Active(entries[i][2]) end, Paint)
			end
			pill.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				Lib.PlayClick()
				if cycle then
					local index = 1
					for j, entry in ipairs(entries) do
						if entry[2] == current then
							index = j
							break
						end
					end
					current = entries[index % #entries + 1][2]
					Paint()
					onChange(current)
				elseif multi then
					local value = entries[i][2]
					selected[value] = not selected[value] or nil
					Paint()
					onChange(Snapshot())
				else
					current = entries[i][2]
					Paint()
					onChange(current)
				end
			end)
		end
		Paint()

		Lib.ChoiceControls[title] = {
			Get = function()
				if not multi then return current end
				local list = {}
				for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
					if selected[entry[2]] then list[#list + 1] = entry[2] end
				end
				return list
			end,
			Set = function(value)
				if multi then
					table.clear(selected)
					for _, item in ipairs(type(value) == "table" and value or { value }) do selected[item] = true end
					Paint()
					onChange(Snapshot())
					return
				end
				for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
					if entry[2] == value then
						current = value
						Paint()
						onChange(value)
						return
					end
				end
			end
		}

		if not isLast then
			Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 1),
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -1),
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
				BackgroundTransparency = 0.9,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Parent = Item
			})
		end

		Lib.SearchAdd(parentCard, Item, title)
		return Item
	end

	function Lib.BindDrag(area, onMove)
		area.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			local kind = input.UserInputType
			if kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			onMove(input.Position)
			local UIS, moveConn, endConn = Services.UserInputService
			moveConn = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(changed)
				local moved = changed.UserInputType
				if moved == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or moved == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then onMove(changed.Position) end
			end)
			endConn = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(ended)
				local released = ended.UserInputType
				if released == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or released == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
					moveConn:Disconnect()
					endConn:Disconnect()
				end
			end)
		end)
	end

	function Lib.CreateColorItem(group, title, tbl, key, last, onChange)
		local h, s, v = tbl[key]:ToHSV()
		local open = false
		local item = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = group })
		local label = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 46), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = title,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = item
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(label, "Primary")
		local swatch = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 22), Position = UDim2.new(1, -58, 0, 12), BackgroundColor3 = tbl[key], Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = item,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }),
			Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.8 })
		})
		local svArea = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 70), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 52), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, 1), Parent = item,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) })
		})
		Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = svArea,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }),
			Lib.Create("UIGradient", { Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1) })
		})
		Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = svArea,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }),
			Lib.Create("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1, 0) })
		})
		local svKnob = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(s, 1 - v), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = svArea,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
			Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Thickness = 2, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
		})
		local svHit = Lib.Create("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = svArea })
		local hueSteps = {}
		for i = 0, 6 do hueSteps[#hueSteps + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(i / 6, Color3.fromHSV(i / 6, 1, 1)) end
		local hueBar = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 12), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 130), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Parent = item,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
			Lib.Create("UIGradient", { Color = ColorSequence.new(hueSteps) })
		})
		local hueKnob = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(h, 0, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Parent = hueBar,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
			Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.6 })
		})
		local hueHit = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -12), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = hueBar
		})
		if not last then
			Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = item
			})
		end

		local function Paint(exact)
			local color = exact or Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v)
			tbl[key] = color
			swatch.BackgroundColor3 = color
			svArea.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, 1)
			svKnob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(s, 1 - v)
			hueKnob.Position = UDim2.new(h, 0, 0.5, 0)
			if onChange then onChange(color) end
		end

		Lib.BindDrag(svHit, function(position)
			s = math.clamp((position.X - svArea.AbsolutePosition.X) / svArea.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
			v = 1 - math.clamp((position.Y - svArea.AbsolutePosition.Y) / svArea.AbsoluteSize.Y, 0, 1)
			Paint()
		end)
		Lib.BindDrag(hueHit, function(position)
			h = math.clamp((position.X - hueBar.AbsolutePosition.X) / hueBar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
			Paint()
		end)
		swatch.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			open = not open
			Lib.Tween(item, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, open and 154 or 46) })
		end)

		return item, function(color)
			local nh, ns, nv = color:ToHSV()
			if ns > 0 and nv > 0 then h = nh end
			s, v = ns, nv
			Paint(color)
		end
	end

	function Lib.CreateSettingButtonItem(parentCard, title, desc, onClick, isLast)
		local Item = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0,
			Text = "",

			Parent = parentCard,

		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(Item, "BackgroundColor3", 0.5)

			TextSize = 13,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			Parent = Item

		Lib.RegisterThemeText(TitleLabel, "Primary")

		local DescLabel = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 16),

			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = desc,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130),
			TextSize = 11,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			Parent = Item
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(DescLabel, "Secondary")

		if not isLast then
			Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 1),
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -1),
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
				BackgroundTransparency = 0.9,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Parent = Item
			})
		end

		Item.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Lib.Tween(Item, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Lighten(Lib.Theme.Card, 0.055) }) end)
		Item.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Lib.Tween(Item, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Theme.Card }) end)
		Item.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			Lib.Tween(Item, 0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Lighten(Lib.Theme.Card, 0.105) })
		end)
		Item.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() Lib.Tween(Item, 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Lighten(Lib.Theme.Card, 0.055) }) end)
		Item.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() onClick(TitleLabel) end)

		Lib.SearchAdd(parentCard, Item, title)
		return Item
	end
end

Lib.SearchShown = {}

do
	local Http, Workspace = Services.HttpService, Services.Workspace
	local FILE, LIMIT = "SeptusHub_Waypoints.json", 50
	local Quad, Quint, Back = Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingStyle.Back
	local Out, In = Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingDirection.In
	local KEY = tostring(game.PlaceId)
	local api = {}
	Lib.Waypoints = api

	local data, list = {}, nil
	local rows, markers = {}, {}
	local view, empty, folder
	local markersOn, order = false, 0

	if type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			if isfile(FILE) then
				local decoded = Http:JSONDecode(readfile(FILE))
				if type(decoded) == "table" then data = decoded end
			end
		end)
	end
	list = type(data[KEY]) == "table" and data[KEY] or {}
	data[KEY] = list
	for index = #list, 1, -1 do
		local entry = list[index]
		if type(entry) ~= "table" or type(entry.n) ~= "string" or type(entry.x) ~= "number" or type(entry.y) ~= "number" or type(entry.z) ~= "number" then
			table.remove(list, index)
		end
	end

	local function Round(value)
		return math.floor(value * 100 + 0.5) / 100
	end

	local function Commit()
		if type(writefile) ~= "function" then return end
		pcall(function() writefile(FILE, Http:JSONEncode(data)) end)
	end

	local function Root()
		local character = App.Player.Character
		return character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	end

	local function Clean(text)
		text = tostring(text or ""):gsub("%c", "")
		text = text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
		local length = utf8.len(text)
		if not length then
			text = text:gsub("[\128-\255]", "")
			length = #text
		end
		if length > 24 then text = text:sub(1, (utf8.offset(text, 25) or #text + 1) - 1) end
		return text
	end

	local function Distance(origin, entry)
		local dx, dy, dz = origin.X - entry.x, origin.Y - entry.y, origin.Z - entry.z
		return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
	end

	local function Format(distance)
		return distance and (math.floor(distance + 0.5) .. " st") or "—"
	end

	function api.List()
		return list
	end

	function api.Label(entry)
		local root = Root()
		return Format(root and Distance(root.Position, entry))
	end

	local function Container()
		if folder and folder.Parent then return folder end
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "SeptusWaypoints"
		folder.Parent = Workspace.CurrentCamera or Workspace
		return folder
	end

	local function Unmark(entry)
		local marker = markers[entry]
		if marker then
			markers[entry] = nil
			marker.Part:Destroy()
		end
	end

	local function Mark(entry)
		if markers[entry] then return end
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.CastShadow = false
		part.Transparency = 1
		part.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
		part.Position = Vector3.new(entry.x, entry.y, entry.z)
		local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 38)
		gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
		gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
		gui.LightInfluence = 0
		gui.MaxDistance = 2500
		gui.Adornee = part
		local name = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		name.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
		name.Text = entry.n
		name.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		name.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.55
		name.TextSize = 13
		name.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		name.Parent = gui
		local distance = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		distance.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		distance.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16)
		distance.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
		distance.Text = ""
		distance.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190)
		distance.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.6
		distance.TextSize = 10
		distance.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
		distance.Parent = gui
		local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
		dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7)
		dot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -3, 0, 30)
		dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		corner.Parent = dot
		dot.Parent = gui
		gui.Parent = part
		part.Parent = Container()
		markers[entry] = { Part = part, Distance = distance, Name = name }
	end

	local function SyncMarkers()
		if markersOn then
			for index = 1, #list do Mark(list[index]) end
		else
			for entry in pairs(markers) do Unmark(entry) end
		end
	end

	local function Chip(parent, text, size, position)
		local chip = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = size, Position = position, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), Text = text, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240),
			TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = parent,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(chip, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7)
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(chip, "Primary")
		local scale = Lib.Create("UIScale", { Parent = chip })
		chip.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			Lib.Tween(chip, 0.15, Quad, Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Lighten(Lib.ThemeColor(0.7), 0.07) })
		end)
		chip.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			Lib.Tween(chip, 0.2, Quad, Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Lib.ThemeColor(0.7) })
			Lib.Tween(scale, 0.2, Quad, Out, { Scale = 1 })
		end)
		chip.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
			Lib.Tween(scale, 0.08, Quad, Out, { Scale = 0.94 })
		end)
		chip.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
			Lib.Tween(scale, 0.3, Back, Out, { Scale = 1 })
		end)
		return chip
	end
	Lib.UIChip = Chip

local ROW_H, EDIT_H = 46, 92

local function MakeRow(entry, animate)
	order += 1
	local row = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, animate and 0 or ROW_H), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ClipsDescendants = true, LayoutOrder = order, Parent = view
	})
	local name = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -146, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 6), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = entry.n,
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = row
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(name, "Primary")
	local sub = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -146, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 25), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = api.Label(entry),
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130), TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = row
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(sub, "Secondary")
	local go = Chip(row, "Go", UDim2.fromOffset(46, 28), UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, 9))
	local edit = Chip(row, "✎", UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 9))
	local del = Chip(row, "×", UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), UDim2.new(1, -42, 0, 9))

	local stroke = Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120), Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.8 })
	local field = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 30), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 52), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), Parent = row,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7) }),
		stroke
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeElement(field, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7, true)
	local box = Lib.Create("TextBox", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = entry.n, PlaceholderText = "Waypoint name",
		PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ClearTextOnFocus = false, Parent = field
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(box, "Primary")
	local here = Chip(row, "Move Here", UDim2.fromOffset(76, 30), UDim2.new(1, -148, 0, 52))
	local done = Chip(row, "Done", UDim2.fromOffset(52, 30), UDim2.new(1, -66, 0, 52))
	Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = row
	})

	local open = false
	local function SetOpen(value)
		open = value
		Lib.Tween(row, 0.28, Quint, Out, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, value and EDIT_H or ROW_H) })
		Lib.Tween(stroke, 0.2, Quad, Out, { Transparency = 0.8 })
		if value then
			box.Text = entry.n
			box:CaptureFocus()
		end
	end

	box.Focused:Connect(function()
		Lib.Tween(stroke, 0.2, Quad, Out, { Transparency = 0.4 })
	end)
	box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
		Lib.Tween(stroke, 0.2, Quad, Out, { Transparency = 0.8 })
		if enter then
			api.Rename(entry, box.Text)
			box.Text = entry.n
		end
	end)
	go.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Lib.PlayClick()
		api.Go(entry)
	end)
	edit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Lib.PlayClick()
		SetOpen(not open)
	end)
	here.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Lib.PlayClick()
		api.Move(entry)
	end)
	done.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Lib.PlayClick()
		api.Rename(entry, box.Text)
		SetOpen(false)
	end)
	del.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Lib.PlayClick()
		api.Remove(entry)
	end)
	rows[entry] = { Row = row, Sub = sub, Name = name }
	if animate then Lib.Tween(row, 0.35, Quint, Out, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_H) }) end
end

function api.Rename(entry, text)
	text = Clean(text)
	if text == "" or text == entry.n then return false end
	entry.n = text
	Commit()
	local row = rows[entry]
	if row then row.Name.Text = text end
	local marker = markers[entry]
	if marker then marker.Name.Text = text end
	Lib.Notify({ Title = text, Text = "Waypoint renamed" })
	return true
end

function api.Move(entry)
	local root = Root()
	if not root then
		Lib.Notify({ Title = "Waypoints", Text = "Character not found" })
		return false
	end
	local position = root.Position
	local _, yaw = root.CFrame:ToOrientation()
	entry.x, entry.y, entry.z, entry.a = Round(position.X), Round(position.Y), Round(position.Z), Round(math.deg(yaw))
	Commit()
	local marker = markers[entry]
	if marker then marker.Part.Position = position end
	local row = rows[entry]
	if row then row.Sub.Text = Format(0) end
	Lib.Notify({ Title = entry.n, Text = "Waypoint moved" })
	return true
end
	function api.Go(entry)
		local root = Root()
		if not root then
			Lib.Notify({ Title = "Waypoints", Text = "Character not found" })
			return false
		end
		Lib.TeleHistory.Record(entry.n, root, CFrame.new(entry.x, entry.y, entry.z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(entry.a or 0), 0))
		api.Last = entry
		Lib.Notify({ Title = entry.n, Text = "Teleported! ✓" })
		return true
	end

	function api.AddHere(name)
		local root = Root()
		if not root then
			Lib.Notify({ Title = "Waypoints", Text = "Character not found" })
			return false
		end
		if #list >= LIMIT then
			Lib.Notify({ Title = "Waypoints", Text = "Waypoint limit reached" })
			return false
		end
		name = Clean(name)
		if name == "" then name = "Waypoint " .. (#list + 1) end
		local position = root.Position
		local _, yaw = root.CFrame:ToOrientation()
		local entry = { n = name, x = Round(position.X), y = Round(position.Y), z = Round(position.Z), a = Round(math.deg(yaw)) }
		list[#list + 1] = entry
		Commit()
		api.Last = entry
		if view then
			empty.Visible = false
			MakeRow(entry, true)
		end
		if markersOn then Mark(entry) end
		Lib.Notify({ Title = name, Text = "Waypoint saved" })
		return true
	end

	function api.Remove(entry)
		for index = 1, #list do
			if list[index] == entry then
				table.remove(list, index)
				break
			end
		end
		Unmark(entry)
		if api.Last == entry then api.Last = nil end
		Commit()
		local row = rows[entry]
		rows[entry] = nil
		if row then
			Lib.Tween(row.Row, 0.22, Quad, In, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0) }).Completed:Connect(function()
				row.Row:Destroy()
				if empty then empty.Visible = #list == 0 end
			end)
		elseif empty then
			empty.Visible = #list == 0
		end
	end

	function api.Build(scroll)
		local group = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(scroll, "Waypoints", 5)

		local input = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 56), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = -2, Parent = group })
		local stroke = Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120), Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.8 })
		local field = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -118, 0, 32), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 12), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), Parent = input,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7) }),
			stroke
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(field, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7, true)
		local box = Lib.Create("TextBox", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", PlaceholderText = "Waypoint name",
			PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ClearTextOnFocus = false, Parent = field
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(box, "Primary")
		local save = Chip(input, "Save Here", UDim2.fromOffset(88, 32), UDim2.new(1, -102, 0, 12))
		Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = input
		})
		box.Focused:Connect(function()
			Lib.Tween(stroke, 0.2, Quad, Out, { Transparency = 0.4 })
		end)
		box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
			Lib.Tween(stroke, 0.2, Quad, Out, { Transparency = 0.8 })
			if enter and api.AddHere(box.Text) then box.Text = "" end
		end)
		save.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			if api.AddHere(box.Text) then box.Text = "" end
		end)

		Lib.CreateSettingToggleItem(group, "Waypoint Markers", "Show saved points in the world with name and distance", false, function(value)
			markersOn = value
			SyncMarkers()
		end)

		view = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 100000, Parent = group,
			Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
		})
		empty = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "No waypoints saved for this place", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130),
			TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, LayoutOrder = -1, Visible = #list == 0, Parent = view
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(empty, "Secondary")
		for index = 1, #list do MakeRow(list[index], false) end

		table.insert(Lib.BindActions, {
			id = "WaypointSave", title = "Save Waypoint", desc = "Saves your current position as a waypoint",
			run = function() api.AddHere("") end
		})
		table.insert(Lib.BindActions, {
			id = "WaypointLast", title = "Teleport To Last Waypoint", desc = "Teleports to the last saved or used waypoint",
			run = function()
				if api.Last then api.Go(api.Last) end
			end
		})
	end

	function Lib.StopWaypoints()
		markersOn = false
		for entry in pairs(markers) do Unmark(entry) end
		if folder then
			folder:Destroy()
			folder = nil
		end
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while not State.Unloaded do
			task.wait(0.4)
			local root = Root()
			if root then
				local origin = root.Position
				if markersOn then
					for entry, marker in pairs(markers) do
						local text = Format(Distance(origin, entry))
						if marker.Distance.Text ~= text then marker.Distance.Text = text end
					end
				end
				if view and UI.Main and UI.Main.Visible and State.ActiveMain == "Features" and State.CurrentFeaturesTab == "Teleport" and not State.Minimized then
					for entry, row in pairs(rows) do
						local text = Format(Distance(origin, entry))
						if row.Sub.Text ~= text then row.Sub.Text = text end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

do
	local Workspace, UIS = Services.Workspace, Services.UserInputService
	local PlayersService = game:GetService("Players")
	local Quad, Quint = Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint
	local Out = Enum.EasingDirection.Out
	local RANGES = { 60, 120, 240, 480, 960, 1920 }
	local HISTORY_LIMIT, HISTORY_ROW = 30, 40
	local H = { List = {} }
	local plus = {}
	Lib.TeleHistory = H
	Lib.TeleportPlus = plus
	local list = H.List
	local seq = 0
	local historyView, historyEmpty, Chip
	local historyRows = {}

	local function Root()
		local character = App.Player.Character
		return character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
	end

	local function Fmt(vector)
		return string.format("%d, %d, %d", math.floor(vector.X + 0.5), math.floor(vector.Y + 0.5), math.floor(vector.Z + 0.5))
	end

	local function MakeHistoryRow(entry, animate)
		local row = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, animate and 0 or HISTORY_ROW), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ClipsDescendants = true, LayoutOrder = -entry.id, Parent = historyView
		})
		local name = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -86, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = entry.n,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = row
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(name, "Primary")
		local sub = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -86, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 22), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = os.date("%H:%M:%S", entry.t) .. "  ·  " .. Fmt(entry.to),
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130), TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = row
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(sub, "Secondary")
		local go = Chip(row, "Go", UDim2.fromOffset(52, 26), UDim2.new(1, -66, 0, 7))
		Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = row
		})
		go.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			local root = Root()
			if not root then
				Lib.Notify({ Title = "Teleport", Text = "Character not found" })
				return
			end
			H.Record(entry.n, root, CFrame.new(entry.to))
			Lib.Notify({ Title = entry.n, Text = "Teleported! ✓" })
		end)
		historyRows[entry] = row
		if animate then Lib.Tween(row, 0.3, Quint, Out, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, HISTORY_ROW) }) end
	end

	local function RemoveHistoryRow(entry)
		local row = historyRows[entry]
		historyRows[entry] = nil
		if row then row:Destroy() end
	end

	function H.Push(label, from, to)
		seq += 1
		local entry = { id = seq, n = label, t = os.time(), from = from, to = to }
		list[#list + 1] = entry
		if #list > HISTORY_LIMIT then RemoveHistoryRow(table.remove(list, 1)) end
		if historyView then
			historyEmpty.Visible = false
			MakeHistoryRow(entry, true)
		end
	end

	function H.Record(label, root, cframe)
		local from = root.Position
		root.CFrame = cframe
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		H.Push(label, from, cframe.Position)
	end

	function H.Back()
		local last, root = list[#list], Root()
		if not (last and root) then
			Lib.Notify({ Title = "Teleport", Text = root and "No teleports yet" or "Character not found" })
			return false
		end
		H.Record("Back", root, CFrame.new(last.from))
		Lib.Notify({ Title = "Back", Text = "Teleported! ✓" })
		return true
	end

	function H.Clear()
		for _, row in pairs(historyRows) do row:Destroy() end
		table.clear(historyRows)
		table.clear(list)
		if historyEmpty then historyEmpty.Visible = true end
	end

	function plus.Build(scroll)

		local gray, white, axisColor = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130), Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120)
