		local jump = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = -2, Parent = group })
		local jumpStroke = Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = axisColor, Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.8 })
		local field = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -118, 0, 32), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 10), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), Parent = jump,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7) }),
			jumpStroke
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(field, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7, true)
		local box = Lib.Create("TextBox", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", PlaceholderText = "Go to X, Y, Z",
			PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110), TextColor3 = white, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ClearTextOnFocus = false, Parent = field
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(box, "Primary")
		local jumpGo = Chip(jump, "Go", UDim2.fromOffset(88, 32), UDim2.new(1, -102, 0, 10))
		Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = jump
		})
		local function Jump()
			local numbers = {}
			for token in box.Text:gsub("[%a_]+%d*", " "):gmatch("[-+]?%d*%.?%d+") do numbers[#numbers + 1] = tonumber(token) end
			local root = Root()
			if #numbers < 3 or not root then
				Lib.Notify({ Title = "Position", Text = root and "Invalid coordinates" or "Character not found" })
				return false
			end
			H.Record("Coordinates", root, CFrame.new(numbers[1], numbers[2], numbers[3]))
			Lib.Notify({ Title = "Coordinates", Text = "Teleported! ✓" })
			return true
		end
		box.Focused:Connect(function()
			Lib.Tween(jumpStroke, 0.2, Quad, Out, { Transparency = 0.4 })
		end)
		box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
			Lib.Tween(jumpStroke, 0.2, Quad, Out, { Transparency = 0.8 })
			if enter and Jump() then box.Text = "" end
		end)
		jumpGo.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			if Jump() then box.Text = "" end
		end)

		local holder = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 240), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = -1, Parent = group })
		local map = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 228), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 6), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), ClipsDescendants = true, Active = true, Parent = holder,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }),
			Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = axisColor, Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.8 })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(map, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7, true)
		Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = axisColor, BackgroundTransparency = 0.88, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = map })
		Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = axisColor, BackgroundTransparency = 0.88, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = map })
		local rings, ringLabels = {}, {}
		for index = 1, 2 do
			rings[index] = Lib.Create("Frame", {
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = map,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
				Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = axisColor, Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.8 })
			})
			ringLabels[index] = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 11), BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = gray, TextTransparency = 0.35, TextSize = 9,
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = map
			})
		end
		Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -6, 0, 4), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "N", TextColor3 = gray,
			TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = map
		})
		local radiusLabel = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 12), Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -20), BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = gray, TextSize = 10,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = map
		})
		local cursorLabel = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 12), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -20), BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = gray,
			TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Parent = map
		})
		local me = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 6, Parent = map,
			Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
				BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 6, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
			}),
			Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 8), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -1, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 6 })
		})
		local pulseStroke = Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Thickness = 1.5, Transparency = 0 })
		local pulse = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, ZIndex = 5, Parent = map,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
			pulseStroke
		})

		local zoom, clickOn, hover = 3, true, false
		local zoomIn = Chip(map, "+", UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26), UDim2.new(1, -34, 0, 8))
		local zoomOut = Chip(map, "-", UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26), UDim2.new(1, -34, 0, 38))
		zoomIn.ZIndex, zoomOut.ZIndex = 8, 8
		zoomIn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			zoom = math.max(1, zoom - 1)
		end)
		zoomOut.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			zoom = math.min(#RANGES, zoom + 1)
		end)

		local function ToWorld(px, py, origin)
			local pos, size = map.AbsolutePosition, map.AbsoluteSize
			local k = size.Y * 0.5 / RANGES[zoom]
			return origin.X + (px - pos.X - size.X * 0.5) / k, origin.Z + (py - pos.Y - size.Y * 0.5) / k
		end

		local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
		rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		rayParams.IgnoreWater = true
		local function Ground(x, z, y)
			local character = App.Player.Character
			rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = character and { character } or {}
			local hit = Workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x, y + 250, z), Vector3.new(0, -1500, 0), rayParams)
			return Vector3.new(x, hit and hit.Position.Y + 3.5 or y, z)
		end

		local pulsePos, pulseAt
		map.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			local kind = input.UserInputType
			if not clickOn or (kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then return end
			local root = Root()
			if not root then return end
			local origin = root.Position
			local wx, wz = ToWorld(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y, origin)
			local target = Ground(wx, wz, origin.Y)
			Lib.PlayClick()
			H.Record("Map", root, CFrame.new(target))
			pulsePos, pulseAt = target, os.clock()
		end)
		map.MouseMoved:Connect(function(x, y)
			local root = Root()
			if not root then return end
			local wx, wz = ToWorld(x, y, root.Position)
			cursorLabel.Text = string.format("%d, %d", math.floor(wx + 0.5), math.floor(wz + 0.5))
		end)
		map.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			hover = true
			if scroll:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then scroll.ScrollingEnabled = false end
		end)
		map.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			hover = false
			cursorLabel.Text = ""
			if scroll:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then scroll.ScrollingEnabled = true end
		end)
		Lib.C(UIS.InputChanged, function(input)
			if hover and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
				zoom = math.clamp(zoom + (input.Position.Z > 0 and -1 or 1), 1, #RANGES)
			end
		end)

		local function NewPlayerDot()
			return Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3, Parent = map,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
			})
		end
		local function NewWaypointDot(entry)
			local dot = Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 4, Parent = map,
				Lib.Create("Frame", {
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Rotation = 45,
					BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4
				})
			})
			local label = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 11), Position = UDim2.new(1, 5, 0.5, -6), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = entry.n, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190),
				TextSize = 9, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 4, Parent = dot
			})
			return { dot, label }
		end
		local function NewHistoryDot()
			return Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 3, Parent = map,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
				Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170), Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.35 })
			})
		end

		local function Place(obj, wx, wz, px, pz, k, hw, hh)
			local dx, dy = (wx - px) * k, (wz - pz) * k
			local clamped = false
			if dx > hw then
				dx, clamped = hw, true
			elseif dx < -hw then
				dx, clamped = -hw, true
			end
			if dy > hh then
				dy, clamped = hh, true
			elseif dy < -hh then
				dy, clamped = -hh, true
			end
			obj.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, dx, 0.5, dy)
			return clamped
		end

		local gen, acc, lastH, lastZoom = 0, 0, nil, nil
		local pdots, wdots, hdots = {}, {}, {}
		local seenP, seenW, seenH = {}, {}, {}

		local function Step()
			local root = Root()
			if not root then return end
			local origin = root.Position
			local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
			me.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(look.X, -look.Z))

			local tx, ty, tz = string.format("%.1f", origin.X), string.format("%.1f", origin.Y), string.format("%.1f", origin.Z)
			if values[1].Text ~= tx then values[1].Text = tx end
			if values[2].Text ~= ty then values[2].Text = ty end
			if values[3].Text ~= tz then values[3].Text = tz end

			local size = map.AbsoluteSize
			local w, h = size.X, size.Y
			local range = RANGES[zoom]
			if h ~= lastH then
				for index = 1, 2 do
					local diameter = h * index / 3
					rings[index].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(diameter, diameter)
					ringLabels[index].Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 4, 0.5, -diameter / 2 + 2)
				end
			end
			if h ~= lastH or zoom ~= lastZoom then
				for index = 1, 2 do ringLabels[index].Text = math.floor(range * index / 3 + 0.5) .. " st" end
				radiusLabel.Text = "R " .. range .. " st"
				lastH, lastZoom = h, zoom
			end
			local k = h * 0.5 / range
			local hw, hh = w * 0.5 - 6, h * 0.5 - 6
			local ox, oz = origin.X, origin.Z

			gen += 1
			local localPlayer = App.Player
			for _, plr in ipairs(PlayersService:GetPlayers()) do
				if plr ~= localPlayer then
					local character = plr.Character
					local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if hrp then
						local dot = pdots[plr]
						if not dot then
							dot = NewPlayerDot()
							pdots[plr] = dot
						end
						seenP[plr] = gen
						local pos = hrp.Position
						local dx, dy = (pos.X - ox) * k, (pos.Z - oz) * k
						local inside = math.abs(dx) <= hw and math.abs(dy) <= hh
						if dot.Visible ~= inside then dot.Visible = inside end
						if inside then dot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, dx, 0.5, dy) end
					end
				end
			end
			for plr, dot in pairs(pdots) do
				if seenP[plr] ~= gen then
					dot:Destroy()
					pdots[plr], seenP[plr] = nil, nil
				end
			end

			local points = Lib.Waypoints.List()
			for index = 1, #points do
				local entry = points[index]
				local pack = wdots[entry]
				if not pack then
					pack = NewWaypointDot(entry)
					wdots[entry] = pack
				end
				seenW[entry] = gen
				local clamped = Place(pack[1], entry.x, entry.z, ox, oz, k, hw, hh)
				pack[2].Visible = not clamped
				if pack[2].Text ~= entry.n then pack[2].Text = entry.n end
			end
			for entry, pack in pairs(wdots) do
				if seenW[entry] ~= gen then
					pack[1]:Destroy()
					wdots[entry], seenW[entry] = nil, nil
				end
			end

			for index = math.max(1, #list - 5), #list do
				local entry = list[index]
				local dot = hdots[entry]
				if not dot then
					dot = NewHistoryDot()
					hdots[entry] = dot
				end
				seenH[entry] = gen
				Place(dot, entry.to.X, entry.to.Z, ox, oz, k, hw, hh)
			end
			for entry, dot in pairs(hdots) do
				if seenH[entry] ~= gen then
					dot:Destroy()
					hdots[entry], seenH[entry] = nil, nil
				end
			end

			if pulsePos then
				local alpha = (os.clock() - pulseAt) / 1.1
				if alpha >= 1 then
					pulsePos = nil
					pulse.Visible = false
				else
					local diameter = 8 + 22 * alpha
					pulse.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(diameter, diameter)
					pulseStroke.Transparency = alpha
					Place(pulse, pulsePos.X, pulsePos.Z, ox, oz, k, hw, hh)
					pulse.Visible = true
				end
			end
		end

		Lib.C(Services.Run.Heartbeat, function(dt)
			acc += dt
			if acc < 0.033 then return end
			acc = 0
			if UI.Main and UI.Main.Visible and State.ActiveMain == "Features" and State.CurrentFeaturesTab == "Teleport" and not State.Minimized then Step() end
		end)

		Lib.CreateSettingToggleItem(group, "Map Click Teleport", "Click or tap the map to teleport to that point", true, function(value)
			clickOn = value
		end, true)

		local historyGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(scroll, "Teleport History", 6)
		local bar = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = -2, Parent = historyGroup })
		local back = Chip(bar, "Back", UDim2.fromOffset(72, 30), UDim2.fromOffset(14, 8))
		local clear = Chip(bar, "Clear", UDim2.fromOffset(72, 30), UDim2.fromOffset(94, 8))
		Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = bar
		})
		back.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			H.Back()
		end)
		clear.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			H.Clear()
		end)
		historyView = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 100000, Parent = historyGroup,
			Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
		})
		historyEmpty = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "No teleports in this session", TextColor3 = gray, TextSize = 12,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, LayoutOrder = 0, Visible = #list == 0, Parent = historyView
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(historyEmpty, "Secondary")
		for index = 1, #list do MakeHistoryRow(list[index], false) end

		table.insert(Lib.BindActions, {
			id = "TeleportBack", title = "Teleport Back", desc = "Returns to the position before the last teleport", run = H.Back
		})
	end
end

do
	local UIS, TweenService = Services.UserInputService, Services.Tween
	local Quad, Quint = Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint
	local Out, In = Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingDirection.In
	local ROW, VISIBLE, POOL, HEADER, WIDTH = 38, 8, 40, 54, 540
	local FOOTER = UIS.KeyboardEnabled and 30 or 0
	local OPEN, CLOSE, FAST = TweenInfo.new(0.3, Quint, Out), TweenInfo.new(0.16, Quad, In), TweenInfo.new(0.12, Quad, Out)
	local MAIN = { CurrentTab = "Home", CurrentFeaturesTab = "Features", CurrentScriptsTab = "Scripts", CurrentEmotesTab = "Emotes", CurrentSettingsTab = "Settings" }
	local TABS = { "Home", "Features", "Scripts", "Emotes", "Settings" }
	local BONUS = { Tab = 4, Action = 3, Waypoint = 3, Toggle = 2 }
	local REST = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.14)

	local palette = { Open = false }
	local gui, rows = nil, {}
	local items, shown, byKey, recent = {}, {}, {}, {}
	local selected, token, lastKey, inputConn = 0, 0, 0, nil

	local function Reveal()
		if UI.Main and not UI.Main.Visible then Lib.ToggleMenu(true) end
	end

	local function Add(kind, title, tag, words, run, state, entry)
		local item = {
			Kind = kind, Title = title, Tag = tag, Words = words, Run = run, State = state, Entry = entry,
			Low = Lib.Lower(title), Alt = Lib.Lower(Lib.Ru(title)), Key = kind .. ":" .. title, Score = 0
		}
		items[#items + 1] = item
		byKey[item.Key] = item
	end

	local function Collect()
		table.clear(items)
		table.clear(byKey)
		for index = 1, #TABS do
			local tab = TABS[index]
			Add("Tab", tab, "Menu", "open tab go to page menu", function()
				Reveal()
				Lib.SwitchMainTab(tab)
			end)
		end
		Add("Action", "Toggle Menu", "Action", "show hide window menu", function() Lib.ToggleMenu() end)
		Add("Action", "Rejoin Server", "Action", "reconnect restart rejoin", function() Lib.RejoinCurrentServer() end)
		Add("Action", "Server Hop", "Action", "change server new hop", function() Lib.ServerHop() end)
		Add("Action", "Language: English", "Action", "language english", function() Lib.SetLanguage("English") end)
		Add("Action", "Language: Русский", "Action", "language russian язык русский", function() Lib.SetLanguage("Русский") end)
		local waypoints = Lib.Waypoints
		if waypoints then
			Add("Action", "Save Waypoint Here", "Action", "waypoint save add point mark", function() waypoints.AddHere("") end)
			local list = waypoints.List()
			for index = 1, #list do
				local entry = list[index]
				Add("Waypoint", entry.n, nil, "waypoint teleport tp go to point", function() waypoints.Go(entry) end, nil, entry)
			end
		end
		for _, system in ipairs(Lib.TabSystems) do
			local main = MAIN[system.Key]
			if main then
				local words = "open tab go to " .. Lib.Lower(main)
				local names = {}
				for name in pairs(system.Order) do names[#names + 1] = name end
				table.sort(names, function(a, b) return system.Order[a] < system.Order[b] end)
				for index = 1, #names do
					local name = names[index]
					Add("Tab", name, main, words, function()
						Reveal()
						Lib.SwitchMainTab(main)
						system.Switch(name)
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		for _, title in ipairs(Lib.FeatureToggles) do
			local control = Lib.ToggleControls[title]
			if control then
				Add("Toggle", title, nil, "toggle enable disable switch", function()
					control.Set(not control.Get())
					Lib.Notify({ Title = title, Text = control.Get() and "Enabled" or "Disabled" })
				end, control.Get)
			end
		end
	end

	local function Match(text, token)
		local start = text:find(token, 1, true)
		if start then
			if start == 1 then return 100 end
			local previous = text:byte(start - 1)
			return (previous == 32 or previous == 45 or previous == 58) and 80 or 55
		end
		local length = #token
		if length < 2 then return 0 end
		local at = 1
		for index = 1, length do
			at = text:find(token:sub(index, index), at, true)
			if not at then return 0 end
			at += 1
		end
		return 18
	end

	local function Rank(item, tokens, count)
		local total = 0
		for index = 1, count do
			local token = tokens[index]
			local best = math.max(Match(item.Low, token), Match(item.Alt, token), Match(item.Words, token) * 0.4)
			if best == 0 then return 0 end
			total += best
		end
		return total + BONUS[item.Kind] - #item.Low * 0.02
	end

	local function Search(text)
		table.clear(shown)
		local tokens, count = {}, 0
		for word in Lib.Lower(text):gmatch("%S+") do
			count += 1
			tokens[count] = word
		end
		if count == 0 then
			local seen = {}
			for index = 1, #recent do
				local item = byKey[recent[index]]
				if item then
					shown[#shown + 1] = item
					seen[item] = true
				end
			end
			for index = 1, #items do
				if #shown >= POOL then break end
				local item = items[index]
				if not seen[item] then shown[#shown + 1] = item end
			end
			return
		end
		for index = 1, #items do
			local item = items[index]
			local score = Rank(item, tokens, count)
			if score > 0 then
				item.Score = score
				shown[#shown + 1] = item
			end
		end
		table.sort(shown, function(a, b)
			if a.Score ~= b.Score then return a.Score > b.Score end
			return a.Title < b.Title
		end)
		for index = #shown, POOL + 1, -1 do shown[index] = nil end
	end

	local function Paint()
		local primary, secondary = Lib.Palette.Primary, Lib.Palette.Secondary
		local active = Lib.GetActiveSwitchColor()
		for index = 1, POOL do
			local row, item = rows[index], shown[index]
			row.Button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			row.Bar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			if item then
				row.Button.Visible = true
				row.Button.BackgroundColor3 = primary
				row.Bar.BackgroundColor3 = primary
				row.Title.Text = item.Title
				row.Title.TextColor3 = primary
				local tag, color = item.Tag or "", secondary
				if item.Kind == "Toggle" then
					local enabled = item.State()
					tag, color = enabled and "ON" or "OFF", enabled and active or secondary
				elseif item.Entry then
					tag = Lib.Waypoints.Label(item.Entry)
				end
				row.Tag.Text = tag
				row.Tag.TextColor3 = color
			else
				row.Button.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end

	local function Highlight(row, on, instant)
		local button, bar = on and 0.92 or 1, on and 0 or 1
		if instant then
			row.Button.BackgroundTransparency = button
			row.Bar.BackgroundTransparency = bar
		else
			TweenService:Create(row.Button, FAST, { BackgroundTransparency = button }):Play()
			TweenService:Create(row.Bar, FAST, { BackgroundTransparency = bar }):Play()
		end
	end

	local function Select(index, follow, instant)
		local count = #shown
		local previous = rows[selected]
		if previous then Highlight(previous, false, instant) end
		if count == 0 then
			selected = 0
			return
		end
		selected = (index - 1) % count + 1
		Highlight(rows[selected], true, instant)
		if follow then
			local list = gui.List
			local top = 6 + (selected - 1) * ROW
			local canvas, window = list.CanvasPosition.Y, list.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y
			local target = canvas
			if top < canvas then
				target = top - 6
			elseif top + ROW > canvas + window - 6 then
				target = top + ROW - window + 6
			end
			if target ~= canvas then
				TweenService:Create(list, FAST, { CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(target, 0)) }):Play()
			end
		end
	end

	local function Resize(animate)
		local count = #shown
		local height = HEADER + 1 + (count == 0 and 58 or math.min(count, VISIBLE) * ROW + 12) + FOOTER
		gui.Empty.Visible = count == 0
		local size = UDim2.fromOffset(gui.Width, height)
		if animate then
			TweenService:Create(gui.Panel, FAST, { Size = size }):Play()
		else
			gui.Panel.Size = size
		end
	end

	local function Refresh(text, animate)
		Search(text)
		Paint()
		Resize(animate)
		Select(1, false, true)
		gui.List.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
	end

	local function Pick(index)
		local item = shown[index]
		if not item then return end
		for position = #recent, 1, -1 do
			if recent[position] == item.Key then table.remove(recent, position) end
		end
		table.insert(recent, 1, item.Key)
		recent[6] = nil
		Lib.ClosePalette()
		task.defer(function()
			pcall(item.Run)
		end)
	end

	local function Build()
		local root = Lib.Create("Frame", { Name = "SeptusPalette", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, ZIndex = 400, Parent = UI.Screen })
		local backdrop = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 400, Parent = root
		})
		local scale = Lib.Create("UIScale", { Scale = 0.96 })
		local panel = Lib.Create("CanvasGroup", {
			Name = "Panel", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = REST, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(WIDTH, 200), BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Theme.Base,
			GroupTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 401, Parent = root,
			scale,
			Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120), Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.65 })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(panel, "BackgroundColor3", 1)
		Lib.BindCorner(panel, "PaletteCorner")

		local icon = Lib.Create("ImageLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 15), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 20), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = Lib.SearchIcon,
			ImageTransparency = 0.3, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, Parent = panel
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeImage(icon)
		local box = Lib.Create("TextBox", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -118, 0, HEADER), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", PlaceholderText = "Type a command or search...",
			PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), TextSize = 15, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ClearTextOnFocus = false, Parent = panel
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(box, "Primary")
		local esc = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 20), Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0, 17), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), Text = "esc",
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(145, 145, 145), TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = panel,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5) })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(esc, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7)
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(esc, "Secondary")

		local lines = {}
		lines[1] = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, HEADER), BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.Secondary, BackgroundTransparency = 0.88, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = panel
		})
		local list = Lib.Create("ScrollingFrame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -(HEADER + 1 + FOOTER)), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, HEADER + 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
			ScrollBarThickness = 2, ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100), CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, Parent = panel,
			Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
			Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6) })
		})
		local empty = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, HEADER + 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "No results",
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130), TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Visible = false, Parent = panel
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(empty, "Secondary")

		if FOOTER > 0 then
			lines[2] = Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -FOOTER), BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.Secondary, BackgroundTransparency = 0.88, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = panel
			})
			local hint = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, FOOTER), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -FOOTER), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "↑↓ navigate     ↵ select     esc close",
				TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110), TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Parent = panel
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(hint, "Secondary")
		end

		for index = 1, POOL do
			local button = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
				Name = "Row", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutoButtonColor = false,
				Text = "", BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = index, Visible = false, Parent = list,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) })
			})
			local bar = Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 16), Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -8), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = button,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
			})
			local title = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -130, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = button
			})
			local tag = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(0, 110, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Parent = button
			})
			rows[index] = { Button = button, Bar = bar, Title = title, Tag = tag }
			button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
				if selected ~= index and os.clock() - lastKey > 0.25 then Select(index) end
			end)
			button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				Pick(index)
			end)
		end

		backdrop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.ClosePalette()
		end)
		box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
			if enter and palette.Open then Pick(selected) end
		end)
		box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
			if palette.Open then Refresh(box.Text, true) end
		end)

		return { Root = root, Backdrop = backdrop, Scale = scale, Panel = panel, Box = box, List = list, Empty = empty, Lines = lines, Width = WIDTH }
	end

	local function OnInput(input)
		if not palette.Open then return end
		local key = input.KeyCode
		if key == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
			Lib.ClosePalette()
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.Down then
			lastKey = os.clock()
			Select(selected + 1, true)
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.Up then
			lastKey = os.clock()
			Select(selected - 1, true)
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.Return or key == Enum.KeyCode.KeypadEnter then
			if not gui.Box:IsFocused() then Pick(selected) end
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.K and (UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl)) then
			Lib.ClosePalette()
		end
	end

	function Lib.OpenPalette()
		if State.Unloaded or palette.Open then return end
		if not gui then gui = Build() end
		palette.Open = true
		token += 1
		local mine = token
		gui.Width = math.clamp(UI.Screen.AbsoluteSize.X - 32, 280, WIDTH)
		Collect()
		gui.Box.Text = ""
		local color = Lib.Palette.Secondary
		for index = 1, #gui.Lines do gui.Lines[index].BackgroundColor3 = color end
		Refresh("", false)
		gui.Root.Visible = true
		gui.Backdrop.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		gui.Panel.GroupTransparency = 1
		gui.Panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.14, 12)
		gui.Scale.Scale = 0.96
		TweenService:Create(gui.Backdrop, OPEN, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.55 }):Play()
		TweenService:Create(gui.Panel, OPEN, { GroupTransparency = 0, Position = REST }):Play()
		TweenService:Create(gui.Scale, OPEN, { Scale = 1 }):Play()
		inputConn = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(OnInput)
		task.spawn(function()
			Services.Run.RenderStepped:Wait()
			if palette.Open and token == mine then
				gui.Box:CaptureFocus()
				gui.Box.Text = ""
			end
		end)
	end

	function Lib.ClosePalette()
		if not palette.Open then return end
		palette.Open = false
		token += 1
		local mine = token
		if inputConn then
			inputConn:Disconnect()
			inputConn = nil
		end
		gui.Box:ReleaseFocus()
		TweenService:Create(gui.Backdrop, CLOSE, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
		TweenService:Create(gui.Scale, CLOSE, { Scale = 0.97 }):Play()
		TweenService:Create(gui.Panel, CLOSE, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.14, 8) }):Play()
		local fade = TweenService:Create(gui.Panel, CLOSE, { GroupTransparency = 1 })
		fade.Completed:Connect(function()
			if token == mine and not palette.Open then gui.Root.Visible = false end
		end)
		fade:Play()
	end

	function Lib.TogglePalette()
		if palette.Open then Lib.ClosePalette() else Lib.OpenPalette() end
	end

	function Lib.InitPalette()
		Lib.C(UIS.InputBegan, function(input)
			if input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.K or State.Unloaded or palette.Open then return end
			if not (UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftMeta) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightMeta)) then return end
			if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
			Lib.OpenPalette()
		end)
		table.insert(Lib.BindActions, {
			id = "CommandPalette", title = "Command Palette", desc = "Opens the quick search palette",
			run = Lib.TogglePalette
		})
	end
end

function Lib.BuildGlobalSearch(section, sideBar, tabs, views, stateKey)
	local list, shown = Lib.SearchItems, Lib.SearchShown
	local active = false

	local results = Lib.Create("ScrollingFrame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -190, 1, -20), Position = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 10), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ScrollBarThickness = 2, ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100), CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Visible = false, Parent = section,
		Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 5), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 15) })
	})
	local card = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15), Parent = results,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }),
		Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeElement(card, "BackgroundColor3", 0.5)
	local empty = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "No features found", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130),
		TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Visible = false, Parent = results
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(empty, "Secondary")

	local function SetViews(current)
		for name, view in pairs(views) do
			view.Visible = name == current
		end
	end

	local function Release()
		for i = #shown, 1, -1 do
			local entry = shown[i]
			if entry.Item.Parent then entry.Item.Parent = entry.Parent end
			shown[i] = nil
		end
	end

	local function Apply(text)
		local query = Lib.Lower(text)
		Release()
		if query == "" then
			if active then
				active = false
				results.Visible = false
				SetViews(State[stateKey])
			end
			return
		end
		if not active then
			active = true
			SetViews(nil)
			results.Visible = true
		end
		local length, count = #query, 0
		for i = 1, #list do
			local entry = list[i]
			local item = entry.Item
			if item.Parent then
				local title, alt = entry.Title, entry.Alt
				if title:sub(1, length) == query or title:find(" " .. query, 1, true) or alt:sub(1, length) == query or alt:find(" " .. query, 1, true) then
					item.Parent = card
					count += 1
					shown[count] = entry
				end
			end
		end
		card.Visible = count > 0
		empty.Visible = count == 0
		results.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
	end

	local box = Lib.MakeSearchBox(sideBar, "Search", UDim2.fromOffset(15, 46), UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 28), 0, Apply)
	for _, button in ipairs(tabs:GetChildren()) do
		if button:IsA("TextButton") then
			button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				task.defer(function() box.Text = "" end)
			end)
		end
	end
	section:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if not section.Visible and box.Text ~= "" then box.Text = "" end
	end)
end

function Lib.BuildBrowseSearch(view, scroll, bottom, placeholder, onQuery)
	local api = {}

	local strip = Lib.Create("ScrollingFrame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 56), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 38), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ScrollBarThickness = 2, ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100), ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Visible = false, Parent = view,
		Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
		Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4) })
	})

	local function Layout(hasStrip)
		local top = hasStrip and 102 or 38
		scroll.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, top)
		scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -(top + bottom))
		strip.Visible = hasStrip
	end

	api.Box = Lib.MakeSearchBox(view, placeholder, UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0), UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 30), 0.4, onQuery)

	function api.SetSuggestions(list)
		for _, child in ipairs(strip:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("GuiButton") then child:Destroy() end
		end
		local count = list and #list or 0
		for i = 1, count do
			local data = list[i]
			local card = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 50), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15), Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false,
				LayoutOrder = i, Parent = strip,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) })
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeElement(card, "BackgroundColor3", 0.5)

			local thumb = Lib.Create("ImageLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22),
				ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, Parent = card,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) })
			})
			Lib.LoadWebImage(thumb, data.Image)
			Lib.RegisterThemeElement(thumb, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7)

			local name = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 7), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = data.Name,
				TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = card
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(name, "Primary")

			local sub = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 24), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = data.Sub or "",
				TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130), TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextWrapped = true,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = card
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(sub, "Secondary")

			card.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
				Lib.Tween(card, 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Lighten(Lib.Theme.Card, 0.04) })
			end)
			card.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
				Lib.Tween(card, 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Theme.Card })
			end)
			card.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				Lib.PlayClick()
				api.Box.Text = data.Name
			end)
		end
		Layout(count > 0)
	end

	Layout(false)
	return api
end


function Lib.MakeStore(file, limit)
	local Http = Services.HttpService
	local list, store = {}, {}
	if isfile and readfile then
		pcall(function()
			if isfile(file) then
				local data = Http:JSONDecode(readfile(file))
				if type(data) == "table" then list = data end
			end
		end)
	end
	local function Commit()
		if not writefile then return end
		pcall(function() writefile(file, Http:JSONEncode(list)) end)
	end
	function store.List() return list end
	function store.Find(key)
		for index, entry in ipairs(list) do
			if entry.key == key then return index end
		end
	end
	function store.Has(key) return store.Find(key) ~= nil end
	function store.Add(key, data)
		local index = store.Find(key)
		if index then table.remove(list, index) end
		table.insert(list, 1, { key = key, data = data })
		if limit and #list > limit then table.remove(list) end
		Commit()
	end
	function store.Remove(key)
		local index = store.Find(key)
		if index then
			table.remove(list, index)
			Commit()
		end
	end
	function store.Toggle(key, data)
		if store.Has(key) then
			store.Remove(key)
			return false
		end
		store.Add(key, data)
		return true
	end
	return store
end

	end)

end

function Lib.MiniIcon(kind, parent, position, color)
	local box = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), Position = position, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = parent })
	if kind == "eye" then
		Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 9), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = box,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
			Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = color, Thickness = 1.3 })
		})
		Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = color, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = box,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
		})
	elseif kind == "folder" then
		Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 4), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = box,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2) }),
			Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = color, Thickness = 1.3 })
		})
		Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 9), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 4), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = box,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3) }),
			Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = color, Thickness = 1.3 })
		})
	else
		Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 13), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = box,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
			Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = color, Thickness = 1.3 })
		})
		Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 4), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7), BackgroundColor3 = color, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = box })
		Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 1), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7), BackgroundColor3 = color, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = box })
	end
	return box
end

function Lib.TimeAgo(stamp)
	local diff = math.max(os.time() - stamp, 0)
	if diff < 60 then return "just now" end
	if diff < 3600 then return diff // 60 .. "m ago" end
	if diff < 86400 then return diff // 3600 .. "h ago" end
	if diff < 2592000 then return diff // 86400 .. "d ago" end
	if diff < 31536000 then return diff // 2592000 .. "mo ago" end
	return diff // 31536000 .. "y ago"
end

function Lib.FormatViews(count)
	if count >= 1e6 then return (string.format("%.1f", count / 1e6):gsub("%.0$", "")) .. "M" end
	if count >= 1e3 then return (string.format("%.1f", count / 1e3):gsub("%.0$", "")) .. "K" end
	return tostring(math.floor(count))
end

function Lib.MakeCardList(view, emptyText, cell, gap, padX)
	local scroll = Lib.Create("ScrollingFrame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ScrollBarThickness = 2, ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100),
		BorderSizePixel = 0, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = view,
		Lib.Create("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = cell, CellPadding = gap, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
		Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, padX), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, padX), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 15) })
	})
	local empty = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = emptyText, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150),
		TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Visible = false, Parent = view
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(empty, "Secondary")
	return scroll, empty
end

function Lib.MakeFolderButton(parent, position, field, key, itemData, label)
	local gold, white = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local button = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24), Position = position, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.5,
		AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", ZIndex = 9, Parent = parent,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) })
	})
	local strokes = {}
	for _, descendant in ipairs(Lib.MiniIcon("folder", button, UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5), white):GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("UIStroke") then strokes[#strokes + 1] = descendant end
	end
	local function Paint()
		local collections = Lib[field]
		local color = collections and collections.Has(key) and gold or white
		for _, stroke in ipairs(strokes) do stroke.Color = color end
	end
	Paint()
	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Lib.PlayClick()
		local collections = Lib[field]
		if collections then collections.Pick(key, itemData, label, Paint) end
	end)
	return button
end

function Lib.BuildCollections(view, file, cell, gap, padX, makeCard)
	local Http = Services.HttpService
	local api, data, owners, openId, armed = {}, { next = 1, list = {} }, {}, nil, 0
	local gray, light = Color3.fromRGB(145, 145, 145), Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)

	if isfile and readfile then
		pcall(function()
			if isfile(file) then
				local decoded = Http:JSONDecode(readfile(file))
				if type(decoded) == "table" and type(decoded.list) == "table" then data = decoded end
			end
		end)
	end

	local top = 0
	for index = #data.list, 1, -1 do
		local folder = data.list[index]
		if type(folder) == "table" and type(folder.id) == "number" and type(folder.name) == "string" and type(folder.items) == "table" then
			top = math.max(top, folder.id)
			for item = #folder.items, 1, -1 do
				local entry = folder.items[item]
				if type(entry) ~= "table" or entry.key == nil or type(entry.data) ~= "table" then table.remove(folder.items, item) end
			end
		else
			table.remove(data.list, index)
		end
	end
	data.next = top + 1

	local function Commit()
		if writefile then pcall(writefile, file, Http:JSONEncode(data)) end
	end

	local function Find(id)
		for index, folder in ipairs(data.list) do
			if folder.id == id then return folder, index end
		end
	end

	local function Index(folder, key)
		for index, entry in ipairs(folder.items) do
			if entry.key == key then return index end
		end
	end

	local function Reindex()
		table.clear(owners)
		for _, folder in ipairs(data.list) do
			for _, entry in ipairs(folder.items) do owners[entry.key] = true end
		end
	end
	Reindex()

	local function Clean(text)
		text = text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
		local cut = utf8.offset(text, 33)
		return cut and text:sub(1, cut - 1) or text
	end

	local function Clear(scroll)
		for _, child in ipairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("GuiObject") then child:Destroy() end
		end
	end

	function api.Has(key)
		return owners[key] == true
	end

	function api.Create(name)
		name = Clean(name or "")
		if name == "" then name = "Collection " .. data.next end
		local folder = { id = data.next, name = name, items = {} }
		data.next += 1
		data.list[#data.list + 1] = folder
		Commit()
		return folder
	end

	function api.Toggle(id, key, itemData)
		local folder = Find(id)
		if not folder then return false end
		local index = Index(folder, key)
		if index then
			table.remove(folder.items, index)
		else
			table.insert(folder.items, 1, { key = key, data = itemData })
		end
		Commit()
		Reindex()
		return index == nil
	end

	local rootBar = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = view })
	local nameInput = Lib.Create("TextBox", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -112, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22),
		PlaceholderText = "New collection name...", PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110), TextColor3 = light,
		TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Text = "", ClearTextOnFocus = false, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = rootBar,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7) }),
		Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12) })
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeElement(nameInput, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7, true)
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(nameInput, "Primary")
	local createBtn = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(88, 30), Position = UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Text = "Create",
		TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = rootBar,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7) })
	})

	local folderBar = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, Parent = view })
	local backBtn = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), Text = "\u{2039}",
		TextColor3 = light, TextSize = 20, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = folderBar,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7) })
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeElement(backBtn, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7, true)
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(backBtn, "Primary")
	local nameBox = Lib.Create("TextBox", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -146, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), TextColor3 = light,
		TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Text = "", ClearTextOnFocus = false, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = folderBar,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7) }),
		Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12) })
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeElement(nameBox, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7, true)
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(nameBox, "Primary")
	local deleteBtn = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(88, 30), Position = UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35), Text = "Delete",
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 80), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = folderBar,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7) })
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeElement(deleteBtn, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7, true)

	local foldersScroll, foldersEmpty = Lib.MakeCardList(view, "No collections yet\nCreate one above, then press the folder button on any card", UDim2.fromOffset(190, 72), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12), padX)
	local itemsScroll, itemsEmpty = Lib.MakeCardList(view, "This collection is empty\nPress the folder button on a card to add it here", cell, gap, padX)
	for _, scroll in ipairs({ foldersScroll, itemsScroll }) do
		scroll.Position, scroll.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 38), UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -38)
	end
	itemsScroll.Visible = false

	local Render

	local function Tile(folder, order)
		local tile = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15), Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, LayoutOrder = order, Parent = foldersScroll,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(tile, "BackgroundColor3", 0.5)
		local stroke = Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35), Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.5, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Parent = tile })
		local icon = Lib.MiniIcon("folder", tile, UDim2.fromOffset(34, 36), gray)
		icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		Lib.Create("UIScale", { Scale = 2.2, Parent = icon })
		local name = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -78, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(66, 17), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = folder.name, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245),
			TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = tile
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(name, "Primary")
		local count = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -78, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(66, 38), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Items: " .. #folder.items, TextColor3 = gray,
			TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = tile
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(count, "Secondary")
		tile.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			Lib.Tween(tile, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Lighten(Lib.Theme.Card, 0.05) })
			Lib.Tween(stroke, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120), Transparency = 0 })
		end)
		tile.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			Lib.Tween(tile, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Theme.Card })
			Lib.Tween(stroke, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Color = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35), Transparency = 0.5 })
		end)
		tile.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			openId = folder.id
			Render()
		end)
	end

	function Render()
		local folder = openId and Find(openId)
		if not folder then openId = nil end
		armed = 0
		deleteBtn.Text = "Delete"
		rootBar.Visible = not folder
		folderBar.Visible = folder ~= nil
		foldersScroll.Visible = not folder
		itemsScroll.Visible = folder ~= nil
		Clear(foldersScroll)
		Clear(itemsScroll)
		if folder then
			nameBox.Text = folder.name
			for index, entry in ipairs(folder.items) do makeCard(entry.data, index, itemsScroll) end
			itemsEmpty.Visible = #folder.items == 0
			foldersEmpty.Visible = false
		else
			for index, entry in ipairs(data.list) do Tile(entry, index) end
			foldersEmpty.Visible = #data.list == 0
			itemsEmpty.Visible = false
		end
	end

	local function Submit(needText)
		local name = Clean(nameInput.Text)
		if needText and name == "" then return end
		nameInput.Text = ""
		api.Create(name)
		Render()
	end

	createBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Lib.PlayClick()
		Submit(false)
	end)
	nameInput.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
		if enter then Submit(true) end
	end)
	backBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Lib.PlayClick()
		openId = nil
		Render()
	end)
	nameBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		local folder = openId and Find(openId)
		if not folder then return end
		local text = Clean(nameBox.Text)
		if text == "" then text = folder.name end
		nameBox.Text = text
		if text ~= folder.name then
			folder.name = text
			Commit()
		end
	end)
	deleteBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Lib.PlayClick()
		if armed > 0 and os.clock() - armed < 2.5 then
			local _, index = Find(openId)
			if index then
				table.remove(data.list, index)
				Commit()
				Reindex()
			end
			openId = nil
			Render()
			return
		end
		local stamp = os.clock()
		armed = stamp
		deleteBtn.Text = "Confirm?"
		task.delay(2.5, function()
			if armed == stamp then
				armed = 0
				deleteBtn.Text = "Delete"
			end
		end)
	end)

	local picker, pickerList, pickerInput
	local current = {}

	local function FillPicker()
		Clear(pickerList)
		for order, folder in ipairs(data.list) do
			local row = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, LayoutOrder = order, Parent = pickerList,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) })
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeElement(row, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7, true)
			local name = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -128, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = folder.name, TextColor3 = light,
				TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = row
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(name, "Primary")
			local count = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 40), Position = UDim2.new(1, -108, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130),
				TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Parent = row
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(count, "Secondary")
			local box = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.5, -10), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35), Text = "",
				TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = row,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5) })
			})
			local function Paint(on)
				box.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
				box.Text = on and "\u{2713}" or ""
				count.Text = "Items: " .. #folder.items
			end
			Paint(Index(folder, current.key) ~= nil)
			row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				Lib.PlayClick()
				Paint(api.Toggle(folder.id, current.key, current.data))
				if current.done then current.done() end
				api.Changed()
			end)
		end
	end

	local function BuildPicker()
		picker = Lib.BuildFilterModal("Add to Collection", "")
		picker.Backdrop.ZIndex = 40
		local bar = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = picker.Content })
		pickerInput = Lib.Create("TextBox", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -98, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), PlaceholderText = "New collection name...", PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110),
			TextColor3 = light, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Text = "", ClearTextOnFocus = false, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = bar,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7) }),
			Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12) })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(pickerInput, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7, true)
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(pickerInput, "Primary")
		local addBtn = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(88, 34), Position = UDim2.new(1, -88, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Text = "Create",
			TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = bar,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7) })
		})
		pickerList = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = picker.Content,
			Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
		})
		local function Submit(needText)
			local name = Clean(pickerInput.Text)
			if needText and name == "" then return end
			pickerInput.Text = ""
			api.Toggle(api.Create(name).id, current.key, current.data)
			FillPicker()
			if current.done then current.done() end
			api.Changed()
		end
		addBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			Submit(false)
		end)
		pickerInput.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
			if enter then Submit(true) end
		end)
	end

	function api.Pick(key, itemData, label, done)
		if not picker then BuildPicker() end
		current.key, current.data, current.done = key, itemData, done
		picker.Sub.Text = label or ""
		pickerInput.Text = ""
		FillPicker()
		picker.Open()
	end

	function api.Changed()
		if view.Visible then Render() end
	end

	function api.Show()
		Render()
	end

	return api
end

function Lib.MakeFilterButton(sideBar, onClick)
	local api, hover = {}, false
	local function Idle() return State.LightTheme and Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150) end
	local button = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 34), Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 1, -74), BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.Primary, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = sideBar,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7) })
	})
	local label = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -72, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Filters", TextSize = 14,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = Idle(), Parent = button
	})
	local pieces = {}
	local function Piece(size, position, round)
		local piece = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = size, Position = position, BackgroundColor3 = Idle(), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = button })
		if round then Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0), Parent = piece }) end
		pieces[#pieces + 1] = piece
	end
	Piece(UDim2.fromOffset(14, 2), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 11))
	Piece(UDim2.fromOffset(14, 2), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 21))
	Piece(UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), UDim2.fromOffset(21, 9), true)
	Piece(UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), UDim2.fromOffset(13, 19), true)

	local badge = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 18), Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0.5, -9), BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.Primary, Text = "0",
		TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Visible = false, Parent = button,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
	})

	local function Paint()
		local color = hover and Lib.Palette.Primary or Idle()
		local info = { Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out }
		Lib.Tween(label, 0.15, info[1], info[2], { TextColor3 = color })
		for _, piece in ipairs(pieces) do Lib.Tween(piece, 0.15, info[1], info[2], { BackgroundColor3 = color }) end
		Lib.Tween(button, 0.15, info[1], info[2], { BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.Primary, BackgroundTransparency = hover and 0.92 or 1 })
		badge.BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.Primary
		badge.TextColor3 = State.LightTheme and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end

	button.MouseEnter:Connect(function() hover = true Paint() end)
	button.MouseLeave:Connect(function() hover = false Paint() end)
	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Lib.PlayClick()
		onClick()
	end)
	table.insert(Lib.ThemeHooks, Paint)
	Paint()

	function api.SetCount(count)
		badge.Text = tostring(count)
		badge.Visible = count > 0
	end
	return api
end

function Lib.MakeFilterChips(parent, title, options, isOn, onPick, order, cellWidth, disabled)
	local section = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order, Parent = parent })
	local heading = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = title, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200), TextSize = 12,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = section
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(heading, "Primary")
	local grid = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), Parent = section,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9) }),
		Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6) }),
		Lib.Create("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(cellWidth, 28), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeElement(grid, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7)

	local buttons = {}
	local function Refresh()
		local light = State.LightTheme
		for option, button in pairs(buttons) do
			local on = isOn(option)
			local off = disabled and disabled[option]
			Lib.Tween(button, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, {
				BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.Primary,
				BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1,
				TextColor3 = on and (light and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)) or (off and Color3.fromRGB(85, 85, 85) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150))
			})
		end
	end
	for index, option in ipairs(options) do
		local button = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.Primary, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = option, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), AutoButtonColor = false, LayoutOrder = index, Parent = grid,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7) })
		})
		buttons[option] = button
		button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			onPick(option)
			Refresh()
		end)
	end
	Refresh()
	table.insert(Lib.ThemeHooks, Refresh)
	return Refresh
end

function Lib.BuildFilterModal(title, subtitle)
	local api, busy = {}, false
	local backdrop = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
		Name = "FilterBackdrop", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Visible = false, ZIndex = 30, Parent = UI.Main
	})
	local window = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 470), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),

		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12) }),
		Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60), Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.5 })

		Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 37), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = subtitle, TextSize = 12,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 32, Parent = window
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(sub, "Secondary")
	local close = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), Position = UDim2.new(1, -42, 0, 14), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "\u{00D7}", TextSize = 20,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 32, Parent = window
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(close, "Secondary")
	api.Backdrop, api.Sub = backdrop, sub

	api.Content = Lib.Create("ScrollingFrame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -70), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 70), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 2,
		ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100), CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ZIndex = 32, Parent = window,
		Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 14), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
