			патроновворужии патроноввмагазине осталосьпатронов текущиепатроны текущийпатрон
	]])
	local AMMO_STOP = Words([[
			storedammo maxstoredammo reserveammo ammostorage ammoreserve totalammo ammototal ammopool
			ammobackup ammobank ammocache ammowarehouse ammoinventory ammosupply ammosupplies ammoreservoir
			spareammo extraammo backupammo sparerounds extrarounds backuprrounds maxammo ammomax maxclip
			maxmag clipmax magmax maxbullet maxround maxshell maxcartridge maxcapacity maxload maxstored
			maxreserve clipcapacity magcapacity magazinecapacity gunmaxammo weaponmaxammo toolmaxammo
			ammocapacity weaponcapacity clipmaxammo magmaxammo magazinemaxammo isreloading reloading
			reloadtime reloadprogress reloadstate reloadspeed reloadstart reloadend hasammo noammo
			outofammo emptygun ammotype ammoname ammoid ammokind ammodamage ammospeed ammopower ammoweight
			ammosize ammocaliber ammogauge
	]])
	local JAM = Words([[
			jammed isjammed isjam jam jamstate jamstatus gunjammed weaponjammed tooljammed playerjammed
			gunjam weaponjam tooljam jammedstate jammedstatus jammedvalue jammedflag jamflag jamvalue
			jamamount jamcount isgunjammed isweaponjammed istooljammed hasjam hasjammed getjammed setjammed
			acsclientjammed acsjam acsjammed weaponisjammed gunisjammed toolisjammed isjamming jamming
			jammedbool
	]])
	local JAM_STOP = Words([[
			jammer jamsound jamanim jamsfx
	]])
	local ZERO = Words([[
			recoil spread inaccuracy kickback kick recoilpower spreadpower recoilamount spreadamount
			aiminaccuracy aimspread aimrecoil hipspread hiprecoil adsspread adsrecoil gunrecoil gunspread
			camrecoil camspread weaponrecoil weaponspread minrecoil maxrecoil minspread maxspread recoilup
			recoildown recoilleft recoilright recoiltilt recoilx recoily recoilhorizontal recoilvertical
			spreadx spready spreadhorizontal spreadvertical inaccuracystep inaccuracydecrease
			aiminaccuracystep aiminaccuracydecrease recoilpowerstep recoilpowerstepamount recoilstep
			recoilstepamount spreadstep spreadstepamount recoilreduction spreadreduction recoildecrease
			spreaddecrease recoilrecovery spreadrecovery recoildecay spreaddecay recoilcontrol
			spreadcontrol verticalrecoil horizontalrecoil verticalspread horizontalspread camerarecoil
			cameraspread walkrecoil walkspread jumprecoil jumpspread crouchrecoil crouchspread pronerecoil
			pronespread bulletspread bulletrecoil bulletinaccuracy
	]])

	local AMMO_ATTRS = {
		"ACSClientAmmoInGun", "AmmoInGun", "CurrentAmmo", "ClipAmmo", "MagAmmo", "Ammo",
		"AmmoCount", "BulletsInGun", "RoundsInGun", "BulletsLeft", "RoundsLeft", "ShellsInGun"
	}
	local JAM_ATTRS = { "ACSClientJammed", "Jammed", "IsJammed", "JammedState", "IsJam", "GunJammed", "WeaponJammed" }
	local WALL_KEYS = Words("penetration penetrationpower wallpenetration penetrationamount penetrationdepth")
	local FOLDERS = { "NPCs", "Npcs", "npcs", "Enemies", "Mobs", "Monsters", "Bots" }
	local MUZZLE_ATTACHMENTS = { "Muzzle", "muzzle", "MuzzlePoint", "muzzlePoint", "BarrelPoint", "Tip", "tip" }
	local MUZZLE_PARTS = { "Muzzle", "muzzle", "Barrel", "barrel", "Tip", "tip", "MuzzlePoint" }
	local PARTS_ALL, PARTS_BOTH, PARTS_HEAD, PARTS_TORSO = { "Head", "Torso", "Center" }, { "Head", "Torso" }, { "Head" }, { "Torso" }

	local ZPATHS = {}
	for path in ([[
		gunRecoil.gunRecoilUp.1 gunRecoil.gunRecoilUp.2 gunRecoil.gunRecoilLeft.1 gunRecoil.gunRecoilLeft.2
		gunRecoil.gunRecoilRight.1 gunRecoil.gunRecoilRight.2 gunRecoil.gunRecoilTilt.1 gunRecoil.gunRecoilTilt.2
		camRecoil.camRecoilUp.1 camRecoil.camRecoilUp.2 camRecoil.camRecoilLeft.1 camRecoil.camRecoilLeft.2
		camRecoil.camRecoilRight.1 camRecoil.camRecoilRight.2 camRecoil.camRecoilTilt.1 camRecoil.camRecoilTilt.2
		MinSpread MaxSpread MinRecoilPower MaxRecoilPower RecoilPowerStepAmount AimInaccuracyStepAmount AimInaccuracyDecrease
	]]):gmatch("%S+") do
		local parts = {}
		for piece in path:gmatch("[^%.]+") do parts[#parts + 1] = tonumber(piece) or piece end
		ZPATHS[#ZPATHS + 1] = { parts = parts, spread = path:find("Spread", 1, true) ~= nil or path:find("Inaccuracy", 1, true) ~= nil }
	end

	local C = {
		SA = false, AutoFire = true, BlockMouse = true, SnapDelay = 0.02, HoldAfter = 0.001, Clicks = 1, ClickInterval = 0.02,
		LoopSpeed = 1, Repeat = "RPM", FixedTime = 0.5, TargetPart = "Head", WallCheck = true, ShowFOV = true, FOV = 300,
		NPCs = true, Players = false, TeamCheck = true, MaxDistance = 1000, AimCheck = true, AimKey = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2,
		CheckAmmo = true, CheckJammed = true, ZeroRecoil = false, ZeroSpread = false,
		WallMode = "muzzle", WallMult = 1, WallOverride = false, WallOverrideVal = 10, MaxThickness = 10,
		TB = false, TBHold = 0.02, TBCooldown = 0.1, TBWall = true, TBParts = { Head = true }
	}
	local function NewAim(speed)
		return { On = false, Speed = speed, Loop = false, Locked = nil, Targets = { Player = true }, Part = "Head", Predict = "Custom", Ms = 50, Wall = true, Buf = {} }
	end
	local Cf, Ms = NewAim(50), NewAim(25)

	local kinds = {}
	local function Kind(name)
		local kind = kinds[name]
		if kind == nil then
			local key = name:lower():gsub("[%s_%-]", "")
			if AMMO[key] and not AMMO_STOP[key] then
				kind = "ammo"
			elseif JAM[key] and not JAM_STOP[key] then
				kind = "jam"
			elseif ZERO[key] then
				kind = (key:find("spread", 1, true) or key:find("inaccuracy", 1, true)) and "spread" or "recoil"
			else
				kind = false
			end
			kinds[name] = kind
		end
		return kind
	end

	local function Dig(tbl, parts)
		local cur = tbl
		for i = 1, #parts do
			if type(cur) ~= "table" then return nil end
			cur = cur[parts[i]]
		end
		return cur
	end

	local function Put(tbl, parts, value)
		local cur = tbl
		for i = 1, #parts - 1 do
			cur = cur[parts[i]]
			if type(cur) ~= "table" then return end
		end
		local key = parts[#parts]
		if cur[key] ~= nil then cur[key] = value end
	end

	local function WallScan(tbl, depth)
		if depth > 4 then return nil end
		for key, value in pairs(tbl) do
			if type(key) == "string" and type(value) == "number" then
				local name = key:lower():gsub("[%s_%-]", "")
				if not name:find("bulletpen", 1, true) and (name:find("wallbang", 1, true) or WALL_KEYS[name]) then return value, key end
			end
			if type(value) == "table" then
				local found, foundKey = WallScan(value, depth + 1)
				if found then return found, foundKey end
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local cache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

	local function Build(tool)
		local data = { Zero = {}, Paths = {} }
		for _, attr in ipairs(AMMO_ATTRS) do
			if type(tool:GetAttribute(attr)) == "number" then
				data.AmmoAttr = attr
				break
			end
		end
		for _, attr in ipairs(JAM_ATTRS) do
			if tool:GetAttribute(attr) ~= nil then
				data.JamAttr = attr
				break
			end
		end
		local roots = { tool }
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
		if char then roots[#roots + 1] = char end
		if backpack then roots[#roots + 1] = backpack end
		local seen = {}
		for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
			for _, inst in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
				if not seen[inst] then
					seen[inst] = true
					local kind = Kind(inst.Name)
					if kind == "ammo" then
						if not data.AmmoAttr and not data.AmmoInst and (inst:IsA("IntValue") or inst:IsA("NumberValue")) then data.AmmoInst = inst end
					elseif kind == "jam" then
						if not data.JamAttr and not data.JamInst and inst:IsA("ValueBase") then data.JamInst = inst end
					elseif kind and (inst:IsA("IntValue") or inst:IsA("NumberValue")) then
						data.Zero[inst] = { inst.Value, kind == "spread" }
					end
				end
			end
		end
		local module = tool:FindFirstChild("ACS_Settings")
		if module then
			local ok, settings = pcall(require, module)
			if ok and type(settings) == "table" then
				data.Settings = settings
				data.RPM = settings.ShootRate or settings.FireRate or settings.RPM
				for _, path in ipairs(ZPATHS) do
					local value = Dig(settings, path.parts)
					if value ~= nil then data.Paths[path] = { value, path.spread } end
				end
			end
		end
		cache[tool] = data
		return data
	end

	local function Data(tool)
		return cache[tool] or Build(tool)
	end

	local function Equipped()
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		return char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	end

	local function Ammo(tool)
		local data = Data(tool)
		if data.AmmoAttr then
			local value = tool:GetAttribute(data.AmmoAttr)
			if type(value) == "number" then return value, "attr:" .. data.AmmoAttr end
		end
		local inst = data.AmmoInst
		if inst and inst.Parent then return inst.Value, "val:" .. inst.Name end
		return nil
	end

	local function Jammed(tool)
		local data = Data(tool)
		local value
		if data.JamAttr then value = tool:GetAttribute(data.JamAttr) end
		if value == nil and data.JamInst and data.JamInst.Parent then value = data.JamInst.Value end
		if type(value) == "boolean" then return value end
		if type(value) == "number" then return value ~= 0 end
		return false
	end

	local function CanShoot(tool)
		if not tool then return false end
		if C.CheckJammed and Jammed(tool) then return false end
		if C.CheckAmmo then
			local ammo = Ammo(tool)
			if ammo and ammo <= 0 then return false end
		end
		return true
	end

	local function Zero(tool)
		local data = Data(tool)
		local recoil, spread = C.ZeroRecoil, C.ZeroSpread
		for inst, info in pairs(data.Zero) do
			if inst.Parent and (info[2] and spread or not info[2] and recoil) then inst.Value = 0 end
		end
		if data.Settings then
			for path, info in pairs(data.Paths) do
				if info[2] and spread or not info[2] and recoil then pcall(Put, data.Settings, path.parts, 0) end
			end
		end
	end

	local function Restore(tool)
		local data = cache[tool]
		if not data then return end
		for inst, info in pairs(data.Zero) do
			if inst.Parent then inst.Value = info[1] end
		end
		if data.Settings then
			for path, info in pairs(data.Paths) do pcall(Put, data.Settings, path.parts, info[1]) end
		end
		cache[tool] = nil
	end

	local zeroLinks = {}
	local function UnlinkZero()
		for _, link in ipairs(zeroLinks) do link:Disconnect() end
		table.clear(zeroLinks)
	end

	local function HookChar(char)
		zeroLinks[#zeroLinks + 1] = char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			if child:IsA("Tool") then Zero(child) end
		end)
		zeroLinks[#zeroLinks + 1] = char.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
			if child:IsA("Tool") then Restore(child) end
		end)
	end

	local function SyncZero()
		local tool = Equipped()
		if tool then
			Restore(tool)
			if C.ZeroRecoil or C.ZeroSpread then Zero(tool) end
		end
		UnlinkZero()
		if C.ZeroRecoil or C.ZeroSpread then
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			if char then HookChar(char) end
			zeroLinks[#zeroLinks + 1] = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(HookChar)
		end
	end

	local blocked, savedBehavior, savedIcon = false, nil, nil
	local function Block()
		if blocked then return end
		blocked = true
		savedBehavior, savedIcon = UIS.MouseBehavior, UIS.MouseIconEnabled
		pcall(function()
			UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCurrentPosition
			UIS.MouseIconEnabled = false
		end)
	end
	local function Unblock()
		if not blocked then return end
		blocked = false
		pcall(function()
			UIS.MouseBehavior = savedBehavior
			UIS.MouseIconEnabled = savedIcon
		end)
	end

	local VIM
	local function Click()
		if type(mouse1click) == "function" then return mouse1click() end
		if type(mouse1press) == "function" and type(mouse1release) == "function" then
			mouse1press()
			task.wait(0.01)
			mouse1release()
			return
		end
		VIM = VIM or game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
		local loc = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
		pcall(VIM.SendMouseButtonEvent, VIM, loc.X, loc.Y, 0, true, game, 1)
		task.wait(0.01)
		pcall(VIM.SendMouseButtonEvent, VIM, loc.X, loc.Y, 0, false, game, 1)
	end

	local held = false
	live[#live + 1] = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if processed then return end
		local key = C.AimKey
		if input.UserInputType == key or input.KeyCode == key then held = true end
	end)
	live[#live + 1] = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		local key = C.AimKey
		if input.UserInputType == key or input.KeyCode == key then held = false end
	end)
	local function Held()
		return not C.AimCheck or held
	end

	local npcs, npcOn = {}, false
	local function Track(inst)
		if inst.ClassName == "Humanoid" then
			local model = inst.Parent
			if model and model.ClassName == "Model" then npcs[model] = inst end
		end
	end
	local function StartNpc()
		if npcOn then return end
		npcOn = true
		for _, inst in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do Track(inst) end
		live[#live + 1] = Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(Track)
	end

	local folderModels, folderStamp = {}, 0
	local function FolderModels()
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - folderStamp > 1 then
			folderStamp = now
			table.clear(folderModels)
			for _, name in ipairs(FOLDERS) do
				local folder = Workspace:FindFirstChild(name, true)
				if folder then
					for _, inst in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
						if inst.ClassName == "Model" and inst:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then folderModels[#folderModels + 1] = inst end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return folderModels
	end

	local function NpcLive(model, hum)
		if hum.Parent ~= model or not model:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then return nil end
		if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) or model == LocalPlayer.Character then return false end
		return hum.Health > 0
	end

	local function Alive(model)
		if not model or not model.Parent then return false end
		local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		return hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0
	end

	local function PartOf(model, kind)
		if not model.Parent then return nil end
		if kind == "Head" then return model:FindFirstChild("Head") end
		local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local torso = model:FindFirstChild("Torso") or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or root
		if kind == "Torso" then return torso end
		return root or torso or model:FindFirstChild("Head")
	end

	local function Cam()
		return Workspace.CurrentCamera
	end

	local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
	rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	rayParams.IgnoreWater = true
	local filterBuf = {}
	local function Filter(a, b)
		table.clear(filterBuf)
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		if char then filterBuf[#filterBuf + 1] = char end
		if a then filterBuf[#filterBuf + 1] = a end
		if b then filterBuf[#filterBuf + 1] = b end
		rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterBuf
	end

	local function Clear(from, part)
		Filter(part.Parent)
		return Workspace:Raycast(from, part.Position - from, rayParams) == nil
	end

	local function Predict(part, mode, ms)
		local velocity = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local time = mode == "Custom" and ms or math.clamp(velocity.Magnitude * 4, 0, 200)
		return part.Position + velocity * (time / 1000)
	end

	local function AimTargets(aim)
		local out, T = aim.Buf, aim.Targets
		table.clear(out)
		if T.Player then
			for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local char = plr.Character
				if plr ~= LocalPlayer and char then
					local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if hum and hum.Health > 0 then out[#out + 1] = char end
				end
			end
		end
		if T.Npc_Humanoid then
			StartNpc()
			for model, hum in pairs(npcs) do
				local alive = NpcLive(model, hum)
				if alive == nil then
					npcs[model] = nil
				elseif alive and model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and model:FindFirstChild("Head")
					and (model:FindFirstChild("Torso") or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")) then
					out[#out + 1] = model
				end
			end
		end
		if T.Npc_Workspace then
			for _, model in ipairs(FolderModels()) do out[#out + 1] = model end
		end
		return out
	end

	local function Valid(aim, part)
		local model = part.Parent
		if not model then return false end
		local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum and hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
		local cam = Cam()
		if not cam then return false end
		local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
		if aim.Wall and not Clear(origin, part) then return false end
		local _, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
		return onScreen and (part.Position - origin).Magnitude <= 1000
	end

	local function Best(aim)
		if aim.Loop and aim.Locked then
			if Valid(aim, aim.Locked) then return aim.Locked end
			aim.Locked = nil
		end
		local cam = Cam()
		if not cam then return nil end
		local list = AimTargets(aim)
		local origin, size = cam.CFrame.Position, cam.ViewportSize
		local cx, cy = size.X / 2, size.Y / 2
		local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
		for i = 1, #list do
			local part = PartOf(list[i], aim.Part)
			if part then
				local point, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
				if onScreen then
					local dx, dy = point.X - cx, point.Y - cy
					local dist = dx * dx + dy * dy
					if dist < bestDist and (not aim.Wall or Clear(origin, part)) then best, bestDist = part, dist end
				end
			end
		end
		if best and aim.Loop then aim.Locked = best end
		return best
	end

	local aimLink
	local function AimStep()
		local cam = Cam()
		if not cam then return end
		if Cf.On then
			local part = Best(Cf)
			if part then
				local current = cam.CFrame
				cam.CFrame = current:Lerp(CFrame.new(current.Position, Predict(part, Cf.Predict, Cf.Ms)), math.clamp(Cf.Speed / 100, 0.001, 1))
			end
		end
		if Ms.On then
			local part = Best(Ms)
			if part then
				local point, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(Predict(part, Ms.Predict, Ms.Ms))
				if onScreen then
					local size = cam.ViewportSize
					local factor = math.clamp(Ms.Speed / 50, 0.001, 1)
					local dx, dy = (point.X - size.X / 2) * factor, (point.Y - size.Y / 2) * factor
					if mousemoverel then
						mousemoverel(dx, dy)
					elseif mousemoveabs then
						mousemoveabs(size.X / 2 + dx, size.Y / 2 + dy)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local function RefreshAim()
		local need = Cf.On or Ms.On
		if need and not aimLink then
			aimLink = Run.RenderStepped:Connect(AimStep)
		elseif not need and aimLink then
			aimLink:Disconnect()
			aimLink = nil
		end
	end

	local candList, candStamp = {}, 0
	local function Cands()
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - candStamp > 0.05 then
			candStamp = now
			table.clear(candList)
			if C.NPCs then
				StartNpc()
				for model, hum in pairs(npcs) do
					local alive = NpcLive(model, hum)
					if alive == nil then
						npcs[model] = nil
					elseif alive then
						candList[#candList + 1] = model
					end
				end
			end
			if C.Players then
				local team = C.TeamCheck and LocalPlayer.Team
				for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
					local char = plr.Character
					if plr ~= LocalPlayer and char and char ~= LocalPlayer.Character and not (team and plr.Team == team) then
						local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
						if hum and hum.Health > 0 then candList[#candList + 1] = char end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return candList
	end

	local function Root()
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		return char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Head"))
	end

	local function FindMuzzle(tool)
		for _, name in ipairs(MUZZLE_ATTACHMENTS) do
			local found = tool:FindFirstChild(name, true)
			if found and found:IsA("Attachment") then return found end
		end
		for _, name in ipairs(MUZZLE_PARTS) do
			local found = tool:FindFirstChild(name, true)
			if found and found:IsA("BasePart") then return found end
		end
		local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
		if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then return handle end
		return nil
	end

	local function MuzzlePos(tool)
		local data = Data(tool)
		local ref = data.Muzzle
		if ref == nil then
			ref = FindMuzzle(tool) or false
			data.Muzzle = ref
		end
		if not ref or not ref.Parent then return nil end
		if ref:IsA("Attachment") then return ref.WorldPosition end
		if ref.Name == "Handle" then return ref.Position + ref.CFrame.LookVector * 1.5 end
		return ref.Position
	end

	local function Thickness(enter, dir, hit, owner)
		local unit = dir.Unit
		Filter(owner, hit)
		local exit = Workspace:Raycast(enter + unit * 0.05, unit * 50, rayParams)
		if not exit then return 50 end
		return (exit.Position - enter).Magnitude
	end

	local function Walls(root, part)
		local owner = part.Parent
		local origin = root.Position
		if C.WallMode == "muzzle" then
			local tool = Equipped()
			local pos = tool and MuzzlePos(tool)
			if pos then origin = pos end
		elseif C.WallMode == "camera" then
			origin = Cam().CFrame.Position
		end
		local target = part.Position
		local dir = target - origin
		local total, single, last = 0, 0, nil
		for _ = 1, 32 do
			Filter(owner)
			local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, dir, rayParams)
			if not result then break end
			local inst = result.Instance
			if inst == last then
				local skip = result.Position + dir.Unit * 0.5
				dir = target - skip
				if dir.Magnitude < 0.1 then break end
				origin = skip
			else
				last = inst
				local thick = Thickness(result.Position, dir, inst, owner)
				if thick > single then single = thick end
				if thick > C.MaxThickness then return total, true, single end
				total = total + thick
				local nextOrigin = result.Position + dir.Unit * (thick + 0.2) + result.Normal * 0.05
				dir = target - nextOrigin
				if dir.Magnitude < 0.1 then break end
				origin = nextOrigin
			end
		end
		return total, false, single
	end

	local function WallPower(tool)
		if C.WallOverride then return C.WallOverrideVal, "override" end
		if not tool then return 0, "0" end
		local data = Data(tool)
		if not data.Settings then return 0, "0" end
		if data.WallBase == nil then
			local value, key = WallScan(data.Settings, 0)
			data.WallBase, data.WallKey = type(value) == "number" and value or 0, key or "0"
		end
		return data.WallBase * C.WallMult, data.WallKey
	end

	local function CanHit(part)
		if not C.WallCheck then return true, 0, "wallcheck_off" end
		local root = Root()
		if not root then return false, 0, "no_root" end
		local total, thick, single = Walls(root, part)
		if thick then return false, total, "too_thick_wall", single end
		if total <= 0.01 then return true, 0, "clear" end
		local power = WallPower(Equipped())
		if power <= 0 then return false, total, "no_wallbang" end
		if total <= power then return true, total, "wb_ok" end
		return false, total, "too_thick"
	end

	local lastTarget, lastInfo = nil, "—"
	local function FindSilent()
		local root, cam = Root(), Cam()
		if not root or not cam then return nil end
		local mouse = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
		local origin = root.Position
		local list = Cands()
		local best, bestDist, reason, blockReason = nil, C.FOV, "—", nil
		for i = 1, #list do
			local model = list[i]
			if Alive(model) then
				local part = PartOf(model, C.TargetPart)
				if part and (part.Position - origin).Magnitude <= C.MaxDistance then
					local point, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
					if onScreen then
						local dist = (Vector2.new(point.X, point.Y) - mouse).Magnitude
						if dist < bestDist then
							local ok, total, why, single = CanHit(part)
							if ok then
								best, bestDist, reason = part, dist, string.format("%s (%.1f)", why, total)
							else
								blockReason = single and string.format("%s (single=%.1f)", why, single) or why
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		lastTarget = best
		lastInfo = (not best and blockReason) and ("BLOCKED: " .. blockReason) or reason
		return best
	end

	local firing, savedCF = false, nil

	local function Hold(part, seconds)
		local stop = os.clock() + seconds
		repeat
			if State.Unloaded or not Alive(part.Parent) then return false end
			local cam = Cam()
			cam.CFrame = lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position)
			task.wait()
		until os.clock() >= stop
		return true
	end

	local function Fire(part)
		if firing then return end
		firing = true
		local ok = pcall(function()
			local model = part.Parent
			if not Alive(model) or not CanShoot(Equipped()) then return end
			local cam = Cam()
			if C.BlockMouse then Block() end
			savedCF = cam.CFrame
			Hold(part, C.SnapDelay)
			if Alive(model) and CanShoot(Equipped()) then
				for _ = 1, C.Clicks do
					if State.Unloaded or not Alive(model) then break end
					cam.CFrame = lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position)
					task.wait(C.ClickInterval)
					if State.Unloaded or not Alive(model) then break end
					cam.CFrame = lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position)
					if C.AutoFire then Click() end
				end
				Hold(part, math.max(0.001, C.HoldAfter))
				if C.ZeroRecoil or C.ZeroSpread then
					local tool = Equipped()
					if tool then Zero(tool) end
				end
			end
			cam.CFrame = savedCF
			savedCF = nil
			Unblock()
		end)
		if not ok then
			if savedCF then pcall(function() Cam().CFrame = savedCF end) end
			savedCF = nil
			Unblock()
		end
		firing = false
	end

	local function Pause(seconds, model)
		local stop = os.clock() + seconds
		while os.clock() < stop and C.SA and not State.Unloaded and Alive(model) do task.wait(0.02) end
	end

	local saActive = false
	local function SilentLoop()
		if saActive then return end
		saActive = true
		task.spawn(function()
			while C.SA and not State.Unloaded do
				local speed = math.max(0.1, C.LoopSpeed)
				local part = Held() and not firing and FindSilent()
				if part and Alive(part.Parent) then
					local model = part.Parent
					Fire(part)
					if C.Repeat == "Time" then
						if C.FixedTime <= 0 then
							while C.SA and not State.Unloaded and Alive(model) do task.wait(0.02) end
						else
							Pause(C.FixedTime / speed, model)
						end
					else
						local tool = Equipped()
						local rpm = tool and Data(tool).RPM
						if type(rpm) ~= "number" or rpm <= 0 then rpm = 600 end
						Pause(60 / rpm / speed, model)
					end
				else
					task.wait(0.1 / speed)
				end
				task.wait()
			end
			saActive = false
		end)
	end

	local function OnCrosshair()
		local root, cam = Root(), Cam()
		if not root or not cam then return false end
		local parts = C.TBParts
		local kindsList = parts.All and PARTS_ALL or (parts.Head and parts.Torso and PARTS_BOTH) or (parts.Head and PARTS_HEAD) or (parts.Torso and PARTS_TORSO)
		if not kindsList then return false end
		local mouse = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
		local origin = root.Position
		local list = Cands()
		for i = 1, #list do
			local model = list[i]
			if Alive(model) then
				for j = 1, #kindsList do
					local part = PartOf(model, kindsList[j])
					if part and (part.Position - origin).Magnitude <= C.MaxDistance then
						local point, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
						if onScreen and (Vector2.new(point.X, point.Y) - mouse).Magnitude < 30 and (not C.TBWall or Clear(origin, part)) then return true end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	local tbActive = false
	local function TriggerLoop()
		if tbActive then return end
		tbActive = true
		task.spawn(function()
			while C.TB and not State.Unloaded do
				if not Held() then
					task.wait(0.05)
				else
					local tool = Equipped()
					if tool and not CanShoot(tool) then
						task.wait(0.05)
					elseif OnCrosshair() then
						task.wait(C.TBHold)
						if State.Unloaded or not C.TB then break end
						if OnCrosshair() then
							Click()
							task.wait(C.TBCooldown)
						end
					else
						task.wait(0.02)
					end
				end
			end
			tbActive = false
		end)
	end

	local fov = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Name = "CombatFOV", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(600, 600),
		Visible = false, ZIndex = 0, Parent = UI.Screen,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
		Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
	})
	local fovLink
	local function RefreshFov()
		local show = C.SA and C.ShowFOV
		fov.Visible = show
		fov.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(C.FOV * 2, C.FOV * 2)
		if show and not fovLink then
			fovLink = Run.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
				local mouse = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
				fov.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mouse.X, mouse.Y)
			end)
		elseif not show and fovLink then
			fovLink:Disconnect()
			fovLink = nil
		end
	end

	function Lib.StopCombat()
		C.SA, C.TB, Cf.On, Ms.On = false, false, false, false
		RefreshAim()
		RefreshFov()
		UnlinkZero()
		if savedCF then pcall(function() Cam().CFrame = savedCF end) savedCF = nil end
		Unblock()
		for tool in pairs(cache) do Restore(tool) end
		for _, link in ipairs(live) do link:Disconnect() end
		table.clear(live)
		fov:Destroy()
	end

	local function Toggle(group, title, desc, tbl, key, last, after)
		local item = Lib.CreateSettingToggleItem(group, title, desc, tbl[key], function(value)
			tbl[key] = value
			if after then after(value) end
		end, last)
		reg[#reg + 1] = { title, "T", function() return tbl[key] end }
		return item
	end

	local function Slider(group, title, desc, min, max, tbl, key, step, suffix, last, after)
		local item = Lib.CreateSettingSliderItem(group, title, desc, min, max, tbl[key], function(value)
			tbl[key] = value
			if after then after(value) end
		end, last, suffix, step)
		reg[#reg + 1] = { title, "S", function() return tbl[key] end }
		return item
	end

	local function Choice(group, title, options, default, apply, last, multi)
		local item = Lib.CreateSettingChoiceItem(group, title, options, default, apply, last, multi)
		reg[#reg + 1] = { title, "C" }
		return item
	end

	local function Gear(item, modal)
		local gear = Lib.Create("ImageButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), Position = UDim2.new(1, -98, 0.5, -14), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), AutoButtonColor = false,
			Image = "rbxassetid://119430435918970", ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180), ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, Parent = item,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }),
			Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 5), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 5), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 5) })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(gear, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7)
		gear.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			modal.Open()
		end)
	end

	local TARGET_OPTIONS = { { "Players", "Player" }, { "NPC Humanoid", "Npc_Humanoid" }, { "NPC Folders", "Npc_Workspace" } }
	local PART_OPTIONS = { "Head", "Torso", "Center" }

	local function AimModal(aim, name, maxSpeed)
		local modal = Lib.CreateModal(name .. " Settings", 430, 460)
		local behavior = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(modal.Content, "Behavior", 1)
		Slider(behavior, name .. " Speed", "Aim smoothing speed", 0, maxSpeed, aim, "Speed", 1, nil, false)
		Toggle(behavior, name .. " Loop Target", "Keeps the locked target until it dies or leaves view", aim, "Loop", true, function(value)
			if not value then aim.Locked = nil end
		end)
		local targets = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(modal.Content, "Targets", 2)
		Choice(targets, name .. " Targets", TARGET_OPTIONS, { "Player" }, function(set) aim.Targets = set end, false, true)
		Choice(targets, name .. " Target Part", PART_OPTIONS, aim.Part, function(value) aim.Part = value end, true)
		local prediction = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(modal.Content, "Prediction", 3)
		Choice(prediction, name .. " Predict Mode", { "Custom", "Auto" }, aim.Predict, function(value) aim.Predict = value end)
		Slider(prediction, name .. " Predict", "Prediction time", 1, 100, aim, "Ms", 1, "ms", false)
		Toggle(prediction, name .. " Wall Check", "Ignore targets behind walls", aim, "Wall", true)
		return modal
	end

	local cfModal, msModal = AimModal(Cf, "Cframe", 100), AimModal(Ms, "Mouse", 50)

	local saModal = Lib.CreateModal("Silent Aim Settings", 430, 520)
	local firingGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(saModal.Content, "Firing", 1)
	Toggle(firingGroup, "Block Mouse", "Locks the cursor while the shot is fired", C, "BlockMouse", false)
	Slider(firingGroup, "Snap Delay", "Time the camera is held on target before the shot", 0.001, 5, C, "SnapDelay", 0.001, "s", false)
	Slider(firingGroup, "Hold After Shot", "Time the camera stays on target after the shot", 0.001, 5, C, "HoldAfter", 0.001, "s", false)
	Slider(firingGroup, "Clicks Count", "Clicks fired per cycle", 1, 5, C, "Clicks", 1, nil, false)
	Slider(firingGroup, "Click Interval", "Pause before every click", 0.001, 1, C, "ClickInterval", 0.001, "s", true)
	local loopGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(saModal.Content, "Loop", 2)
	Slider(loopGroup, "Loop Speed", "Speed multiplier of the aim loop", 0.1, 5, C, "LoopSpeed", 0.1, "x", false)
	Choice(loopGroup, "Repeat Mode", { "RPM", "Time" }, C.Repeat, function(value) C.Repeat = value end)
	Slider(loopGroup, "Fixed Time", "Pause between shots in Time mode, 0 = until death", 0, 5, C, "FixedTime", 0.01, "s", true)
	local aimGroupModal = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(saModal.Content, "Targeting", 3)
	Choice(aimGroupModal, "Silent Target Part", { "Head", "Torso" }, C.TargetPart, function(value) C.TargetPart = value end)
	Toggle(aimGroupModal, "Wall Check", "Skips targets that cannot be hit through walls", C, "WallCheck", true)

	local tbModal = Lib.CreateModal("Trigger Bot Settings", 430, 340)
	local tbGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(tbModal.Content, "Trigger", 1)
	Slider(tbGroup, "Hold Before Shot", "Delay between target detection and the shot", 0.001, 1, C, "TBHold", 0.001, "s", false)
	Slider(tbGroup, "Shot Cooldown", "Pause between shots", 0.01, 2, C, "TBCooldown", 0.01, "s", false)
	Toggle(tbGroup, "Trigger Wall Check", "Ignores targets behind walls", C, "TBWall", false)
	Choice(tbGroup, "Trigger Parts", { "Head", "Torso", "All" }, { "Head" }, function(set) C.TBParts = set end, true, true)

	local wbModal = Lib.CreateModal("Wallbang Settings", 430, 400)
	local wbGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(wbModal.Content, "Wallbang", 1)
	Slider(wbGroup, "Wallbang Multiplier", "Multiplies the weapon wallbang power", 0, 20, C, "WallMult", 0.5, "x", false)
	Toggle(wbGroup, "Wallbang Override", "Replaces the weapon value with your own", C, "WallOverride", false)
	Slider(wbGroup, "Override Value", "Custom wallbang power", 0, 100, C, "WallOverrideVal", 1, " studs", false)
	Slider(wbGroup, "Max Wall Thickness", "Maximum thickness of a single wall", 0.1, 100, C, "MaxThickness", 0.5, " studs", false)
	Choice(wbGroup, "Wall Origin", { "muzzle", "camera", "root" }, C.WallMode, function(value) C.WallMode = value end, true)

	local diagModal = Lib.CreateModal("Combat Diagnostics", 380, 440)
	local diagGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(diagModal.Content, "Live", 1)
	local function InfoRow(title, last)
		local row = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = diagGroup })
		local name = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(0.4, -14, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = title, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240),
			TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = row
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(name, "Primary")
		local value = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(0.6, -14, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "—", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150),
			TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = row
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(value, "Secondary")
		if not last then
			Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
				BackgroundTransparency = 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = row
			})
		end
		return value
	end
	local dTarget, dWall, dAmmo, dJam, dWb = InfoRow("Target"), InfoRow("Wall"), InfoRow("Ammo"), InfoRow("Jammed"), InfoRow("Wallbang")
	local dNpc, dMouse, dTools, dAim, dTrigger = InfoRow("NPC"), InfoRow("Mouse"), InfoRow("Cached Tools"), InfoRow("Aim Check"), InfoRow("Trigger Bot", true)

	local function Count(tbl)
		local count = 0
		for _ in pairs(tbl) do count += 1 end
		return count
	end

	local function RefreshDiag()
		dTarget.Text = lastTarget and lastTarget.Parent and (lastTarget.Parent.Name .. " → " .. lastTarget.Name) or "—"
		dWall.Text = lastInfo
		local tool = Equipped()
		if tool then
			local ammo, source = Ammo(tool)
			dAmmo.Text = ammo and (ammo .. " (" .. source .. ")") or "—"
			dJam.Text = tostring(Jammed(tool))
			local power, key = WallPower(tool)
			dWb.Text = string.format("%.1f studs (%s)", power, tostring(key))
		else
			dAmmo.Text, dJam.Text, dWb.Text = "—", "—", "—"
		end
		dNpc.Text = tostring(Count(npcs))
		dMouse.Text = blocked and "LOCKED" or "free"
		dTools.Text = tostring(Count(cache))
		dAim.Text = C.AimCheck and (held and "HELD" or "NOT HELD") or "disabled"
		dTrigger.Text = C.TB and "ENABLED" or "disabled"
	end

	local diagActive = false
	local function OpenDiag()
		diagModal.Open()
		if diagActive then return end
		diagActive = true
		task.spawn(function()
			while not State.Unloaded do
				RefreshDiag()
				task.wait(0.5)
				if not diagModal.Backdrop.Visible then break end
			end
			diagActive = false
		end)
	end

	local aimGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(scroll, "Aim Assist", 1)
	Gear(Toggle(aimGroup, "Cframe Aim", "Smoothly rotates the camera towards the closest target", Cf, "On", false, function(value)
		if not value then Cf.Locked = nil end
		RefreshAim()
	end), cfModal)
	Gear(Toggle(aimGroup, "Mouse Aim", "Moves the mouse towards the closest target", Ms, "On", true, function(value)
		if not value then Ms.Locked = nil end
		RefreshAim()
	end), msModal)

	local silentGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(scroll, "Silent Aim", 2)
	Gear(Toggle(silentGroup, "Silent Aim", "Snaps the camera to the target, fires and returns it back", C, "SA", false, function(value)
		RefreshFov()
		if value then SilentLoop() end
	end), saModal)
	Toggle(silentGroup, "Auto-Fire", "Clicks automatically when a target is locked", C, "AutoFire", false)
	Toggle(silentGroup, "Show FOV Circle", "Draws the Silent Aim FOV around the cursor", C, "ShowFOV", false, RefreshFov)
	Slider(silentGroup, "FOV Radius", "Silent Aim field of view radius", 10, 800, C, "FOV", 1, "px", true, RefreshFov)

	local triggerGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(scroll, "Trigger Bot", 3)
	Gear(Toggle(triggerGroup, "Trigger Bot", "Fires automatically when the crosshair is on a target", C, "TB", true, function(value)
		if value then TriggerLoop() end
	end), tbModal)

	local weaponGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(scroll, "Weapon", 4)
	Toggle(weaponGroup, "Zero Recoil", "Removes weapon recoil", C, "ZeroRecoil", false, SyncZero)
	Toggle(weaponGroup, "Zero Spread", "Removes weapon spread and inaccuracy", C, "ZeroSpread", false, SyncZero)
	Toggle(weaponGroup, "Check Ammo", "Does not shoot with an empty magazine", C, "CheckAmmo", false)
	Toggle(weaponGroup, "Check Jammed", "Does not shoot with a jammed weapon", C, "CheckJammed", false)
	Lib.CreateSettingButtonItem(weaponGroup, "Wallbang Settings", "Power, thickness limit and origin of wallbang checks", function() wbModal.Open() end, true)

	local targetGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(scroll, "Targeting", 5)
	Toggle(targetGroup, "Target NPCs", "Silent Aim and Trigger Bot target NPCs", C, "NPCs", false)
	Toggle(targetGroup, "Target Players", "Silent Aim and Trigger Bot target players", C, "Players", false)
	Toggle(targetGroup, "Team Check", "Ignores players from your team", C, "TeamCheck", false)
	Slider(targetGroup, "Max Distance", "Maximum target distance", 100, 5000, C, "MaxDistance", 50, "m", false)
	Toggle(targetGroup, "Aim Check", "Works only while the aim key is held", C, "AimCheck", false)
	Choice(targetGroup, "Aim Key", { { "RMB", "MouseButton2" }, { "LMB", "MouseButton1" }, "E", "Q", "F", { "L-Alt", "LeftAlt" }, { "R-Alt", "RightAlt" }, { "L-Shift", "LeftShift" } }, "MouseButton2", function(name)
		C.AimKey = name:find("MouseButton", 1, true) and Enum.UserInputType[name] or Enum.KeyCode[name]
		held = false
	end, true)

	local toolsGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(scroll, "Tools", 6)
	Lib.CreateSettingButtonItem(toolsGroup, "Combat Diagnostics", "Live target, ammo, wallbang and aim state", OpenDiag, true)

	Lib.ConfigExtras = Lib.ConfigExtras or {}
	Lib.ConfigExtras.Combat = {
		Dump = function()
			local dump = {}
			for _, entry in ipairs(reg) do
				local title, kind, getter = entry[1], entry[2], entry[3]
				if kind == "C" then
					dump[title] = Lib.ChoiceControls[title].Get()
				else
					dump[title] = getter()
				end
			end
			return dump
		end,
		Apply = function(data)
			for _, entry in ipairs(reg) do
				local title, kind = entry[1], entry[2]
				local value = data[title]
				if value ~= nil then
					if kind == "T" then
						local control = Lib.ToggleControls[title]
						if control and type(value) == "boolean" then control.Set(value) end
					elseif kind == "S" then
						local control = Lib.SliderControls[title]
						if control and type(value) == "number" then control(value) end
					else
						local control = Lib.ChoiceControls[title]
						if control then control.Set(value) end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	}
end

	local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
	rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

	local function pick(o)
		if type(o) == "table" then
			return o[1]
		end
		return o
	end

	local function v2(x, y)
		return Vector2.new(math.floor(x + 0.5), math.floor(y + 0.5))
	end

	local function pp(f)
		f = f % 1
		if f < 0.5 then
			return f * 2
		end
		return (1 - f) * 2
	end

	local function colorFn(c1, c2, rainbow, phase)
		return function(f)
			if rainbow then
				return Color3.fromHSV((f + phase) % 1, 0.75, 1)
			end
			return c1:Lerp(c2, pp(f + phase))
		end
	end

	local function lerp3(c1, c2, x)
		local g = cfg.Gradient
		if g.ThreeColor and not cfg.Visible.Enabled then
			if x < 0.5 then
				return c1:Lerp(g.Color3, x * 2)
			end
			return g.Color3:Lerp(c2, (x - 0.5) * 2)
		end
		return c1:Lerp(c2, x)
	end

	local function gcol(f, c1, c2, solid)
		local g = cfg.Gradient
		if not g.Enabled then
			return solid
		end
		if g.Reverse then
			f = 1 - f
		end
		f = math.clamp(f, 0, 1)
		local t = GT * g.Speed
		local s = g.Scale
		local mode = g.Mode
		local x
		if mode == "Rainbow" then
			return Color3.fromHSV(((f * s) * 0.6 + t * 0.08) % 1, 0.8, 1)
		elseif mode == "Scroll" then
			x = pp(f * s + t * 0.25)
		elseif mode == "Reverse" then
			x = pp(f * s - t * 0.25)
		elseif mode == "Pulse" then
			x = math.sin(t) * 0.5 + 0.5
		elseif mode == "Wave" then
			x = math.sin(f * s * math.pi * 2 + t) * 0.5 + 0.5
		elseif mode == "Shine" then
			local base = lerp3(c1, c2, f)
			local band = (f * s - t * 0.25) % 1
			local w = math.max(0, 1 - math.abs(band - 0.5) * 6)
			return base:Lerp(white, w * 0.85)
		else
			x = f
		end
		if g.Bands > 1 then
			x = math.min(math.floor(x * g.Bands), g.Bands - 1) / (g.Bands - 1)
		end
		return lerp3(c1, c2, x)
	end

	local function sf(nx, ny)
		nx = math.clamp(nx, 0, 1)
		ny = math.clamp(ny, 0, 1)
		local s = cfg.Gradient.Shape
		if s == "Horizontal" then
			return nx
		elseif s == "Diagonal" then
			return (nx + ny) / 2
		elseif s == "Radial" then
			local dx, dy = nx - 0.5, ny - 0.5
			return math.min(1, math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) * 2)
		end
		return ny
	end

	local function gc(pal, f, solid)
		if pal.flat then
			return pal.solid
		end
		return gcol(f, pal.c1, pal.c2, solid or pal.solid)
	end

	local function pc(flag, pal, f, own, useVis)
		if pal.flat then
			return own
		end
		if cfg.Gradient.Enabled and flag then
			return gcol(f, pal.c1, pal.c2, own)
		end
		if useVis and pal.vis then
			return pal.vis
		end
		return own
	end

	local HSEG = 24
	local builders = {}
	local nameGui

	local function mk(obj, g, class, props)
		local d = Drawing.new(class)
		for k, v in pairs(props) do
			d[k] = v
		end
		obj.all[#obj.all + 1] = d
		g.list[#g.list + 1] = d
		return d
	end

	builders.box = function(obj, g)

		g.Box = mk(obj, g, "Square", {Thickness = 1, Filled = false, Visible = false, ZIndex = 2})
		g.Fill = mk(obj, g, "Square", {Filled = true, Visible = false, ZIndex = 0})
	end

	builders.edges = function(obj, g)
		g.T, g.B, g.L, g.R = {}, {}, {}, {}
		for i = 1, 8 do
			g.T[i] = mk(obj, g, "Line", {Visible = false, ZIndex = 2})
			g.B[i] = mk(obj, g, "Line", {Visible = false, ZIndex = 2})
			g.L[i] = mk(obj, g, "Line", {Visible = false, ZIndex = 2})
			g.R[i] = mk(obj, g, "Line", {Visible = false, ZIndex = 2})
		end
	end

	builders.corners = function(obj, g)

		end
	end

	builders.arrow = function(obj, g)
		g.F, g.O = {}, {}

		end
		g.Txt = mk(obj, g, "Text", {Center = true, Outline = true, Size = 13, Color = white, Visible = false, ZIndex = 4})
	end

	builders.head = function(obj, g)
		g.DotO = mk(obj, g, "Circle", {Filled = true, NumSides = 24, Color = black, Visible = false, ZIndex = 1})
		g.Dot = mk(obj, g, "Circle", {Filled = true, NumSides = 24, Visible = false, ZIndex = 2})
		g.VO = mk(obj, g, "Line", {Color = black, Thickness = 3, Visible = false, ZIndex = 1})
		g.V = mk(obj, g, "Line", {Thickness = 1, Visible = false, ZIndex = 2})
	end

	builders.text = function(obj, g)
		g.T = {}
		for _, k in ipairs(textKeys) do
			if k == "Name" then
				if not nameGui or not nameGui.Parent then
					nameGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
					nameGui.Name = "HubEspNames"
					nameGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
					nameGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
					nameGui.DisplayOrder = 1
					nameGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
					Lib.MountGui(nameGui)
				end
				local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
				label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
				label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 20)
				label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
				label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
				label.TextStrokeColor3 = black
				label.Visible = false
				label.Parent = nameGui
				obj.all[#obj.all + 1] = label
				g.list[#g.list + 1] = label
				g.Label = label
			else
				local b = mk(obj, g, "Text", {Center = true, Outline = true, Visible = false, ZIndex = 3})
				local a = mk(obj, g, "Text", {Center = true, Outline = true, Visible = false, ZIndex = 4})
				g.T[k] = {a, b}
			end
		end
	end

	local function createObject()
		return {all = {}, G = {}, pal = {}}
	end

	local function drop(obj, name)
		local g = obj.G[name]
		if g and g.shown then
			for _, d in ipairs(g.list) do
				d.Visible = false
			end
			g.shown = false
		end
	end

	local function use(obj, name, cond)
		if cond then
			local g = obj.G[name]
			if not g then
				g = {list = {}, shown = false}
				obj.G[name] = g
				builders[name](obj, g)
			end
			g.shown = true
			return g
		end
		drop(obj, name)
		return nil
	end

	local function hideObject(obj)
		for name in pairs(obj.G) do
			drop(obj, name)
		end
	end

	local function removeObject(obj)
		for _, d in ipairs(obj.all) do
			pcall(typeof(d) == "Instance" and d.Destroy or d.Remove, d)
		end
	end

	local function setText(g, key, text, size, color, x, y, alpha)
		if key == "Name" then
			local label = g.Label
			local bold = cfg.Text.Bold
			local face = bold and State.CurrentBoldFace or State.CurrentRegularFace
			local font = face or (bold and State.CurrentBoldFont or State.CurrentRegularFont) or (bold and Enum.Font.GothamBold or Enum.Font.GothamMedium)
			if g.fontRef ~= font then
				g.fontRef = font
				if face then
					label.FontFace = face
				else
					label.Font = font
				end
			end
			label.Text = text
			label.TextSize = size
			label.TextColor3 = color
			label.TextTransparency = 1 - alpha
			label.TextStrokeTransparency = 1 - alpha
			label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(x + 0.5), math.floor(y + 0.5))
			label.Visible = true
			return
		end
		local pr = g.T[key]
		local a, b = pr[1], pr[2]
		local font = cfg.Text.Font
		a.Font = font
		a.Text = text
		a.Size = size
		a.Color = color
		a.Position = v2(x, y)
		a.Transparency = alpha
		a.Visible = true
		b.Font = font
		b.Text = text
		b.Size = size
		b.Color = color
		b.Position = v2(x + 1, y)
		b.Transparency = alpha
		b.Visible = cfg.Text.Bold
	end

	local function hideText(g, key)
		if key == "Name" then
			g.Label.Visible = false
			return
		end
		local pr = g.T[key]
		pr[1].Visible = false
		pr[2].Visible = false
	end

	local function sl(l, x1, y1, x2, y2, col, th, alpha)
		l.From = v2(x1, y1)
		l.To = v2(x2, y2)
		l.Color = col
		l.Thickness = th
		l.Transparency = alpha
		l.Visible = true
	end

	local function isLocalCharacter(model)
		return lp.Character ~= nil and model == lp.Character
	end

	local function addHumanoid(h)
		local model = h.Parent
		if model and model:IsA("Model") and not isLocalCharacter(model) then
			humModels[model] = true
		end
	end

	local function addWorkspaceModel(m)
		if m:IsA("Model") and not isLocalCharacter(m) then
			npcWorkspace[m] = true
		end
	end

	local function playerOf(model)
		local pl = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
		if pl then
			return pl
		end
		local byName = Players:FindFirstChild(model.Name)
		if byName and byName:IsA("Player") then
			return byName
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function labelFor(pl)
		return cfg.Name.UseDisplay and pl.DisplayName or pl.Name
	end

	local function teamBlocked(pl)
		return cfg.TeamCheck and lp.Team ~= nil and pl.Team == lp.Team
	end

	local function collectTargets()
		local list = {}
		local T = cfg.Targets
		if T["Player"] then
			for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if p ~= lp and p.Character and not teamBlocked(p) then
					list[p.Character] = {Name = labelFor(p), Player = p}
				end
			end
		end
		if T["Player Humanoid"] or T["Npc Humanoid (better)"] then
			for m in pairs(humModels) do
				if m.Parent and not isLocalCharacter(m) and not list[m] then
					local pl = playerOf(m)
					if pl then
						if T["Player Humanoid"] and pl ~= lp and not teamBlocked(pl) then
							list[m] = {Name = labelFor(pl), Player = pl}
						end
					elseif T["Npc Humanoid (better)"] then
						list[m] = {Name = m.Name}
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if T["Npc WorkSpace"] then
			for m in pairs(npcWorkspace) do
				if m.Parent and not isLocalCharacter(m) and not list[m] and not playerOf(m) then
					list[m] = {Name = m.Name}
				end
			end
		end
		if cfg.Self.Enabled and lp.Character then
			list[lp.Character] = {Name = labelFor(lp), Player = lp, Self = true}
		end
		return list
	end

	local function findRoot(model)
		local r = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("Torso") or model.PrimaryPart
		if r and r:IsA("BasePart") then
			return r
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function snapGeneric(model)
		local minX, minY, minZ = math.huge, math.huge, math.huge
		local maxX, maxY, maxZ = -math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
		local count = 0

		local function add(p)
			local cf = p.CFrame
			local s = p.Size
			local r, u, l = cf.RightVector, cf.UpVector, cf.LookVector
			local hx = 0.5 * (math.abs(r.X) * s.X + math.abs(u.X) * s.Y + math.abs(l.X) * s.Z)
			local hy = 0.5 * (math.abs(r.Y) * s.X + math.abs(u.Y) * s.Y + math.abs(l.Y) * s.Z)
			local hz = 0.5 * (math.abs(r.Z) * s.X + math.abs(u.Z) * s.Y + math.abs(l.Z) * s.Z)
			local pos = cf.Position
			minX = math.min(minX, pos.X - hx)
			maxX = math.max(maxX, pos.X + hx)
			minY = math.min(minY, pos.Y - hy)
			maxY = math.max(maxY, pos.Y + hy)
			minZ = math.min(minZ, pos.Z - hz)
			maxZ = math.max(maxZ, pos.Z + hz)
			count = count + 1
		end

		for _, p in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then
				add(p)
			end
		end
		if count == 0 then
			for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") then
					add(p)
				end
			end
		end
		if count == 0 then
			return nil
		end

		local wh = maxY - minY
		if wh <= 0.1 or wh > 80 then
			return nil
		end
		local ww = ((maxX - minX) + (maxZ - minZ)) / 2
		local cx, cz = (minX + maxX) / 2, (minZ + maxZ) / 2
		local c = Vector3.new(cx, (minY + maxY) / 2, cz)
		return {
			pos = c,
			top = Vector3.new(cx, maxY, cz),
			bot = Vector3.new(cx, minY, cz),
			cf = CFrame.new(c),
			wh = wh,
			wr = ww / wh
		}
	end

	local function getSnap(model, humanoid)
		if not humanoid then
			return snapGeneric(model)
		end
		local root = findRoot(model)
		if not root then
			return nil
		end
		local pos = root.Position
		local hip = humanoid.HipHeight > 0 and (humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2) or (3 * math.clamp(root.Size.Y / 2, 0.4, 6))
		local topW = Vector3.new(pos.X, pos.Y + hip * 0.87, pos.Z)
		local botW = Vector3.new(pos.X, pos.Y - hip, pos.Z)
		local mid = (topW + botW) / 2
		return {
			pos = pos,
			top = topW,
			bot = botW,
			cf = CFrame.new(mid) * (root.CFrame - root.CFrame.Position),
			wh = hip * 1.87,
			wr = nil
		}
	end

	local function project(snap, camera)
		local top = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(snap.top)
		local bot = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(snap.bot)
		if top.Z <= 0 or bot.Z <= 0 then
			return nil
		end
		local hpx = bot.Y - top.Y
		if hpx <= 2 then
			return nil
		end
		local mid = camera:WorldToViewportPoint((snap.top + snap.bot) / 2)
		local scale = cfg.Box.Scale / 100
		local h = hpx * scale
		local w = hpx * (snap.wr or (cfg.Box.Width / 100)) * scale
		return mid.X - w / 2, mid.Y - h / 2, mid.X + w / 2, mid.Y + h / 2
	end

	local function isVisible(model, pos, camera)
		rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {lp.Character, model, camera}
		local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
		return Workspace:Raycast(origin, pos - origin, rayParams) == nil
	end

	local function anyEnabled()
		return cfg.Box.Enabled or cfg.Name.Enabled or cfg.Health.Enabled or cfg.Distance.Enabled or cfg.Tool.Enabled or cfg.Tracer.Enabled
			or cfg.Skeleton.Enabled or cfg.Chams.Enabled or cfg.Arrows.Enabled or cfg.HeadDot.Enabled or cfg.ViewLine.Enabled or cfg.History.Enabled
	end

	local trackConns = {}
	local humTracked, wsTracked = false, false

	local function syncTracking()
		local T = cfg.Targets
		local active = anyEnabled()
		local needHum = active and (T["Player Humanoid"] or T["Npc Humanoid (better)"]) and true or false
		local needWs = active and T["Npc WorkSpace"] and true or false
		if needHum and not humTracked then
			humTracked = true
			for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
				if v:IsA("Humanoid") then
					addHumanoid(v)
				end
			end
			trackConns.hAdd = Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(v)
				if v:IsA("Humanoid") then
					task.defer(addHumanoid, v)
				end
			end)
			trackConns.hRem = Workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(v)
				if v:IsA("Humanoid") then
					local m = v.Parent
					if m then
						humModels[m] = nil
					end
				elseif v:IsA("Model") then
					humModels[v] = nil
				end
			end)
		elseif not needHum and humTracked then
			humTracked = false
			trackConns.hAdd:Disconnect()
			trackConns.hRem:Disconnect()
			table.clear(humModels)
		end
		if needWs and not wsTracked then
			wsTracked = true
			for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
				addWorkspaceModel(v)
			end
			trackConns.wAdd = Workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(addWorkspaceModel)
			trackConns.wRem = Workspace.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(m)
				npcWorkspace[m] = nil
			end)
		elseif not needWs and wsTracked then
			wsTracked = false
			trackConns.wAdd:Disconnect()
			trackConns.wRem:Disconnect()
			table.clear(npcWorkspace)
		end
	end

	local function getTracerOrigin(viewport)
		local o = cfg.Tracer.Origin
		if o == "Center" then
			return Vector2.new(viewport.X / 2, viewport.Y / 2)
		elseif o == "Top" then
			return Vector2.new(viewport.X / 2, 0)
		elseif o == "Mouse" then
			return UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		end
		return Vector2.new(viewport.X / 2, viewport.Y)
	end

	local cubeEdges = {{1, 2}, {3, 4}, {5, 6}, {7, 8}, {1, 3}, {2, 4}, {5, 7}, {6, 8}, {1, 5}, {2, 6}, {3, 7}, {4, 8}}
	local CD = {}
	for i = 1, 8 do
		CD[i] = {0, 0, 0, 0}
	end
	local CP = {}

	local function setCD(i, a, b, c, d)
		local t = CD[i]
		t[1], t[2], t[3], t[4] = a, b, c, d
	end

	local function drawBox(obj, minX, minY, maxX, maxY, pal, alpha, forceOn, snap, camera)
		local b, g = cfg.Box, cfg.Gradient
		local on = forceOn or b.Enabled
		local style = b.Style
		local w, h = maxX - minX, maxY - minY
		local rw, rh = math.floor(w + 0.5), math.floor(h + 0.5)
		local th = b.Thickness
		local outl = b.Outline
		local gradOn = g.Enabled and not pal.flat

		local full = on and style == "Full"
		local plain = full and not gradOn
		local seg = on and ((style == "Full" and gradOn) or style == "Dashed")
		local corner = on and (style == "Corners" or style == "Brackets")
		local diamond = on and style == "Diamond"
		local cube = on and style == "3D" and snap ~= nil

		local fillOn = on and b.Filled
		local gridFill = fillOn and gradOn and g.Fill and g.FillType ~= "Solid"
		local singleFill = fillOn and not gridFill

		local bg = use(obj, "box", plain or singleFill)
		if bg then
			bg.Outline.Position = v2(minX, minY)
			bg.Outline.Size = Vector2.new(rw, rh)
			bg.Outline.Thickness = th + 2
			bg.Outline.Transparency = alpha
			bg.Outline.Visible = plain and outl
			bg.Box.Position = v2(minX, minY)
			bg.Box.Size = Vector2.new(rw, rh)
			bg.Box.Color = pal.solid
			bg.Box.Thickness = th
			bg.Box.Transparency = alpha
			bg.Box.Visible = plain
			bg.Fill.Position = v2(minX, minY)
			bg.Fill.Size = Vector2.new(rw, rh)
			bg.Fill.Color = (gradOn and g.Fill) and gc(pal, 0.5) or pal.solid
			bg.Fill.Transparency = b.Opacity * alpha
			bg.Fill.Visible = singleFill
		end

		local eg = use(obj, "edges", seg)
		if eg then
			local dash = style == "Dashed"
			for i = 1, 8 do
				local t, bt, l, r = eg.T[i], eg.B[i], eg.L[i], eg.R[i]
				if not dash or i % 2 == 1 then
					local x0, x1 = minX + (i - 1) * w / 8, minX + i * w / 8
					local y0, y1 = minY + (i - 1) * h / 8, minY + i * h / 8
					local f = (i - 0.5) / 8
					sl(t, x0, minY, x1, minY, gc(pal, sf(f, 0)), th, alpha)
					sl(bt, x0, maxY, x1, maxY, gc(pal, sf(f, 1)), th, alpha)
					sl(l, minX, y0, minX, y1, gc(pal, sf(0, f)), th, alpha)
					sl(r, maxX, y0, maxX, y1, gc(pal, sf(1, f)), th, alpha)
				else
					t.Visible = false
					bt.Visible = false
					l.Visible = false
					r.Visible = false
				end
			end
		end

		local cg = use(obj, "corners", corner or diamond)
		if cg then
			local count = 8
			if diamond then
				count = 4
				local mx, my = minX + w / 2, minY + h / 2
				setCD(1, mx, minY, maxX, my)
				setCD(2, maxX, my, mx, maxY)
				setCD(3, mx, maxY, minX, my)
				setCD(4, minX, my, mx, minY)
			else
				local cw = w * b.CornerW / 100
				local ch = style == "Brackets" and (h / 2) or (h * b.CornerH / 100)
				if style == "Brackets" then
					cw = w * 0.25
				end
				setCD(1, minX, minY, minX + cw, minY)
				setCD(2, minX, minY, minX, minY + ch)
				setCD(3, maxX, minY, maxX - cw, minY)
				setCD(4, maxX, minY, maxX, minY + ch)
				setCD(5, minX, maxY, minX + cw, maxY)
				setCD(6, minX, maxY, minX, maxY - ch)
				setCD(7, maxX, maxY, maxX - cw, maxY)
				setCD(8, maxX, maxY, maxX, maxY - ch)
			end
			for i = 1, 8 do
				local main, out = cg.C[i], cg.CO[i]
				if i <= count then
					local d = CD[i]
					local nx = ((d[1] + d[3]) / 2 - minX) / math.max(w, 1)
					local ny = ((d[2] + d[4]) / 2 - minY) / math.max(h, 1)
					sl(main, d[1], d[2], d[3], d[4], gc(pal, sf(nx, ny)), th, alpha)
					if outl then
						sl(out, d[1], d[2], d[3], d[4], black, th + 2, alpha)
					else
						out.Visible = false
					end
				else
					main.Visible = false
					out.Visible = false
				end
			end
		end

		local qg = use(obj, "cube", cube)
		if qg then
			local s = b.Scale / 100
			local wr = snap.wr or (b.Width / 100)
			local sx, sy, sz = snap.wh * wr * s / 2, snap.wh * s / 2, snap.wh * wr * s * 0.75 / 2
			for idx = 0, 7 do
				local ax = (idx % 2 == 1) and sx or -sx
				local ay = (math.floor(idx / 2) % 2 == 1) and sy or -sy
				local az = (math.floor(idx / 4) % 2 == 1) and sz or -sz
				CP[idx + 1] = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(snap.cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(ax, ay, az)))
			end
			for i, e in ipairs(cubeEdges) do
				local a, c = CP[e[1]], CP[e[2]]
				local l, o = qg.L[i], qg.O[i]
				if a.Z > 0 and c.Z > 0 then
					local nx = ((a.X + c.X) / 2 - minX) / math.max(w, 1)
					local ny = ((a.Y + c.Y) / 2 - minY) / math.max(h, 1)
					if outl then
						sl(o, a.X, a.Y, c.X, c.Y, black, th + 2, alpha)
					else
						o.Visible = false
					end
					sl(l, a.X, a.Y, c.X, c.Y, gc(pal, sf(nx, ny)), th, alpha)
				else
					l.Visible = false
					o.Visible = false
				end
			end
		end

		local fg = use(obj, "fill", gridFill)
		if fg then
			local ft, shape = g.FillType, g.Shape
			local cols, rows
			if ft == "Stripes" then
				if shape == "Horizontal" then
					cols, rows = 12, 1
				else
					cols, rows = 1, 12
				end
			elseif ft == "Checker" then
				cols, rows = 6, 6
			elseif shape == "Vertical" then
				cols, rows = 1, 12
			elseif shape == "Horizontal" then
				cols, rows = 12, 1
			else
				cols, rows = 6, 6
			end
			local cw, ch = w / cols, h / rows
			local k = 0
			for r = 1, rows do
				for c = 1, cols do
					k = k + 1
					local sq = fg.S[k]
					local vis = true
					if ft == "Stripes" then
						vis = ((shape == "Horizontal") and c or r) % 2 == 1
					elseif ft == "Checker" then
						vis = (r + c) % 2 == 0
					end
					if vis then
						local x0 = math.floor(minX + (c - 1) * cw + 0.5)
						local y0 = math.floor(minY + (r - 1) * ch + 0.5)
						local x1 = math.floor(minX + c * cw + 0.5)
						local y1 = math.floor(minY + r * ch + 0.5)
						sq.Position = Vector2.new(x0, y0)
						sq.Size = Vector2.new(math.max(1, x1 - x0), math.max(1, y1 - y0))
						sq.Color = gc(pal, sf((c - 0.5) / cols, (r - 0.5) / rows))
						sq.Transparency = b.Opacity * alpha
						sq.Visible = true
					else
						sq.Visible = false
					end
				end
			end
			for j = k + 1, 36 do
				fg.S[j].Visible = false
			end
		end
	end

	local arrowShapes = {
		Triangle = {{{1, 0}, {-0.7, 0.75}, {-0.7, -0.75}}},
		Dart = {{{1, 0}, {-0.8, 0.75}, {-0.3, 0}}, {{1, 0}, {-0.3, 0}, {-0.8, -0.75}}},
		Chevron = {
			{{1, 0}, {-0.1, 0.85}, {0.25, 0}}, {{-0.1, 0.85}, {-0.5, 0.5}, {0.25, 0}},
			{{1, 0}, {0.25, 0}, {-0.1, -0.85}}, {{-0.1, -0.85}, {0.25, 0}, {-0.5, -0.5}}
		},
		Needle = {{{1.3, 0}, {-0.6, 0.38}, {-0.2, 0}}, {{1.3, 0}, {-0.2, 0}, {-0.6, -0.38}}},
		Double = {{{1, 0}, {0.2, 0.6}, {0.2, -0.6}}, {{0.05, 0}, {-0.75, 0.6}, {-0.75, -0.6}}}
	}

	local function drawArrow(obj, snap, camera, viewport, pal, dist)
		local a = cfg.Arrows
		local sp = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(snap.pos)
		local onScreen = sp.Z > 0 and sp.X > 0 and sp.X < viewport.X and sp.Y > 0 and sp.Y < viewport.Y
		local ag = use(obj, "arrow", a.Enabled and not onScreen)
		if not ag then
			return
		end
		local rel = camera.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(snap.pos)
		local dx, dy = rel.X, -rel.Y
		local len = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
		if len < 0.001 then
			dx, dy, len = 0, 1, 1
		end
		dx, dy = dx / len, dy / len
		local px, py = -dy, dx
		local cx, cy = viewport.X / 2, viewport.Y / 2
		local S = a.Size * (a.DistScale and math.clamp(1.5 - dist / math.max(cfg.MaxDistance, 1), 0.6, 1.3) or 1)
		local rx = math.max(30, math.min(a.Radius * 1.4, cx - S * 1.6 - 6))
		local ry = math.max(30, math.min(a.Radius, cy - S * 1.6 - 6))
		local k = 1 / math.sqrt((dx / rx) ^ 2 + (dy / ry) ^ 2)
		local bx, by = cx + dx * k, cy + dy * k
		local col = pc(cfg.Gradient.Extras, pal, 0.5, a.Color, false)
		local shape = arrowShapes[a.Style] or arrowShapes.Dart
		local function at(u, v)
			return Vector2.new(bx + (dx * u + px * v) * S, by + (dy * u + py * v) * S)
		end
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local f, o, tri = ag.F[i], ag.O[i], shape[i]
			if tri then
				local A, B, C = at(tri[1][1], tri[1][2]), at(tri[2][1], tri[2][2]), at(tri[3][1], tri[3][2])
				f.PointA, f.PointB, f.PointC = A, B, C
				f.Color = col
				f.Visible = a.Filled
				o.PointA, o.PointB, o.PointC = A, B, C
				o.Color = a.Filled and black or col
				o.Visible = a.Outline or not a.Filled
			else
				f.Visible = false
				o.Visible = false
			end
		end
		ag.Txt.Visible = a.ShowDist
		if a.ShowDist then
			ag.Txt.Text = math.floor(dist) .. "m"
			ag.Txt.Position = v2(bx - dx * (S * 1.3 + 10), by - dy * (S * 1.3 + 10))
		end
	end

	local hpB, hpCol, hpBZ = {}, {}, -1

	local function hpColor(t, bz)
		if t <= bz then
			return black:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0), t / bz)
		end
		return Color3.fromHSV(((t - bz) / (1 - bz)) * 0.3333, 1, 1)
	end

	local function rebuildHp(bz)
		hpBZ = bz
		hpB[0] = 0
		hpB[1] = bz
		for i = 2, HSEG do
			hpB[i] = bz + (1 - bz) * (i - 1) / (HSEG - 1)
		end
		for i = 1, HSEG do
			hpCol[i] = hpColor((hpB[i - 1] + hpB[i]) / 2, bz)
		end
	end

	local function drawHealth(hg, x, minY, maxY, h, pct)
		local hp = cfg.Health
		local bz = hp.BlackZone / 100
		if bz ~= hpBZ then
			rebuildHp(bz)
		end
		hg.Bg.Thickness = hp.Thickness + 2
		hg.Bg.From = v2(x, maxY + 1)
		hg.Bg.To = v2(x, minY - 1)
		hg.Bg.Visible = true
		local mode = hp.Mode
		local dyn = hpColor(pct, bz)
		for i = 1, HSEG do
			local s = hg.S[i]
			local lo, hi = hpB[i - 1], hpB[i]
			if pct > lo then
				local top = math.min(hi, pct)
				s.From = v2(x, maxY - h * lo)
				s.To = v2(x, maxY - h * top)
				s.Thickness = hp.Thickness
				if mode == "Gradient" then
					s.Color = hpCol[i]
				elseif mode == "Dynamic" then
					s.Color = dyn
				else
					s.Color = hp.Color
				end
				s.Visible = true
			else
				s.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end

	local R15Pairs = {
		{"Head", "UpperTorso"}, {"UpperTorso", "LowerTorso"},
		{"UpperTorso", "LeftUpperArm"}, {"LeftUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm"}, {"LeftLowerArm", "LeftHand"},
		{"UpperTorso", "RightUpperArm"}, {"RightUpperArm", "RightLowerArm"}, {"RightLowerArm", "RightHand"},
		{"LowerTorso", "LeftUpperLeg"}, {"LeftUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg"}, {"LeftLowerLeg", "LeftFoot"},
		{"LowerTorso", "RightUpperLeg"}, {"RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg"}, {"RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot"}
	}
	local SA, SB = {}, {}

	local function bodyPart(model, name)
		local p = model:FindFirstChild(name)
		if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
			return p
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function fillSkeleton(model)
		local n = 0
		if model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") then
			for _, pr in ipairs(R15Pairs) do
				local a, b = bodyPart(model, pr[1]), bodyPart(model, pr[2])
				if a and b then
					n = n + 1
					SA[n], SB[n] = a.Position, b.Position
				end
			end
			return n
		end
		local torso, head = bodyPart(model, "Torso"), bodyPart(model, "Head")
		if not (torso and head) then
			return 0
		end
		local sy = torso.Size.Y / 2
		local neck = torso.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, sy, 0))
		local hip = torso.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, -sy, 0))
		n = n + 1
		SA[n], SB[n] = head.Position, neck
		n = n + 1
		SA[n], SB[n] = neck, hip
		for _, nm in ipairs({"Left Arm", "Right Arm"}) do
			local limb = bodyPart(model, nm)
			if limb then
				local ly = limb.Size.Y / 2
				local top = limb.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, ly * 0.8, 0))
				local bot = limb.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, -ly, 0))
				n = n + 1
				SA[n], SB[n] = neck, top
				n = n + 1
				SA[n], SB[n] = top, bot
			end
		end
		for _, nm in ipairs({"Left Leg", "Right Leg"}) do
			local limb = bodyPart(model, nm)
			if limb then
				local ly = limb.Size.Y / 2
				local top = limb.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, ly, 0))
				local bot = limb.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, -ly, 0))
				n = n + 1
				SA[n], SB[n] = hip, top
				n = n + 1
				SA[n], SB[n] = top, bot
			end
		end
		return n
	end

	local function drawSkeleton(sg, model, camera, pal, minX, minY, w, h)
		local sk = cfg.Skeleton
		local n = math.min(fillSkeleton(model), 16)
		for i = 1, 16 do
			local o, l = sg.O[i], sg.L[i]
			local shown = false
			if i <= n then
				local a = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(SA[i])
				local c = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(SB[i])
				if a.Z > 0 and c.Z > 0 then
					shown = true
					local nx = ((a.X + c.X) / 2 - minX) / math.max(w, 1)
					local ny = ((a.Y + c.Y) / 2 - minY) / math.max(h, 1)
					if sk.Outline then
						sl(o, a.X, a.Y, c.X, c.Y, black, sk.Thickness + 2, 1)
					else
						o.Visible = false
					end
					sl(l, a.X, a.Y, c.X, c.Y, pc(cfg.Gradient.Skeleton, pal, sf(nx, ny), sk.Color, true), sk.Thickness, 1)
				end
			end
			if not shown then
				o.Visible = false
				l.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end

	local chamData = {}

	local function getContainer()
		local ok, ui = pcall(function()
			return gethui and gethui()
		end)
		if ok and typeof(ui) == "Instance" then
			return ui
		end
		return game:GetService("CoreGui")
	end

	local chamsFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	chamsFolder.Name = "HubChams"
	pcall(function()
		chamsFolder.Parent = getContainer()
	end)
	if not chamsFolder.Parent then
		chamsFolder.Parent = Workspace
	end

	local function removeChams(model)
		local d = chamData[model]
		if not d then
			return
		end
		if d.hl then
			pcall(function()
				d.hl:Destroy()
			end)
		end
		for _, a in pairs(d.adorns) do
			pcall(function()
				a:Destroy()
			end)
		end
		chamData[model] = nil
	end

	local function updateChams(model, pal, snap)
		local ch, g = cfg.Chams, cfg.Gradient
		local d = chamData[model]
		if not d then
			d = {adorns = {}}
			chamData[model] = d
		end
		local gradOn = g.Enabled and g.Chams
		local pulse = ch.Pulse and (math.sin(GT * 3) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.35 or 0
		local ft = math.clamp(ch.FillTransparency + pulse, 0, 1)
		local fillSolid = pal.vis or ch.Fill

		if ch.Mode == "Highlight" then
			for part, a in pairs(d.adorns) do
				pcall(function()
					a:Destroy()
				end)
				d.adorns[part] = nil
			end
			local hl = d.hl
			if not hl or not hl.Parent then
				hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
				hl.Parent = chamsFolder
				d.hl = hl
			end
			hl.Adornee = model
			hl.DepthMode = ch.ThroughWalls and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
			hl.FillTransparency = ft
			hl.OutlineTransparency = ch.OutlineTransparency
			if gradOn then
				hl.FillColor = gcol(0.5, pal.c1, pal.c2, fillSolid)
				hl.OutlineColor = gcol(0.85, pal.c1, pal.c2, ch.Outline)
			else
				hl.FillColor = fillSolid
				hl.OutlineColor = ch.Outline
			end
		else
			if d.hl then
				pcall(function()
					d.hl:Destroy()
				end)
				d.hl = nil
			end
			local minY = snap.bot.Y
			local span = math.max(snap.top.Y - minY, 0.1)
			local seen = {}
			for _, part in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Transparency < 1 then
					seen[part] = true
					local a = d.adorns[part]
					if not a or not a.Parent then
						a = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
						a.Adornee = part
						a.ZIndex = 1
						a.Parent = chamsFolder
						d.adorns[part] = a
					end
					a.Size = part.Size + Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)
					a.AlwaysOnTop = ch.ThroughWalls
					a.Transparency = ft
					local f = 1 - math.clamp((part.Position.Y - minY) / span, 0, 1)
					a.Color3 = gradOn and gcol(f, pal.c1, pal.c2, fillSolid) or fillSolid
				end
			end
			for part, a in pairs(d.adorns) do
				if not seen[part] then
					pcall(function()
						a:Destroy()
					end)
					d.adorns[part] = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local tracked = {}
	local ghosts = {}
	local tagText = {Left = "LEFT", Teleport = "TP", Death = "DEAD", Gone = "GONE"}

	local function clearGhosts()
		for _, gh in ipairs(ghosts) do
			removeObject(gh.obj)
		end
		table.clear(ghosts)
	end

	local function addGhost(tr, tag)
		local H = cfg.History
		if not H.Enabled or not H.Triggers[tag] or not tr.snap then
			return
		end
		if #ghosts >= 40 then
			removeObject(ghosts[1].obj)
			table.remove(ghosts, 1)
		end
		ghosts[#ghosts + 1] = {obj = createObject(), name = tr.name, snap = tr.snap, born = tick(), tag = tag}
	end

	local function track(model, info, snap, alive)
		local tr = tracked[model]
		if not tr then
			if snap and alive then
				tracked[model] = {name = info.Name, snap = snap, player = info.Player}
			end
			return
		end
		tr.name = info.Name
		tr.player = info.Player
		if not alive then
			if not tr.dead then
				tr.dead = true
				addGhost(tr, "Death")
			end
			return
		end
		tr.dead = false
		if snap then
			if (snap.pos - tr.snap.pos).Magnitude > cfg.History.TpDist then
				addGhost(tr, "Teleport")
			end
			tr.snap = snap
		end
	end

	local function trackCleanup(targets)
		for model, tr in pairs(tracked) do
			if not targets[model] then
				if not tr.dead then
					if tr.player and not tr.player.Parent then
						addGhost(tr, "Left")
					elseif not model.Parent then
						addGhost(tr, "Gone")
					end
				end
				tracked[model] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	local function drawGhosts(camera, camPos, viewport)
		local H = cfg.History
		local now = tick()
		for i = #ghosts, 1, -1 do
			local gh = ghosts[i]
			local age = now - gh.born
			local obj = gh.obj
			if age >= H.Time then
				removeObject(obj)
				table.remove(ghosts, i)
			else
				local snap = gh.snap
				local dist = (snap.pos - camPos).Magnitude
				local minX, minY, maxX, maxY
				if dist <= cfg.MaxDistance then
					minX, minY, maxX, maxY = project(snap, camera)
				end
				if not minX then
					hideObject(obj)
				else
					local alpha = H.Fade and math.clamp(1 - age / H.Time, 0.2, 1) or 1
					local pal = obj.pal
					pal.flat, pal.vis = true, nil
					pal.c1, pal.c2, pal.solid = H.Color, H.Color, H.Color
					local cx = (minX + maxX) / 2
					drawBox(obj, minX, minY, maxX, maxY, pal, alpha, true, snap, camera)

					local tg = use(obj, "text", true)
					local n = cfg.Name
					setText(tg, "Name", gh.name .. " [" .. tagText[gh.tag] .. "]", n.Size, H.Color, cx, minY - n.Size - 4, alpha)
					hideText(tg, "Tool")
					hideText(tg, "HealthText")
					local below = maxY + 2
					if cfg.Distance.Enabled then
						setText(tg, "Distance", math.floor(dist) .. "m", cfg.Distance.Size, H.Color, cx, below, alpha)
						below = below + cfg.Distance.Size + 1
					else
						hideText(tg, "Distance")
					end
					if H.Timer then
						local s
						if H.TimerMode == "Elapsed" then
							s = string.format("+%.1fs", age)
						else
							s = string.format("%.1fs", math.max(H.Time - age, 0))
						end
						setText(tg, "Timer", s, 14, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), cx, below, alpha)
					else
						hideText(tg, "Timer")
					end

					local trg = use(obj, "tracer", cfg.Tracer.Enabled)
					if trg then
						trg.Line.From = getTracerOrigin(viewport)
						trg.Line.To = v2(cx, maxY)
						trg.Line.Color = H.Color
						trg.Line.Thickness = cfg.Tracer.Thickness
						trg.Line.Transparency = alpha * 0.8
						trg.Line.Visible = true
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function processTarget(model, info, camera, viewport, camPos)
		local obj = objects[model]
		if not obj then
			obj = createObject()
			objects[model] = obj
		end
		local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local alive = humanoid == nil or humanoid.Health > 0
		local snap = alive and getSnap(model, humanoid) or nil
		if cfg.History.Enabled then
			track(model, info, snap, alive)
		end
		local dist = snap and (snap.pos - camPos).Magnitude or math.huge
		if not snap or dist > cfg.MaxDistance then
			hideObject(obj)
			removeChams(model)
			return
		end
		if info.Self and cfg.Self.HideFirstPerson then
			local hd = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
			if hd and (hd.Position - camPos).Magnitude < 2.2 then
				hideObject(obj)
				removeChams(model)
				return
			end
		end

		local g = cfg.Gradient
		local pal = obj.pal
		pal.flat = false
		pal.vis = nil
		local solid = cfg.Box.Color
		local c1, c2 = g.Color1, g.Color2
		if cfg.Visible.Enabled then
			local vis = isVisible(model, snap.pos, camera)
			solid = vis and cfg.Visible.Visible or cfg.Visible.Hidden
			c1 = solid
			c2 = solid:Lerp(black, 0.55)
			pal.vis = solid
		end
		pal.c1, pal.c2, pal.solid = c1, c2, solid

		if cfg.Chams.Enabled then
			updateChams(model, pal, snap)
		else
			removeChams(model)
		end

		local minX, minY, maxX, maxY = project(snap, camera)
		if not minX then
			hideObject(obj)
			drawArrow(obj, snap, camera, viewport, pal, dist)
			return
		end

		local w, h = maxX - minX, maxY - minY
		local cx = minX + w / 2

		drawBox(obj, minX, minY, maxX, maxY, pal, 1, false, snap, camera)

		local n, d, t, hp = cfg.Name, cfg.Distance, cfg.Tool, cfg.Health
		local tg = use(obj, "text", n.Enabled or d.Enabled or t.Enabled or (hp.Enabled and hp.Number))
		if tg then
			if n.Enabled then
				setText(tg, "Name", info.Name, n.Size, pc(g.Text, pal, sf(0.5, 0), n.Color, false), cx, minY - n.Size - 4, 1)
			else
				hideText(tg, "Name")
			end
			local below = maxY + 2
			if d.Enabled then
				setText(tg, "Distance", math.floor(dist) .. "m", d.Size, pc(g.Text, pal, sf(0.5, 1), d.Color, false), cx, below, 1)
				below = below + d.Size + 1
			else
				hideText(tg, "Distance")
			end
			local tool = t.Enabled and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
			if tool then
				setText(tg, "Tool", tool.Name, t.Size, t.Color, cx, below, 1)
			else
				hideText(tg, "Tool")
			end
			hideText(tg, "HealthText")
			hideText(tg, "Timer")
		end

		local hg = use(obj, "health", hp.Enabled and humanoid and humanoid.MaxHealth > 0)
		if hg then
			local pct = math.clamp(humanoid.Health / humanoid.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
			local x = hp.Side == "Right" and (maxX + 5) or (minX - 5)
			drawHealth(hg, x, minY, maxY, h, pct)
			if tg and hp.Number then
				local hs = 13
				local lo = minY - 2
				local ty = math.clamp(maxY - h * pct - hs / 2, lo, math.max(maxY - hs, lo))
				local tx = hp.Side == "Right" and (x + 15) or (x - 15)
				setText(tg, "HealthText", tostring(math.floor(humanoid.Health)), hs, white, tx, ty, 1)
			end
		end

		local tr = cfg.Tracer
		local trg = use(obj, "tracer", tr.Enabled)
		if trg then
			trg.Line.From = getTracerOrigin(viewport)
			trg.Line.To = v2(cx, maxY)
			trg.Line.Color = pc(g.Tracer, pal, 0.5, tr.Color, true)
			trg.Line.Thickness = tr.Thickness
			trg.Line.Transparency = 1
			trg.Line.Visible = true
		end

		local sg = use(obj, "skel", cfg.Skeleton.Enabled and humanoid ~= nil)
		if sg then
			drawSkeleton(sg, model, camera, pal, minX, minY, w, h)
		end

		local hd, vl = cfg.HeadDot, cfg.ViewLine
		local hdg = use(obj, "head", hd.Enabled or vl.Enabled)
		if hdg then
			local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local okh = head and head:IsA("BasePart")
			local sp = okh and camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position) or nil
			local showDot = hd.Enabled and sp ~= nil and sp.Z > 0
			hdg.DotO.Visible = showDot
			hdg.Dot.Visible = showDot
			if showDot then
				local r = math.clamp(h * 0.06 * hd.Size, 1.5, 60)
				local pt = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y)
				hdg.DotO.Position = pt
				hdg.DotO.Radius = r + 1.5
				hdg.Dot.Position = pt
				hdg.Dot.Radius = r
				hdg.Dot.Color = pc(g.Extras, pal, sf(0.5, 0.1), hd.Color, false)
			end
			local showV = false
			if vl.Enabled and sp ~= nil then
				local b = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position + head.CFrame.LookVector * vl.Length)
				if sp.Z > 0 and b.Z > 0 then
					showV = true
					hdg.VO.From = v2(sp.X, sp.Y)
					hdg.VO.To = v2(b.X, b.Y)
					hdg.VO.Thickness = vl.Thickness + 2
					hdg.V.From = hdg.VO.From
					hdg.V.To = hdg.VO.To
					hdg.V.Thickness = vl.Thickness
					hdg.V.Color = pc(g.Extras, pal, 0.5, vl.Color, false)
				end
			end
			hdg.VO.Visible = showV
			hdg.V.Visible = showV
		end

		drawArrow(obj, snap, camera, viewport, pal, dist)
	end

	local function espStep()
		local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then
			return
		end
		GT = tick()

		if not anyEnabled() then
			for _, obj in pairs(objects) do
				hideObject(obj)
			end
			for model in pairs(chamData) do
				removeChams(model)
			end
			clearGhosts()
			table.clear(tracked)
			return
		end

		local targets = collectTargets()
		for model, obj in pairs(objects) do
			if not targets[model] or not model.Parent then
				removeObject(obj)
				objects[model] = nil
			end
		end
		for model in pairs(chamData) do
