		local BODY_H = RULER_H + 4 * (LANE_H + LANE_GAP) + 4
		local MIN_SPAN = 0.5
		local STEPS = { 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60, 120, 300 }
		local LANE_COLORS = { Color3.fromRGB(46, 213, 115), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 60), Color3.fromRGB(90, 170, 255) }
		local LANE_NAMES = { "Move", "LMB", "RMB", "Keys" }
		local GLOW_INFO = TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		local View = { S = 0, Span = 10, TS = 0, TSpan = 10 }
		local clips, clipByDown, ownerOf, counts, pool, ticks, KeyNames = {}, {}, {}, { clicks = 0, keys = 0 }, {}, {}, {}
		local drag, anim, hovering, playT, activeClip, wasRec, lastDur
		local Rebuild, Render

		local TLRow = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, BODY_H + 36), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = MacroGroup })
		local TLInfo = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 4), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Timeline is empty",
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130), TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = TLRow
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(TLInfo, "Secondary")
		local ZoomOut = MakeChip(TLRow, "\u{2212}", UDim2.fromOffset(24, 20), UDim2.new(1, -104, 0, 4))
		local ZoomIn = MakeChip(TLRow, "+", UDim2.fromOffset(24, 20), UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 4))
		local FitBtn = MakeChip(TLRow, "Fit", UDim2.fromOffset(34, 20), UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 4))

		local Body = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, BODY_H), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = TLRow })
		local function LaneY(lane)
			return RULER_H + 2 + (lane - 1) * (LANE_H + LANE_GAP)
		end
		for lane = 1, 4 do
			local label = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(LABEL_W - 4, LANE_H), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, LaneY(lane)), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = LANE_NAMES[lane],
				TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130), TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = Body
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(label, "Secondary")
		end

		local Stage = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -LABEL_W, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(LABEL_W, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22),
			ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = Body, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(Stage, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7)

		local PanHit = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -RULER_H), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, RULER_H), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 1, Parent = Stage
		})
		for lane = 1, 4 do
			Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LANE_H), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, LaneY(lane)), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128),
				BackgroundTransparency = 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1, Parent = Stage, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) })
			})
		end
		local Ruler = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, RULER_H), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 2, Parent = Stage
		})
		for i = 1, 20 do
			ticks[i] = {
				line = Lib.Create("Frame", {
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 5), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128), BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 3, Parent = Stage
				}),
				label = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 10), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130), TextSize = 9,
					Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Visible = false, ZIndex = 3, Parent = Stage
				})
			}
		end

		local MoveClip = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, LANE_H - 6), BackgroundColor3 = LANE_COLORS[1], BackgroundTransparency = 0.55, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 2,
			Parent = Stage, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) })
		})
		local Played = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = LANE_COLORS[1], BackgroundTransparency = 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2,
			Parent = MoveClip, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) })
		})

		local DimL = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -RULER_H), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, RULER_H), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BackgroundTransparency = 0.45, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5, Parent = Stage })
		local DimR = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -RULER_H), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, RULER_H), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BackgroundTransparency = 0.45, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5, Parent = Stage })

		local Playhead = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = RED, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 8, Parent = Stage,
			Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 8), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-4, 0), BackgroundColor3 = RED, BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2) })
			})
		})

		local GlowStroke = Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = WHITE, Thickness = 2, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
		local Glow = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 4, 1, 4), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-2, -2), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, ZIndex = 6,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5) }), GlowStroke
		})
		local Sel = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 4, 1, 4), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-2, -2), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, ZIndex = 6,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5) }),
			Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80), Thickness = 2, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
		})

		local function MakeHandle()
			return Lib.Create("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, BODY_H), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false,
				Visible = false, ZIndex = 9, Parent = Stage, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) })
			})
		end
		local HandleA, HandleB = MakeHandle(), MakeHandle()

		local function IsPress(input)
			local kind = input.UserInputType
			return kind == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or kind == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		end

		local function Locked()
			return Macro.Playing or Macro.Recording
		end

		local function Dur()
			if Macro.Recording then return Macro.LiveT or 0 end
			return Macro.Duration
		end

		local function KeyName(value)
			local name = KeyNames[value]
			if not name then
				local ok, result = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode:FromValue(value).Name end)
				name = ok and result or "?"
				KeyNames[value] = name
			end
			return name
		end

		local function ClipName(c)
			if c.lane == 4 then return "Key " .. c.name end
			return c.lane == 2 and "Left click" or "Right click"
		end

		local function Hold()
			if scroll:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
				scroll.ScrollingEnabled = not ((hovering and UIS.MouseEnabled) or drag ~= nil)
			end
		end

		local function TimeAt(x)
			local width = Stage.AbsoluteSize.X
			if width <= 0 then return View.S end
			return View.S + math.clamp((x - Stage.AbsolutePosition.X) / width, 0, 1) * View.Span
		end

		local function Info()
			local d = Dur()
			local c = (Macro.Playing and activeClip) or (Macro.Selected and clipByDown[Macro.Selected])
			if Macro.Recording then
				TLInfo.Text = string.format("Recording... %.1fs", d)
			elseif c then
				TLInfo.Text = string.format("%s at %.2fs", ClipName(c), c.a)
			elseif d > 0 then
				TLInfo.Text = string.format("%.1fs  \u{2022}  %d clicks  \u{2022}  %d keys  \u{2022}  trim %.1f-%.1fs", d, counts.clicks, counts.keys, Macro.TrimA, Macro.TrimB)
			else
				TLInfo.Text = "Timeline is empty"
			end
		end

		local function PlaceClip(c, S, Span, width)
			local frame = c.frame
			local x0, w = (c.a - S) / Span, (c.b - c.a) / Span
			if x0 + w < -0.02 or x0 > 1.02 then
				frame.Visible = false
				return
			end
			frame.Position = UDim2.new(x0, 0, 0, LaneY(c.lane) + 3)
			frame.Size = UDim2.new(w, 5, 0, LANE_H - 6)
			if c.lane == 4 then frame.TextTransparency = (w * width < 26) and 1 or 0 end
			frame.Visible = true
		end

		local function PlaceTrim()
			local S, Span = View.S, View.Span
			local xa, xb = (Macro.TrimA - S) / Span, (Macro.TrimB - S) / Span
			local has = Dur() > 0 and not Macro.Recording
			HandleA.Visible = has and xa > -0.02 and xa < 1.02
			HandleB.Visible = has and xb > -0.02 and xb < 1.02
			HandleA.Position = UDim2.new(xa, 0, 0, 0)
			HandleB.Position = UDim2.new(xb, 0, 0, 0)
			local ca, cb = math.clamp(xa, 0, 1), math.clamp(xb, 0, 1)
			DimL.Size = UDim2.new(has and ca or 0, 0, 1, -RULER_H)
			DimR.Position = UDim2.new(cb, 0, 0, RULER_H)
			DimR.Size = UDim2.new(has and 1 - cb or 0, 0, 1, -RULER_H)
		end

		local function PlacePlayhead()
			if not playT then
				Playhead.Visible = false
				return
			end
			local x = (playT - View.S) / View.Span
			Playhead.Visible = x >= -0.01 and x <= 1.01
			Playhead.Position = UDim2.new(x, -1, 0, 0)
		end

		local function SetPlayed(t)
			local d = Dur()
			Played.Size = UDim2.fromScale((t and d > 0) and math.clamp(t / d, 0, 1) or 0, 1)
		end

		function Render()
			local d = Dur()
			local S, Span = View.S, View.Span
			local width = Stage.AbsoluteSize.X
			if width <= 0 then width = 400 end

			local step = STEPS[#STEPS]
			local target = Span * 80 / width
			for i = 1, #STEPS do
				if STEPS[i] >= target then
					step = STEPS[i]
					break
				end
			end
			local count = 0
			local t = math.ceil(S / step - 1e-6) * step
			while t <= S + Span + 1e-6 and count < #ticks do
				count = count + 1
				local tick = ticks[count]
				local x = (t - S) / Span
				tick.line.Position = UDim2.new(x, 0, 0, RULER_H - 5)
				tick.label.Position = UDim2.new(x, 3, 0, 2)
				local text
				if t >= 60 then
					text = string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(t / 60), math.floor(t % 60 + 0.5))
				elseif step < 1 then
					text = string.format("%.1fs", t)
				else
					text = string.format("%ds", math.floor(t + 0.5))
				end
				if tick.text ~= text then
					tick.text = text
					tick.label.Text = text
				end
				tick.line.Visible, tick.label.Visible = true, true
				t = t + step
			end
			for i = count + 1, #ticks do
				ticks[i].line.Visible, ticks[i].label.Visible = false, false
			end

			local showMove = d > 0 and (#Macro.Frames > 1 or Macro.Recording)
			MoveClip.Visible = showMove
			if showMove then
				MoveClip.Position = UDim2.new(-S / Span, 0, 0, LaneY(1) + 3)
				MoveClip.Size = UDim2.new(d / Span, 0, 0, LANE_H - 6)
			end

			for i = 1, #clips do PlaceClip(clips[i], S, Span, width) end
			local selFrame = Macro.Selected and clipByDown[Macro.Selected] and clipByDown[Macro.Selected].frame
			if selFrame and selFrame.Visible then
				Sel.Parent = selFrame
				Sel.Visible = true
			else
				Sel.Visible = false
			end

			PlaceTrim()
			PlacePlayhead()
		end

		local function Clamp()
			local d = math.max(Dur(), 1)
			View.TSpan = math.clamp(View.TSpan, math.min(MIN_SPAN, d), d)
			View.TS = math.clamp(View.TS, 0, d - View.TSpan)
		end

		local function Step(dt)
			local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-dt * 16)
			View.S = View.S + (View.TS - View.S) * alpha
			View.Span = View.Span + (View.TSpan - View.Span) * alpha
			if math.abs(View.TS - View.S) < 0.0008 * View.TSpan and math.abs(View.TSpan - View.Span) < 0.0008 * View.TSpan then
				View.S, View.Span = View.TS, View.TSpan
				if anim then
					anim:Disconnect()
					anim = nil
				end
			end
			Render()
		end

		local function Goto(s, span, instant)
			View.TS, View.TSpan = s, span
			Clamp()
			if instant then
				View.S, View.Span = View.TS, View.TSpan
				if anim then
					anim:Disconnect()
					anim = nil
				end
				Render()
			elseif not anim then
				anim = Run.Heartbeat:Connect(Step)
			end
		end

		local function Fit(instant)
			Goto(0, math.max(Dur(), 1), instant)
		end

		local function Zoom(factor, ratio)
			local anchor = View.TS + ratio * View.TSpan
			local span = View.TSpan * factor
			Goto(anchor - ratio * span, span)
		end

		local function MakeClip(index)
			local frame = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
				AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", Visible = false, ZIndex = 4, BorderSizePixel = 0, TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = Stage, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) })
			})
			frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				local c = ownerOf[frame]
				if not c or not IsPress(input) or Locked() then return end
				Macro.Selected = c.down
				local moves = table.create(#c.moves)
				for i = 1, #c.moves do moves[i] = c.moves[i].t end
				drag = { kind = "C", clip = c, t0 = TimeAt(input.Position.X), a = c.down.t, b = c.up and c.up.t or c.down.t, moves = moves }
				Hold()
				Render()
				Info()
			end)
			pool[index] = frame
			return frame
		end

		local function SetActive(c)
			activeClip = c
			if c then
				Glow.Parent = c.frame
				Glow.Visible = true
				GlowStroke.Thickness = 5
				Services.Tween:Create(GlowStroke, GLOW_INFO, { Thickness = 2 }):Play()
			else
				Glow.Visible = false
			end
			Info()
		end

		local function Current(t)
			local found
			for i = 1, #clips do
				local c = clips[i]
				if c.a > t then break end
				if t <= c.b + 0.18 then found = c end
			end
			return found
		end

		function Rebuild()
			local events = Macro.Events
			local rec = Macro.Recording
			table.clear(clips)
			table.clear(clipByDown)
			table.clear(ownerOf)
			local openMouse, openKey = {}, {}
			local nClicks, nKeys = 0, 0
			for i = 1, #events do
				local ev = events[i]
				local k = ev.k
				if k == K_DOWN or k == K_KEYDOWN then
					if k == K_DOWN then nClicks = nClicks + 1 else nKeys = nKeys + 1 end
					if #clips < MAX_DOTS then
						local c = { lane = k == K_KEYDOWN and 4 or (ev.a == 1 and 2 or 3), a = ev.t, b = ev.t, down = ev, moves = {} }
						clips[#clips + 1] = c
						clipByDown[ev] = c
						if k == K_DOWN then
							openMouse[ev.a] = c
						else
							openKey[ev.a] = c
							c.name = KeyName(ev.a)
						end
					end
				elseif k == K_UP then
					local c = openMouse[ev.a]
					if c then
						c.up, c.b = ev, ev.t
						openMouse[ev.a] = nil
					end
				elseif k == K_KEYUP then
					local c = openKey[ev.a]
					if c then
						c.up, c.b = ev, ev.t
						openKey[ev.a] = nil
					end
				elseif k == K_MOVE then
					local c = openMouse[1] or openMouse[2]
					if c then c.moves[#c.moves + 1] = ev end
				end
			end
			if rec then
				local now = Dur()
				for _, c in pairs(openMouse) do c.b = math.max(c.a, now) end
				for _, c in pairs(openKey) do c.b = math.max(c.a, now) end
			end
			for i = 1, #clips do
				local c = clips[i]
				local frame = pool[i] or MakeClip(i)
				c.frame = frame
				ownerOf[frame] = c
				frame.BackgroundColor3 = LANE_COLORS[c.lane]
				frame.Text = c.name or ""
			end
			for i = #clips + 1, #pool do
				pool[i].Visible = false
				ownerOf[pool[i]] = nil
			end
			counts.clicks, counts.keys = nClicks, nKeys
			if Macro.Selected and not clipByDown[Macro.Selected] then Macro.Selected = nil end
			if activeClip then SetActive(nil) end

			if rec then
				playT = Dur()
			elseif wasRec then
				playT = nil
				Macro.PlayFrom = nil
			end
			local d = Dur()
			if rec or wasRec ~= rec or d ~= lastDur then
				View.TS, View.TSpan = 0, math.max(d, rec and 5 or 1)
				Clamp()
				View.S, View.Span = View.TS, View.TSpan
			else
				Clamp()
				if not anim then View.S, View.Span = View.TS, View.TSpan end
			end
			wasRec, lastDur = rec, d
			Render()
			Info()
		end

		local function Scrub(x)
			playT = math.clamp(TimeAt(x), 0, Dur())
			Macro.PlayFrom = playT
			PlacePlayhead()
		end

		Ruler.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if not IsPress(input) or Locked() or Macro.Duration <= 0 then return end
			drag = { kind = "S" }
			Hold()
			Scrub(input.Position.X)
		end)

		PanHit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if not IsPress(input) then return end
			drag = { kind = "P", x0 = input.Position.X, s0 = View.TS }
			Hold()
		end)

		local function BindHandle(handle, kind)
			handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if IsPress(input) and not Locked() and Macro.Duration > 0 then
					drag = { kind = kind }
					Hold()
				end
			end)
		end
		BindHandle(HandleA, "A")
		BindHandle(HandleB, "B")

		Stage.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			hovering = true
			Hold()
		end)
		Stage.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			hovering = false
			Hold()
		end)

		Lib.C(UIS.InputChanged, function(input)
			local kind = input.UserInputType
			if kind == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
				if not hovering then return end
				local z = input.Position.Z
				if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift) then
					Goto(View.TS - z * View.TSpan * 0.15, View.TSpan)
				else
					local width = Stage.AbsoluteSize.X
					local ratio = width > 0 and math.clamp((UIS:GetMouseLocation().X - Stage.AbsolutePosition.X) / width, 0, 1) or 0.5
					Zoom(0.78 ^ z, ratio)
				end
				return
			end
			if kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			if not drag then
				if hovering and (not UI.Main.Visible or State.Minimized) then
					hovering = false
					Hold()
				end
				return
			end
			local x = input.Position.X
			local d = Dur()
			local dk = drag.kind
			if dk == "A" then
				Macro.TrimA = math.max(0, math.min(TimeAt(x), Macro.TrimB - 0.1))
				PlaceTrim()
				Info()
			elseif dk == "B" then
				Macro.TrimB = math.min(d, math.max(TimeAt(x), Macro.TrimA + 0.1))
				PlaceTrim()
				Info()
			elseif dk == "S" then
				Scrub(x)
			elseif dk == "P" then
				local width = Stage.AbsoluteSize.X
				if width > 0 then
					if math.abs(x - drag.x0) > 3 then drag.moved = true end
					Goto(drag.s0 - (x - drag.x0) / width * View.TSpan, View.TSpan, true)
				end
			elseif dk == "C" then
				local c = drag.clip
				local dt = math.clamp(TimeAt(x) - drag.t0, -drag.a, d - drag.b)
				if dt ~= drag.dt then
					drag.dt = dt
					drag.moved = true
					c.down.t = drag.a + dt
					c.a = c.down.t
					if c.up then
						c.up.t = drag.b + dt
						c.b = c.up.t
					else
						c.b = c.a
					end
					for i = 1, #c.moves do c.moves[i].t = drag.moves[i] + dt end
					PlaceClip(c, View.S, View.Span, Stage.AbsoluteSize.X)
				end
			end
		end)

		Lib.C(UIS.InputEnded, function(input)
			if not drag or not IsPress(input) then return end
			local finished = drag
			drag = nil
			Hold()
			if finished.kind == "P" and not finished.moved then
				if Macro.Selected then
					Macro.Selected = nil
					Render()
					Info()
				end
			elseif finished.kind == "C" and finished.moved then
				local events = Macro.Events
				for i, e in ipairs(events) do e.o = i end
				table.sort(events, function(x, y)
					if x.t ~= y.t then return x.t < y.t end
					return x.o < y.o
				end)
				Rebuild()
			end
		end)

		ZoomOut.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			Zoom(1.5, 0.5)
		end)
		ZoomIn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			Zoom(0.67, 0.5)
		end)
		FitBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

		end)
		UI.Screen.Destroying:Connect(function()

				anim = nil
			end
		end)

		local function Cut(a, b)
			local frames, events = Macro.Frames, Macro.Events
			local keptFrames, keptEvents = {}, {}
			if #frames > 1 then
				local cf, md, jump = Interp(frames, a)
				keptFrames[1] = { t = 0, cf = cf, md = md, jump = jump }
				for i = 1, #frames do
					local f = frames[i]
					if f.t > a and f.t < b then keptFrames[#keptFrames + 1] = { t = f.t - a, cf = f.cf, md = f.md, jump = f.jump } end
				end
				cf, md, jump = Interp(frames, b)
				keptFrames[#keptFrames + 1] = { t = b - a, cf = cf, md = md, jump = jump }
			end
			for i = 1, #events do
				local e = events[i]
				if e.t >= a and e.t <= b then keptEvents[#keptEvents + 1] = { t = e.t - a, k = e.k, a = e.a, b = e.b, c = e.c } end
			end
			Macro.Frames, Macro.Events = keptFrames, keptEvents
			Macro.StartPos = keptFrames[1] and keptFrames[1].cf or Macro.StartPos
			Macro.Duration = b - a
			Macro.Selected = nil
			playT, Macro.PlayFrom = nil, nil
			ResetTrim()
			SetStatus(string.format("Trimmed to %.1fs", Macro.Duration))
			Rebuild()
		end

		local ActionRow = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = MacroGroup,
			Lib.Create("UIListLayout", {
				FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
				VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
			}),

		})

		local function ActionChip(text, order, callback)
			local chip = MakeChip(ActionRow, text, UDim2.new(0.25, -5, 0, 28), UDim2.new())
			chip.LayoutOrder = order
			chip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				Lib.PlayClick()
				if not Locked() then callback() end
			end)
		end

		ActionChip("Trim", 1, function()
			local a, b = Macro.TrimA, Macro.TrimB
			if Macro.Duration <= 0 or b - a >= Macro.Duration - 0.01 then
				Lib.Notify({ Title = "Macro Recorder", Text = "Drag the handles to choose what to keep" })
				return
			end
			Cut(a, b)
		end)
		ActionChip("Reset", 2, function()
			ResetTrim()
			PlaceTrim()
			Info()
		end)
		ActionChip("Delete", 3, function()
			local selected = Macro.Selected
			if not selected then
				Lib.Notify({ Title = "Macro Recorder", Text = "Select a point on the timeline first" })
				return
			end
			local c = clipByDown[selected]
			local kill = { [selected] = true }
			if c then
				if c.up then kill[c.up] = true end
				for i = 1, #c.moves do kill[c.moves[i]] = true end
			end
			local events, kept = Macro.Events, {}
			for i = 1, #events do
				if not kill[events[i]] then kept[#kept + 1] = events[i] end
			end
			Macro.Events = kept
			Macro.Selected = nil
			Rebuild()
		end)
		ActionChip("Clear", 4, function()
			Macro.Frames, Macro.Events, Macro.Selected, Macro.StartPos, Macro.Duration = {}, {}, nil, nil, 0
			playT, Macro.PlayFrom = nil, nil
			ResetTrim()
			SetStatus("Idle")
			Rebuild()
		end)

		Lib.CreateSettingSliderItem(MacroGroup, "Macro Speed", "Playback speed of the recording", 0.25, 4, Macro.Speed, function(value)
			Macro.Speed = value
		end, true, "x", 0.05)

		Macro.OnChange = Rebuild
		Macro.OnRecord = function(t)
			Macro.LiveT = t
			Rebuild()
		end
		Macro.OnPlayhead = function(t)
			if t then
				playT = t
				SetPlayed(t)
				if View.TSpan < Dur() - 0.001 and (t > View.S + View.Span * 0.92 or t < View.S) then
					Goto(t - View.TSpan * 0.1, View.TSpan)
				end
				PlacePlayhead()
				local c = Current(t)
				if c ~= activeClip then SetActive(c) end
			else
				playT = nil
				SetPlayed(nil)
				if activeClip then SetActive(nil) end
				PlacePlayhead()
			end
		end
		Rebuild()
	end

	local NameBox = Lib.Create("TextBox", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -112, 0, 32), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 9), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), PlaceholderText = "Macro name...",

		TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = SaveRow, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) })

	local SavedList = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = SavedGroup,
		Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
		Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10) })
	})

	local function MacroPath(name)
		return MACRO_FOLDER .. "/" .. name .. ".json"
	end

	local function RebuildSaved()
		for _, child in ipairs(SavedList:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("GuiObject") then child:Destroy() end
		end
		if not canSave then
			local note = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Your executor does not support file saving",
				TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130), TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Parent = SavedList
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(note, "Secondary")
			return
		end
		local files = {}
		pcall(function() files = listfiles(MACRO_FOLDER) end)
		local names = {}
		for _, path in ipairs(files) do
			local name = path:match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")
			if name then names[#names + 1] = name end
		end
		table.sort(names)
		if #names == 0 then
			local note = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "No saved movements yet",
				TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130), TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Parent = SavedList
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(note, "Secondary")
			return
		end
		for i, name in ipairs(names) do
			local item = Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), LayoutOrder = i, Parent = SavedList,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) })
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeElement(item, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7)
			local nameLabel = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = name,
				TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = item
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(nameLabel, "Primary")
			local placeLabel = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 26), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Place: ...",
				TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130), TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = item
			})
			local function ShowPlace(info)
				if not placeLabel.Parent then return end
				if info.pid then
					placeLabel.Text = string.format("Place: %s (%d)", info.pn ~= "" and info.pn or "Unknown", info.pid)
					placeLabel.TextColor3 = info.pid == placeId and Color3.fromRGB(46, 213, 115) or Color3.fromRGB(235, 170, 60)
				else
					placeLabel.Text = "Place: unknown (saved before place tracking)"
				end
			end
			if placeCache[name] then
				ShowPlace(placeCache[name])
			else
				task.spawn(function()
					local ok, raw = pcall(readfile, MacroPath(name))
					local head = ok and type(raw) == "string" and raw:sub(1, 400) or ""
					local info = { pid = tonumber(head:match('"pid":(%d+)')), pn = head:match('"pn":"(.-)"') or "" }
					placeCache[name] = info
					ShowPlace(info)
				end)
			end
			local loadBtn = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 26), Position = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0.5, -13), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, Text = "Load", TextColor3 = BLACK,
				TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = item, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) })
			})
			local deleteBtn = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26), Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0.5, -13), BackgroundColor3 = RED, Text = "×", TextColor3 = WHITE,
				TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = item, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) })
			})
			loadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				Lib.PlayClick()
				local ok, raw = pcall(readfile, MacroPath(name))
				local data = ok and DecodeMacro(raw)
				if not data then
					Lib.Notify({ Title = "Macro Recorder", Text = "Failed to load \"" .. name .. "\"" })
					return
				end
				StopRecording(true)
				StopPlayback(true)
				Macro.Frames, Macro.Events, Macro.Duration, Macro.StartPos, Macro.Selected = data.Frames, data.Events, data.Duration, data.StartPos, nil
				ResetTrim()
				Changed()
				SetStatus(string.format("Loaded \"%s\" (%.1fs)", name, data.Duration))
				Lib.Notify({ Title = "Macro Recorder", Text = "Loaded \"" .. name .. "\"" })
				local info = placeCache[name]
				if info and info.pid and info.pid ~= placeId then
					Lib.Notify({ Title = "Macro Recorder", Text = "Recorded in another place: " .. (info.pn ~= "" and info.pn or tostring(info.pid)) })
				end
			end)
			deleteBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				Lib.PlayClick()
				if type(delfile) == "function" then pcall(delfile, MacroPath(name)) end
				placeCache[name] = nil
				RebuildSaved()
			end)
		end
	end

	SaveBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Lib.PlayClick()
		if not canSave then
			Lib.Notify({ Title = "Macro Recorder", Text = "Your executor does not support file saving" })
			return
		end
		if not HasData() then
			Lib.Notify({ Title = "Macro Recorder", Text = "Record a movement first" })
			return
		end
		local name = NameBox.Text:gsub("[^%w%-_ ]", ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
		if name == "" then name = "Macro " .. os.date("%H-%M-%S") end
		local ok = pcall(writefile, MacroPath(name), EncodeMacro())
		Lib.Notify({ Title = "Macro Recorder", Text = ok and ("Saved \"" .. name .. "\"") or "Failed to write the file" })
		if ok then
			placeCache[name] = nil
			NameBox.Text = ""
			RebuildSaved()
		end
	end)

	RebuildSaved()
end

do
	local FeaturesSection = Lib.Create("CanvasGroup", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, Parent = UI.ContentArea })

		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = FeaturesSideBar,

	local MakeFeaturesTab
	local FeaturesViews
	Lib.SwitchFeaturesTab, MakeFeaturesTab, FeaturesViews = Lib.CreateTabSystem(FeaturesSection, FeaturesTabs, "CurrentFeaturesTab")

	local View_Visuals = MakeFeaturesTab("Visuals", 4)

	local function MakeScroll(view)
		local scr = Lib.Create("ScrollingFrame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, ScrollBarThickness = 2,
			ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100), BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Parent = view
		})
		Lib.SearchScrolls[scr] = true
		local lyt = Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 14), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = scr })
		Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 5), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 15), Parent = scr })

		lyt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
			scr.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, lyt.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 20)
		end)
		return scr
	end

		Apply = function(data)
			local rgb = data.Neon
			if type(rgb) == "table" and #rgb == 3 then Lib.NeonSet(Color3.fromRGB(rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3])) end

	local function OpenPlayerPickerModal(title, onSelectPlayer)
		local backdrop = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Name = "PlayerPickerModalBackdrop",
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			ZIndex = 40,
			Parent = UI.Main
		})

		local window = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(360, 360),
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 16),
			ClipsDescendants = true,
			ZIndex = 41,
			Parent = backdrop,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) }),
			Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40), Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.4 })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(window, "BackgroundColor3", 0.5)

		local wTitle = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 35),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 8),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = title,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
			TextSize = 15,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			ZIndex = 42,
			Parent = window
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(wTitle, "Primary")

		local closeBtn = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0, 10),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
			Text = "×",
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
			TextSize = 16,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			ZIndex = 42,
			Parent = window,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) })
		})

		local scroll = Lib.Create("ScrollingFrame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -55),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 45),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			ScrollBarThickness = 2,
			ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			ZIndex = 42,
			Parent = window
		})

		local layout = Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = scroll })
		layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
			scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 10)
		end)

		local closed = false
		local function CloseModal()
			if closed then return end
			closed = true
			Lib.Tween(window, 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 320) })
			Lib.GlassClose(backdrop, function() backdrop:Destroy() end)
		end

		closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			CloseModal()
		end)

		for _, p in ipairs(Services.Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if p ~= App.Player then
				local pBtn = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44),
					BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22),
					Text = "",
					AutoButtonColor = false,
					ZIndex = 43,
					Parent = scroll,
					Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) })
				})
				Lib.RegisterThemeElement(pBtn, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7)

				Lib.Create("ImageLabel", {
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32),
					Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, -16),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. p.UserId .. "&w=100&h=100",
					ZIndex = 44,
					Parent = pBtn,
					Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })

					ZIndex = 44,

					BackgroundTransparency = 1,

					TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130),
					TextSize = 10,
					Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
					TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
					ZIndex = 44,
					Parent = pBtn
				})
				Lib.RegisterThemeText(subLbl, "Secondary")

				pBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					Lib.PlayClick()

		window.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 320)

	local StalkGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(FunnyScroll, "Stalk Mode", 1)
	local StalkPlayerBtn = Lib.CreateSettingButtonItem(StalkGroup, "Target: None", "Click to select player to stalk", function(titleLbl)
		OpenPlayerPickerModal("Select Stalk Target", function(p)
			State.StalkTarget = p
			titleLbl.Text = "Target: " .. p.DisplayName

	local function UpdateStalk()
		if Refs.StalkConn then Refs.StalkConn:Disconnect() Refs.StalkConn = nil end
		if not State.StalkActive or not State.StalkTarget then
			if App.Player.Character and App.Player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
				App.Camera.CameraSubject = App.Player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			end
			return
		end

		Refs.StalkConn = Services.Run.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			if not State.StalkActive or not State.StalkTarget or not State.StalkTarget.Character then return end
			local targetRoot = State.StalkTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local myChar = App.Player.Character
			local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if targetRoot and myRoot then
				myRoot.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(State.StalkOffsetX, State.StalkOffsetY, State.StalkOffsetZ)
				myRoot.Anchored = State.StalkDisableMovement

				local targetHum = State.StalkTarget.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if targetHum then App.Camera.CameraSubject = targetHum end
			end
		end)
	end

	Lib.CreateSettingToggleItem(StalkGroup, "Stalk Active", "Locks your position relative to the target player", State.StalkActive, function(val)
		State.StalkActive = val
		UpdateStalk()
	end)
	Lib.CreateSettingSliderItem(StalkGroup, "Offset X", "Adjust horizontal lateral stalk offset", -30, 30, State.StalkOffsetX, function(val) State.StalkOffsetX = val end)
	Lib.CreateSettingSliderItem(StalkGroup, "Offset Y", "Adjust vertical stalk offset height", -30, 30, State.StalkOffsetY, function(val) State.StalkOffsetY = val end)
	Lib.CreateSettingSliderItem(StalkGroup, "Offset Z", "Adjust forward/backward distance behind target", -30, 30, State.StalkOffsetZ, function(val) State.StalkOffsetZ = val end)
	Lib.CreateSettingToggleItem(StalkGroup, "Disable Movement", "Locks character anchoring in place while stalking", State.StalkDisableMovement, function(val) State.StalkDisableMovement = val end, true)

	local FakeLagGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(FunnyScroll, "Fake Lag", 2)
	Lib.CreateSettingToggleItem(FakeLagGroup, "Complete Suspension", "Drops character movement to appear frozen to others", State.FakeLagSuspension, function(val)
		State.FakeLagSuspension = val
		local hum = App.Player.Character and App.Player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = val and 0.5 or (State.WalkSpeedTouched and State.WalkSpeed) or (Refs.OrigHum == hum and Refs.OrigWS) or 16 end
	end)
	Lib.CreateSettingToggleItem(FakeLagGroup, "Usual Lag", "Simulates realistic high ping latency and movement stutters", State.FakeLagUsual, function(val)
		State.FakeLagUsual = val
		if not val and App.Player.Character and App.Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			App.Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = false
		end
	end, true)

	task.spawn(function()
		while not State.Unloaded do
			task.wait(math.random(1, 3))
			if State.FakeLagUsual and App.Player.Character and App.Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
				App.Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = true
				task.wait(math.random(1, 2) * 0.4)
				if State.FakeLagUsual and App.Player.Character and App.Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
					App.Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = false
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	local FlingGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(FunnyScroll, "Fling Target", 3)
	Lib.CreateSettingButtonItem(FlingGroup, "Select Target", "Choose player to fling", function(titleLbl)
		OpenPlayerPickerModal("Select Fling Target", function(p)
			State.FlingTarget = p
			titleLbl.Text = "Target: " .. p.DisplayName
		end)
	end)
	Lib.CreateSettingButtonItem(FlingGroup, "Execute Fling", "Applies high-speed rotational thrust against target", function(titleLbl)
		if not State.FlingTarget or not State.FlingTarget.Character or State.IsFlinging then return end
		local myChar = App.Player.Character
		local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not myRoot then return end

		State.IsFlinging = true
		Lib.Notify({ Title = "Fling", Text = "Applying fling on " .. State.FlingTarget.DisplayName })
		local oldPos = myRoot.CFrame
		local bv = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity", myRoot)
		bv.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 99999, 0)
		bv.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
		bv.P = math.huge
		local bt = Instance.new("BodyThrust", myRoot)
		bt.Force = Vector3.new(9999, 9999, 9999)
		if myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Sit = true end

		local fTime = 0
		local conn
		conn = Services.Run.Stepped:Connect(function(_, dt)
			fTime = fTime + dt
			if fTime > 2.5 or not State.FlingTarget or not State.FlingTarget.Character or not State.FlingTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
				if bv then bv:Destroy() end
				if bt then bt:Destroy() end
				myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				myRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				myRoot.CFrame = oldPos
				if myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Sit = false end
				State.IsFlinging = false
				conn:Disconnect()
				return
			end
			myRoot.CFrame = State.FlingTarget.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
		end)
	end, true)

	local BringGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(FunnyScroll, "Bring Parts", 4)
	Lib.CreateSettingButtonItem(BringGroup, "Select Target", "Choose player to bring unanchored parts to", function(titleLbl)
		OpenPlayerPickerModal("Select Bring Target", function(p)
			State.BringTarget = p
			titleLbl.Text = "Target: " .. p.DisplayName
		end)
	end)
	Refs.BringObjs = {}

	function Lib.StopBring()
		State.IsBringing = false
		if Refs.BringConn then Refs.BringConn:Disconnect() Refs.BringConn = nil end
		if Refs.DescConn then Refs.DescConn:Disconnect() Refs.DescConn = nil end
		if Refs.BringFolder then Refs.BringFolder:Destroy() Refs.BringFolder = nil end
		local objs = Refs.BringObjs
		for i = 1, #objs do objs[i]:Destroy() end
		table.clear(objs)
	end

	Lib.CreateSettingButtonItem(BringGroup, "Toggle Bring Parts", "Attaches physics parts to target", function(titleLbl)
		if State.IsBringing then
			Lib.StopBring()
			Lib.Notify({ Title = "Bring Parts", Text = "Stopped bringing parts" })
			return
		end

		if not State.BringTarget or not State.BringTarget.Character then return end
		State.IsBringing = true
		Lib.Notify({ Title = "Bring Parts", Text = "Bringing physics objects to " .. State.BringTarget.DisplayName })

		Refs.BringFolder = Instance.new("Folder", workspace)
		local attPart = Instance.new("Part", Refs.BringFolder)
		attPart.Anchored = true
		attPart.CanCollide = false
		attPart.Transparency = 1
		local Attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment", attPart)

		local function ForcePart(v)
			if v:IsA("BasePart") and not v.Anchored and not v.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and not v.Parent:FindFirstChild("Head") and v.Name ~= "Handle" then
				for _, x in ipairs(v:GetChildren()) do
					if x:IsA("BodyMover") or x:IsA("RocketPropulsion") then x:Destroy() end
				end
				v.CanCollide = false
				local Torque = Instance.new("Torque", v)
				Torque.Torque = Vector3.new(100000, 100000, 100000)
				local AlignPos = Instance.new("AlignPosition", v)
				local Attachment2 = Instance.new("Attachment", v)
				Torque.Attachment0 = Attachment2
				AlignPos.MaxForce = math.huge
				AlignPos.MaxVelocity = math.huge
				AlignPos.Responsiveness = 200
				AlignPos.Attachment0 = Attachment2
				AlignPos.Attachment1 = Attachment1
				local objs = Refs.BringObjs
				local n = #objs
				objs[n + 1], objs[n + 2], objs[n + 3] = Torque, AlignPos, Attachment2
			end
		end

		for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do ForcePart(v) end
		Refs.DescConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(ForcePart)

		Refs.BringConn = Services.Run.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			if not State.IsBringing or not State.BringTarget or not State.BringTarget.Character then
				Lib.StopBring()
				return
			end
			local hrp = State.BringTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if hrp then Attachment1.WorldCFrame = hrp.CFrame end
		end)
	end, true)

	local MiscUtilityGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(MiscScroll, "Camera & Utilities", 2)

	Lib.CreateSettingSliderItem(MiscUtilityGroup, "Fov Changer", "Adjust the camera field of view angle", 30, 120, State.FOV, function(val)
		State.FOV = val
		if App.Camera then App.Camera.FieldOfView = val end
	end, true)

	Lib.BuildMiscUtilities(MiscScroll)

	do
		local Quint, Quad, Back, Out = Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out
		local Tween, Create = Lib.Tween, Lib.Create
		local HEAD = "rbxassetid://113533839488998"
		local Rows, V, S = {}, {}, { open = false, built = false, query = "", total = 0, token = 0, tpToken = 0 }

		local function Interactive(button, canAct, onEnter, onLeave)
			local scale = Create("UIScale", { Parent = button })
			button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
				if not canAct() then return end
				Tween(scale, 0.25, Quint, Out, { Scale = 1.03 })
				onEnter()
			end)
			button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
				Tween(scale, 0.3, Quint, Out, { Scale = 1 })
				onLeave()
			end)
			button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
				if canAct() then Tween(scale, 0.08, Quad, Out, { Scale = 0.95 }) end
			end)
			button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
				Tween(scale, 0.35, Back, Out, { Scale = 1 })
			end)
		end

		local function Reveal(label, x, y, transparency)
			label.TextTransparency = 1
			label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x + 12, y)
			Tween(label, 0.45, Quint, Out, { TextTransparency = transparency, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y) })
		end

		local Card = Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 148), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15), LayoutOrder = 1, ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = TeleportScroll,
			Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) }),
			Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120), Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.7 })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(Card, "BackgroundColor3", 0.5)

		V.Glow = Create("ImageLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(130, 130), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 50), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Image = "rbxassetid://1316045217", ImageTransparency = 1, Parent = Card
		})
		local Ring = Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(68, 68), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = Card,
			Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
		})
		V.RingStroke = Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Thickness = 1.5, Transparency = 0.88, Parent = Ring })
		V.Avatar = Create("ImageLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 58), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 24),
			Image = HEAD, ImageTransparency = 0.6, Parent = Ring,
			Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
		})
		V.AvatarScale = Create("UIScale", { Parent = V.Avatar })

		local function Label(y, size, font, text, role, transparency)
			local label = Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -112, 0, size + 6), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(98, y), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = text, TextTransparency = transparency,
				TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), TextSize = size, Font = font, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = Card
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(label, role)
			return label
		end
		V.Name = Label(18, 16, Enum.Font.GothamBold, "No Player Selected", "Primary", 0.35)
		V.User = Label(42, 12, Enum.Font.Gotham, "Select an active player from the menu below", "Secondary", 0)
		V.Reg = Label(60, 11, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, "Registered: —", "Secondary", 0.2)

		local Buttons = Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 36), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -52), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = Card,
			Create("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 10) })
		})
		V.Tp = Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -5, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245), BackgroundTransparency = 0.65, Text = "Teleport", TextTransparency = 0.5,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = Buttons,
			Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) })
		})
		V.Sp = Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -5, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 26), BackgroundTransparency = 0.65, Text = "Spectate", TextTransparency = 0.5,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = Buttons,
			Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }),
			Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120), Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.6 })
		})

		local function HasTarget()
			return State.TeleportTarget ~= nil
		end

		Interactive(V.Tp, HasTarget, function()
			Tween(V.Tp, 0.2, Quad, Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) })
		end, function()
			Tween(V.Tp, 0.2, Quad, Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245) })
		end)
		Interactive(V.Sp, HasTarget, function()
			if not State.IsSpectating then Tween(V.Sp, 0.2, Quad, Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40) }) end
		end, function()
			if not State.IsSpectating then Tween(V.Sp, 0.2, Quad, Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 26) }) end
		end)

		local function Paint()
			local on = State.TeleportTarget ~= nil
			local transparency = on and 0 or 0.65
			local text = on and 0 or 0.5
			Tween(V.Tp, 0.3, Quint, Out, { BackgroundTransparency = transparency, TextTransparency = text })
			Tween(V.Sp, 0.3, Quint, Out, { BackgroundTransparency = transparency, TextTransparency = text })
		end

		local function StopSpectating()
			State.IsSpectating = false
			V.Sp.Text = "Spectate"
			Tween(V.Sp, 0.25, Quad, Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 26), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240) })
			local hum = App.Player.Character and App.Player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then App.Camera.CameraSubject = hum end
		end

		local function SetTarget(plr)
			if plr and not plr.Parent then plr = nil end
			local prev = State.TeleportTarget
			if plr == prev then return end
			State.TeleportTarget = plr
			local prevRow = prev and Rows[prev]
			if prevRow then prevRow.Mark(false) end

			if not plr then
				if State.IsSpectating then StopSpectating() end
				if V.Pulse then V.Pulse:Cancel() end
				Tween(V.Glow, 0.4, Quad, Out, { ImageTransparency = 1 })
				Tween(V.RingStroke, 0.4, Quad, Out, { Transparency = 0.88 })
				V.Avatar.Image = HEAD
				V.Avatar.ImageTransparency = 0.6
				V.Name.Text = "No Player Selected"
				V.User.Text = "Select an active player from the menu below"
				V.Reg.Text = "Registered: —"
				Reveal(V.Name, 98, 18, 0.35)
				Reveal(V.User, 98, 42, 0)
				Reveal(V.Reg, 98, 60, 0.2)
			else
				V.Avatar.Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. plr.UserId .. "&w=150&h=150"
				V.Avatar.ImageTransparency = 0
				V.AvatarScale.Scale = 0.6
				Tween(V.AvatarScale, 0.55, Back, Out, { Scale = 1 })
				V.RingStroke.Transparency = 0.1
				Tween(V.RingStroke, 0.9, Quint, Out, { Transparency = 0.6 })
				V.Glow.ImageTransparency = 0.9
				V.Glow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(130, 130)
				if V.Pulse then V.Pulse:Cancel() end
				V.Pulse = Services.Tween:Create(V.Glow, TweenInfo.new(2.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), { ImageTransparency = 0.95, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 160) })
				V.Pulse:Play()
				V.Name.Text = plr.DisplayName
				V.User.Text = "@" .. plr.Name
				V.Reg.Text = "Registered: " .. os.date("%d.%m.%Y", os.time() - plr.AccountAge * 86400)
				Reveal(V.Name, 98, 18, 0)
				Reveal(V.User, 98, 42, 0)
				Reveal(V.Reg, 98, 60, 0.2)
				if State.IsSpectating then
					local hum = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if hum then App.Camera.CameraSubject = hum else StopSpectating() end
				end
				local row = Rows[plr]
				if row then row.Mark(true) end
			end
			Paint()
		end

		Card.Destroying:Connect(function()
			if V.Pulse then V.Pulse:Cancel() end
		end)

		V.Tp.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			local plr = State.TeleportTarget
			if not plr then return end
			Lib.PlayClick()
			local char = plr.Character
			local targetRoot = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
			local myChar = App.Player.Character
			local myRoot = myChar and (myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or myChar:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
			if not (targetRoot and myRoot) then return end
			Lib.TeleHistory.Record(plr.DisplayName, myRoot, targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3))
			S.tpToken += 1
			local token = S.tpToken
			V.Tp.Text = "Teleported! ✓"
			task.delay(1.2, function()
				if S.tpToken == token and V.Tp.Parent then V.Tp.Text = "Teleport" end
			end)
		end)

		V.Sp.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			local plr = State.TeleportTarget
			if not plr then return end
			Lib.PlayClick()
			if State.IsSpectating then
				StopSpectating()
				return
			end
			local hum = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not hum then return end
			State.IsSpectating = true
			App.Camera.CameraSubject = hum
			V.Sp.Text = "Stop Spectating"
			Tween(V.Sp, 0.25, Quad, Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 50, 50), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) })
		end)

		local ListCard = Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 54), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15), LayoutOrder = 2, ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = TeleportScroll,
			Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) }),
			Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120), Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.7 })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(ListCard, "BackgroundColor3", 0.5)

		local Header = Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 54), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = ListCard,
			Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) })
		})
		Header.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Tween(Header, 0.2, Quad, Out, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.96 }) end)
		Header.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Tween(Header, 0.25, Quad, Out, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end)

		local Title = Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Select Target Player",
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = Header
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(Title, "Primary")

		local Pill = Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), Parent = Header,
			Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
			Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10) })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(Pill, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7)
		V.Count = Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "0",
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200), TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = Pill
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(V.Count, "Secondary")

		V.Arrow = Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0.5, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "▼",
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Parent = Header
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(V.Arrow, "Secondary")

		V.ListGroup = Create("CanvasGroup", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 200), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 98), BackgroundTransparency = 1, GroupTransparency = 1, Parent = ListCard
		})
		V.Scroll = Create("ScrollingFrame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ScrollBarThickness = 2, ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80), BorderSizePixel = 0,
			CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = V.ListGroup,
			Create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
			Create("UIPadding", { PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4) })
		})
		V.Empty = Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 70), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "No other players in this server", Visible = false,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Parent = V.ListGroup
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(V.Empty, "Secondary")

		local function Filter()
			local query, shown = S.query, 0
			for _, row in pairs(Rows) do
				local visible = query == "" or row.key:find(query, 1, true) ~= nil
				row.wrap.Visible = visible
				if visible then shown += 1 end
			end
			V.Empty.Visible = shown == 0
			V.Empty.Text = S.total == 0 and "No other players in this server" or "No players found"
		end

		Lib.MakeSearchBox(ListCard, "Search", UDim2.fromOffset(12, 60), UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 30), 0.1, function(text)
			S.query = text:lower()
			Filter()
		end)

		local function MakeRow(plr)
			local wrap = Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = V.Scroll })
			local row = Create("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", Parent = wrap,
				Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) })
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeElement(row, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7)
			local bar = Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.SwitchOn, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = row,
				Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
			})
			Create("ImageLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0.5, -17), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30),
				Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. plr.UserId .. "&w=100&h=100", Parent = row,
				Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
			})
			local name = Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -176, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 8), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = plr.DisplayName, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240),
				TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = row
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(name, "Primary")
			local user = Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -176, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 26), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "@" .. plr.Name, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130),
				TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = row
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(user, "Secondary")
			local reg = Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(105, 18), Position = UDim2.new(1, -115, 0.5, -9), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Reg: " .. os.date("%d.%m.%Y", os.time() - plr.AccountAge * 86400),
				TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(115, 115, 115), TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Parent = row
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(reg, "Secondary")

			local selected = false
			local function Rest()
				return selected and Lib.Lighten(Lib.Theme.Item, 0.07) or Lib.Theme.Item
			end
			row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
				Tween(row, 0.18, Quad, Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Lighten(Lib.Theme.Item, selected and 0.1 or 0.04) })
			end)
			row.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
				Tween(row, 0.22, Quad, Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Rest() })
			end)
			row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				Lib.PlayClick()
				SetTarget(plr)
			end)

			Rows[plr] = {
				wrap = wrap,
				btn = row,
				key = (plr.DisplayName .. " " .. plr.Name):lower(),
				Mark = function(on)
					selected = on
					Tween(bar, 0.35, Back, Out, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, on and 24 or 0) })
					Tween(row, 0.25, Quad, Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Rest() })
				end
			}
			if State.TeleportTarget == plr then
				selected = true
				bar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 24)
				row.BackgroundColor3 = Rest()
			end
		end

		local function Sync(skip)
			local others, seen = {}, {}
			local list = Services.Players:GetPlayers()
			for i = 1, #list do
				local plr = list[i]
				if plr ~= App.Player and plr ~= skip then
					others[#others + 1] = plr
					seen[plr] = true
				end
			end
			S.total = #others
			V.Count.Text = tostring(#others)
			for plr, row in pairs(Rows) do
				if not seen[plr] then
					row.wrap:Destroy()
					Rows[plr] = nil
				end
			end
			if not S.built then return end
			table.sort(others, function(a, b)
				return a.DisplayName:lower() < b.DisplayName:lower()
			end)
			for i = 1, #others do
				local plr = others[i]
				if not Rows[plr] then MakeRow(plr) end
				Rows[plr].wrap.LayoutOrder = i
			end
			Filter()
		end

		Header.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			S.open = not S.open
			S.token += 1
			local token, open = S.token, S.open
			if open and not S.built then
				S.built = true
				Sync()
			end
			Tween(V.Arrow, 0.3, Quint, Out, { Rotation = open and 180 or 0 })
			Tween(ListCard, 0.4, Quint, Out, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, open and 308 or 54) })
			Tween(V.ListGroup, open and 0.4 or 0.2, Quad, Out, { GroupTransparency = open and 0 or 1 })
			if not open then return end
			for _, row in pairs(Rows) do
				local btn = row.btn
				btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 0)
				task.delay(math.min(row.wrap.LayoutOrder, 8) * 0.035, function()
					if S.token == token and btn.Parent then Tween(btn, 0.45, Quint, Out, { Position = UDim2.new() }) end
				end)
			end
		end)

		Lib.C(Services.Players.PlayerAdded, function() Sync() end)
		Lib.C(Services.Players.PlayerRemoving, function(plr)
			if State.TeleportTarget == plr then SetTarget(nil) end
			Sync(plr)
		end)
		Sync()
	end

	local TeleportToolsGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(TeleportScroll, "Teleport Utilities", 4)
	Lib.CreateSettingToggleItem(TeleportToolsGroup, "Teleport Tool", "Gives a tool to click anywhere on map to instantly teleport", State.Tool_Teleport, function(val)
		State.Tool_Teleport = val
		if val then Refs.Tools.TeleportTool.Parent = App.Player.Backpack else pcall(function() Refs.Tools.TeleportTool.Parent = nil end) end
	end, true)

	Lib.TeleportPlus.Build(TeleportScroll)
	Lib.Waypoints.Build(TeleportScroll)
	Lib.InitPalette()

	local ServerSettingsModalBackdrop = Lib.Create("TextButton", { Name = "ServerSettingsModalBackdrop", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Visible = false, ZIndex = 30, Parent = UI.Main })
	local ServerSettingsWindow = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(340, 330), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 16), ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = 31, Parent = ServerSettingsModalBackdrop, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) }), Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40), Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.4 }) })
	Lib.RegisterThemeElement(ServerSettingsWindow, "BackgroundColor3", 0.5)

	local sListSetTitle = Lib.Create("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 35), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 8), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Server List Settings", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), TextSize = 15, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 32, Parent = ServerSettingsWindow })
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(sListSetTitle, "Primary")

	local CloseSettingsBtn = Lib.Create("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), Position = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0, 10), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Text = "×", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), TextSize = 16, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, ZIndex = 32, Parent = ServerSettingsWindow, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }) })

	local SettingsContent = Lib.Create("ScrollingFrame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -55), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 45), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ScrollBarThickness = 2, ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 32, Parent = ServerSettingsWindow })

	SettingsLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()

	function Lib.ServerButton(parent, text, position, solid, callback)
		local button = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(96, 26), Position = position, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = text, TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = parent,

		local scale = button:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		local rest, hover = solid and 0 or 0.92, solid and 0.12 or 0.82
		button.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Lib.Tween(button, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { BackgroundTransparency = hover }) end)
		button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			Lib.Tween(button, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { BackgroundTransparency = rest })
			Lib.Tween(scale, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Scale = 1 })
		end)
		button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() Lib.Tween(scale, 0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Scale = 0.94 }) end)
		button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() Lib.Tween(scale, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Scale = 1 }) end)
		button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			callback(button)
		end)
		return button
	end

	local function CreateServerEntry(serverData, order)
		local maxPlayers = math.max(serverData.maxPlayers, 1)
		local fraction = math.clamp(serverData.playing / maxPlayers, 0, 1)
		local percent = math.floor(fraction * 100)
		local ping = tonumber(serverData.ping)
		local id = tostring(serverData.id)

		local item = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 74), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), LayoutOrder = order, Parent = ServerListScroll,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) }),
			Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128), Transparency = 0.88, Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(item, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7)
		Lib.HoverStroke(item)

		local row = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 9), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = item,
			Lib.Create("UIListLayout", {
				FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
				Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
			})
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, LayoutOrder = 1, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = serverData.playing .. " / " .. serverData.maxPlayers, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = row
		}), "Primary")

		if ping and ping > 0 then
			local tone = ping < 90 and Color3.fromRGB(46, 213, 115) or (ping < 160 and Color3.fromRGB(230, 162, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(235, 87, 87))
			Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, LayoutOrder = 2, BackgroundColor3 = tone, BackgroundTransparency = 0.85,
				Text = math.floor(ping) .. " ms", TextColor3 = tone, TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = row,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
				Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8) })
			})
		end

		Lib.RegisterThemeText(Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 32), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "ID " .. id:sub(1, 8) .. "  \u{00B7}  " .. percent .. "% full", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130), TextSize = 11,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = item
		}), "Secondary")

		local track = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, 5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 55), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128), BackgroundTransparency = 0.8,
			BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = item,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
		})
		local fill = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = percent < 60 and Color3.fromRGB(46, 213, 115) or (percent < 85 and Color3.fromRGB(230, 162, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(235, 87, 87)),
			BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = track,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
		})
		task.delay(math.min(order, 8) * 0.04, function()
			if fill.Parent then Lib.Tween(fill, 0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(fraction, 1) }) end
		end)

		Lib.ServerButton(item, "Join", UDim2.new(1, -108, 0, 9), true, function(button)
			button.Text = "Joining..."
			pcall(function() Services.Teleport:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, serverData.id, App.Player) end)
			task.delay(6, function()
				if button.Parent then button.Text = "Join" end
			end)
		end)
		Lib.ServerButton(item, "Copy ID", UDim2.new(1, -108, 0, 39), false, function(button)
			local copy = setclipboard or toclipboard or set_clipboard
			if copy then pcall(copy, id) end
			button.Text = "Copied!"
			task.delay(1.4, function()
				if button.Parent then button.Text = "Copy ID" end
			end)
		end)
	end

	function Lib.FlushServers(count)
		local view = Lib.ServerView
		local stop = math.min(#view.Pending, view.Shown + count)
		for i = view.Shown + 1, stop do CreateServerEntry(view.Pending[i], i) end
		view.Shown = stop
	end

	ServerListScroll:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(function()
		local view = Lib.ServerView
		if view.Shown < #view.Pending and ServerListScroll.CanvasPosition.Y + ServerListScroll.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y > ServerListScroll.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y - 180 then
			Lib.FlushServers(20)
		end
	end)

	Lib.ServerHosts = { "https://games.roproxy.com", "https://games.roblox.com" }
	Lib.ServerBands = { ["10-20%"] = { 10, 20 }, ["30-40%"] = { 30, 40 }, ["50-60%"] = { 50, 60 }, ["70-80%"] = { 70, 80 } }

	function Lib.FetchServerPage(placeId, order, cursor)
		local hosts = Lib.ServerHosts
		local path = "/v1/games/" .. tostring(placeId) .. "/servers/Public?sortOrder=" .. order .. "&excludeFullGames=true&limit=100" .. (cursor and ("&cursor=" .. cursor) or "")
		local why = "no response"
		local started = os.clock()
		for attempt = 1, 2 do
			for i = 1, #hosts do
				local ok, body, reason = API.HTTPRequest(hosts[i] .. path)
				if ok and body then
					local decoded
					local decodedOk = pcall(function() decoded = Services.HttpService:JSONDecode(body) end)
					if decodedOk and type(decoded) == "table" and type(decoded.data) == "table" then
						if i > 1 then hosts[1], hosts[i] = hosts[i], hosts[1] end
						return decoded
					end
					local err = decodedOk and type(decoded) == "table" and type(decoded.errors) == "table" and decoded.errors[1] and decoded.errors[1].message
					why = hosts[i]:match("//([^/]+)") .. ": " .. tostring(err or "invalid response")
				else
					why = tostring(reason or why)
				end
				if os.clock() - started > 30 then return nil, why end
			end
			if attempt == 1 then task.wait(1.4) end
		end
		return nil, why
	end

	function Lib.LoadServerList()
		local SL = State.ServerList
		SL.Gen = SL.Gen + 1
		local gen = SL.Gen
		SL.Loading = true

		for _, c in ipairs(ServerListScroll:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("Frame") then c:Destroy() end
		end
		Lib.ServerView.Pending, Lib.ServerView.Shown = {}, 0
		ServerListScroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero

		local reason = ServerStatusLabel:FindFirstChild("Reason")
		if reason then reason.Text = "" end
		ServerStatusLabel.Text = "Fetching servers..."
		ServerStatusLabel.Visible = true
		ServerListScroll.Visible = false

		task.spawn(function()
			local lo, hi = 0, 100
			if SL.FillState == "Almost Empty" then hi = 25 elseif SL.FillState == "Almost Full" then lo = 80 end
			local band = Lib.ServerBands[SL.PercentRange]
			if band then lo, hi = math.max(lo, band[1]), math.min(hi, band[2]) end

			local filtered = lo > 0 or hi < 100
			local order = SL.Sort == "Least Players" and "Asc" or "Desc"
			if filtered then
				if lo > 0 and hi < 100 then order = hi <= 50 and "Asc" or "Desc"
				elseif hi < 100 then order = "Asc"
				else order = "Desc" end
			end

			local maxPages = (filtered and lo <= hi) and 15 or 1
			local wanted = filtered and 60 or 100
			local list, scanned, cursor = {}, 0, nil
			local placeId, currentJob = game.PlaceId, game.JobId

			for page = 1, maxPages do
				local res, why = Lib.FetchServerPage(placeId, order, cursor)
				if SL.Gen ~= gen then return end
				if not res then
					if scanned == 0 then
						ServerStatusLabel.Text = "Failed to fetch servers (HTTP / Proxy error)."
						if reason then reason.Text = tostring(why):sub(1, 150) end
						ServerStatusLabel.Visible = true
						SL.Loading = false
						return
					end
					break
				end

				local lastPct
				for _, s in ipairs(res.data) do
					if s.playing and s.maxPlayers and s.maxPlayers > 0 then
						scanned = scanned + 1
						local pct = math.floor(s.playing / s.maxPlayers * 100)
						lastPct = pct
						if pct >= lo and pct <= hi and s.id ~= currentJob then list[#list + 1] = s end
					end
				end

				cursor = res.nextPageCursor
				if not cursor or #list >= wanted then break end
				if lastPct and ((order == "Asc" and lastPct > hi) or (order == "Desc" and lastPct < lo)) then break end

				ServerStatusLabel.Text = "Scanning servers..."
				if reason then reason.Text = scanned .. " scanned  ·  " .. #list .. " found" end
				task.wait(0.3)
				if SL.Gen ~= gen then return end
			end

			if SL.Gen ~= gen then return end

			if #list > 0 then
				table.sort(list, function(a, b)
					if SL.Sort == "Least Players" then return a.playing < b.playing end
					return a.playing > b.playing
				end)
				for i = #list, wanted + 1, -1 do list[i] = nil end
				Lib.ServerView.Pending = list
				Lib.FlushServers(24)
				ServerStatusLabel.Visible = false
				ServerListScroll.Visible = true
			else
				ServerStatusLabel.Text = "No servers found matching filters."
				if reason then reason.Text = scanned .. " servers scanned" end
				ServerStatusLabel.Visible = true
			end

			SL.Loading = false
		end)
	end

	ServerListHeaderBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Lib.PlayClick()
		State.ServerList.IsOpen = not State.ServerList.IsOpen
		Lib.Tween(ServerListArrow, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Rotation = State.ServerList.IsOpen and 180 or 0 })
		Lib.Tween(ServerListCard, 0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Size = State.ServerList.IsOpen and UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 344) or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50) })

		if State.ServerList.IsOpen then Lib.LoadServerList() end
	end)
end
