	function Src.Decode(url, headers)
		local success, body = API.HTTPRequest(url, nil, headers)
		if not (success and body) then return nil end
		local decoded
		local ok = pcall(function() decoded = Services.HttpService:JSONDecode(body) end)
		return ok and type(decoded) == "table" and decoded or nil
	end

	function Src.Abs(url, host)
		if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then return nil end
		if url:sub(1, 2) == "//" then return "https:" .. url end
		if url:sub(1, 1) == "/" then return host .. url end
		return url
	end

	function Src.Stamp(value)
		if type(value) == "number" then return value > 1e12 and value // 1000 or value end
		if type(value) ~= "string" or value == "" then return nil end
		local ok, date = pcall(DateTime.fromIsoDate, value)
		return ok and date and date.UnixTimestamp or nil
	end

	function Src.Meta(source, entry)
		local stats = type(source.stats) == "table" and source.stats or {}
		entry.views = entry.views or tonumber(source.views or source.viewCount or stats.views or stats.viewCount)
		entry.created = entry.created or Src.Stamp(source.createdAt or source.created_at or source.publishedAt or source.date)
		entry.updated = entry.updated or Src.Stamp(source.updatedAt or source.lastUpdated or source.updated_at or source.bumpedAt)
	end

	function Src.ParseBlox(decoded, result)
		if decoded.result and decoded.result.scripts then
			result.success = true
			result.totalPages = decoded.result.totalPages or 1
			local host = "https://scriptblox.com"
			for _, s in ipairs(decoded.result.scripts) do
				local place = type(s.game) == "table" and s.game or {}
				local entry = {
					title = s.title,
					game = place.name or "Universal",
					imageUrl = Src.Abs(s.image, host) or Src.Abs(place.imageUrl, host),
					gameImage = Src.Abs(place.imageUrl, host),
					hasKey = s.key,
					isVerified = s.verified,
					script = s.script or s.code or "",
					slug = s.slug,
					link = s.slug and (host .. "/script/" .. s.slug) or nil,
					origin = "ScriptBlox"
				}
				Src.Meta(s, entry)
				result.data[#result.data + 1] = entry
			end
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	function Src.ParseR(decoded, result)
		local rawScripts = nil
		if type(decoded.data) == "table" then
			rawScripts = decoded.data
			result.totalPages = (decoded.meta and decoded.meta.totalPages) or 1
		elseif type(decoded.scripts) == "table" then
			rawScripts = decoded.scripts
			result.totalPages = decoded.totalPages or (decoded.info and decoded.info.maxPages) or 1
		end

		if rawScripts and #rawScripts > 0 then
			result.success = true
			local host = "https://rscripts.net"
			for _, s in ipairs(rawScripts) do
				local place = type(s.game) == "table" and s.game or {}
				local gameImage = Src.Abs(place.thumbnailUrl, host) or Src.Abs(place.logoUrl, host) or Src.Abs(place.imageUrl, host) or Src.Abs(place.imgurl, host)
				local img = Src.Abs(s.imageUrl, host) or Src.Abs(s.image, host) or gameImage
				local code = type(s.script) == "string" and s.script or type(s.code) == "string" and s.code or ""
				if code:find("^https?://%S+$") then code = "" end
				local slug = s.slug or s._id or s.id
				local entry = {
					title = s.title or s.name,
					game = (s.game and (s.game.title or s.game.name)) or "Universal",
					imageUrl = img,
					gameImage = gameImage,
					hasKey = s.hasKey or s.isKeySystem or s.keySystem or s.key,
					isVerified = s.isVerified or (s.risk and s.risk.level == "Safe") or (s.creator and s.creator.isVerified),
					script = code,
					raw = type(s.rawScript) == "string" and s.rawScript or "",
					id = s._id or s.id,
					slug = slug,
					link = slug and (host .. "/script/" .. slug) or nil,
					origin = "Rscripts"
				}
				Src.Meta(s, entry)
				result.data[#result.data + 1] = entry
			end
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	function Src.ParseHax(decoded, result)
		local rows = decoded.data
		if type(rows) ~= "table" then return false end
		result.success = true
		local pg = decoded.pagination
		if pg then
			local current = pg.page or 1
			result.totalPages = pg.totalPages or (pg.hasMore and current + 1) or current
		end
		local host = "https://haxhell.com"
		for _, s in ipairs(rows) do
			local flags, game, media, links = s.flags or {}, s.game or {}, s.media or {}, s.links or {}
			local gameImage = Src.Abs(game.thumbnailUrl, host) or Src.Abs(game.iconUrl, host)
			local entry = {
				title = s.title,
				game = game.name or "Universal",
				imageUrl = Src.Abs(media.thumbnailUrl, host) or gameImage,
				gameImage = Src.Abs(game.iconUrl, host) or gameImage,
				hasKey = flags.keySystem,
				isVerified = flags.verified,
				script = "",
				slug = s.slug,
				raw = links.raw or "",
				link = Src.Abs(links.web or links.page or links.url, host) or (s.slug and (host .. "/scripts/" .. s.slug) or nil),
				origin = "HaxHell"
			}
			Src.Meta(s, entry)
			result.data[#result.data + 1] = entry
		end
		return true
	end

	function Src.Wrap(value)
		if type(value) ~= "string" or value == "" then return "" end
		if value:find("^https?://%S+$") then return 'loadstring(game:HttpGet("' .. value .. '"))()' end
		return value
	end

	Src.Hosts = { "rscripts.net", "rawscripts.net", "scriptblox.com", "robloxscripts.com" }

	function Src.IsPublisher(url)
		local host = url:match("^https?://([^/:]+)")
		if not host then return false end
		host = host:lower()
		for _, known in ipairs(Src.Hosts) do
			if host == known or host:sub(-#known - 1) == "." .. known then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	function Src.Unwrap(code)
		for _ = 1, 3 do
			local url = code:match("^%s*loadstring%s*%(%s*game:HttpGet%w*%s*%(%s*[\"']([^\"']+)[\"'][^%)]*%)%s*%)%s*%(%s*%)%s*;?%s*$")
				or code:match("^%s*(https?://%S+)%s*$")
			if not url or not Src.IsPublisher(url) then break end
			local ok, body = API.HTTPRequest(url)
			body = ok and type(body) == "string" and body:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
			if body == "" then break end
			code = body
		end
		return code
	end

	function Src.Resolve(data)
		local code = ""
		if data.origin == "HaxHell" and data.slug then
			local decoded = Src.Decode("https://haxhell.com/api/v1/scripts/" .. data.slug)
			local source = decoded and decoded.data and decoded.data.source
			if decoded and type(decoded.data) == "table" then Src.Meta(decoded.data, data) end
			if source then
				local inline = type(source.code) == "string" and source.code or ""
				code = (source.displayAsRawLink or inline == "") and Src.Wrap(source.rawUrl) or inline
			end
		end
		if code == "" and type(data.raw) == "string" and data.raw ~= "" then code = Src.Wrap(data.raw) end
		if code == "" and type(data.script) == "string" and data.script ~= "" and not data.script:find("^https?://%S+$") then code = data.script end
		if code == "" and data.origin == "Rscripts" and data.id then
			local decoded = Src.Decode("https://rscripts.net/api/v2/script?id=" .. data.id)
			local item = decoded and decoded.script
			item = type(item) == "table" and (item[1] or item) or nil
			if item then Src.Meta(item, data) end
			if item and type(item.rawScript) == "string" then
				data.raw = item.rawScript
				code = Src.Wrap(item.rawScript)
			end
		end
		if code ~= "" then code = Src.Unwrap(code) end
		return code
	end

	function Src.Params()
		local sort, show = State.ScriptsSort, State.ScriptsShow
		local by = sort ~= "Relevance" and sort or (show == "Trending" and "Views") or (show == "New" and "Newest") or nil
		return by, State.ScriptsOrder == "Descending" and "desc" or "asc"
	end

	function Src.ScriptBlox(page, q)
		local result = { success = false, data = {}, totalPages = 1 }
		local by, order = Src.Params()
		local url
		if q ~= "" then
			url = "https://scriptblox.com/api/script/search?q=" .. Services.HttpService:UrlEncode(q) .. "&page=" .. page
		else
			url = "https://scriptblox.com/api/script/fetch?page=" .. page
			if by then
				url = url .. "&sortBy=" .. (by == "Views" and "views" or by == "Likes" and "likeCount" or "createdAt") .. "&order=" .. order
			end
		end
		local decoded = Src.Decode(url)
		if decoded then Src.ParseBlox(decoded, result) end
		return result
	end

	function Src.RscriptsKey()
		if Src.RKey ~= nil then return Src.RKey end
		local key = getgenv and getgenv().RscriptsKey
		if type(key) ~= "string" or key == "" then
			key = nil
			if type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and isfile("SeptusHub/rscripts.key") then
				local ok, text = pcall(readfile, "SeptusHub/rscripts.key")
				key = ok and type(text) == "string" and text:match("%S+") or nil
			end
		end
		Src.RKey = key or false
		return Src.RKey
	end

	function Src.Rscripts(page, q)
		local result = { success = false, data = {}, totalPages = 1 }
		local by, order = Src.Params()
		local apiKey = Src.RscriptsKey()
		if apiKey then
			local sort = by == "Views" and (order == "desc" and "most-views" or "least-views")
				or by == "Likes" and "most-likes"
				or by == "Newest" and (order == "desc" and "newest" or "oldest")
				or "recommended"
			local url = "https://api.rscripts.net/v1/scripts?limit=30&page=" .. page .. "&sort=" .. sort .. (q ~= "" and ("&q=" .. Services.HttpService:UrlEncode(q)) or "")
			local decoded = Src.Decode(url, { Authorization = "Bearer " .. apiKey })
			if decoded and Src.ParseR(decoded, result) then return result end
		end
		local orderBy = by == "Views" and "views" or by == "Likes" and "likes" or by == "Newest" and "date" or nil
		local query = "page=" .. page .. (orderBy and ("&orderBy=" .. orderBy .. "&sort=" .. order) or "") .. (q ~= "" and ("&q=" .. Services.HttpService:UrlEncode(q)) or "")
		local urls = { "https://rscripts.net/api/v2/scripts?" .. query }
		if q == "" then
			local legacy = orderBy == "views" and "&sort=views" or orderBy == "likes" and "&sort=likes" or ""
			urls[2] = "https://rscripts.net/api/scripts?page=" .. page .. legacy
			urls[3] = "https://api.rscripts.net/v1/scripts?limit=30&page=" .. page .. legacy
		end
		for _, url in ipairs(urls) do
			local decoded = Src.Decode(url)
			if decoded and Src.ParseR(decoded, result) then break end
		end
		return result
	end

	function Src.HaxHell(page, q)
		local result = { success = false, data = {}, totalPages = 1 }
		local by = Src.Params()
		local url
		if q == "" and State.ScriptsShow == "Trending" and State.ScriptsSort == "Relevance" then
			if page > 1 then return result end
			url = "https://haxhell.com/api/v1/scripts/trending?limit=24"
		else
			url = "https://haxhell.com/api/v1/scripts?page=" .. page .. "&limit=30&patched=false&isPaid=false&sort=" .. (by == "Views" and "views" or "latest")
			if #q >= 2 then url ..= "&q=" .. Services.HttpService:UrlEncode(q) end
		end
		local decoded = Src.Decode(url)
		if decoded then Src.ParseHax(decoded, result) end
		return result
	end

	function Src.ParseRoblox(decoded, result, seen)
		local rows = decoded.data
		if type(rows) ~= "table" then return false end
		result.success = true
		local pg = decoded.pagination
		if type(pg) == "table" then
			local pages = tonumber(pg.totalPages or pg.pages or pg.pageCount)
			local total, limit = tonumber(pg.total), tonumber(pg.limit)
			if not pages and total and limit and limit > 0 then pages = math.ceil(total / limit) end
			if not pages and (pg.hasMore or pg.hasNext) then pages = (tonumber(pg.page) or 1) + 1 end
			result.totalPages = math.max(result.totalPages, pages or 1)
		end
		local host = "https://robloxscripts.com"
		for _, s in ipairs(rows) do
			local slug, access = s.slug, s.accessType
			local dedupe = s.id or slug
			if access ~= "paid" and not (dedupe and seen[dedupe]) then
				if dedupe then seen[dedupe] = true end
				local place = type(s.game) == "table" and s.game or {}
				local gameImage = Src.Abs(place.iconUrl, host)
				local code = type(s.script) == "string" and s.script or ""
				if code:find("^https?://%S+$") then code = "" end
				local entry = {
					title = s.title,
					game = place.name or "Universal",
					imageUrl = Src.Abs(s.image, host) or gameImage,
					gameImage = gameImage,
					hasKey = s.key == true or access == "key",
					isVerified = s.isVerified == true or s.verified == true,
					script = code,
					raw = type(s.rawScriptUrl) == "string" and s.rawScriptUrl or (slug and (host .. "/raw/" .. slug .. "?src=api") or ""),
					id = s.id,
					slug = slug,
					link = Src.Abs(s.url, host),
					origin = "Roblox Scripts"
				}
				Src.Meta(s, entry)
				result.data[#result.data + 1] = entry
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	Src["Roblox Scripts"] = function(page, q)
		local result = { success = false, data = {}, totalPages = 1 }
		local base = "https://robloxscripts.com/api/v1/scripts?limit=30&page=" .. page
		local urls = { base }
		if q ~= "" then
			local encoded = Services.HttpService:UrlEncode(q)
			urls = { base .. "&q=" .. encoded, base .. "&game=" .. encoded }
		end
		local bodies, pending = {}, #urls
		for index, url in ipairs(urls) do
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok, decoded = pcall(Src.Decode, url)
				bodies[index] = ok and decoded or false
				pending -= 1
			end)
		end
		local started = os.clock()
		while pending > 0 and os.clock() - started < 30 do task.wait(0.05) end
		local seen = {}
		for index = 1, #urls do
			if bodies[index] then Src.ParseRoblox(bodies[index], result, seen) end
		end
		return result
	end

	function Src.Fetch(page)
		local q = State.ScriptsQuery ~= "" and State.ScriptsQuery or State.ScriptsGame
		local jobs = {}
		for _, name in ipairs(Src.Order) do
			if State.ScriptsSources[name] and Src[name] and not Src.Off[name] then jobs[#jobs + 1] = name end
		end
		local results, pending = {}, #jobs
		for index, name in ipairs(jobs) do
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok, res = pcall(Src[name], page, q)
				results[index] = ok and res or nil
				pending -= 1
			end)
		end
		local started = os.clock()
		while pending > 0 and os.clock() - started < 45 do task.wait(0.05) end

		local merged, lists, longest = { success = false, data = {}, totalPages = 1 }, {}, 0
		for index = 1, #jobs do
			local res = results[index]
			if res and res.success then
				merged.success = true
				merged.totalPages = math.max(merged.totalPages, res.totalPages or 1)
				lists[#lists + 1] = res.data
				longest = math.max(longest, #res.data)
			end
		end
		if not merged.success and State.ScriptsSources.Rscripts then
			local fallback = Src.ScriptBlox(page, q)
			if fallback.success then return fallback end
		end
		for index = 1, longest do
			for _, list in ipairs(lists) do
				if list[index] then merged.data[#merged.data + 1] = list[index] end
			end
		end
		return merged
	end

	function Src.Count()
		local sources, count = State.ScriptsSources, 0
		for _, name in ipairs(Src.Order) do
			if (sources[name] == true) ~= (name == "Rscripts") then
				count += 1
				break
			end
		end
		if State.ScriptsGame ~= "" then count += 1 end
		if State.ScriptsShow ~= "New" then count += 1 end
		if State.ScriptsSort ~= "Relevance" then count += 1 end
		if State.ScriptsOrder ~= "Descending" then count += 1 end
		return count
	end

		local function ShowCode(S)
			local text = S.code
			if text == "" then
				code.Text = "-- Failed to load the script source"
				lineCount.Text = ""
				return
			end
			local count = select(2, text:gsub("\n", "\n")) + 1
			lineCount.Text = count .. (count == 1 and " line" or " lines")
			code.Text = #text > 6000 and (text:sub(1, 6000) .. "\n-- ... " .. (#text - 6000) .. " more characters") or text
		end

		local function Await(S)
			while S.loading do task.wait(0.1) end
			return S.code
		end

		local function Flash(button, text, good, rest)
			button.Text = text
			button.TextColor3 = good and green or red
			task.wait(1.5)
			if button.Parent then
				button.Text = rest
				button.TextColor3 = Lib.Palette.Primary
			end
		end

		local function CopyCode(button, rest)
			local S = state
			if not S or busy[button] then return end
			busy[button] = true
			button.Text = "Copying..."
			task.spawn(function()
				local source = Await(S)
				local copy = setclipboard or toclipboard or set_clipboard
				local good = source ~= "" and copy ~= nil
				if good then
					copy(source)
					Lib.ScriptStores.Recent.Add(S.key, S.data)
				else
					Lib.Notify({ Title = "Scripts", Text = "Failed to get the script loadstring" })
				end
				Flash(button, good and "Copied!" or "Failed", good, rest)
				busy[button] = nil
			end)
		end

		previewCopy.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

			CopyCode(previewCopy, "Copy")

			Lib.PlayClick()
			local S = state
			if not S or busy[executeBtn] then return end
			busy[executeBtn] = true
			executeBtn.Text = "Executing..."
			task.spawn(function()
				local source = Await(S)
				local fn, err
				if source ~= "" and loadstring then fn, err = loadstring(source) end
				if fn then
					Lib.ScriptStores.Recent.Add(S.key, S.data)
					task.spawn(function()
						local ok, runError = pcall(fn)
						if not ok then Lib.Notify({ Title = "Scripts", Text = "Script error: " .. tostring(runError):sub(1, 90) }) end
					end)
				else
					Lib.Notify({ Title = "Scripts", Text = source == "" and "Failed to get the script source" or ("Compile error: " .. tostring(err):sub(1, 90)) })
				end
				executeBtn.Text = fn and "Executed!" or "Failed"
				executeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = fn and green or red
				executeBtn.TextColor3 = white
				task.wait(1.5)
				if executeBtn.Parent then
					executeBtn.Text = "Execute"
					executeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = white
					executeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				end
				busy[executeBtn] = nil
			end)
		end)

		linkBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			local S = state
			if not S or busy[linkBtn] then return end
			local link, copy = S.data.link, setclipboard or toclipboard or set_clipboard
			if type(link) ~= "string" or link == "" or not copy then
				Lib.Notify({ Title = "Scripts", Text = "Script page link is unavailable" })
				return
			end
			copy(link)
			busy[linkBtn] = true
			task.spawn(function()
				Flash(linkBtn, "Copied!", true, "Copy Link")
				busy[linkBtn] = nil
			end)
		end)

		starBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			local S = state
			if not S then return end
			local on = Lib.ScriptStores.Saved.Toggle(S.key, S.data)
			Lib.Tween(starBtn, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { TextColor3 = on and gold or white })
			if S.star and S.star.Parent then S.star.TextColor3 = on and gold or white end
			if S.onChange then task.defer(S.onChange) end
		end)

		function api.Show(data, key, onChange, cardStar)
			if backdrop.Visible or closing then return end
			local S = { data = data, key = key, onChange = onChange, star = cardStar, loading = true, code = "" }
			state = S
			title.Text = data.title or "Unknown Script"
			place.Text = (data.game and data.game ~= "") and data.game or "Universal"
			Lib.LoadWebImage(heroImage, data.imageUrl)
			Lib.LoadWebImage(thumb, data.gameImage or data.imageUrl)
			starBtn.TextColor3 = Lib.ScriptStores.Saved.Has(key) and gold or white
			PaintFolder()
			BuildChips(data)
			code.Text = "Loading script..."
			lineCount.Text = ""
			body.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
			codeScroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
			windowScale.Scale = 0.94
			Lib.GlassOpen(backdrop)
			Lib.Tween(windowScale, 0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { Scale = 1 })
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok, source = pcall(Src.Resolve, data)
				S.code = ok and type(source) == "string" and source or ""
				S.loading = false
				if state ~= S then return end
				ShowCode(S)
				BuildChips(data)
			end)
		end

		function api.Close()
			if not backdrop.Visible or closing then return end
			closing = true
			state = nil
			Lib.GlassClose(backdrop, function()
				backdrop.Visible = false
				closing = false
			end)
		end

		close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			api.Close()
		end)
		backdrop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(api.Close)

		Lib.ScriptDetails = api
		return api
	end

	end

	function Lib.LoadScriptsPage(page)
		if State.ScriptsLoading then return end
		State.ScriptsLoading = true
		local gen = State.ScriptsGen
		local first = page == 1

		ErrorLabel.Visible = false
		RetryBtn.Visible = false

		if first then
			for _, child in ipairs(BrowseScroll:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end
			end
			State.ScriptsCount = 0
			BrowseScroll.Visible = false
			LoadingLabel.Text = "Loading scripts..."
			LoadingLabel.Visible = true
		else
			MoreLabel.Visible = true
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			local ok = pcall(function()
				local result = Src.Fetch(page)
				if gen ~= State.ScriptsGen then return end

				LoadingLabel.Visible = false
				MoreLabel.Visible = false

				local query = State.ScriptsQuery:lower()
				local gameQuery = State.ScriptsGame:lower()
				local filtered = query ~= "" or gameQuery ~= ""
				if first then
					Lib.ScriptsSearch.SetSuggestions(query ~= "" and result.success and Lib.CollectPlaces(result.data, query) or nil)
				end
				if filtered and result.success then
					local kept = {}
					for _, s in ipairs(result.data) do
						local gameName, title = (s.game or ""):lower(), (s.title or ""):lower()
						if (query == "" or gameName:find(query, 1, true) or title:find(query, 1, true)) and (gameQuery == "" or gameName:find(gameQuery, 1, true)) then
							kept[#kept + 1] = s
						end
					end
					result.data = kept
					if #kept == 0 and page < result.totalPages and page < 4 then
						State.ScriptsLoading = false
						return Lib.LoadScriptsPage(page + 1)
					end
				end

				if result.success and #result.data > 0 then
					local base = State.ScriptsCount
					State.ScriptsCache[page] = true
					State.ScriptsPage = page
					State.ScriptsTotalPages = result.totalPages or 1
					for i, sData in ipairs(result.data) do
						CreateScriptCard(sData, base + i)
					end
					State.ScriptsCount = base + #result.data
					BrowseScroll.Visible = true
				elseif first then
					if filtered and result.success then
						LoadingLabel.Text = "No scripts found"
						LoadingLabel.Visible = true
					else
						ErrorLabel.Visible = true
						RetryBtn.Visible = true
					end
				else
					State.ScriptsBackoff = os.clock() + 4
					if State.ScriptsCount == 0 and filtered then
						LoadingLabel.Text = "No scripts found"
						LoadingLabel.Visible = true
					end
				end

				State.ScriptsLoading = false
			end)
			if not ok and gen == State.ScriptsGen then
				State.ScriptsLoading = false
				LoadingLabel.Visible = false
				MoreLabel.Visible = false
				if first then
					ErrorLabel.Visible = true
					RetryBtn.Visible = true
				else
					State.ScriptsBackoff = os.clock() + 4
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	do
		local cell, gap = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 236), UDim2.fromOffset(15, 15)
		local savedScroll, savedEmpty = Lib.MakeCardList(View_Saved, "No saved scripts yet\nTap the star on a script card to save it", cell, gap, 10)
		Lib.ScriptCollections = Lib.BuildCollections(MakeScriptsTab("Collections", 170), "SeptusHub_ScriptCollections.json", cell, gap, 10, CreateScriptCard)
		local recentScroll, recentEmpty = Lib.MakeCardList(View_Recent, "No recent scripts yet\nScripts you copy will appear here", cell, gap, 10)

		local function Fill(scroll, empty, store, onChange)
			for _, child in ipairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end
			end
			local list = store.List()
			for index, entry in ipairs(list) do CreateScriptCard(entry.data, index, scroll, onChange) end
			empty.Visible = #list == 0
		end

		local function FillSaved() Fill(savedScroll, savedEmpty, Lib.ScriptStores.Saved, FillSaved) end

		function Lib.OnScriptsTab(tabName)
			if tabName == "Saved" then
				FillSaved()
			elseif tabName == "Recent" then
				Fill(recentScroll, recentEmpty, Lib.ScriptStores.Recent)
			elseif tabName == "Collections" then
				Lib.ScriptCollections.Show()
			end
		end
	end

	RetryBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Lib.PlayClick()
		Lib.LoadScriptsPage(1)
	end)
end

	local function CreateEmoteCard(data, order, parent, onChange)
		local Card = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(185, 230), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15), LayoutOrder = order, Parent = parent or EmotesScroll, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }) })
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(Card, "BackgroundColor3", 0.5)

		local thumbType = (data.itemType == "Bundle") and "BundleThumbnail" or "Asset"
		local thumbUrl = "rbxthumb://type=" .. thumbType .. "&id=" .. tostring(data.thumbnailId) .. "&w=420&h=420"

		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(Lib.Create("ImageLabel", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 110), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), Image = thumbUrl, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, Parent = Card, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }) }), "BackgroundColor3", 0.7)
		local key = tostring(data.id)
		local slim = { id = data.id, itemType = data.itemType, name = data.name, price = data.price, thumbnailId = data.thumbnailId }
		Lib.MakeStar(Card, UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 14), Lib.EmoteStores.Saved.Has(key), function()
			local on = Lib.EmoteStores.Saved.Toggle(key, slim)
			if onChange then task.defer(onChange) end
			return on
		end)
		Lib.MakeFolderButton(Card, UDim2.new(1, -64, 0, 14), "EmoteCollections", key, slim, data.name)

		local eName = Lib.Create("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 124), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = data.name, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = Card })
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(eName, "Primary")

		local isFree = data.price == "Free"
		local ePrice = Lib.Create("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 144), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = data.price, TextColor3 = isFree and Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 160), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = Card })
		if not isFree then Lib.RegisterThemeText(ePrice, "Secondary") end

		local isPlaying = (State.CurrentPlayingAssetId == data.id)
		local actionBtn = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 30), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -38),
			BackgroundColor3 = isPlaying and Color3.fromRGB(220, 50, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
			Text = isPlaying and "Stop" or "Play",
			TextColor3 = isPlaying and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
			TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = Card,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) })
		})

		if isPlaying then State.CurrentEmoteButton = actionBtn end

		actionBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			if State.CurrentPlayingAssetId ~= data.id then
				Lib.EmoteStores.Recent.Add(key, slim)
			end
			Lib.PlayEmote(data.id, data.itemType, actionBtn)
		end)
	end

	do
		local cell, gap = UDim2.fromOffset(185, 230), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
		local savedScroll, savedEmpty = Lib.MakeCardList(View_EmotesSaved, "No saved emotes yet\nTap the star on an emote card to save it", cell, gap, 8)
		Lib.EmoteCollections = Lib.BuildCollections(MakeEmotesTab("Collections", 170), "SeptusHub_EmoteCollections.json", cell, gap, 8, CreateEmoteCard)
		local recentScroll, recentEmpty = Lib.MakeCardList(View_EmotesRecent, "No recent emotes yet\nEmotes you play will appear here", cell, gap, 8)

		local function Fill(scroll, empty, store, onChange)
			for _, child in ipairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end
			end
			local list = store.List()
			for index, entry in ipairs(list) do CreateEmoteCard(entry.data, index, scroll, onChange) end
			empty.Visible = #list == 0
		end

		local function FillSaved() Fill(savedScroll, savedEmpty, Lib.EmoteStores.Saved, FillSaved) end

		function Lib.OnEmotesTab(tabName)
			if tabName == "Saved" then
				FillSaved()
			elseif tabName == "Recent" then
				Fill(recentScroll, recentEmpty, Lib.EmoteStores.Recent)
			elseif tabName == "Collections" then
				Lib.EmoteCollections.Show()
			end
		end
	end

	function Lib.LoadEmotesPage(page)
		if State.EmotesLoading then return end
		State.EmotesLoading = true
		local gen = State.EmotesGen

		for _, child in ipairs(EmotesScroll:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end
		end

		EmotesLoadingLabel.Text = (State.EmotesCategory == "Emotes") and "Loading emotes..." or "Loading animation packs..."
		EmotesLoadingLabel.Visible = true
		EmotesErrorLabel.Visible = false
		EmotesRetryBtn.Visible = false
		EmotesPaginationPanel.Visible = false
		EmotesScroll.Visible = false

		task.spawn(function()
			local isPack = (State.EmotesCategory == "Animation Packs")
			local currentCache = isPack and State.AnimationPacksCache or State.EmotesCache

			local result = currentCache[page]
			if not result then
				local ok, fetched = Lib.Timed(function()
					return (isPack and API.FetchAnimationPacks or API.FetchEmotes)(page, State.EmotesSort)
				end, 90)
				result = ok and fetched or { success = false, error = "script error: " .. tostring(fetched) }
				if result.success then currentCache[page] = result end
			end
			if gen ~= State.EmotesGen then return end

			if result and result.success and result.data and #result.data > 0 then
				State.EmotesPage = page
				State.EmotesTotalPages = result.totalPages or 1
				EmotesPageLabel.Text = "Page " .. tostring(page) .. " / " .. tostring(State.EmotesTotalPages)

				for i, eData in ipairs(result.data) do
					CreateEmoteCard(eData, i)
				end
				EmotesScroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)

				if page == 1 then
					local query = State.EmotesQuery:lower()
					local suggestions
					if query ~= "" then
						suggestions = {}
						for _, e in ipairs(result.data) do
							local name = e.name:lower()
							if name:sub(1, #query) == query or name:find(" " .. query, 1, true) then
								suggestions[#suggestions + 1] = {
									Name = e.name,
									Sub = e.price,
									Image = "rbxthumb://type=" .. (e.itemType == "Bundle" and "BundleThumbnail" or "Asset") .. "&id=" .. tostring(e.thumbnailId) .. "&w=150&h=150"
								}
								if #suggestions == 10 then break end
							end
						end
					end
					Lib.EmotesSearch.SetSuggestions(suggestions)
				end

				EmotesLoadingLabel.Visible = false
				EmotesScroll.Visible = true
				EmotesPaginationPanel.Visible = true
			elseif result and result.empty then
				Lib.EmotesSearch.SetSuggestions(nil)
				EmotesLoadingLabel.Text = "Nothing found"
				EmotesLoadingLabel.Visible = true
			else
				EmotesLoadingLabel.Visible = false
				local reason = result and result.error
				EmotesErrorLabel.Text = "Failed to load " .. ((State.EmotesCategory == "Emotes") and "emotes" or "animation packs") .. ((reason and reason ~= "") and ("\n" .. reason:sub(1, 420)) or "\nNo items returned")
				EmotesErrorLabel.Visible = true
				EmotesRetryBtn.Visible = true
			end

			State.EmotesLoading = false
		end)
	end

	EmotesPrevBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Lib.PlayClick()
		if State.EmotesPage > 1 and not State.EmotesLoading then Lib.LoadEmotesPage(State.EmotesPage - 1) end
	end)
	EmotesNextBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Lib.PlayClick()
		if State.EmotesPage < State.EmotesTotalPages and not State.EmotesLoading then Lib.LoadEmotesPage(State.EmotesPage + 1) end
	end)
	EmotesRetryBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Lib.PlayClick()
		Lib.LoadEmotesPage(State.EmotesPage)
	end)
end

do
	local Asset = game:GetService("AssetService")
	local token, pending, failedId = 0, 0, nil
	local dst, source, current

	local function Free()
		token = token + 1
		if dst then pcall(dst.Destroy, dst) end
		dst, source, current = nil, nil, nil
	end

	Lib.ReleaseBgSaturation = Free

	function Lib.RefreshBgSaturation()
		token = token + 1
		local mine, image, id = token, UI.CustomBgImage, Lib.BgAssetId
		if State.BgSaturation == 100 or not id or not image.Visible then
			if dst then
				if image.Visible and Lib.BgResolved then image.Image = Lib.BgResolved end
				Free()
			end
			return
		end
		if failedId == id then return end

		task.spawn(function()
			local ok = pcall(function()
				if current ~= id then
					if dst then pcall(dst.Destroy, dst) dst = nil end
					local editable = Asset:CreateEditableImageAsync(Content.fromAssetId(tonumber(id)))
					dst, current = editable, id
					source = editable:ReadPixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, editable.Size)
				end
				local size = dst.Size
				local width, height, saturation = size.X, size.Y, State.BgSaturation / 100
				local out = buffer.create(buffer.len(source))
				local readu8, writeu8 = buffer.readu8, buffer.writeu8
				for y = 0, height - 1 do
					for offset = y * width * 4, (y + 1) * width * 4 - 4, 4 do
						local r, g, b = readu8(source, offset), readu8(source, offset + 1), readu8(source, offset + 2)
						local luma = r * 0.299 + g * 0.587 + b * 0.114
						writeu8(out, offset, math.clamp(luma + (r - luma) * saturation, 0, 255) // 1)
						writeu8(out, offset + 1, math.clamp(luma + (g - luma) * saturation, 0, 255) // 1)
						writeu8(out, offset + 2, math.clamp(luma + (b - luma) * saturation, 0, 255) // 1)
						writeu8(out, offset + 3, readu8(source, offset + 3))
					end
					if y % 48 == 47 then
						task.wait()
						if mine ~= token then return end
					end
				end
				dst:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, size, out)
				image.ImageContent = Content.fromObject(dst)
			end)
			if not ok and mine == token then
				failedId = id
				Lib.Notify({ Title = "Background", Text = "Saturation is not supported for this image or executor" })
			end
		end)
	end

	function Lib.QueueBgSaturation()
		pending = pending + 1
		local mine = pending
		task.delay(0.35, function()
			if mine == pending and not State.Unloaded then Lib.RefreshBgSaturation() end
		end)
	end
end

function Lib.BuildMusic(group)
	local Http, Run, UIS = Services.HttpService, Services.Run, Services.UserInputService
	local Market = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
	local FILE, FOLDER, BARS = "SeptusHub_Music.json", "SeptusHub_Music", 14
	local WHITE, BLACK = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	local request = request or http_request or (syn and syn.request)
	local playlists, order, rows = {}, {}, {}
	local list, activeIndex
	local mode, cur, loading, failed, autoPaused, token = "Asset ID", nil, false, false, false, 0
	local Refresh, Play, Toggle, Step, Rebuild, RebuildPlaylists, SwitchPlaylist, FinishFade, StopAll

	local sounds = {
		Lib.Create("Sound", { Name = "SeptusMusic", Volume = 0, Parent = UI.Screen }),
		Lib.Create("Sound", { Name = "SeptusMusicB", Volume = 0, Parent = UI.Screen })
	}
	local sound = sounds[1]
	local gains = { [sounds[1]] = 1, [sounds[2]] = 0 }
	local fade

	local function ApplyVolume()
		local master = State.MusicVolume / 100
		for i = 1, 2 do
			local s = sounds[i]
			s.Volume = master * gains[s]
		end
	end
	ApplyVolume()

	local function ParseTracks(tracks)
		local out = {}
		for _, entry in ipairs(tracks) do
			if type(entry) == "table" and type(entry.value) == "string" and (entry.kind == "id" or entry.kind == "url") then
				out[#out + 1] = { kind = entry.kind, value = entry.value, name = tostring(entry.name or entry.value), fav = entry.fav == true }
			end
		end
		return out
	end

	if isfile and readfile then
		pcall(function()
			if not isfile(FILE) then return end
			local data = Http:JSONDecode(readfile(FILE))
			if type(data.playlists) == "table" then
				for _, pl in ipairs(data.playlists) do
					if type(pl) == "table" and type(pl.name) == "string" and type(pl.tracks) == "table" then
						playlists[#playlists + 1] = { name = pl.name, tracks = ParseTracks(pl.tracks) }
					end
				end
				activeIndex = tonumber(data.active)
			else
				playlists[1] = { name = "Main Playlist", tracks = ParseTracks(data) }
			end
		end)
	end
	if #playlists == 0 then playlists[1] = { name = "Main Playlist", tracks = {} } end
	activeIndex = math.clamp(math.floor(activeIndex or 1), 1, #playlists)
	list = playlists[activeIndex].tracks

	pcall(function()
		if makefolder and not isfolder(FOLDER) then makefolder(FOLDER) end
	end)

	local function Save()
		if not writefile then return end
		local out = table.create(#playlists)
		for i, pl in ipairs(playlists) do
			local tracks = table.create(#pl.tracks)
			for j, entry in ipairs(pl.tracks) do
				tracks[j] = { kind = entry.kind, value = entry.value, name = entry.name, fav = entry.fav }
			end
			out[i] = { name = pl.name, tracks = tracks }
		end
		pcall(writefile, FILE, Http:JSONEncode({ v = 2, active = activeIndex, playlists = out }))
	end

	local function Hash(text)
		local h = 5381
		for i = 1, #text do h = (h * 33 + text:byte(i)) % 4294967296 end
		return h
	end

	local function Resolve(entry)
		if entry.kind == "id" then return "rbxassetid://" .. entry.value end
		if not (request and writefile and isfile and getcustomasset) then return nil end
		local ext = entry.value:gsub("[?#].*$", ""):match("%.(%a%w?%w?%w?)$") or "mp3"
		local path = FOLDER .. "/m_" .. Hash(entry.value) .. "." .. ext
		if not isfile(path) then
			local response = request({ Url = entry.value, Method = "GET" })
			if not response or (response.StatusCode or 200) >= 400 or not response.Body or #response.Body == 0 then return nil end
			writefile(path, response.Body)
		end
		return getcustomasset(path)
	end

	local function Row(height)
		return Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = group })
	end

	local top = Row(58)
	top.ZIndex = 5

		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(96, 36), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 11), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22),

		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = top,

		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 36), Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "▾",
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = modeBtn
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(chevron, "Secondary")

	local input = Lib.Create("TextBox", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -188, 0, 36), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(116, 11), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22),
		PlaceholderText = "Paste an Asset ID...", PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240),
		TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Text = "", ClearTextOnFocus = false, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = top,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }),
		Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10) })
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeElement(input, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7, true)
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(input, "Primary")

	local addBtn = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 36), Position = UDim2.new(1, -68, 0, 11), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
		Text = "Add", TextColor3 = BLACK, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = top,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) })
	})

	local popup = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(96, 66), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 50), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22),
		Visible = false, ZIndex = 10, Parent = top,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }),
		Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60), Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.4 })
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeElement(popup, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7)

		mode = value
		modeBtn.Text = value
		input.PlaceholderText = value == "URL" and "Paste an audio URL..." or "Paste an Asset ID..."

	for i, label in ipairs({ "Asset ID", "URL" }) do

	modeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	local plRow = Row(46)
	plRow.ZIndex = 4

	local plBtn = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 34), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 6), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22),

	})

	local plTitle = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {

		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = plBtn
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(plTitle, "Primary")
	local plChevron = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 34), Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "▾",
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = plBtn
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(plChevron, "Secondary")

	local plName = Lib.Create("TextBox", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -302, 0, 34), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 6), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22),
		PlaceholderText = "Playlist name...", PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240),

	function RebuildPlaylists()
		for _, child in ipairs(plPopup:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end

		for i, pl in ipairs(playlists) do

				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = i, Text = string.format("%s  (%d)", pl.name, #pl.tracks),

				Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6) })
			})
			option.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				Lib.PlayClick()
				SwitchPlaylist(i)
			end)
		end
		plPopup.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, math.min(#playlists, 6) * 28 + 6)
	end

	function SwitchPlaylist(index)
		activeIndex = index
		list = playlists[index].tracks
		plPopup.Visible = false
		Save()
		Rebuild()
	end

	local function CleanName(text)
		text = text:gsub("%c", ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
		return text:sub(1, 24)
	end

	local function NameTaken(name, ignore)
		local lower = name:lower()
		for i, pl in ipairs(playlists) do
			if i ~= ignore and pl.name:lower() == lower then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

			Lib.Notify({ Title = "Music", Text = "Too many playlists" })
			return
		end
		local name = CleanName(plName.Text)
		if name == "" then name = "Playlist " .. (#playlists + 1) end
		if NameTaken(name) then
			Lib.Notify({ Title = "Music", Text = "Playlist already exists" })
			return
		end
		playlists[#playlists + 1] = { name = name, tracks = {} }
		plName.Text = ""
		SwitchPlaylist(#playlists)
	end)

	plRename.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

		if name == "" then

			return
		end
		if NameTaken(name, activeIndex) then
			Lib.Notify({ Title = "Music", Text = "Playlist already exists" })
			return
		end
		playlists[activeIndex].name = name
		plName.Text = ""
		Save()
		RebuildPlaylists()
	end)

		Lib.PlayClick()
		if #playlists <= 1 then
			Lib.Notify({ Title = "Music", Text = "Cannot delete the last playlist" })
			return
		end
		table.remove(playlists, activeIndex)
		SwitchPlaylist(math.min(activeIndex, #playlists))
	end)

	function Refresh()
		local status
		if loading then
			status = "LOADING"
		elseif failed then
			status = "ERROR"
		elseif not cur then
			status = "NO TRACK"
		elseif sound.IsPlaying then
			status = "PLAYING"
		else
			status = "PAUSED"
		end
		local playing = status == "PLAYING"
		titleLabel.Text = cur and cur.name or "Nothing playing"
		statusLabel.Text = status
		playBtn.Text = playing and "II" or "▶"
		for entry, button in pairs(rows) do
			local active = entry == cur
			button.Text = (active and playing) and "II" or "▶"
			button.TextColor3 = active and Lib.Palette.Primary or Lib.Palette.Secondary
		end
		if Lib.MiniRefresh then Lib.MiniRefresh() end
	end

	function FinishFade()
		if not fade then return end
		local out, into = fade.out, fade.into
		fade = nil
		out:Stop()
		gains[out], gains[into] = 0, 1
		ApplyVolume()
	end

	function StopAll()
		fade = nil
		for i = 1, 2 do
			sounds[i]:Stop()
			gains[sounds[i]] = 0
		end
		gains[sound] = 1
		ApplyVolume()
	end

	function Play(entry, blend)
		FinishFade()
		local outgoing = sound
		local keep = blend and State.MusicCrossfade > 0 and outgoing.IsPlaying
		cur, loading, failed, autoPaused = entry, true, false, false
		token = token + 1
		local mine = token
		if not keep then StopAll() end
		Refresh()
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, src = pcall(Resolve, entry)
			if mine ~= token then return end
			loading = false
			if not ok or not src then
				failed = true
				Refresh()
				Lib.Notify({ Title = "Music", Text = "Failed to load the track" })
				return
			end
			local incoming = keep and (outgoing == sounds[1] and sounds[2] or sounds[1]) or outgoing
			incoming.SoundId = src
			incoming.TimePosition = 0
			if keep then
				gains[incoming] = 0
				fade = { out = outgoing, into = incoming, start = os.clock(), span = math.max(State.MusicCrossfade, 0.1), from = gains[outgoing] }
				sound = incoming
			end
			ApplyVolume()
			incoming:Play()
			Refresh()
			task.delay(10, function()
				if mine == token and not incoming.IsLoaded then
					failed = true
					Refresh()
				end
			end)
		end)
	end

	function Toggle()
		FinishFade()
		if not cur then
			if order[1] then Play(order[1]) end
		elseif loading then
			return
		elseif failed then
			Play(cur)
		elseif sound.IsPlaying then
			sound:Pause()
		elseif sound.IsPaused then
			sound:Resume()
		else
			sound:Play()
		end
		Refresh()
	end

	function Step(direction, blend)
		local count = #order
		if count == 0 then return end
		local position = cur and table.find(order, cur) or (direction > 0 and 0 or count + 1)
		Play(order[(position - 1 + direction) % count + 1], blend)
	end
	local function Remove(entry)
		if cur == entry then
			token = token + 1
			cur, loading, failed = nil, false, false
			StopAll()
		end
		local position = table.find(list, entry)
		if position then table.remove(list, position) end
		Save()
		Rebuild()
	end

	function Rebuild()
		RebuildPlaylists()
		for _, child in ipairs(listFrame:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("GuiObject") then child:Destroy() end
		end
		table.clear(rows)
		table.clear(order)
		for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
			if entry.fav then order[#order + 1] = entry end
		end
		for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
			if not entry.fav then order[#order + 1] = entry end
		end
		if Lib.MiniRebuild then Lib.MiniRebuild() end

		if #order == 0 then
			local empty = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Playlist is empty", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120),
				TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Parent = listFrame
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(empty, "Secondary")
			Refresh()
			return
		end

		for i, entry in ipairs(order) do
			local item = Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), LayoutOrder = i, Parent = listFrame,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) })
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeElement(item, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7, true)

			local play = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, -14), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "▶",
				TextColor3 = Lib.Palette.Secondary, TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = item
			})
			local name = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -112, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = entry.name,
				TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = item
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(name, "Primary")
			local star = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24), Position = UDim2.new(1, -64, 0.5, -12), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = entry.fav and "★" or "☆", TextColor3 = entry.fav and Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150),
				TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = item
			})

				TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), TextSize = 16, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = item

				entry.fav = not entry.fav
				Save()
				Rebuild()
			end)
			remove.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				Lib.PlayClick()
				Remove(entry)
			end)
		end
		Refresh()
	end

	local function Add()
		local text = input.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
		if text == "" then return end
		local entry
		if mode == "Asset ID" then
			local id = tonumber(text) and text or text:match("rbxassetid://(%d+)") or text:match("[?&]id=(%d+)") or text:match("/library/(%d+)") or text:match("(%d%d%d%d+)")
			if not id then
				Lib.Notify({ Title = "Music", Text = "Invalid Asset ID" })
				return
			end
			entry = { kind = "id", value = id, name = "Asset " .. id, fav = false }
		else
			if not text:match("^https?://") then
				Lib.Notify({ Title = "Music", Text = "Enter a valid http(s) URL" })
				return
			end
			if not (request and writefile and getcustomasset) then
				Lib.Notify({ Title = "Music", Text = "This executor cannot play audio from URLs" })
				return
			end
			local base = text:gsub("[?#].*$", ""):match("([^/]+)$") or text
			base = base:gsub("%.%w+$", "")
			base = base:gsub("%%(%x%x)", function(hex) return string.char(tonumber(hex, 16)) end)
			entry = { kind = "url", value = text, name = base ~= "" and base or text, fav = false }
		end
		for _, other in ipairs(list) do
			if other.kind == entry.kind and other.value == entry.value then
				Lib.Notify({ Title = "Music", Text = "Already in the playlist" })
				return
			end
		end
		if #list >= 100 then
			Lib.Notify({ Title = "Music", Text = "Playlist is full" })
			return
		end
		list[#list + 1] = entry
		input.Text = ""
		popup.Visible = false
		Save()
		Rebuild()
		if entry.kind == "id" then
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok, info = pcall(Market.GetProductInfo, Market, tonumber(entry.value))
				if ok and type(info) == "table" and info.Name and info.Name ~= "" and table.find(list, entry) then
					entry.name = info.Name
					Save()
					Rebuild()
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	local audioClock = 0
	Lib.C(Run.Heartbeat, function(dt)
		if fade then
			local alpha = math.clamp((os.clock() - fade.start) / fade.span, 0, 1)
			local angle = alpha * math.pi / 2
			gains[fade.into] = math.sin(angle)
			gains[fade.out] = fade.from * math.cos(angle)
			ApplyVolume()
			if alpha >= 1 then FinishFade() end
			return
		end
		audioClock = audioClock + dt
		if audioClock < 0.1 then return end
		audioClock = 0
		local span = State.MusicCrossfade
		if span > 0 and not loading and not failed and #order > 1 and sound.IsPlaying then
			local length = sound.TimeLength
			if length > span + 1 and length - sound.TimePosition <= span then Step(1, true) end
		end
	end)

	local function NewSpectrum(count)
		local spec = { count = count, values = table.create(count, 0), lows = table.create(count), highs = table.create(count), attack = table.create(count), decay = table.create(count), peak = 150, active = false }
		for i = 1, count do
			local mix = count > 1 and (i - 1) / (count - 1) or 0
			spec.lows[i] = ((i - 1) / count) ^ 1.7
			spec.highs[i] = (i / count) ^ 1.7
			spec.attack[i] = 14 + 26 * mix
			spec.decay[i] = 3 + 13 * mix
		end
		return spec
	end

	local function Advance(spec, loudness, dt)
		spec.active = true
		spec.peak = math.max(loudness, spec.peak - 80 * dt, 120)
		local level = math.min(loudness / spec.peak, 1)
		local values, lows, highs, attack, decay = spec.values, spec.lows, spec.highs, spec.attack, spec.decay
		for i = 1, spec.count do
			local target = math.clamp((level - lows[i]) / (highs[i] - lows[i]), 0, 1)
			local value = values[i]
			values[i] = value + (target - value) * math.min(1, (target > value and attack[i] or decay[i]) * dt)
		end
	end

	local function ResetSpectrum(spec)
		spec.active = false
		spec.peak = 150
		for i = 1, spec.count do spec.values[i] = 0 end
	end

	local specBars = NewSpectrum(BARS)
	local holder = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Name = "MusicVisualizer", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BARS * 6, 28), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 29),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, ZIndex = 3, Parent = UI.Main
	})

	for i = 1, BARS do
		levels[i] = 0.1
		bars[i] = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.1, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, (i - 1) * 6, 1, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.Primary, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3, Parent = holder,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
		})
	end

	local accumulator = 0
	Lib.C(Run.RenderStepped, function(dt)
		local want = State.MusicVisualizer and sound.IsPlaying
		if holder.Visible ~= want then holder.Visible = want end
		if not want then
			if specBars.active then ResetSpectrum(specBars) end
			return
		end
		accumulator = accumulator + dt
		if accumulator < 0.033 then return end
		local step = accumulator
		accumulator = 0
		if State.MusicRanges then
			Advance(specBars, sound.PlaybackLoudness, step)
			local color = Lib.Palette.Primary
			local values = specBars.values
			for i = 1, BARS do
				local bar = bars[i]
				bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, math.max(values[i], 0.08), 0)
				bar.BackgroundColor3 = color
			end
			return
		end
		table.remove(levels, 1)
		levels[BARS] = math.clamp(sound.PlaybackLoudness / 400, 0.08, 1)
		local phase, color = os.clock() * 8, Lib.Palette.Primary
		for i = 1, BARS do
			local bar = bars[i]
			bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, math.clamp(levels[i] * (0.7 + 0.3 * math.sin(phase + i * 1.3)), 0.08, 1), 0)
			bar.BackgroundColor3 = color
		end
	end)

			pauseBars[i] = Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 2), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, i == 1 and -3 or 3, 0.5, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Theme.Main, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 128, Parent = playBtn,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
			})
		end

		local menuBtn = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26), Position = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 15), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false,
			ZIndex = 127, Parent = mini
		})
		local lines = {}
		for i = 1, 3 do
			lines[i] = Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 2), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, (i - 2) * 5), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.Secondary, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 128, Parent = menuBtn,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
			})
		end

		local hit = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 50), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false,
			ZIndex = 127, Parent = mini
		})
		local track = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -1), BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.Secondary, BackgroundTransparency = 0.7,
			BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 127, Parent = hit, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
		})
		local fill = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.Primary, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 128, Parent = track,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
		})
		local knob = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.Primary,
			BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 129, Parent = fill, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
		})

		local separator = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, HEAD), BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.Secondary, BackgroundTransparency = 0.8,
			BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 126, Parent = mini
		})
		local listScroll = Lib.Create("ScrollingFrame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -(HEAD + 8)), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, HEAD + 4), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
			ScrollBarThickness = 2, ScrollBarImageColor3 = Lib.Palette.Secondary, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			ZIndex = 126, Parent = mini,
			Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 2), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
		})

		local function Paint()
			local primary, secondary, ink = Lib.Palette.Primary, Lib.Palette.Secondary, Lib.Theme.Main
			playBtn.BackgroundColor3 = primary
			playGlyph.TextColor3 = ink
			pauseBars[1].BackgroundColor3, pauseBars[2].BackgroundColor3 = ink, ink
			fill.BackgroundColor3, knob.BackgroundColor3 = primary, primary
			track.BackgroundColor3, separator.BackgroundColor3 = secondary, secondary
			listScroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = secondary
			for i = 1, EQ do eq[i].BackgroundColor3 = primary end
			for i = 1, 3 do lines[i].BackgroundColor3 = listOpen and primary or secondary end
		end
		table.insert(Lib.ThemeHooks, Paint)

		local function SetPlayIcon(playing)
			if playing == wasPlaying then return end
			wasPlaying = playing
			Lib.Tween(playGlyph, 0.2, Quad, Out, { TextTransparency = playing and 1 or 0 })
			for i = 1, 2 do
				Lib.Tween(pauseBars[i], 0.3, Back, Out, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, playing and 13 or 2), BackgroundTransparency = playing and 0 or 1 })
			end
		end

		local function SetMenuIcon(open)
			local color = open and Lib.Palette.Primary or Lib.Palette.Secondary
			Lib.Tween(lines[1], 0.35, Back, Out, { Rotation = open and 45 or 0, Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, open and 0 or -5), BackgroundColor3 = color })
			Lib.Tween(lines[2], 0.2, Quad, Out, { BackgroundTransparency = open and 1 or 0, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(open and 4 or 14, 2), BackgroundColor3 = color })
			Lib.Tween(lines[3], 0.35, Back, Out, { Rotation = open and -45 or 0, Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, open and 0 or 5), BackgroundColor3 = color })
		end

		local function ListHeight()
			local count = math.min(#order, MAXROWS)
			return (count == 0 and 34 or count * (ROW + 2)) + 12
		end

		local function Resize()
			targetHeight = HEAD + (listOpen and ListHeight() or 0)
			Lib.Tween(mini, listOpen and 0.5 or 0.38, Quint, Out, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(WIDTH, targetHeight) })
			Lib.MiniOffset = shown and (targetHeight + 20) or 0
		end

		local function Clock(seconds)
			seconds = math.floor(seconds)
			return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(seconds / 60), seconds % 60)
		end

		local function UpdateTime(force)
			if loading or failed or not cur then
				local text = loading and "LOADING" or failed and "ERROR" or "NO TRACK"
				if sub.Text ~= text then sub.Text = text end
				lastSecond = -1
				return
			end
			local position = sound.TimePosition
			local second = math.floor(position)
			if second == lastSecond and not force then return end
			lastSecond = second
			local length = sound.TimeLength
			sub.Text = length > 0 and (Clock(position) .. " / " .. Clock(length)) or (sound.IsPlaying and "PLAYING" or "PAUSED")
		end

		function Lib.MiniRefresh()
			title.Text = cur and cur.name or "Nothing playing"
			local playing = sound.IsPlaying
			SetPlayIcon(playing)
			UpdateTime(true)
			local primary, secondary = Lib.Palette.Primary, Lib.Palette.Secondary
			for entry, row in pairs(miniRows) do
				local active = entry == cur
				local color = active and primary or secondary
				if row.name.TextColor3 ~= color then Lib.Tween(row.name, 0.2, Quad, Out, { TextColor3 = color }) end
				local want = (active and playing) and 0 or 1
				if row.mark.BackgroundTransparency ~= want then Lib.Tween(row.mark, 0.2, Quad, Out, { BackgroundTransparency = want }) end
			end
		end

		function Lib.MiniRebuild()
			for _, child in ipairs(listScroll:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("GuiObject") then child:Destroy() end
			end
			table.clear(miniRows)
			if #order == 0 then
				Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Playlist is empty", TextColor3 = Lib.Palette.Secondary,
					TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, ZIndex = 127, Parent = listScroll
				})
			else
				for i, entry in ipairs(order) do
					local row = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
						Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, ROW), BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.Primary, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false,
						LayoutOrder = i, ZIndex = 127, Parent = listScroll, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) })
					})
					local name = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
						Size = UDim2.new(1, -44, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = entry.name,
						TextColor3 = Lib.Palette.Secondary, TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
						TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 128, Parent = row
					})
					local mark = Lib.Create("Frame", {
						Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.Primary,
						BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 128, Parent = row, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
					})
					miniRows[entry] = { name = name, mark = mark }
					row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
						row.BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.Primary
						Lib.Tween(row, 0.15, Quad, Out, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.93 })
					end)
					row.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
						Lib.Tween(row, 0.2, Quad, Out, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
					end)
					row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
						Lib.PlayClick()
						if cur == entry then Toggle() else Play(entry) end
					end)
				end
			end
			if listOpen then Resize() end
			Lib.MiniRefresh()
		end

		local function Collapsed()
			return State.MiniPlayer and cur ~= nil and not State.Unloaded and (not UI.Main.Visible or State.MenuHiding or State.Minimized)
		end

		local function Sync()
			local want = Collapsed() and true or false
			if want == shown then return end
			shown = want
			fadeToken = fadeToken + 1
			local token = fadeToken
			if want then
				mini.Visible = true
				mini.Position = HIDDEN
				miniScale.Scale = 0.94
				UpdateTime(true)
				Lib.MiniOffset = targetHeight + 20
				TweenService:Create(mini, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Quint, Out, 0, false, 0.12), { GroupTransparency = 0, Position = SHOWN }):Play()
				TweenService:Create(miniScale, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Back, Out, 0, false, 0.12), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
			else
				Lib.MiniOffset = 0
				if listOpen then
					listOpen = false
					SetMenuIcon(false)
				end
				targetHeight = HEAD
				Lib.Tween(mini, 0.3, Quint, In, { GroupTransparency = 1, Position = HIDDEN })
				Lib.Tween(miniScale, 0.3, Quad, In, { Scale = 0.94 })
				task.delay(0.35, function()
					if fadeToken == token and not shown and mini.Parent then
						mini.Visible = false
						mini.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(WIDTH, HEAD)
					end
				end)
			end
		end
		Lib.MiniSync = Sync

		local function Grow(on)
			Lib.Tween(track, 0.2, Quad, Out, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, on and 4 or 2), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, on and -2 or -1) })
			Lib.Tween(knob, 0.25, Back, Out, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(on and 10 or 0, on and 10 or 0) })
		end

		local function SeekFrom(x)
			local length = sound.TimeLength
			if length <= 0 then return end
			local width = hit.AbsoluteSize.X
			local ratio = math.clamp((x - hit.AbsolutePosition.X) / (width > 0 and width or 1), 0, 1)
			sound.TimePosition = ratio * length
			fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(ratio, 1)
			UpdateTime(true)
		end

		hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			hovering = true
			Grow(true)
		end)
		hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			hovering = false
			if not seeking then Grow(false) end
		end)
		hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			local kind = input.UserInputType
			if kind == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or kind == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				seeking = true
				Grow(true)
				SeekFrom(input.Position.X)
			end
		end)
		Lib.C(UIS.InputChanged, function(input)
			if seeking and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
				SeekFrom(input.Position.X)
			end
		end)
		Lib.C(UIS.InputEnded, function(input)
			local kind = input.UserInputType
			if seeking and (kind == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or kind == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
				seeking = false
				if not hovering then Grow(false) end
			end
		end)

		playBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
			Lib.Tween(playScale, 0.08, Quad, Out, { Scale = 0.88 })
		end)
		playBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
			Lib.Tween(playScale, 0.35, Back, Out, { Scale = 1 })
		end)
		playBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			Lib.Tween(playScale, 0.2, Quad, Out, { Scale = 1 })
		end)
		playBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			Toggle()
		end)
		prevBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			if cur and sound.TimePosition > 3 then
				sound.TimePosition = 0
				UpdateTime(true)
			else
				Step(-1)
			end
		end)
		nextBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			Step(1)
		end)
		menuBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			if not listOpen then
				for i = 1, 3 do Lib.Tween(lines[i], 0.15, Quad, Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.Primary }) end
			end
		end)
		menuBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			if not listOpen then
				for i = 1, 3 do Lib.Tween(lines[i], 0.2, Quad, Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Palette.Secondary }) end
			end
		end)
		menuBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			listOpen = not listOpen
			SetMenuIcon(listOpen)
			Resize()
		end)

		local accumulator = 0
		Lib.C(Run.RenderStepped, function(dt)
			if State.Unloaded then return end
			accumulator = accumulator + dt
			if accumulator < 0.04 then return end
			accumulator = 0
			Sync()
			if not shown then return end
			if sound.IsPlaying then
				if State.MusicRanges then
					Advance(specMini, sound.PlaybackLoudness, 0.04)
					local values = specMini.values
					for i = 1, EQ do
						eq[i].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3 + values[i] * 22)
					end
				else
					local base = math.clamp(sound.PlaybackLoudness / 450, 0.1, 1)
					local phase = os.clock() * 7
					for i = 1, EQ do
						eq[i].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3 + base * 22 * (0.55 + 0.45 * math.sin(phase + i * 1.4)))
					end
				end
				eqIdle = false
			elseif not eqIdle then
				eqIdle = true
				ResetSpectrum(specMini)
				for i = 1, EQ do
					Lib.Tween(eq[i], 0.3, Quad, Out, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 4) })
				end
			end
			UpdateTime(false)
			if not seeking then
				local length = sound.TimeLength
				if length > 0 then fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(sound.TimePosition / length, 0, 1), 1) end
			end
		end)

		Paint()
		SetPlayIcon(false)
	end

	function Lib.StopMusic()
		token = token + 1
		Lib.MiniRefresh, Lib.MiniRebuild, Lib.MiniSync = nil, nil, nil
		Lib.MiniOffset = 0
		sounds[1]:Destroy()
		sounds[2]:Destroy()
		if Lib.MiniFrame then Lib.MiniFrame:Destroy() end
	end

	Rebuild()
end

function Lib.DeriveTheme(spec)
	local out = {}
	if typeof(spec) == "Color3" then
		local r, g, b = spec.R, spec.G, spec.B
		local light = r > 0.9 and g > 0.9 and b > 0.9
		local isDefaultBlack = math.floor(r * 255) == 18 and math.floor(g * 255) == 18 and math.floor(b * 255) == 18
		if isDefaultBlack then
			out.Main, out.Card, out.Item = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15), Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22)
		elseif light then
			out.Main, out.Card, out.Item = Color3.fromRGB(242, 242, 244), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(232, 234, 238)
		else
			local function Scale(k)
				return Color3.new(math.clamp(r * k, 0, 1), math.clamp(g * k, 0, 1), math.clamp(b * k, 0, 1))
			end
			if Lib.Luma(spec) > 0.65 then
				out.Main, out.Card, out.Item = Scale(0.92), Scale(0.98), Scale(0.85)
			else
				out.Main, out.Card, out.Item = Scale(0.45), Scale(0.65), Scale(0.85)
			end
		end
		out.Light = light
		out.Base = spec
		out.Primary = light and Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15) or Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245)
		out.Secondary = light and Color3.fromRGB(85, 85, 85) or Color3.fromRGB(145, 145, 145)
		out.SwitchOff = light and Color3.fromRGB(205, 205, 210) or Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 38)
		out.SwitchOn = light and Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20) or (isDefaultBlack and Color3.fromRGB(46, 213, 115) or spec)
		out.Halloween = false
	else
		out.Light = Lib.Luma(spec.Background) > 0.6
		out.Base = spec.Background
		out.Main, out.Card, out.Item = spec.Background, spec.Surface, spec.Item
		out.Primary, out.Secondary, out.SwitchOn, out.SwitchOff = spec.Text, spec.Muted, spec.Accent, spec.SwitchOff
		out.Halloween = spec.Halloween == true
	end
	return out
end

function Lib.BuildUIPreview(parent, scale, layoutOrder, options)
	options = options or {}
	local BASE_W, BASE_H = 800, 540
	local TABS = {
		{ id = "Home", icon = "rbxassetid://128407802503574" },
		{ id = "Features", icon = "rbxassetid://74917927400316" },
		{ id = "Scripts", icon = "rbxassetid://99356660335373" },
		{ id = "Emotes", icon = "rbxassetid://132655372254315" },
		{ id = "Settings", icon = "rbxassetid://112763474266331" }
	}
	local SUBS = {
		Home = { "Overview", "Account", "Update Log" },
		Features = { "Movement", "Visuals", "Combat" },
		Scripts = { "Browse", "Saved", "Recent" },
		Emotes = { "Emotes", "Saved", "Recent" },
		Settings = { "Appearance", "Config" }
	}
	local reg = { card = {}, item = {}, input = {}, primary = {}, secondary = {}, accent = {}, thumb = {}, button = {}, switch = {}, slider = {}, nav = {}, sub = {} }
	local preview, cur, active, pages = {}, nil, "Home", {}

	local function Add(kind, obj)
		local list = reg[kind]
		list[#list + 1] = obj
		return obj
	end

	local function Round(radius)
		return Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) })
	end

	local function Label(host, text, x, y, w, h, size, role, bold, align)
		return Add(role, Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = text,
			TextSize = size, Font = bold and Enum.Font.GothamBold or Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
			TextXAlignment = align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = host
		}))
	end

	local function Panel(host, kind, x, y, w, h, radius)
		return Add(kind, Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = host,
			Round(radius or 8)
		}))
	end

	local function Paint(rec, animate)
		if not cur then return end
		Lib.SetSwitch(rec.bg, rec.knob, rec.on, rec.on and cur.SwitchOn or cur.SwitchOff, animate)
	end

	local function MakeSwitch(host, x, y, on)
		local bg = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 22), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = host,
			Round(11)
		})
		local knob = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -8), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = bg, Round(8)
		})
		local rec = Add("switch", { bg = bg, knob = knob, on = on })
		Lib.BindSwitchPress(bg, knob)
		bg.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			rec.on = not rec.on
			Paint(rec, true)
		end)
	end

	local function MakeSlider(host, x, y, w, get)
		local track = Panel(host, "item", x, y, w, 6, 3)
		local fill = Add("accent", Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = track, Round(3) }))
		local knob = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2, Parent = track, Round(7)
		})
		Add("slider", { fill = fill, knob = knob, get = get })
	end

	local stage = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Name = "UIPreviewStage",
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BASE_W * scale, BASE_H * scale),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		LayoutOrder = layoutOrder or 0,
		Parent = parent,
		Round(10),
		Lib.Create("UIGradient", { Rotation = 35, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(82, 88, 118), Color3.fromRGB(24, 25, 34)) })
	})

	for _, blob in ipairs({
		{ 0.1, 0.18, 0.32, Color3.fromRGB(90, 120, 255) },
		{ 0.88, 0.82, 0.4, Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 150) },
		{ 0.62, 0.1, 0.2, Color3.fromRGB(70, 220, 190) }
	}) do
		local size = BASE_W * scale * blob[3]
		Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(blob[1], blob[2]),
			BackgroundColor3 = blob[4], BackgroundTransparency = 0.45, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = stage, Round(size)
		})
	end

	local winCorner = Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, State.CornerRadius) })
	local win = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Name = "PreviewWindow",
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BASE_W, BASE_H),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		ZIndex = 2,
		Parent = stage,
		winCorner,
		Lib.Create("UIScale", { Scale = scale })
	})

	local bgc = Lib.Create("CanvasGroup", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 0, Parent = win })
	local bgCorner = Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, State.CornerRadius), Parent = bgc })
	local bgImage = Lib.Create("ImageLabel", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, Visible = false, ZIndex = 0, Parent = bgc
	})
	local gradLayer = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 1, Parent = bgc
	})
	local gradient = Lib.Create("UIGradient", {
		Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.45) }),
		Parent = gradLayer
	})
	local fxLayer = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = 2, Parent = bgc
	})

	local headerIcon = Lib.Create("ImageLabel", {
