}

State.NavAlign = "Center"
Lib.Stats = { FPS = 0, Ping = 0, Players = 0 }
Lib.StatsTick = {}

function Lib.NavPosition(y, align)
	if State.NavStyle == "Icon Rail" then
		return UDim2.fromOffset(y < 0 and -(Lib.NavRailWidth + 8) or 0, 58)
	end
	align = align or State.NavAlign
	if align == "Left" then
		return UDim2.new(0, math.min(372, State.OriginalSize.X.Offset - 270), 0, y)
	elseif align == "Right" then
		return UDim2.new(1, -258, 0, y)
	end
	return UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, y)
end

function Lib.ApplyLayout(width, height, align)
	local scale = Lib.MenuBaseScale or 1
	local view = UI.Screen.AbsoluteSize
	width = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(width) or State.OriginalSize.X.Offset), 560, math.max(560, math.min(1500, view.X / scale - 20)))
	height = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(height) or State.OriginalSize.Y.Offset), 380, math.max(380, math.min(950, view.Y / scale - 20)))
	State.NavAlign = (align == "Left" or align == "Right") and align or "Center"
	State.OriginalSize = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
	UI.Main.Size, UI.Main.Position = Lib.MainLayout()
	UI.TopNavContainer.Position = Lib.NavPosition(State.Minimized and -44 or 11)
end

local function BuildScrollView(view, top)
	local scroll = Lib.Create("ScrollingFrame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -top), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, top), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ScrollBarThickness = 2,
		ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = view
	})
	local layout = Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 16), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = scroll })
	Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 5), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 15), Parent = scroll })
	layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
		scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 20)
	end)
	return scroll
end

function Lib.BuildBindManager(view)
	local UIS = Services.UserInputService
	local Http = Services.HttpService
	local FILE, LEGACY = "SeptusHub_Binds.json", "SeptusHub_Keybinds.json"
	local binds, tiles, held, entries, actionById = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
	local capturing, notifyOn = nil, true

	local function Resolve(kind, name)
		local ok, value = pcall(function()
			return (kind == "Mouse" and Enum.UserInputType or Enum.KeyCode)[name]
		end)
		return ok and value or nil
	end

	local function InputName(input)
		if input == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then return "RMB" end
		if input == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 then return "MMB" end
		return (input.Name:gsub("^Left(%u)", "L%1"):gsub("^Right(%u)", "R%1"))
	end

	local function Save()
		if not writefile then return end
		local out = { Notify = notifyOn, Binds = {} }
		for id, bind in pairs(binds) do
			out.Binds[id] = { Input = bind.Input.Name, Kind = bind.Kind, Mode = bind.Mode }
		end
		pcall(writefile, FILE, Http:JSONEncode(out))
	end

	if isfile and readfile then
		pcall(function()
			if isfile(FILE) then
				local data = Http:JSONDecode(readfile(FILE))
				if type(data.Notify) == "boolean" then notifyOn = data.Notify end
				for id, entry in pairs(data.Binds or {}) do
					local input = Resolve(entry.Kind, entry.Input)
					if input then binds[id] = { Input = input, Kind = entry.Kind, Mode = entry.Mode == "Hold" and "Hold" or "Toggle" } end
				end
			elseif isfile(LEGACY) then
				for id, name in pairs(Http:JSONDecode(readfile(LEGACY))) do
					local key = Resolve("Key", name)
					if key then binds[id] = { Input = key, Kind = "Key", Mode = "Toggle" } end
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	function Lib.GetBindName(id)
		local bind = binds[id]
		return bind and InputName(bind.Input) or nil
	end

	local CAT_LIST = { "Actions", "Visuals", "Movement", "Combat", "Protect", "Shaders", "Funny", "Misc", "Server", "Teleport", "QoL" }
	local CAT_ORDER = {}
	for i, name in ipairs(CAT_LIST) do CAT_ORDER[name] = i end
	CAT_ORDER.Other = #CAT_LIST + 1

	local function CategoryOf(title)
		local control = Lib.ToggleControls[title]
		local node = control and control.Item
		while node do
			if CAT_ORDER[node.Name] and node:IsA("CanvasGroup") then return node.Name end
			node = node.Parent
		end
		return "Other"
	end

	for index, action in ipairs(Lib.BindActions or {}) do
		actionById[action.id] = action
		if not Lib.ToggleControls[action.id] then
			entries[#entries + 1] = { id = action.id, title = action.title, cat = "Actions", order = index }
		end
	end
	for _, title in ipairs(Lib.FeatureToggles) do
		if Lib.ToggleControls[title] then
			entries[#entries + 1] = { id = title, title = title, cat = CategoryOf(title), toggle = true, order = 0 }
		end
	end
	table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
		local ca, cb = CAT_ORDER[a.cat], CAT_ORDER[b.cat]
		if ca ~= cb then return ca < cb end
		if ca == 1 then return a.order < b.order end
		return a.title < b.title
	end)
	local present = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
		entry.search = Lib.Lower(entry.title) .. "|" .. Lib.Lower(Lib.Ru(entry.title))
		present[entry.cat] = true
	end

	local HINT_IDLE = "Click a key to rebind it"
	local HINT_REC = "Press a key or mouse button  \u{2022}  Esc cancels  \u{2022}  Backspace clears"
	local CONFLICT = Color3.fromRGB(230, 70, 70)
	local TweenService = Services.Tween
	local PULSE = TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true)
	local PRESS = TweenInfo.new(0.07, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local SPRING = TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local HOVER = TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local FLASH = TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local REST, DOWN = UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3)
	local filter, query = "All", ""
	local dupCount, conflictTotal = {}, 0
	local recTweens, chips = {}, {}
	local Apply

	local function Report(id, state)
		if notifyOn then Lib.Notify({ Title = id, Text = state and "Enabled" or "Disabled" }) end
		if Lib.HudRefresh then Lib.HudRefresh() end
	end

	local function Fire(id, bind, down)
		local control = Lib.ToggleControls[id]
		if control then
			if bind.Mode == "Hold" then
				if control.Get() ~= down then
					control.Set(down)
					Report(id, down)
				end
			elseif down then
				control.Set(not control.Get())
				Report(id, control.Get())
			end
		elseif down and actionById[id] then
			actionById[id].run()
		end
	end

	local search = Lib.MakeSearchBox(view, "Search binds...", UDim2.fromOffset(5, 0), UDim2.new(1, -15, 0, 30), 0.15, function(text)
		query = Lib.Lower(text)
		Apply()
	end)

	local scroll = BuildScrollView(view, 40)

	local settingsGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(scroll, "Bind Settings", 1)
	Lib.CreateSettingToggleItem(settingsGroup, "Bind Notifications", "Show a notification when a bind turns a feature on or off", notifyOn, function(value)
		notifyOn = value
		Save()
	end, true)

	local filterFrame = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = scroll,
		Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
	})
	local chipRow = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = filterFrame,
		Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Wraps = true, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
	})
	local hint = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), LayoutOrder = 2, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = HINT_IDLE, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130),
		TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = filterFrame
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(hint, "Secondary")

	local keysGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(scroll, "Keys", 3)
	local grid = Lib.Create("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(110, 64), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
	local holder = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = keysGroup,
		Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10) }),
		grid
	})
	local empty = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), LayoutOrder = 2, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "No matching keys", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130),
		TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Visible = false, Parent = keysGroup
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(empty, "Secondary")

	local recStroke = Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Thickness = 2, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })

	local function Move(tile, position, info)
		TweenService:Create(tile.face, info, { Position = position }):Play()
	end

	local function IsConflict(id)
		local bind = binds[id]
		return bind ~= nil and (dupCount[bind.Input] or 0) > 1
	end

	local function FaceColor(tile)
		local face = Lib.Theme.Item
		if not tile.hover then return face end
		return State.LightTheme and face:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.06) or Lib.Lighten(face, 0.06)
	end

	local function Style(tile)
		local id = tile.entry.id
		local bind = binds[id]
		local conflict = IsConflict(id)
		local lip = Lib.Theme.Base:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), State.LightTheme and 0.18 or 0.5)
		if conflict then
			lip = CONFLICT:Lerp(lip, 0.25)
		elseif bind then
			lip = Lib.Palette.SwitchOn:Lerp(lip, 0.45)
		end
		tile.lip.BackgroundColor3 = lip
		tile.face.BackgroundColor3 = FaceColor(tile)
		local text = bind and InputName(bind.Input) or "None"
		tile.key.Text = text
		tile.key.TextSize = not bind and 13 or (#text <= 1 and 22 or (#text <= 3 and 17 or 13))
		tile.key.TextColor3 = conflict and CONFLICT or (bind and Lib.Palette.Primary or Lib.Palette.Secondary)
		tile.name.TextColor3 = Lib.Palette.Secondary
		tile.mark.Visible = conflict
		local showMode = bind ~= nil and tile.entry.toggle == true
		tile.badge.Visible = showMode
		if showMode then
			tile.badge.Text = bind.Mode == "Hold" and "HOLD" or "TOG"
			tile.badge.BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Theme.Base
			tile.badge.TextColor3 = Lib.Palette.Secondary
		end
	end

	local function StyleChips()
		for name, chip in pairs(chips) do
			local active = name == filter
			chip.BackgroundColor3 = active and Lib.Palette.Primary or Lib.Theme.Item
			chip.TextColor3 = active and Lib.Theme.Base or ((name == "Conflicts" and conflictTotal > 0) and CONFLICT or Lib.Palette.Primary)
		end
	end

	function Apply()
		local shown = 0
		for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
			local visible = query == "" or entry.search:find(query, 1, true) ~= nil
			if visible and filter ~= "All" then
				if filter == "Bound" then
					visible = binds[entry.id] ~= nil
				elseif filter == "Conflicts" then
					visible = IsConflict(entry.id)
				else
					visible = entry.cat == filter
				end
			end
			tiles[entry.id].frame.Visible = visible
			if visible then shown = shown + 1 end
		end
		empty.Visible = shown == 0
	end

	local function RefreshAll()
		table.clear(dupCount)
		for _, bind in pairs(binds) do dupCount[bind.Input] = (dupCount[bind.Input] or 0) + 1 end
		conflictTotal = 0
		for _, count in pairs(dupCount) do
			if count > 1 then conflictTotal = conflictTotal + count end
		end
		for id, tile in pairs(tiles) do
			if id ~= capturing then Style(tile) end
		end
		StyleChips()
		Apply()
	end

	local function EndCapture()
		local id = capturing
		capturing = nil
		for i = #recTweens, 1, -1 do
			recTweens[i]:Cancel()
			recTweens[i] = nil
		end
		recStroke.Parent = nil
		hint.Text = HINT_IDLE
		local tile = id and tiles[id]
		if tile then
			tile.key.TextTransparency = 0
			Style(tile)
			Move(tile, REST, SPRING)
		end
	end

	local function ToggleCapture(id)
		local previous = capturing
		if previous then EndCapture() end
		if previous == id then return end
		capturing = id
		local tile = tiles[id]
		tile.key.Text = "..."
		tile.key.TextSize = 22
		tile.key.TextColor3 = Lib.Palette.Primary
		tile.mark.Visible = false
		hint.Text = HINT_REC
		recStroke.Color = Lib.Palette.Primary
		recStroke.Transparency = 0
		recStroke.Parent = tile.face
		Move(tile, DOWN, PRESS)
		recTweens[1] = TweenService:Create(recStroke, PULSE, { Transparency = 0.8 })
		recTweens[2] = TweenService:Create(tile.key, PULSE, { TextTransparency = 0.7 })
		recTweens[1]:Play()
		recTweens[2]:Play()
	end

	local function Bounce(tile)
		local target = tile.lip.BackgroundColor3
		tile.lip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		TweenService:Create(tile.lip, FLASH, { BackgroundColor3 = target }):Play()
		tile.face.Position = DOWN
		Move(tile, REST, SPRING)
	end

	local function Collide(id)
		local key = binds[id].Input
		local first
		for otherId, other in pairs(binds) do
			if other.Input == key and otherId ~= id then
				local tile = tiles[otherId]
				first = first or tile.entry.title
				tile.face.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-4, 0)
				Move(tile, REST, SPRING)
			end
		end
		tiles[id].face.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 0)
		Move(tiles[id], REST, SPRING)
		Lib.Notify({ Title = "Bind conflict", Text = InputName(key) .. " is also used by " .. (first or "?") })
	end

	local function BuildTile(entry, order)
		local frame = Lib.Create("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order, Parent = holder })
		local lip = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = frame, Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9) })
		})
		local face = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -4), BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = frame,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9) })
		})
		local keyLabel = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 26), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 9), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", TextSize = 20,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = face
		})
		local nameLabel = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 1, -20), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = entry.title, TextSize = 10,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = face
		})
		local badge = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 15), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0, 5), Text = "TOG", TextSize = 9,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 2, Parent = face,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5) })
		})
		local mark = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 15), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "!", TextColor3 = CONFLICT,
			TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Visible = false, Parent = face
		})
		local tile = { entry = entry, frame = frame, lip = lip, face = face, key = keyLabel, name = nameLabel, badge = badge, mark = mark, hover = false }
		tiles[entry.id] = tile

		face.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			tile.hover = true
			if capturing ~= entry.id then TweenService:Create(face, HOVER, { BackgroundColor3 = FaceColor(tile) }):Play() end
		end)
		face.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			tile.hover = false
			if capturing ~= entry.id then
				TweenService:Create(face, HOVER, { BackgroundColor3 = FaceColor(tile) }):Play()
				Move(tile, REST, SPRING)
			end
		end)
		face.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
			if capturing ~= entry.id then Move(tile, DOWN, PRESS) end
		end)
		face.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
			if capturing ~= entry.id then Move(tile, REST, SPRING) end
		end)
		face.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			ToggleCapture(entry.id)
		end)
		badge.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			local bind = binds[entry.id]
			if not bind then return end
			Lib.PlayClick()
			bind.Mode = bind.Mode == "Hold" and "Toggle" or "Hold"
			Style(tile)
			Save()
		end)
	end

	for index, entry in ipairs(entries) do BuildTile(entry, index) end

	local function AddChip(name, order)
		local chip = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 26), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, LayoutOrder = order, Text = name, TextSize = 12,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = chipRow,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
			Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12) })
		})
		chips[name] = chip
		chip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Lib.PlayClick()
			filter = name
			StyleChips()
			Apply()
		end)
	end
	AddChip("All", 1)
	AddChip("Bound", 2)
	AddChip("Conflicts", 3)
	for i, name in ipairs(CAT_LIST) do
		if present[name] then AddChip(name, 3 + i) end
	end
	if present.Other then AddChip("Other", 3 + #CAT_LIST + 1) end

	local function Resize()
		local width = holder.AbsoluteSize.X - 20
		if width < 120 then return end
		local cols = math.clamp(math.floor((width + 8) / 118), 2, 8)
		local cell = math.floor((width - (cols - 1) * 8) / cols)
		if grid.CellSize.X.Offset ~= cell then grid.CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(cell, 64) end
	end
	holder:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(Resize)
	Resize()

	table.insert(Lib.ThemeHooks, function()
		for id, tile in pairs(tiles) do
			if id ~= capturing then Style(tile) end
		end
		StyleChips()
	end)
	RefreshAll()

	Lib.C(UIS.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
		local kind = input.UserInputType
		local key
		if kind == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			key = input.KeyCode
		elseif kind == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 or kind == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 then
			key = kind
		end
		if not key or key == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return end
		if capturing then
			local id = capturing
			EndCapture()
			if key == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then return end
			if key == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace or key == Enum.KeyCode.Delete then
				binds[id] = nil
			else
				local previous = binds[id]
				binds[id] = {
					Input = key, Kind = key.EnumType == Enum.KeyCode and "Key" or "Mouse", Mode = previous and previous.Mode or "Toggle"
				}
			end
			Save()
			RefreshAll()
			local tile = tiles[id]
			if tile then Bounce(tile) end
			if binds[id] and IsConflict(id) then Collide(id) end
			if Lib.HudRefresh then Lib.HudRefresh() end
			return
		end
		if processed or State.Unloaded then return end
		for id, bind in pairs(binds) do
			if bind.Input == key then
				if bind.Mode == "Hold" then held[id] = key end
				Fire(id, bind, true)
			end
		end
	end)

	Lib.C(UIS.InputEnded, function(input)
		if next(held) == nil then return end
		local key = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and input.KeyCode or input.UserInputType
		for id, heldKey in pairs(held) do
			if heldKey == key then
				held[id] = nil
				local bind = binds[id]
				if bind then Fire(id, bind, false) end
			end
		end
	end)

	return search
end

function Lib.BuildHUD(view)
	local cfg = { Enabled = false, FPS = true, Ping = true, Players = false, Time = false, Features = true, Binds = true, Style = "Classic", Position = "Bottom Left", Scale = 100, Opacity = 85 }

	local hud = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Name = "SeptusHUD", AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Theme.Card,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.15, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 5, Parent = UI.Screen,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }),
		Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 3), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
		Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12) })
	})
	local scaleObject = Lib.Create("UIScale", { Parent = hud })
	table.insert(Lib.ThemeHooks, function() hud.BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Theme.Card end)

	local labels = {}
	local function MakeLabel(name, order, role, size, font)
		local label = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Name = name, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "",
			TextColor3 = Lib.Palette[role], TextSize = size, Font = font, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = 5, Parent = hud
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(label, role)
		labels[name] = label
		return label
	end
	MakeLabel("FPS", 1, "Primary", 13, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
	MakeLabel("Ping", 2, "Primary", 13, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
	MakeLabel("Players", 3, "Primary", 13, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
	MakeLabel("Time", 4, "Primary", 13, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
	MakeLabel("Features", 5, "Secondary", 12, Enum.Font.GothamMedium)

	local MUTED = "#8E8E93"
	local GOOD, MID, BAD = Color3.fromRGB(52, 199, 89), Color3.fromRGB(255, 184, 77), Color3.fromRGB(235, 87, 87)
	local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
	local Quint, Quad, Back, Out = Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out

	local island = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
		Name = "SeptusHUDIsland", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(96, 32), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
		BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ClipsDescendants = true, Visible = false, ZIndex = 5, Parent = UI.Screen,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16) }),
		Lib.Create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(46, 46, 52), Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
	})
	local islandScale = Lib.Create("UIScale", { Parent = island })
	local islandDot = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 12), BackgroundColor3 = GOOD, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 6, Parent = island,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
	})
	local islandStats = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 32), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, RichText = true, Text = "",
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 6, Parent = island
	})
	local islandList = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, -44), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 40), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200),
		TextTransparency = 1, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, ZIndex = 6, Parent = island
	})
	local hover, peek, expanded, peekToken, lastW, lastH, lastSig, lastDot = false, false, false, 0, nil, nil, nil, nil

	local function Place()
		local top = cfg.Position:find("Top", 1, true) ~= nil
		local right = cfg.Position:find("Right", 1, true) ~= nil
		local anchor = Vector2.new(right and 1 or 0, top and 0 or 1)
		local position = UDim2.new(right and 1 or 0, right and -12 or 12, top and 0 or 1, top and 64 or -12)
		hud.AnchorPoint, hud.Position = anchor, position
		if island.Visible then
			Lib.Tween(island, 0.5, Quint, Out, { Position = position, AnchorPoint = anchor })
		else
			island.AnchorPoint, island.Position = anchor, position
		end
		local scale, alpha = cfg.Scale / 100, 1 - cfg.Opacity / 100
		scaleObject.Scale = scale
		islandScale.Scale = scale
		hud.BackgroundTransparency = alpha
		island.BackgroundTransparency = alpha
	end

	local function Peek()
		peekToken = peekToken + 1
		local token = peekToken
		peek = true
		task.delay(2.4, function()
			if token == peekToken then
				peek = false
				if Lib.HudRefresh then Lib.HudRefresh() end
			end
		end)
	end

	local function FitIsland(plain, lines, instant)
		local statsWidth = TextService:GetTextSize(plain, 12, Enum.Font.GothamBold, Vector2.new(800, 32)).X
		local width, height = statsWidth + 42, 32
		local expand = (hover or peek) and #lines > 0
		if expand then
			local widest = 0
			for i = 1, #lines do
				widest = math.max(widest, TextService:GetTextSize(lines[i], 12, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Vector2.new(800, 20)).X)
			end
			width = math.max(width, widest + 30)
			height = 46 + #lines * 15 + 6
		end
		width = math.max(width, 84)
		if expand ~= expanded then
			expanded = expand
			Lib.Tween(islandList, expand and 0.35 or 0.15, Quad, Out, { TextTransparency = expand and 0 or 1 })
		end
		if instant then
			island.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
		elseif width ~= lastW or height ~= lastH then
			Lib.Tween(island, expand and 0.5 or 0.38, expand and Back or Quint, Out, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height) })
		end
		lastW, lastH = width, height
	end

	local function Refresh()
		local show = cfg.Enabled and not State.Unloaded
		local useIsland = cfg.Style == "Dynamic Island"
		hud.Visible = show and not useIsland
		if not show then
			island.Visible = false
			return
		end
		local stats = Lib.Stats
		local lines = {}
		if cfg.Features then
			for _, title in ipairs(Lib.FeatureToggles) do
				local control = Lib.ToggleControls[title]
				if control and control.Get() then
					local bind = cfg.Binds and Lib.GetBindName and Lib.GetBindName(title)
					lines[#lines + 1] = Lib.Tr(title) .. (bind and ("  [" .. bind .. "]") or "")
				end
			end
		end

		if not useIsland then
			island.Visible = false
			labels.FPS.Visible = cfg.FPS
			labels.FPS.Text = Lib.Tr("FPS") .. "  " .. stats.FPS
			labels.Ping.Visible = cfg.Ping
			labels.Ping.Text = Lib.Tr("Ping") .. "  " .. stats.Ping .. " " .. Lib.Tr("ms")
			labels.Players.Visible = cfg.Players
			labels.Players.Text = Lib.Tr("Players") .. "  " .. stats.Players
			labels.Time.Visible = cfg.Time
			labels.Time.Text = os.date("%H:%M:%S")
			labels.Features.Visible = #lines > 0
			labels.Features.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
			return
		end

		local appear = not island.Visible
		island.Visible = true
		local rich, plain = {}, {}
		local function Add(name, value)
			rich[#rich + 1] = name == "" and value or string.format('<font color="%s">%s</font> %s', MUTED, name, value)
			plain[#plain + 1] = name == "" and value or (name .. " " .. value)
		end
		if cfg.FPS then Add(Lib.Tr("FPS"), tostring(stats.FPS)) end
		if cfg.Ping then Add(Lib.Tr("Ping"), stats.Ping .. Lib.Tr("ms")) end
		if cfg.Players then Add(Lib.Tr("Players"), tostring(stats.Players)) end
		if cfg.Time then Add("", os.date("%H:%M")) end
		if #rich == 0 then Add("", "Septus") end
		islandStats.Text = table.concat(rich, "  ·  ")

		local fps = stats.FPS
		local dot = (fps == 0 or fps >= 45) and GOOD or fps >= 25 and MID or BAD
		if dot ~= lastDot then
			lastDot = dot
			Lib.Tween(islandDot, 0.4, Quad, Out, { BackgroundColor3 = dot })
		end

		local signature = table.concat(lines, "\n")
		islandList.Text = signature
		if lastSig ~= nil and signature ~= lastSig and #lines > 0 and not appear then Peek() end
		lastSig = signature

		if appear then
			islandScale.Scale = cfg.Scale / 100 * 0.7
			Lib.Tween(islandScale, 0.5, Back, Out, { Scale = cfg.Scale / 100 })
		end
		FitIsland(table.concat(plain, "  ·  "), lines, appear)
	end

	island.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		hover = true
		Refresh()
	end)
	island.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		hover = false
		Refresh()
	end)
	island.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
		Lib.Tween(islandScale, 0.1, Quad, Out, { Scale = cfg.Scale / 100 * 0.95 })
	end)
	island.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
		Lib.Tween(islandScale, 0.35, Back, Out, { Scale = cfg.Scale / 100 })
	end)
	island.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Peek()
		Refresh()
	end)

	Lib.HudRefresh = Refresh
	Lib.StatsTick[#Lib.StatsTick + 1] = Refresh

	local scroll = BuildScrollView(view, 0)
	local mainGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(scroll, "HUD", 1)
	Lib.SearchGroups[mainGroup] = true
	Lib.CreateSettingToggleItem(mainGroup, "Enable HUD", "Shows a compact overlay with live information on your screen", cfg.Enabled, function(value)
		cfg.Enabled = value
		Refresh()
	end)
	Lib.CreateSettingChoiceItem(mainGroup, "HUD Style", { "Classic", "Dynamic Island" }, cfg.Style, function(value)
		cfg.Style = value
		Place()
		Refresh()
	end)
	Lib.CreateSettingChoiceItem(mainGroup, "HUD Position", { "Top Left", "Top Right", "Bottom Left", "Bottom Right" }, cfg.Position, function(value)
		cfg.Position = value
		Place()
	end)
	Lib.CreateSettingSliderItem(mainGroup, "HUD Scale", "Size of the overlay", 70, 150, cfg.Scale, function(value)
		cfg.Scale = value
		Place()
	end, false, "%")
	Lib.CreateSettingSliderItem(mainGroup, "HUD Opacity", "How solid the overlay background is", 20, 100, cfg.Opacity, function(value)
		cfg.Opacity = value
		Place()
	end, true, "%")

	local infoGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(scroll, "HUD Information", 2)
	Lib.SearchGroups[infoGroup] = true
	local function InfoToggle(title, desc, key, last)
		Lib.CreateSettingToggleItem(infoGroup, title, desc, cfg[key], function(value)
			cfg[key] = value
			Refresh()
		end, last)
	end
	InfoToggle("HUD FPS", "Frames per second", "FPS")
	InfoToggle("HUD Ping", "Network latency to the server", "Ping")
	InfoToggle("HUD Players", "Players in the current server", "Players")
	InfoToggle("HUD Clock", "Your local time", "Time")
	InfoToggle("HUD Active Features", "Lists every feature that is currently enabled", "Features")
	InfoToggle("HUD Show Binds", "Shows the bound key next to each active feature", "Binds", true)

	Lib.ConfigExtras.HUD = {
		Dump = function()
			local out = {}
			for key, value in pairs(cfg) do out[key] = value end
			return out
		end,
		Apply = function(data)
			pcall(function()
				local toggles = { Enabled = "Enable HUD", FPS = "HUD FPS", Ping = "HUD Ping", Players = "HUD Players", Time = "HUD Clock", Features = "HUD Active Features", Binds = "HUD Show Binds" }
				for key, title in pairs(toggles) do
					if type(data[key]) == "boolean" then Lib.ToggleControls[title].Set(data[key]) end
				end
				if type(data.Style) == "string" then Lib.ChoiceControls["HUD Style"].Set(data.Style) end
				if type(data.Position) == "string" then Lib.ChoiceControls["HUD Position"].Set(data.Position) end
				if type(data.Scale) == "number" then Lib.SliderControls["HUD Scale"](data.Scale) end
				if type(data.Opacity) == "number" then Lib.SliderControls["HUD Opacity"](data.Opacity) end
			end)
		end
	}

	Place()
end

function Lib.BuildShareGroup(scroll, order, getDump, applyDump)
	local group = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(scroll, "Share", order)

	local function Deliver(code, label)
		local copied = Lib.CopyText(code)
		Lib.Notify({ Title = "Share", Text = copied and (label .. " code copied") or "Clipboard unavailable, copy the code from the field" })
	end

	local row = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = group })
	local box = Lib.Create("TextBox", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -118, 0, 34), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), Text = "",
		PlaceholderText = "Paste a share code...", PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240),
		TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, ClearTextOnFocus = false, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = row,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }),
		Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10) })
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeElement(box, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7)
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(box, "Primary")
	local import = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(94, 34), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 12), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		Text = "Import", TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = row,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) })
	})
	import.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Lib.PlayClick()
		local kind, data = Lib.ShareDecode(box.Text)
		if not kind then
			Lib.Notify({ Title = "Share", Text = data })
			return
		end
		if kind ~= "CFG" then
			Lib.Notify({ Title = "Share", Text = "This is a UI Studio preset code, import it in UI Studio" })
			return
		end
		for _, key in ipairs({ "CustomBg", "FontId" }) do
			if type(data[key]) == "string" and data[key]:find("://", 1, true) then data[key] = nil end
		end
		data.PlaceId, data.PlaceName = nil, nil
		applyDump(data)
		box.Text = ""
		Lib.Notify({ Title = "Share", Text = "Settings imported" })
	end)

	Lib.CreateSettingButtonItem(group, "Export Current Settings", "Creates a code with your current settings that you can send to anyone", function()
		local code = Lib.ShareEncode("CFG", getDump())
		box.Text = code
		Deliver(code, "Settings")
	end, true)
end

function Lib.BuildLanguageGroup(parent, order)
	local group = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(parent, "Language", order)
	Lib.SearchGroups[group] = true
	Lib.CreateSettingChoiceItem(group, "Interface Language", { "English", "Русский" }, State.Language, function(value)
		if value ~= State.Language then Lib.SetLanguage(value) end
	end, true)
end

Lib.ConfigExtras.Layout = {
	Dump = function()
		return { Width = State.OriginalSize.X.Offset, Height = State.OriginalSize.Y.Offset, Nav = State.NavAlign }
	end,
	Apply = function(data)
		pcall(Lib.ApplyLayout, data.Width, data.Height, data.Nav)
	end
}


function Lib.BuildAppearanceTabs(view)
	local NAMES = { "Theme", "Window", "Background", "Notifications", "Language", "Interface" }
	local COUNT, TOP = #NAMES, 44
	local Quad, Quint = Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint
	local Out, In = Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingDirection.In
	local SHOW = TweenInfo.new(0.36, Quint, Out, 0, false, 0.05)
	local HIDE = TweenInfo.new(0.14, Quad, In)
	local REST = UDim2.fromOffset(0, TOP)
	local pages, scrolls, buttons, order, running = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
	local current = NAMES[1]

	local bar = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 34), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 3), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15), Parent = view,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9) })
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeElement(bar, "BackgroundColor3", 0.5)

	local track = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, -6), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = bar })

	local thumb = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 / COUNT, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 34, 34), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = track,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7) })
	})

	local function ThumbColor()
		return State.LightTheme and Lib.Theme.Item or Lib.Lighten(Lib.Theme.Item, 0.08)
	end
	thumb.BackgroundColor3 = ThumbColor()
	table.insert(Lib.ThemeHooks, function()
		Lib.Tween(thumb, 0.25, Quad, Out, { BackgroundColor3 = ThumbColor() })
	end)

	local function Play(page, info, goal)
		local old = running[page]
		if old then old:Cancel() end
		local tween = Services.Tween:Create(page, info, goal)
		running[page] = tween
		tween:Play()
		return tween
	end

	local function Switch(name)
		if name == current or not order[name] then return end
		local direction = order[name] >= order[current] and 1 or -1
		current = name
		Lib.Tween(thumb, 0.34, Quint, Out, { Position = UDim2.fromScale((order[name] - 1) / COUNT, 0) })
		for key, page in pairs(pages) do
			local selected = key == name
			local button = buttons[key]
			UI.TextThemeElements[button] = selected and "Primary" or "Secondary"
			Lib.Tween(button, 0.2, Quad, Out, { TextColor3 = selected and Lib.Palette.Primary or Lib.Palette.Secondary })
			if selected then
				local fresh = not page.Visible or page.GroupTransparency > 0.98
				if fresh then
					page.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, TOP + 14 * direction)
					page.GroupTransparency = 1
				end
				page.Visible = true
				Play(page, SHOW, { Position = REST, GroupTransparency = 0 })
				if fresh then Lib.Cascade(page) end
			elseif page.Visible then
				Play(page, HIDE, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, TOP - 10 * direction), GroupTransparency = 1 }).Completed:Connect(function(state)
					if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and current ~= key then page.Visible = false end
				end)
			end
		end
	end

	for index, name in ipairs(NAMES) do
		order[name] = index
		local selected = index == 1

		local button = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 / COUNT, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale((index - 1) / COUNT, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = name,
			TextColor3 = selected and Lib.Palette.Primary or Lib.Palette.Secondary, TextSize = 12, TextScaled = true, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 2, Parent = track,
			Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 9), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 9) }),
			Lib.Create("UITextSizeConstraint", { MaxTextSize = 12, MinTextSize = 7 })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(button, selected and "Primary" or "Secondary")
		buttons[name] = button

		button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			if current ~= name then Lib.Tween(button, 0.15, Quad, Out, { TextColor3 = Lib.Palette.Primary }) end
		end)
		button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			if current ~= name then Lib.Tween(button, 0.15, Quad, Out, { TextColor3 = Lib.Palette.Secondary }) end
		end)
		button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if current ~= name then Lib.PlayClick() end
			Switch(name)
		end)

		local page = Lib.Create("CanvasGroup", {
			Name = name, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -TOP), Position = REST, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Visible = selected, GroupTransparency = selected and 0 or 1, Parent = view
		})
		pages[name] = page

		scrolls[name] = Lib.Create("ScrollingFrame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 2,
			ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100), ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
			CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = page,
			Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 16), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
			Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 5), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 15) })
		})
	end

	Lib.SwitchAppearancePage = Switch
	return scrolls
end

	local THEMES_FILE = "SeptusHub_Themes.json"
	local THEME_KEYS = { "Background", "Surface", "Text", "Accent", "Item", "Muted", "SwitchOff" }

	local function SaveCustomThemes()
		if not writefile then return end
		local out = {}
		for i, theme in ipairs(State.CustomThemes) do
			local entry = { Name = theme.Name }
			for _, key in ipairs(THEME_KEYS) do
				entry[key] = theme[key]:ToHex()
			end
			out[i] = entry
		end
		pcall(writefile, THEMES_FILE, Services.HttpService:JSONEncode(out))
	end

	local function LoadCustomThemes()
		if not (isfile and readfile) then return end
		pcall(function()
			if not isfile(THEMES_FILE) then return end
			for _, entry in ipairs(Services.HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(THEMES_FILE))) do
				local theme = { Name = tostring(entry.Name or "Custom") }
				for _, key in ipairs(THEME_KEYS) do
					theme[key] = Color3.fromHex(entry[key])
				end
				table.insert(State.CustomThemes, theme)
			end
		end)
	end

	local function BindDrag(area, onMove)
		area.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			onMove(input.Position)
			local moveConn, endConn
			moveConn = Services.UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(changed)
				if changed.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or changed.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
					onMove(changed.Position)
				end
			end)
			endConn = Services.UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(ended)
				if ended.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or ended.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
					moveConn:Disconnect()
					endConn:Disconnect()
				end
			end)
		end)
	end

		local function PickerVisuals()

			return color
		end

		function LoadPicker(color)
			local h, s, v = color:ToHSV()
			if s > 0 and v > 0 then picker.H = h end
			picker.S, picker.V = s, v
			PickerVisuals()
		end

			SetColor(picker.Key, PickerVisuals(), true)
		end

				local channels = { math.round(current.R * 255), math.round(current.G * 255), math.round(current.B * 255) }
				local typed = tonumber(box.Text)
				if typed then channels[i] = math.clamp(math.round(typed), 0, 255) end
				local color = Color3.fromRGB(channels[1], channels[2], channels[3])
				LoadPicker(color)
				SetColor(picker.Key, color, true)
			end)
		end

		end

				local ok, color = pcall(Color3.fromHex, hexBox.Text)
				if ok then
					SetColor(key, color)

				end
			end)
		end

		for name, rows in pairs({
			Basic = { { "Background", "Background" }, { "Surface", "Surface" }, { "Text", "Text" }, { "Accent", "Accent" } },

			end
		end

		local function SelectTab(name)

				button.TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20) or Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140)
			end
		end

	local function CreateThemePicker(parent, layoutOrder)

		local function Hover()
			if State.LightTheme then return Lib.Theme.Item:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.06) end
			return Lib.Lighten(Lib.Theme.Item, 0.07)
		end

		local function Bind(card)
			card.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
				Lib.Tween(card, 0.15, Quad, Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Hover() })
			end)
			card.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
				Lib.Tween(card, 0.15, Quad, Out, { BackgroundColor3 = Lib.Theme.Item })
			end)
		end

		local function UpdateSelection()
			for index, record in pairs(records) do
				local on = State.SelectedThemeIndex == index
				record.Check.Visible = on
				Lib.Tween(record.Stroke, 0.2, Quad, Out, { Transparency = on and 0.1 or 1 })
			end
		end

		function Lib.SelectTheme(index)
			local spec = Lib.ResolveTheme(index)
			if not spec then return end
			State.SelectedThemeIndex = index
			Lib.ApplyTheme(spec)
			UpdateSelection()
		end

		function Lib.AddCustomTheme(theme)
			for i, existing in ipairs(State.CustomThemes) do
				if existing.Name == theme.Name then
					State.CustomThemes[i] = theme
					SaveCustomThemes()
					Rebuild()
					return #Lib.ThemePresets + i
				end
			end
			table.insert(State.CustomThemes, theme)
			SaveCustomThemes()
			Rebuild()
			return #Lib.ThemePresets + #State.CustomThemes
		end

		local function DeleteCustom(theme)
			local position = table.find(State.CustomThemes, theme)
			if not position then return end
			local index = #Lib.ThemePresets + position
			table.remove(State.CustomThemes, position)
			SaveCustomThemes()
			Rebuild()
			if State.SelectedThemeIndex == index then
				Lib.SelectTheme(1)
			elseif State.SelectedThemeIndex > index then
				State.SelectedThemeIndex = State.SelectedThemeIndex - 1
				UpdateSelection()
			end
		end

			local derived = Lib.DeriveTheme(spec)

				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5) })

			local colors = { derived.Main, derived.Card, derived.SwitchOn, derived.Primary }
			for k = 1, 4 do

					Size = UDim2.new(0.25, k < 4 and 1 or 0, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale((k - 1) * 0.25, 0), BackgroundColor3 = colors[k], BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = strips

			end

				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 30), Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 12), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = name, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240),

		function Rebuild()
			for _, child in ipairs(Grid:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("GuiButton") and child ~= addCard then child:Destroy() end
			end
			table.clear(records)
			local presets = #Lib.ThemePresets
			if filter ~= 2 then
				for k, theme in ipairs(State.CustomThemes) do
					AddCard(presets + k, k, theme.Name, theme, theme)
				end
			end
			if filter ~= 3 then
				for i = 1, presets do
					AddCard(i, 100 + i, NAMES[i] or ("Theme " .. i), Lib.ThemePresets[i])
				end
				AddCard(0, 200, "Halloween 🎃", Lib.HalloweenTheme)
			end
			UpdateSelection()
		end

		addCard = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, LayoutOrder = 0, Parent = Grid,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) })

			TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = addCard
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(addLabel, "Primary")

		addCard.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

		end)

		LoadCustomThemes()
		Rebuild()
	end

		local fontBtns, customFonts = {}, {}
		local FONT_FILE, FONT_DIR = "SeptusHub_Fonts.json", "SeptusHub_Fonts"
		local Http, Market = Services.HttpService, game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
		local selectedKey = State.SelectedFontIndex
		local Select

		local function MakeFaces(entry)
			local family = "rbxassetid://" .. entry.id
			if not entry.direct then
				if not (writefile and getcustomasset and isfile and isfolder and makefolder) then
					return nil, "Executor lacks writefile / getcustomasset"
				end
				local path = FONT_DIR .. "/" .. entry.id .. ".json"
				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					if not isfolder(FONT_DIR) then makefolder(FONT_DIR) end
					if not isfile(path) then
						writefile(path, Http:JSONEncode({
							name = "SeptusFont" .. entry.id,
							faces = {
								{ name = "Regular", weight = 400, style = "normal", assetId = family },
								{ name = "Bold", weight = 700, style = "normal", assetId = family }
							}
						}))
					end
					return getcustomasset(path)
				end)
				if not ok or type(result) ~= "string" or result == "" then return nil, "Could not prepare the font file" end
				family = result
			end
			local ok, regular, bold = pcall(function()
				return Font.new(family, Enum.FontWeight.Regular, Enum.FontStyle.Normal), Font.new(family, Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
			end)
			if not ok then return nil, "Invalid font asset" end
			return regular, bold
		end

		local function Persist()
			if writefile then pcall(writefile, FONT_FILE, Http:JSONEncode(customFonts)) end
		end

		local function AddFontButton(key, data, order, entry)
			local Item = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36),

				AutoButtonColor = false,
				LayoutOrder = order,
				Parent = FontListScroll,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) })
			})
			Lib.PinFont(Item)
			if data.boldFace then Item.FontFace = data.boldFace else Item.Font = data.bold end
			Lib.RegisterThemeElement(Item, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7)
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(Item, "Primary")

			local isSelected = key == selectedKey

			local Stroke = Lib.Create("UIStroke", {
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
				Thickness = 1.5,
				Transparency = isSelected and 0 or 1,
				ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
				Parent = Item
			})

			local CheckBadge = Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 13),
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 1),
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
				Visible = isSelected,
				Parent = Item,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
				Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Text = "✓",
					TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
					TextSize = 9,
					Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
				})
			})

			fontBtns[key] = { Item = Item, Stroke = Stroke, Badge = CheckBadge, Data = data, Entry = entry }

			if entry then
				local Remove = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
					Position = UDim2.new(1, -15, 0, 1),
					BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 70, 70),
					Text = "×",
					TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
					TextSize = 11,
					Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
					AutoButtonColor = false,
					ZIndex = 3,
					Parent = Item,
					Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
				})
				Remove.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					Lib.PlayClick()
					local index = table.find(customFonts, entry)
					if index then table.remove(customFonts, index) end
					Persist()
					local wasSelected = selectedKey == key
					fontBtns[key] = nil
					Lib.FontSelectors[key] = nil
					Item:Destroy()
					if wasSelected then Select(1) end
				end)
			end

			Item.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				Lib.PlayClick()
				Select(key)
			end)
		end

		Select = function(key)
			local info = fontBtns[key]
			if not info then return end
			selectedKey = key
			for otherKey, other in pairs(fontBtns) do
				local selected = otherKey == key
				other.Badge.Visible = selected
				other.Stroke.Transparency = selected and 0 or 1
			end
			if info.Entry then
				State.SelectedFontIndex, State.SelectedFontId = 0, info.Entry.id
			else
				State.SelectedFontIndex, State.SelectedFontId = key, nil
			end
			local data = info.Data
			Lib.ApplyGlobalFont(data.regular, data.bold, data.regularFace, data.boldFace)
		end

		for i, fData in ipairs(FontItems) do
			AddFontButton(i, fData, i)
			Lib.FontSelectors[i] = function() Select(i) end
		end

		local function Register(entry)
			local regular, bold = MakeFaces(entry)
			if not regular then return false, bold end
			local key = "c" .. entry.id
			AddFontButton(key, {
				regular = Enum.Font.Gotham, bold = Enum.Font.GothamBold, regularFace = regular, boldFace = bold
			}, 100 + #customFonts, entry)
			Lib.FontSelectors[key] = function() Select(key) end
			return true
		end

		function Lib.AddCustomFont(raw)
			local id = tostring(raw):match("%d+")
			if not id or #id < 5 then
				Lib.Notify({ Title = "App Font", Text = "Enter a valid font Asset ID" })
				return false
			end
			local key = "c" .. id
			if fontBtns[key] then
				Select(key)
				return true
			end
			local ok, info = pcall(Market.GetProductInfo, Market, tonumber(id))
			if not ok or type(info) ~= "table" then
				Lib.Notify({ Title = "App Font", Text = "Asset " .. id .. " was not found" })
				return false
			end
			local entry = { id = id, name = tostring(info.Name or id):sub(1, 40), direct = info.AssetTypeId == 73 }
			customFonts[#customFonts + 1] = entry
			local added, err = Register(entry)
			if not added then
				table.remove(customFonts)
				Lib.Notify({ Title = "App Font", Text = tostring(err) })
				return false
			end
			Persist()
			Select(key)
			Lib.Notify({ Title = "App Font", Text = entry.name .. " applied" })
			return true
		end

		if isfile and readfile then
			pcall(function()
				if not isfile(FONT_FILE) then return end
				for _, entry in ipairs(Http:JSONDecode(readfile(FONT_FILE))) do
					if type(entry) == "table" and tostring(entry.id):match("^%d+$") then
						local clean = { id = tostring(entry.id), name = tostring(entry.name or entry.id), direct = entry.direct == true }
						customFonts[#customFonts + 1] = clean
						Register(clean)
					end
				end
			end)
		end

	local function UpdateBg()
		local val = bgInput.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
		State.CustomBackgroundId = val
		local image = UI.CustomBgImage
		local mine = (Lib.BgToken or 0) + 1
		Lib.BgToken = mine
		if val == "" then
			image.Visible = false
			Lib.BgAssetId, Lib.BgResolved = nil, nil
			Lib.RefreshBgSaturation()
			return
		end
		local resolved, id = Lib.ResolveImage(val)
		image.Image = resolved
		image.Visible = true
		Lib.BgResolved, Lib.BgAssetId = resolved, id
		Lib.RefreshBgSaturation()
		if not id then return end
		task.spawn(function()
			local Provider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
			for attempt = 1, 4 do
				if Lib.BgToken ~= mine then return end
				local status
				pcall(Provider.PreloadAsync, Provider, { image }, function(_, result) status = result end)
				if status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then return end
				task.wait(attempt * 2)
			end
			if Lib.BgToken == mine and not image.IsLoaded and image.Image == resolved then
				image.Image = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. id .. "&w=768&h=432"
			end
		end)
	end

		local function Dot(parent, size, alpha)
			return Lib.Create("Frame", {
				Name = "Dot", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				BackgroundColor3 = Tint(), BackgroundTransparency = alpha, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = parent,
				Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
			})
		end

		local function Count(base, span)
			return math.floor(base + span * Fx.Intensity / 100)
		end

		local flakes, stars, glints = {}, {}, {}

		local function BuildSnow()
			snowBox:ClearAllChildren()
			table.clear(flakes)
			if not Fx.Snow then return end
			for i = 1, Count(12, 38) do
				local x, y = rng:NextNumber(), rng:NextNumber()
				local obj = Dot(snowBox, rng:NextInteger(2, 4), 0.3 + rng:NextNumber() * 0.4)
				obj.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y)
				flakes[i] = {
					obj = obj, x = x, y = y,
					speed = 0.035 + rng:NextNumber() * 0.06,
					amp = 0.008 + rng:NextNumber() * 0.014,
					freq = 0.4 + rng:NextNumber() * 0.8,
					phase = rng:NextNumber() * 6.28
				}
			end
		end

		local function BuildStars()
			starBox:ClearAllChildren()
			table.clear(stars)
			if not Fx.Twinkle then return end
			for i = 1, Count(14, 40) do
				local obj = Dot(starBox, rng:NextInteger(1, 3), 0.9)
				obj.Position = UDim2.fromScale(rng:NextNumber(), rng:NextNumber())
				stars[i] = {
					obj = obj, phase = rng:NextNumber() * 6.28,
					speed = 0.8 + rng:NextNumber() * 1.6, low = 0.2 + rng:NextNumber() * 0.25
				}
			end
		end

		local function BuildGlints()
			glintBox:ClearAllChildren()
			table.clear(glints)
			if not Fx.Particles then return end
			for i = 1, Count(8, 18) do
				local size = rng:NextInteger(3, 16)
				local x, y = rng:NextNumber(), rng:NextNumber()
				local obj = Dot(glintBox, size, 0.9)
				obj.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y)
				glints[i] = {
					obj = obj, x = x, y = y,
					vx = rng:NextNumber(-0.01, 0.01), vy = -(0.008 + rng:NextNumber() * 0.02),
					base = 0.7 + (size - 3) / 13 * 0.25,
					freq = 0.5 + rng:NextNumber(), phase = rng:NextNumber() * 6.28
				}
			end
		end

		local streak = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Name = "Dot", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 2), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = Tint(),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, Parent = shotBox,
			Lib.Create("UIGradient", { Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }) })
		})
		local shooting = false

		local function Shoot()
			local size = fxLayer.AbsoluteSize
			if shooting or size.X < 120 then return end
			shooting = true
			local angle = math.rad(rng:NextInteger(22, 40))
			local dist = size.X * rng:NextNumber(0.3, 0.5)
			local x, y = rng:NextNumber(0.05, 0.65), rng:NextNumber(0.02, 0.35)
			local life = 0.9 + rng:NextNumber() * 0.5
			streak.Rotation = math.deg(angle)
			streak.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y)
			streak.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			streak.Visible = true
			Lib.Tween(streak, life, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, {
				Position = UDim2.fromScale(x + math.cos(angle) * dist / size.X, y + math.sin(angle) * dist / size.Y)
			})
			Lib.Tween(streak, life * 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.1 }).Completed:Once(function()
				Lib.Tween(streak, life * 0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.In, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }).Completed:Once(function()
					streak.Visible = false
					shooting = false
				end)
			end)
		end

		local conn, acc, clock, nextShot = nil, 0, 0, 3

		local function Tick(dt)
			acc = acc + dt
			if acc < 0.0333 then return end
			local step = math.min(acc, 0.1)
			acc = 0
			if State.Unloaded or State.Minimized or not UI.Main.Visible then return end
			clock = clock + step
			for i = 1, #flakes do
				local f = flakes[i]
				local y = f.y + f.speed * step
				if y > 1.04 then
					y = -0.04
					f.x = rng:NextNumber()
				end
				f.y = y
				f.obj.Position = UDim2.fromScale(f.x + math.sin(clock * f.freq + f.phase) * f.amp, y)
			end
			for i = 1, #stars do
				local s = stars[i]
				s.obj.BackgroundTransparency = s.low + (0.92 - s.low) * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(clock * s.speed + s.phase))
			end
			for i = 1, #glints do
				local g = glints[i]
				local x, y = g.x + g.vx * step, g.y + g.vy * step
				if y < -0.05 then
					y = 1.05
					x = rng:NextNumber()
				elseif x > 1.05 then
					x = -0.05
				elseif x < -0.05 then
					x = 1.05
				end
				g.x, g.y = x, y
				g.obj.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y)
				g.obj.BackgroundTransparency = g.base + math.sin(clock * g.freq + g.phase) * 0.06
			end
			if Fx.Shooting then
				nextShot = nextShot - step
				if nextShot <= 0 then
					nextShot = rng:NextNumber(5, 12) * 100 / (50 + Fx.Intensity)
					Shoot()
				end
			end
		end

		local function Sync()
			local need = Fx.Snow or Fx.Twinkle or Fx.Particles or Fx.Shooting
			if need and not conn then
				acc = 0
				conn = Run.Heartbeat:Connect(Tick)
			elseif not need and conn then
				conn:Disconnect()
				conn = nil
			end
		end

		local spin
		local function ApplySpin()
			if spin then
				spin:Cancel()
				spin = nil
			end
			gradient.Rotation = Fx.Angle
			if Fx.Gradient and Fx.Spin and UI.Main.Visible then
				spin = Tween:Create(gradient, TweenInfo.new(45, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, -1), { Rotation = Fx.Angle + 360 })
				spin:Play()
			end
		end

		local function ApplyGradient()
			layer.Visible = Fx.Gradient
			if not Fx.Gradient then return end
			local a, b, c = Custom.A, Custom.A:Lerp(Custom.B, 0.5), Custom.B
			for _, preset in ipairs(Presets) do
				if preset[1] == Fx.Style then
					a, b, c = preset[2], preset[3], preset[4]
					break
				end
			end
			gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, a), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, b), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c)
			})
			layer.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - Fx.Strength / 100
		end

		local pending = 0
		local function QueueRebuild()
			pending = pending + 1
			local mine = pending
			task.delay(0.25, function()
				if mine ~= pending or State.Unloaded then return end
				BuildSnow()
				BuildStars()
				BuildGlints()
			end)
		end

		Lib.C(UI.Main:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), ApplySpin)
		table.insert(Lib.ThemeHooks, function()
			local color = Tint()
			for _, obj in ipairs(fxLayer:GetDescendants()) do
				if obj.Name == "Dot" then obj.BackgroundColor3 = color end
			end
		end)

		function Lib.StopBgFx()
			if conn then
				conn:Disconnect()
				conn = nil
			end
			if spin then
				spin:Cancel()
				spin = nil
			end
		end

		local Group = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(Pages.Background, "Gradient & Effects", 6)

		Lib.CreateSettingToggleItem(Group, "Background Gradient", "Soft color gradient behind the interface", Fx.Gradient, function(value)
			Fx.Gradient = value
			ApplyGradient()
			ApplySpin()
		end)
		Lib.CreateSettingChoiceItem(Group, "Gradient Style", names, Fx.Style, function(value)
			Fx.Style = value
			ApplyGradient()
		end)

		local function OnColor()
			if Fx.Style ~= "Custom" then
				Lib.ChoiceControls["Gradient Style"].Set("Custom")
			else
				ApplyGradient()
			end
		end
		local setA = select(2, Lib.CreateColorItem(Group, "Gradient Color 1", Custom, "A", false, OnColor))
		local setB = select(2, Lib.CreateColorItem(Group, "Gradient Color 2", Custom, "B", false, OnColor))

		Lib.CreateSettingSliderItem(Group, "Gradient Strength", "How strongly the gradient shows through", 5, 100, Fx.Strength, function(value)
			Fx.Strength = value
			if Fx.Gradient then layer.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - value / 100 end
		end, false, "%")
		Lib.CreateSettingSliderItem(Group, "Gradient Angle", "Direction of the color flow", 0, 360, Fx.Angle, function(value)
			Fx.Angle = value
			ApplySpin()
		end, false, "°")
		Lib.CreateSettingToggleItem(Group, "Animated Gradient", "Slowly rotates the gradient while the menu is open", Fx.Spin, function(value)
			Fx.Spin = value
			ApplySpin()
		end)

		local function Effect(title, desc, key, build)
			Lib.CreateSettingToggleItem(Group, title, desc, Fx[key], function(value)
				Fx[key] = value
				build()
				Sync()
			end)
		end
		Effect("Snowfall", "Calm snowflakes slowly falling behind the interface", "Snow", BuildSnow)
		Effect("Twinkling Stars", "Tiny stars that softly fade in and out", "Twinkle", BuildStars)
		Effect("Shooting Stars", "A rare falling star every few seconds", "Shooting", function() end)
		Effect("Floating Particles", "Slow drifting dust and soft glints", "Particles", BuildGlints)
		Lib.CreateSettingSliderItem(Group, "Effect Intensity", "Amount of snowflakes, stars and particles", 20, 100, Fx.Intensity, function(value)
			Fx.Intensity = value
			QueueRebuild()
		end, true, "%")

		local function Rgb(color)
			return { math.round(color.R * 255), math.round(color.G * 255), math.round(color.B * 255) }
		end

		Lib.ConfigExtras.BgFx = {
			Dump = function()
				return {
					Gradient = Fx.Gradient, Style = Fx.Style, Angle = Fx.Angle, Strength = Fx.Strength, Spin = Fx.Spin,
					Snow = Fx.Snow, Twinkle = Fx.Twinkle, Shooting = Fx.Shooting, Particles = Fx.Particles,
					Intensity = Fx.Intensity, A = Rgb(Custom.A), B = Rgb(Custom.B)
				}
			end,
			Apply = function(data)
				if type(data.A) == "table" and #data.A == 3 then setA(Color3.fromRGB(data.A[1], data.A[2], data.A[3])) end
				if type(data.B) == "table" and #data.B == 3 then setB(Color3.fromRGB(data.B[1], data.B[2], data.B[3])) end
				if type(data.Style) == "string" then Lib.ChoiceControls["Gradient Style"].Set(data.Style) end
				for _, pair in ipairs({
					{ "Gradient Strength", data.Strength }, { "Gradient Angle", data.Angle }, { "Effect Intensity", data.Intensity }
				}) do
					if type(pair[2]) == "number" then Lib.SliderControls[pair[1]](pair[2]) end
				end
				for _, pair in ipairs({
					{ "Background Gradient", data.Gradient }, { "Animated Gradient", data.Spin }, { "Snowfall", data.Snow },
					{ "Twinkling Stars", data.Twinkle }, { "Shooting Stars", data.Shooting }, { "Floating Particles", data.Particles }
				}) do
					if type(pair[2]) == "boolean" then Lib.ToggleControls[pair[1]].Set(pair[2]) end
				end
			end
		}
	end

do
	local FILE = "SeptusHub_Sounds.json"
	local Http, Market, Debris = Services.HttpService, game:GetService("MarketplaceService"), game:GetService("Debris")
	local Presets = {
		{ "Default", "rbxassetid://6895079853", 1, 0.5 },
		{ "Soft Tick", "rbxassetid://6895079853", 1.35, 0.35 },
		{ "Deep Tap", "rbxassetid://6895079853", 0.78, 0.45 },
		{ "Airy", "rbxassetid://6895079853", 1.7, 0.3 },
		{ "Switch", "rbxasset://sounds/switch.ogg", 1, 0.4 },
		{ "Snap", "rbxasset://sounds/snap.mp3", 1, 0.3 },
		{ "Ping", "rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav", 1, 0.25 },
		{ "Off", "", 1, 0 }
	}
	local custom, selected, busy, Rebuild = {}, "p:Default", false, nil

	local function Resolve(key)
		local kind, value = key:match("^(%a):(.+)$")
		if kind == "p" then
			for _, preset in ipairs(Presets) do
				if preset[1] == value then return preset[2], preset[3], preset[4] end
			end
		elseif kind == "c" then
			for _, entry in ipairs(custom) do
				if entry.id == value then return "rbxassetid://" .. value, 1, 0.5 end
			end
		end
	end

	local function Persist()
		if not writefile then return end
		local out = {}
		for i, entry in ipairs(custom) do out[i] = { id = entry.id, name = entry.name } end
		pcall(writefile, FILE, Http:JSONEncode({ selected = selected, custom = out }))
	end

	local function Apply()
		local id, speed, volume = Resolve(selected)
		ClickSound.SoundId, ClickSound.PlaybackSpeed, ClickSound.Volume = id, speed, volume
	end

	local function Preview(key)
		local id, speed, volume = Resolve(key)
		if not id or id == "" then return end
		local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
		sound.SoundId, sound.PlaybackSpeed, sound.Volume = id, speed, volume
		sound.Parent = UI.Screen
		sound:Play()
		Debris:AddItem(sound, 6)
	end

	local function Probe(id)
		local probe = Instance.new("Sound")
		probe.SoundId, probe.Volume = "rbxassetid://" .. id, 0
		probe.Parent = UI.Screen
		local deadline = os.clock() + 5
		while not probe.IsLoaded and os.clock() < deadline do task.wait(0.1) end
		local loaded, length = probe.IsLoaded, probe.TimeLength
		probe:Destroy()
		return loaded and length > 0, length
	end

	if isfile and readfile then
		pcall(function()
			if not isfile(FILE) then return end
			local data = Http:JSONDecode(readfile(FILE))
			for _, entry in ipairs(data.custom or {}) do
				if type(entry) == "table" and tostring(entry.id):match("^%d+$") then
					custom[#custom + 1] = { id = tostring(entry.id), name = tostring(entry.name or entry.id) }
				end
			end
			if type(data.selected) == "string" then selected = data.selected end
		end)
	end
	if not Resolve(selected) then selected = "p:Default" end
	Apply()

	function Lib.SelectClickSound(key)
		if not Resolve(key) then return false end
		selected = key
		Apply()
		Persist()
		Rebuild()
		return true
	end

	function Lib.GetClickSoundKey()
		return selected
	end

	local SoundGroup = Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(Pages.Interface, "Interface Sounds", 7)

	local AddCard = Lib.Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = SoundGroup })
	local input = Lib.Create("TextBox", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 36), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 8), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22),
		PlaceholderText = "Paste a Sound Asset ID...", PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240),
		TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Text = "", ClearTextOnFocus = false, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = AddCard,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }),
		Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10) })
	})
	Lib.RegisterThemeElement(input, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7, true)
	Lib.RegisterThemeText(input, "Primary")

	local addBtn = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 36), Position = UDim2.new(1, -72, 0, 8), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
		Text = "Add", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = AddCard,
		Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) })
	})

	local list = Lib.Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 2, Parent = SoundGroup,
		Lib.Create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
		Lib.Create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10) })
	})

	local function Row(label, key, order, removable)
		local active = key == selected
		local id = Resolve(key)
		local item = Lib.Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22), LayoutOrder = order, Parent = list,
			Lib.Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) })
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeElement(item, "BackgroundColor3", 0.7, true)

		local pick = Lib.Create("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = item })

		local dot = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 40), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = active and "\u{25CF}" or "\u{25CB}",
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Parent = item
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(dot, active and "Primary" or "Secondary")

		local name = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, removable and -112 or -82, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = label,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = item
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(name, "Primary")

		pick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if key ~= selected and Lib.SelectClickSound(key) then Preview(key) end
		end)

		if id ~= "" then
			local play = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), Position = UDim2.new(1, removable and -66 or -36, 0.5, -14), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "\u{25B6}",
				TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = item
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(play, "Secondary")
			play.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Preview(key) end)
		end

		if removable then
			local remove = Lib.Create("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0.5, -14), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "\u{00D7}",
				TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), TextSize = 16, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = item
			})
			Lib.RegisterThemeText(remove, "Secondary")
			remove.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				Lib.PlayClick()
				local value = key:sub(3)
				for i, entry in ipairs(custom) do
					if entry.id == value then
						table.remove(custom, i)
						break
					end
				end
				if selected == key then
					selected = "p:Default"
					Apply()
				end
				Persist()
				Rebuild()
			end)
		end
	end

	function Rebuild()
		for _, child in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("GuiObject") then child:Destroy() end
		end
		local header = Lib.Create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Click sound", LayoutOrder = 0,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = list
		})
		Lib.RegisterThemeText(header, "Secondary")
		local order = 0
		for _, preset in ipairs(Presets) do
			order += 1
			Row(preset[1], "p:" .. preset[1], order, false)
		end
		for _, entry in ipairs(custom) do
			order += 1
			Row(entry.name, "c:" .. entry.id, order, true)
		end
	end

	addBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Lib.PlayClick()
		if busy then return end
		local text = input.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
		local id = text:match("^%d+$") or text:match("rbxassetid://(%d+)") or text:match("[?&]id=(%d+)") or text:match("/library/(%d+)") or text:match("(%d%d%d%d+)")
		if not id then
			Lib.Notify({ Title = "Sounds", Text = "Invalid Asset ID" })
			return
		end
		for _, entry in ipairs(custom) do
			if entry.id == id then
				Lib.Notify({ Title = "Sounds", Text = "Already saved" })
				return
			end
		end
		if #custom >= 30 then
			Lib.Notify({ Title = "Sounds", Text = "Saved list is full" })
			return
		end
		busy = true
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, length = Probe(id)
			busy = false
			if State.Unloaded then return end
			if not ok then
				Lib.Notify({ Title = "Sounds", Text = "Sound failed to load" })
				return
			end
			if length > 5 then
				Lib.Notify({ Title = "Sounds", Text = "Sound is too long (max 5 seconds)" })
				return
			end
			local entry = { id = id, name = "Sound " .. id }
			custom[#custom + 1] = entry
			input.Text = ""
			Persist()
			Rebuild()
			Preview("c:" .. id)
			Lib.Notify({ Title = "Sounds", Text = "Sound saved" })
			local good, info = pcall(Market.GetProductInfo, Market, tonumber(id))
			if good and type(info) == "table" and info.Name and info.Name ~= "" and table.find(custom, entry) then
				entry.name = info.Name
				Persist()
				Rebuild()
			end
		end)
	end)

	Rebuild()
end
	Lib.BuildMusic(Lib.CreateFeatureGroup(Pages.Interface, "Music", 8))

	Lib.BuildStudioCard(Pages.Interface, 0)
	pcall(Lib.BuildLanguageGroup, Pages.Language, 1)

	task.spawn(function()
		while not State.Unloaded do
			if State.AnimatedBgEnabled and UI.CustomBgImage.Visible then
				Lib.Tween(UI.CustomBgImage, 4, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.47, 0.47), Size = Lib.BgSize(1.1) })
				task.wait(4)
				Lib.Tween(UI.CustomBgImage, 4, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = Lib.BgSize(1) })
				task.wait(4)
			else
				task.wait(1)
			end
		end
	end)

	local ConfigScroll = Lib.Create("ScrollingFrame", {

	function PlaceCfg.Filter()
		local query, shown = PlaceCfg.Query, 0
		for _, card in ipairs(PlaceCfg.Cards) do
			local match = query == "" or card.Key:find(query, 1, true) ~= nil
			card.Frame.Visible = match
			if match then shown += 1 end
		end
		for _, group in ipairs(PlaceCfg.Groups) do
			local any = false
			for _, card in ipairs(group.Cards) do
				if card.Frame.Visible then
					any = true
					break
				end
			end
			group.Frame.Visible = any
			group.Apply()
		end
		PlaceCfg.Empty.Text = #PlaceCfg.Cards == 0 and "No saved configs found." or "No configs found"
		PlaceCfg.Empty.Visible = shown == 0
	end

		PlaceCfg.Query = Lib.Lower(text)
		PlaceCfg.Filter()
	end)
